jobs.title: Chef de Projets
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Sr. Project Engineer is responsible for managing technical projects or processes independently with limited supervision. The role includes coaching junior professionals and solving complex problems through investigation and analysis.
This job profile is intended for specialist professionals that apply advanced knowledge of a job area. Required to manage projects / processes independently with limited supervision. Typically coaches and reviews the work of lower level professionals.
Votre mission principale :

• Incarner le lien et piloter les interlocuteurs internes et externes en vue de la livraison du contrat / projet sur les activités pièces de rechange / retrofit / projets neufs.

• Mener le projet à son terme en satisfaisant le client (coût, qualité et délai) et en optimisant le résultat financier pour Sulzer (revenu, marge et cash).

Le chef de projet confirmé intervient sur les projets à forts enjeux et complexes dans l’entreprise

Activités significatives

• Organiser et superviser les réunions de revue de contrat (handover), d'enclenchement et de suivi en interne (KOM), en intégrant et pilotant l’ensemble des compétences transversales nécessaires à l’accomplissement du projet.

• Procéder, dès les phases initiales et en cours de réalisation, aux analyses de risque des projets, à leurs mises à jour nécessaires ; définir et piloter les plans d’actions correctives et préventives correspondants

• Assurer la communication régulière vers les clients (réunion d’enclenchement, réunion de suivi, reporting…), en maintenant le bon niveau de coopération par un relationnel adapté.

• Créer et maintenir des plannings projets (MS Project), outil principal de pilotage des projets.

• Piloter et coordonner les activités & les équipes en interne, en conformité avec le planning des projets, en assurant notamment la collaboration et les interfaces entre le BE, la Gestion production, les Achats, la Production, la Qualité, la force de vente et le Tendering.

• Créer et maintenir les indicateurs clé (fiabilité des engagements, documentation…) au niveau de chaque projet en charge.

• Obtenir les validations documentaires (technique, qualité, approvisionnement) en lien avec les clients et les fournisseurs.

• Etablir les prévisions de facturation, marge et cash-flow au niveau de chaque projet géré.

• Favoriser la négociation de modification de commande (« change order ») avec le client pour améliorer les conditions contractuelles du contrat initial, le revenu et la marge du projet.

• Documenter le projet sur toute sa durée pour prévenir tout cas de litige.

• Déployer et formaliser le retour d’expérience sur l’activité projet.

Compétences métier – technique

• Compétences en mécanique (culture technique mécanique), acquises via une formation d’ingénieur et une expérience professionnelle dans l’environnement mécanique

• Compétences confirmées en gestion de projet (minimum de 7 années dans le management de projets majeurs dans des environnements techniques exigeants, type nucléaire, Oil & Gas, mécanique de précision à l’international)

• Compétences financières / contrôle de gestion d’un projet : connaissances des indicateurs financiers majeurs

• Management des indicateurs / KPI clés : OTD (Livraison à l’heure) et Gross Profit (marge).

• Compétences en relation client & fournisseur (la capacité à gérer le relationnel fournisseur est fondamental sur le poste)

• Connaissances en planification de projet (Type « MS project »)

• Compétences en ERP (suivi de projet sous ERP, type SAP).

• Anglais courant (Lu, écrit, parlé) Niveau C1

What we offer you

Ce que nous vous proposons

• Avantage 1 : Évoluer sur des projets stratégiques pour le Groupe

• Avantage 2 : Buchelay : référence nucléaire au sein du Gr

jobs.description:

O Analista de Aplicação é responsável por fornecer suporte técnico às equipes de vendas e realizar análise técnica das configurações dos produtos para determinar preços específicos do cliente.
Este perfil de emprego destina-se a profissionais experientes que aplicam conhecimento prático de uma área de trabalho e trabalham de forma independente com supervisão geral. Principais Responsabilidades:
Responsável por preparar e enviar propostas comerciais de serviços (Sulzer Pumps, bombas não-Sulzer e turbomáquinas) recebidas pela Salesforce e outras entidades legais da Sulzer, garantindo a entrega no prazo;
• Responsável por definir o escopo do trabalho conforme o relatório de inspeção e as especificações técnicas;
• Alinhar o escopo do serviço e o orçamento com os fornecedores;
• Criação da base de custo para a proposta;
• Preparar a proposta e inserir pedidos no SAP.

Habilidades Necessárias:
• Graduação em Engenharia Mecânica;
• Experiência no departamento comercial (equipamentos rotativos como bombas, compressores, motores, etc.) atendendo indústrias pesadas;
• Conhecimento técnico em bombas e/ou equipamentos rotativos

About the role

jobs.title: FP&A Controller - D365
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

We are looking for a dynamic FP&A Controller to join our Finance & Controlling team in Madrid, Spain.

This is an exciting opportunity to collaborate with international stakeholders, leverage your expertise in finance analytics, whilst contributing to the success of a newly established office in central Madrid. If you enjoy creating impact and eager to advance your career within a global and mission-led organisation, we want to hear from you!

Your main tasks and responsibilities:

• Prepare and consolidate the annual budget, ensuring alignment with company objectives and financial goals.

• Periodically refresh and update predictive financial forecasts to reflect the latest business trends and market conditions.

• Conduct thorough profitability and performance reporting, identifying key financial metrics.

• Perform detailed plan analytics and risk assessments, continuously improving financial planning and analysis processes.

• Provide recommendations to the business based on in-depth financial analysis, supporting strategic decision-making.

• Manage collections reporting and analytics, ensuring accurate and timely information to support decision-making processes.

• Deliver comprehensive reporting and analytics on procurement activities, contributing to informed purchasing decisions.

• Oversee the period end close processes, generating accurate and insightful period end financial reports and analytics to ensure financial integrity.

• Handle period end closing and related analytics, ensuring thorough and precise financial tracking and reporting for projects.

• Oversee CAPEX planning, forecasting, investment strategy, period-end close activities, and reporting.

• Ensure all financial reporting and processes comply with International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS) and maintain strong internal controls for the processes performed by this role.

• Comply with relevant QESH regulations, maintaining the highest standards of financial compliance.

To succeed in this role, you will need:

• Degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, or related fields.

• Minimum 3-5 years of experience in financial planning and analysis or similar finance roles; exposure or interest in the industrial sector is a plus.

• Strong skills in financial modelling, forecasting, and data analytics, with a solid understanding of global finance processes and standards; proficiency in Tagetik, Qlik, and/or integrated ERP systems is advantageous. Nice to have experience using Microsoft Dynamics 365.

• Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, able to deliver key insights to leadership, collaborate with regional and global stakeholders to drive structured solutions, and comfortable working with a level of independence.

• Fluency in English

What we offer you

• A competitive salary as well as participation in the variable remuneration system based on personal and financial objectives

• Restaurant Tickets

• Permanent contract

• Accident insurance

• Central workplace in Nuevos Ministerios

No visa or work permit support can be provided for this role

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

About the role

Job Summary
The Order Support Specialist is responsible for supporting the order processing function by handling routine tasks, updating systems, and communicating with internal teams. This role follows standard procedures and makes smaller decisions autonomously.
This job profile is intended for support staff that follows established procedures and works under close supervision. Smaller/easier decisions are made autonomously. Internal Mapping Note - HR TO REMOVE PRIOR TO POSTING!

This job and its associated grade are specifically aligned with roles that have the following scope of responsibility: Small, Medium, Large, Division / Extra Large organization.

Key
• Responsibilities
Process routine customer orders and update systems.
Track delivery schedules and report delays.
Communicate with internal teams to resolve basic issues.
Maintain accurate records of order transactions.
Support reporting and documentation tasks.
Assist in customer service inquiries related to orders.
Skills &
• Qualifications
May require basic vocational training (or equivalent work experience) and up to 2 years of relevant experience to carry out the role.

Basic understanding of order processing systems.
Good communication and organizational skills.
Attention to detail and ability to follow procedures.
Customer-focused mindset.
Proficiency in Microsoft Office.

jobs.description:

About the role

Nous recherchons un(e) Chef de Projet dynamique et expérimenté(e) pour rejoindre notre équipe. Le/la Chef de Projet sera responsable de la planification, de l'exécution et de la clôture réussie de projets variés, en veillant à l'atteinte des objectifs dans le respect des délais et du budget.

jobs.title: Técnico Mecânico
Vendedor Externo de Equipamentos PL
Industry aftermarket support
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Sales Support Coordinator is responsible for providing administrative and operational support to the sales team. This includes processing orders, maintaining customer records, and coordinating with internal departments to ensure smooth sales operations. The role requires strong organizational skills and a customer-focused mindset.
This job profile is intended for experienced professionals who apply practical knowledge of a job area and work independently with general supervision. Responsible for providing aftermarket support for Chinese industry.
- Offer quotations and spare parts list to customers or after-sales;
- Provide preliminary selection to after-sales for retrofit projects;
- Maintain close communication with plants to ensure orders delivery on time and enhance customers satisfaction;
- Assist after-sales in utilizing sales tools to track and manage registered quotations;
- Follow up on payments with intermediaries and key account;
- Other office work assigned by team leader

What we offer you

• 10~15 days’ annual leave and 5 days’ sick leave

• Long Service Award

• Annual Physical Examination

• Supplementary Commercial Insurance

• Team Building

• Festival Gifts

• Good working atmosphere and personal development opportunity

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: SJR95936 Supervisor(a) Técnico
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

É responsável por instalar, configurar, calibrar e reparar produtos e sistemas técnicos nos locais de campo dos clientes. Esta função executa uma variedade de tarefas de manutenção e suporte técnico e pode fornecer treinamento no local para o pessoal de suporte ao cliente.
Este perfil de trabalho destina-se a pessoal experiente em nível de suporte que geralmente trabalha de forma autônoma e só requer supervisão mais próxima em situações não rotineiras.
Principais responsabilidades

Realizar manutenção e suporte técnico em produtos e equipamentos instalados;
Solucionar, diagnosticar e resolver falhas;
Determinar quando os produtos devem ser atualizados ou substituídos;
Fornecer treinamento no local para o pessoal de suporte ao cliente;
Coordenar com as equipes de engenharia para questões complexas.

Habilidades e qualificações

Requer formação profissional e experiência de trabalho;
Fortes habilidades técnicas e diagnósticas;
Capacidade de trabalhar de forma independente em ambientes de campo;
Familiaridade com os procedimentos de instalação e calibração.

What we offer you

• Convênio médico, odontológico e seguro de vida
• Vale alimentação, refeição e transporte público
• Programa de bem-estar e Gympass
• Participação nos Lucros e Resultados (PLR)
• Previdência privada
• Ampla variedade de oportunidades de aprendizado

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Project Estimator / Proposals Engineer
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

At Sulzer GT Aero, we are global specialists in the repair, overhaul, and field service of industrial, marine, and power gas turbines. With over 20 years of expertise, we deliver tailored solutions that ensure reliability, performance, and rapid turnaround for critical rotating equipment. From spare parts and consultancy to full turbine refurbishment, we are the trusted partner for clients worldwide.

We are seeking an Project Estimator / Proposals Engineer to join our team at our Netherley facility near Stonehaven – a key hub for turbine operations and customer support. Job Responsibilities

• Prepare accurate and timely quotations for gas turbine repair and overhaul projects.

• Analyse inspection reports and project specifications to calculate costs.

• Collaborate with Engineering, Procurement, Production, and other internal teams.

• Ensure smooth commercial and technical handover to Project Engineers.

• Monitor and report on key metrics such as order value, margin reviews, and win rates.

• Maintain and update pricing models and standard scopes of work.

• Build strong relationships with customers and suppliers to reduce risk and maximise opportunities.

Job Qualifications

• Strong financial acumen and ability to forecast costs and margins.

• Excellent organisational and communication skills.

• Ability to manage multiple projects under pressure and meet deadlines.

• Experience in estimating within the rotating equipment MRO industry.

• Knowledge of industrial gas turbines and associated equipment (desirable).

• A recognised qualification in engineering (preferred).

What we offer you

• A competitive salary

• Annual performance-based bonus aligned with both individual and company results

• 33 days of annual leave

• Access to a wide range of retail and entertainment discounts — including the option to join Costco for exclusive member savings

• Discounted personal car leasing available for employees, family members, and friends

• Confidential support through our Employee Assistance Programme, offering guidance on personal and professional matters

• Ongoing learning and development through Sulzer Learning Pathways and structured on-the-job training, helping you grow your career with us

• We’re proud to support those who’ve served. Sulzer is a Bronze Award holder under the MoD’s Defence Employer Recognition Scheme, meaning we actively welcome and support ex-military personnel and reservists in building successful careers with us.

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Gas Turbine Inspector
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

• Purpose of the Job: Responsible for the inspection activities required in the SASOS workshop Main Duties involved but not limited to:
•  Bulk Strip and Detail Strip Inspection of Gas Turbines.
•  Provision of engine bulk strip and detailed defect reports.
•  Carry out stage inspections during engine build.
•  Controlling the workshop Control Order Files and support documentation.
•  Assisting the Company Quality Assurance representative in the absence of the supervisor.
•  Ensuring all measuring equipment in the workshop is approved calibrated and certified accordingly IAW the QMS manuals.
•  Development and revision of workshop procedures as and when required.
•  Sourcing suitable and effective alternatives to the OEM for required materials/repairs/overhauls.
•  Shipping and receipt of material to and from SASOS approved vendors.
•  Assist with in a timely manner the shipping and receipt of material to and from SASOS approved vendors. Progress and expedite all sub-con activity effectively.
•  Obtaining the most cost effective and minimum turn time for engine material requiring repair/overhaul/replacement.
•  Issuing of certificates of conformity for all materials being issued to and purchased by customers.
•  Assisting with shop floor fitting duties as designated by the Charge Hand or Operations Manager.
•  All other duties as relevant to the post and deemed reasonable by the Company.

Education requirements (desirable):
•  Minimum NC Mechanical Engineering (or equivalent), preferably HNC Mech. Eng. Where formal qualifications are not held, suitable proven experience is
• essential.

Job experience:
 Previous experience in a similar role

• Knowledge requirements (professional, technical, language, safety):
•  Working knowledge of industrial gas turbines and/or power turbines and associated equipment
•  Ability to understand and communicate illustrated parts catalogues.
•  Ability to understand engineering drawings.

What we offer you

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Gas Turbine Fitter
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

• Responsible for the repair and overhaul of industrial gas turbines, power turbines and associated accessories and equipment. Main Tasks:
• The duties involved include but are not limited to:
•  Maintaining standards of engineering, appearance, timekeeping, discipline and housekeeping.
•  The receipt, bulk strip, detail strip, sub assembly and final build of industrial gas turbines and power turbines.
•  Training of internal employees.
•  Adherence to and completion of all procedures and documentation controlling the overhaul process.
•  Accurate recording of all critical fits/clearances.
•  Highlighting and reporting of critical out-of-tolerance measurements and other non-conforming issues such as damaged or inadequately overhauled components.
 Safe and correct use of all equipment and specialised tooling, including engine tooling is stored and maintained correctly and that any defective or missing equipment is reported immediately to supervising staff.

Education requirements (desirable):
 ITI, SVQ Graduate (or equivalent)., At least 6 years’ experience of overhauling and repairing gas turbines.

Job experience:
•  Previous experience in a similar role would be advantageous.
• Knowledge requirements (professional, technical, language, safety):
•  Knowledge of gas turbine repair and refurbishment would be advantageous
•  Experience working as a senior workshop member in a fabrication, repair or construction environment.

Competencies:
• Good written and verbal communication (English).
•  Good organisational skills.
•  Adaptable approach, able to work independently, and function effectively as part of a team.
•  Strong team player capable of working across various departments and with external stakeholders.
•  Attention to detail

jobs.title: Machinist
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary

The Sr. Machine Operator is responsible for operating and maintaining production machinery, ensuring efficient and safe operations. This role performs advanced machine setup, monitors production quality, and may assist in training junior operators.

This job profile is intended for experienced support-level staff that generally works autonomously and only requires closer supervision in non-routine situations.
The Opportunity:

Sulzer is looking for an experienced Machinist to undertake machining of components and parts on driven machinery in accordance with Sulzer standards and specification.

ENVIRONMENTAL, SAFETY AND HEALTH

• Direct responsibility for the Health, Safety and Environment of all employees who either directly work in your area of control, or who visit the operational areas you are responsible for, either internal or external visitors. Including full legal & company compliance in areas under your responsibility.

• Develop a positive safety culture through the Sulzer Behavioral Safety Program.

• Follow safety rules and regulations, attend safety meetings, and contribute towards having a safe work environment.

Your Responsibilities : (NOT LIMITED TO)

• Ensure quality standards and engineering standards are conformed to in accordance with engineering drawings.

• Ensure product is compliant with Sulzer and Customer specific quality and engineering standards

• Be able to work independently and make decisions in conjunction with the supervisor regarding tooling, jigs and fixtures.

• Pre and final machining of components in accordance with specifications.

• Follow departmental standards, both written and verbal.

• Fully inspect work done according to specific requirements.

• Read, analyze, understand, and follow engineering drawings

• Read, understand, and follow instructions given on the production order.

• Use specific engineering measuring equipment such as micrometers, Vernier’s etc.

• Operate different machines, follow the safety standards, and use guards where applicable.

• Any other reasonable work instructions to be followed.
What We’re Looking For:

• Detailed knowledge of the various machining practices including turning, milling, shaft grinding, drilling and marking off, experience required.

• Sound knowledge of CNC and manual machining practices required experience in Mazatrol and Haas control. Knowledge on Fanuc and Siemens an advantage.

• Qualified Trade Tested Fitter or Fitter/Turner

• Communication skills

• Drive & motivation

• Ability to act independently.

• Flexibility and ability to adapt to change.

• Attention to detail.

• Team driven.

• Quality and customer service orientated.

• Show initiative.

What we offer you

Medical Aid
Pension Fund

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: VTL Machine Technician
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Machine Operator is responsible for operating and monitoring machinery used in the manufacturing process. This role ensures that machines run efficiently, products meet quality standards, and safety protocols are followed.
This job profile is intended for support staff that follows established procedures and works under close supervision. Smaller/easier decisions are made autonomously.
Summary: Works under limited supervision, sets up and operates machine tools without assistance, following department policy and procedures. Manufactures and reconditions components parts to customer, OEM, and industry standards using conventions, machine tools, including VTL, lathes, milling machines, grinders, etc. Interprets mechanical drawings, blueprints, sketches, and performs precision metal cutting, grinding, shaping and fitting. Constantly measures components, parts and raw materials with precision measuring instruments, gauges and tools.

Essential Functions:

• Sets up and operates conventional machine tools, under limited supervision.

• Plans sequence of own work operations and methods of set-up, including methods of mounting, leveling aligning, holding and fastening work.

• Interprets blueprints, charts, tables, handbook formulas, sketches, and written and verbal orders. Lays out work according to requirements. Selects and grinds own cutting tools.

• Works within close tolerances to meet customer/contract specifications and applies knowledge of qualities of metals and alloys being machined.

• Performs any bench work necessary to finish and fit parts to required customer specifications.

• Follow procedures according to ISO 9001.

· Safety obligations:
o All employees understand and are able to explain the structure and objectives of the SBP.
o All employees follow the safety rules.
o All employees have "the right and duty to intervene" in the event a safety concern becomes evident. In addition, acceptance of an intervention should be accepted in a positive manner as it could have prevented an accident.
All employees are required to comply with all work instructions, policies, and posted signs or instructions regarding safety, including but not limited to proper use of required PPE at all times.

Secondary Responsibilities:

• Maintains a safe, neat, and orderly workstation.

• Maintains machine tools as required to keep machines in good operating condition.

• Assists in the disassembly, inspection, and re-assembly of pump equipment when required.

• Provides information to allow a smooth transition for other coworkers to follow through with in–process work during or prior to a shift change as required.

• Assis other team members as directed, including training and assisting less experience coworkers.

• Works overtime as required.

• Participates in 5S and housekeeping assignments.

• Performs other duties as assigned.

Supervisory Responsibilities:
· Supervisory Responsibilities:
· None
Qualifications:

• High school diploma or equivalent

• Minimum of three (3) years’ experience in a machine shop operating all types of conventional machine tools including lathes, milling machine, boring machines, and drills.

• Ability to read and interpret standard and metric drawings and blueprints, applying knowledge of tool geometry, feeds, speed and basic math skills.

Physical Requirements:

• Must be able to lift objects weighing up to 50 lbs.

What we offer you

• Competitive Paid Time Off

• 12 Company Paid Holidays per year

• Annual Bonus Program

• Full Medical, Dental, and Vision benefits

• Company Paid Short Term and Long Term Disability, Company Paid Life Insurance

• 6% 401K or Roth Company Match with Immediate Vesting

• Company Paid Retirement Security Contributions following 1

descriptionByLocale.it:
Descrizione Sulzer è una società leader nel settore dell'ingegneria con un orgoglioso patrimonio di innovazione. Unisciti al nostro team globale per accrescere le tue competenze e sviluppare soluzioni innovative che consentano una società prospera e più sostenibile. Mansioni - Revisione e analisi dei requisiti del cliente per proposte e licitazioni; - Preparare proposte e concorsi dettagliati e competitivi; - Collaborare con equipes multifuncionais, incluindo vendas, engenharia e jurídico; - Garantir a conformidade com as especificações técnicas, requisitos comerciais e padrões regulatórios; - Compilare tutta la documentazione necessaria per le richieste, inclusi documenti tecnici, dichiarazioni di conformità e certificazioni; - Presentare proposte ed esclarecer aspetti tecnici durante le trattative; - Mantenere aggiornati i registri di tutte le proposte e richieste all'interno di Salesforce; - Partecipazione alle trattative e alle riunioni di chiarimento con i clienti.
• Requisiti - Laurea in Ingegneria (Meccanica, Ambientale, Processi, Chimica o aree correlate) o esperienza pratica equivalente in applicazioni di trattamento dell'acqua o degli effluenti; - Conhecimento in apparecchiature rotanti, come bombe centrifughe, agitatori e miscelatori, utilizzati in stazioni di trattamento dell'acqua e degli effluenti; - L'esperienza nei processi di trattamento fisico, nella rimozione del filo e nelle soluzioni containerizzate/modulari sarà considerata una differenza; - Capacità di comprendere specifiche tecniche con l'aiuto dell'equipe e voglia di imparare a trasformarle in soluzioni tecniche. Cosa offerta - Convênio médico, odontológico e seguro de vida - Vale alimentação, refeição e transporte público - Programa di benessere e Gympass - Partecipazione ai Profitti e Risultati (PLR) - Previdenza privata - Ampia varietà di opportunità di apprendimento Contatto Sulzer è un datore di lavoro per le pari opportunità. Crediamo nella forza di una forza lavoro diversificata e ci impegniamo a offrire un ambiente di lavoro inclusivo. Siamo orgogliosi di essere riconosciuti come Top Employer 2026 in Brasile, Canada, Cina, Finlandia, Germania, Irlanda, Messico, Svizzera, Sud Africa, Regno Unito e Stati Uniti.
descriptionByLocale.de:
Beschreibung Sulzer ist ein führendes Ingenieurunternehmen mit einer stolzen Tradition der Innovation. Werden Sie Teil unseres globalen Teams, um Ihr Fachwissen zu erweitern und innovative Lösungen zu entwickeln, die eine wohlhabende und nachhaltigere Gesellschaft ermöglichen. Mansioni – Überprüfen und analysieren Sie die
• Anforderungen des Kunden für Vorschläge und Lizenzen; - Vorbereitung von Vorschlägen, detaillierten Wettbewerben und Wettbewerben; - Zusammenarbeit mit multifunktionalen Geräten, einschließlich Verkauf, Technik und Recht; - Garantieren Sie eine Konformität mit den Spezifikationen der Technik, den Geschäftsanforderungen und den Vorschriften der Padrões; - Erstellen Sie alle notwendigen Dokumente für Lizenzen, einschließlich technischer Dokumente, Konformitätserklärungen und Zertifikate; - Stellen Sie Vorschläge zur Verfügung und klären Sie technische Aspekte während des Verhandlungsvorgangs ab; - Manter-Registrierungen für alle Aktualisierungen als Vorschläge und Lizenzen für Salesforce; - Teilnahme an Verhandlungen und Treffen mit Kunden.
• Anforderungen: Abschluss in der Technik (Mechanik, Ambiental, Prozess, Quecksilber oder vergleichbare Bereiche) oder gleichwertige praktische Erfahrung in der Anwendung von Wasser- oder Abwasserbehandlungen; - Mit rotierenden Geräten, wie Zentrifugenpumpen, Rührwerken und Rührwerken, die in Wasserbehandlungs- und Abflussstationen verwendet werden; - Erfahrung mit Prozessen zur finanziellen Behandlung, Entfernung von Gütern und Container-/Modullösungen, die auf Unterschiede ausgelegt sind; - Fähigkeit, die spezifischen technischen Daten mit der Ausrüstung zu verstehen und die Möglichkeit zu haben, sie in technische Lösungen umzuwandeln. Geschäftsstelle - Medizinischer, zahnmedizinischer und lebenssicherer Rat - Lebensmittelversorgung, Abgabe und öffentlicher Transport - Wohlfühlprogramme und Gympass - Gewinn- und Verlustbeteiligung (PLR) - Privatleben - Vielfältige Möglichkeiten zur Fortbildung Kontakt Sulzer ist ein Arbeitgeber mit Chancengleichheit. Wir glauben an die Stärke einer vielfältigen Belegschaft und setzen uns dafür ein, ein integratives Arbeitsumfeld zu bieten. Wir sind stolz darauf, in Brasilien, Kanada, China, Finnland, Deutschland, Irland, Mexiko, der Schweiz, Südafrika, dem Vereinigten Königreich und den USA als Top-Arbeitgeber 2026 ausgezeichnet zu werden.

Rejoignez notre équipe mondiale pour développer votre expertise et développer des solutions innovantes qui permettent une société prospère et plus durable. Mansioni - Réviser et analyser les exigences du client pour les propositions et les demandes ; - Préparer des propositions et des concours détaillés et compétitifs ; - Collaborer avec des équipes multifonctionnelles, y compris des vendeurs, des ingénieurs et des avocats ; - Garantir la conformité aux spécifications techniques, aux exigences commerciales et aux réglementations ; - Compiler toute la documentation nécessaire pour les licitations, y compris les documents techniques, les déclarations de conformité et les certificats ; - Présenter des propositions et déclarer des aspects techniques au cours des négociations ; - Tenir les registres actualisés de toutes les propositions et demandes dans Salesforce ; - Participer aux négociations et aux réunions de déclaration avec les clients. Conditions requises - Diplôme en ingénierie (mécanique, ambiant, processus, chimique ou domaines correlatas) ou expérience pratique équivalente dans les applications de traitement de l'eau ou des eaux usées ; - Conhecimento em equipamentos rotativos, como bombas centrífugas, agitadores e misturadores, utilizados em estações de tratamento de agua e efluentes; - L'expérience dans les processus de traitement physique, de retrait de fil et de solutions conteneurisées/modulaires, sera prise en compte comme un différentiel ; - Capacité à comprendre les spécifications techniques à l'intention de l'équipement et à apprendre à transformer les solutions techniques. Cosa ofriamo - Convenio médico, odontológico e seguro de vida - Vale alimentação, refeição e transporte public - Programa di benessere e Gympass - Partecipazione ai Profitti e Risultati (PLR) - Previdenza privata - Ampia varietà di opportunità di learningimento Contatto Sulzer est un employeur garantissant l'égalité des chances. Nous croyons en la force d’une main-d’œuvre diversifiée et nous nous engageons à offrir un environnement de travail inclusif. jobs.title: Cost Estimation Engineer (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Zur Verstärkung unseres Teams suchen wir einen Cost Estimation Engineer (m/w/d), der in der Angebots‑ und Projektphase maßgeblich zur Kosten‑ und Wirtschaftlichkeitstransparenz beiträgt. Die Position ist auf Verantwortungsbereiche in kleinen, mittleren und großen Organisationseinheiten ausgelegt und verbindet technisches Know-how mit kaufmännischem Verständnis.
Ihre Aufgaben

• Erstellung von Kosten‑ und Durchlaufzeitkalkulationen für Projekte in der Angebots‑ und Sales‑Phase

• Kostenkalkulation und Bewertung von Blechbauteilen unter Einsatz von Laser­schneiden, Stanzen, Umformen, Biegen und Schweißen

• Analyse technischer Spezifikationen, Zeichnungen, Stücklisten und historischer Daten

• Bewertung von Fertigungstechnologien, Materialeinsatz und Supply‑Strategien hinsichtlich Kosten und Effizienz

• Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Sales, Engineering, Produktion, Einkauf und Logistik zur Kostenoptimierung

• Unterstützung des Vertriebs in enger Abstimmung mit den Engineering‑Teams

• Weiterentwicklung von Kalkulations‑ und Kostenschätzungstools

• Durchführung von Kosten‑, Prozess‑ und Effizienzanalysen zur Identifikation von Optimierungspotenzialen

• Mitarbeit an globalen Business‑Intelligence‑ und Prozessverbesserungsprojekten (z. B. QlikSense)

Ihr Profil

• Abgeschlossenes Studium im Bereich Maschinenbau, Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen oder vergleichbar

• Mindestens 5 Jahre relevante Berufserfahrung im Cost Engineering, in der Kalkulation oder im Engineering

• Sehr gute Kenntnisse in CAD‑ und Simulationstools

• Sehr gute Englischkenntnisse sind erforderlich, Deutschkenntnisse von Vorteil

• Fundiertes Verständnis mechanischer Konstruktions‑ und Fertigungsprinzipien

• Analytische, strukturierte Arbeitsweise sowie hohe Team‑ und Kommunikationsfähigkeit

What we offer you

• Modernes Arbeitsumfeld: Top ausgestattete Arbeitsplätze, kostenlose Parkplätze sowie Kaffee und Wasser

• Flexibilität für Ihre Work-Life-Balance: Gleitzeitsystem und flexible Arbeitszeiten für eine optimale Vereinbarkeit von Beruf und Privatleben

• Attraktive Zusatzleistungen: JobRad-Leasing, Corporate Benefits, Betriebsrente und weitere Vergünstigungen für Mitarbeitende

• Globale Perspektive & Zusammenarbeit: Enge Kooperation mit der zentralen IT und Anbindung an internationale Konzernstrukturen

• Wir bieten darüber hinaus: Verantwortungsvolle und abwechslungsreiche Aufgaben in einem internationalen Umfeld, Zusammenarbeit mit einem engagierten Team und modernen Technologien, Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten und Entwicklungsperspektiven sowie eine attraktive Vergütung und Sozialleistungen

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Machinist
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Machinist is responsible for operating and maintaining production machinery, ensuring efficient and safe operations. This role performs advanced machine setup, monitors production quality, and may assist in training junior machinists.
This job profile is intended for experienced support-level staff that generally works autonomously and only requires closer supervision in non-routine situations. At Sulzer, you are empowered to deliver superior results. As a pioneer in industry, we have a proud heritage of innovation and continue to evolve for the future. Join our story and create your own impact by developing your expertise and building solutions that help make our lives safer, smarter and more sustainable.

Join our Services team within Rotating Equipment Services division in Ontario as a Journey-person Machinist to help us take Sulzer Rotating Equipment Services (Canada) Ltd., to the next level.

In this role, working under limited supervision, you will:

• Set-up and operate conventional machine tools as directed; Perform layouts

• Read and interpret drawings, including geometric dimensioning and tolerancing

• Use proper machining techniques: setup feeds and speeds for both carbide and high-speed steel cutting tools per standard operating procedures and methods

• Manufacture or repair product on time as defined by direct supervisor and production schedule.

• Improve methods for higher quality and improved costs

To succeed in this role, you will need:

• Completion of a related apprenticeship program preferred

• Working knowledge and ability to effectively set-up all or most of the following machines: Engine Lathe, Milling Machine, Radial Drill, Horizontal Boring Mill, Vertical Boring Mill

• CNC machine tool experience an asset

• Working knowledge of tool geometry and application

• Working knowledge of effects of feeds and speeds on alloy materials

• Ability to work overtime as required

If you are qualified with proven expertise in this position, take the next step and make the most of your skills.

What we offer you

• On-site car parking

• Eligible for overtime

• Length of service awards

• Health and dental benefits

• Employee Assistance Program

• Defined contribution pension plan

• Vacation: 15 days upon completion of 1 year of service, increasing per vacation accrual schedule

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Electrical Fitter
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Join Sulzer's Cardiff Service Centre and bring your expertise in electric motor repairs to our dynamic team. We offer flexible work options, abundant overtime, career progression, and long-term job security. Experience in Low and High Voltage electric motor repair and overhauls is essential. Be part of a global organisation, working on exciting projects across the mining and power generation sectors. 

About the Role:
As an Electrical Fitter, you will play a pivotal role in maintaining and repairing electrical rotating equipment. Your daily responsibilities will include:

• Repairing Low Voltage (LV) and High Voltage (HV) rotating machinery, with a focus on electric motors and generators.

• Performing full overhauls, rewinds, and conducting static and dynamic testing.

• Disassembling and assembling various electrical rotating equipment.

• Attending client sites for critical repairs and servicing.

• Ensuring work is completed safely and to the highest standard.

What We're Looking For

• A Certificate III in Electrical Fitting (or equivalent).

• Extensive experience in repairing, rewinding, and overhauling electric motors, including DC motors, medium to high-voltage motors, and generators.

• Strong focus on safety and excellent time management skills.

• A customer-first mindset with flexibility and problem-solving capabilities.

What we offer you

• Flexible Work Schedule: Enjoy a four-day workweek for better work-life balance.

• Professional Growth: Access training programs and cutting-edge technology to elevate your career.

• Competitive Compensation: Attractive hourly rates with clear career progression pathways.

• Job Security: Strong pipeline of projects in mining and power generation.

• Health & Wellbeing: Participate in wellbeing initiatives and stay fit for the future.

• Recognition & Rewards: Celebrate success with gift cards, monthly BBQs, and other recognition programs.

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Tecnico de Taller
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Lead (Field) Service Technician is responsible for installing, configuring, calibrating, and repairing technical products and systems at customer field locations. This role performs a variety of maintenance and technical support tasks and may provide onsite training to customer support personnel.
This job profile is intended for experienced support-level staff that generally works autonomously and only requires closer supervision in non-routine situations.
Required Education

• Intermediate or Advanced Electromechanical Technician (equivalent to FP I / FP II) or equivalent hands-on experience.

Specific Knowledge

• Basic Occupational Risk Prevention Training (Nivel Básico) and safety training related to the risks of the specific work area..

• Valid driver’s license.

Purpose of the Role
Ensure the delivery of high‑quality service in the maintenance and repair of equipment both in the workshop and at customer sites. Provide technical troubleshooting and support in coordination with the Workshop Manager and the Service Center team.

Key Responsibilities
Operational Work

• Execute planned tasks assigned by the Team Leader, delivering high‑quality mechanical and electrical service to company customers (commissioning, maintenance, repairs, and troubleshooting of electrical systems and automation).

• Provide technical solutions to day‑to‑day issues in coordination with the Workshop Manager.

• Supervise installations, assemblies, and commissioning activities performed by Sulzer subcontractors in the area, following the instructions of the Workshop Manager.

• Act as a point of contact for the Sales team in the assigned region, assisting with technical site visits when required for measurements, analysis, studies, or when the complexity of a quotation or project justifies technical involvement.

• Perform driving and delivery tasks for the Mining & Construction division (delivery of pumps to customers) whenever required by the Workshop Manager based on the workload and work organization.

What we offer you

• Ability to handle tools, coordinate actions, and perform manual tasks.
• Attention to detail and precision.
• Ability to work logically and systematically to achieve consistent performance in a highly structured environment.

jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

To support our growth plans, we’re looking for a Steam Turbine Technical Field Authority who will play a critical, high‑impact role in developing, delivering, and shaping our steam turbine offering across Sulzer’s UK Service Network. If you want to grow your career, take on complex turbine challenges, and be backed by real investment and real capability, this is where you’ll thrive.

At Sulzer, you’ll be part of a team with one of the UK’s most advanced high‑speed balancing capabilities, handling rotors up to 50 tonnes, supported by 14 specialist Service Centres equipped with cutting‑edge rotating equipment expertise.
About the Role

This is not just another field role. This is a key technical authority position at the centre of Sulzer’s expanding Steam Turbine capability, working directly with customers, influencing project scope, and supporting major steam turbine overhauls, upgrades, repairs, and field service mobilisation.
You’ll be the technical expert our teams rely on. The person customers trust. And the driving force behind the success of UK-wide steam turbine projects.

What You’ll Be Doing

• Scope and evaluate work at customer sites across the UK, acting as the technical lead for inspections, diagnosis, and repair recommendations.

• Provide expert technical guidance to Sulzer Service Centres nationwide, ensuring alignment on engineering standards and steam turbine best practice.

• Support delivery of complex projects, from major overhauls to precision balancing, rotor assessments, troubleshooting, performance improvements, and outage support.

• Interface directly with customers, advising on condition, risk, repair options and project planning.

• Drive continuous improvement, working with engineering, operations, and field service teams to enhance our turbine offering and market competitiveness.

What We’re Looking For

• Strong background in Steam Turbine engineering, ideally within field service, overhauls, or rotating equipment environments.

• Proven experience in site-based inspections, fault-finding, and technical assessment.

• Confidence working directly with customers to scope, advise, and lead on technical solutions.

• The ability to act as a “go‑to” authority for steam turbine matters across multiple teams.

• A passion for engineering excellence, problem‑solving, and continuous improvement.

• Willingness to travel UK-wide as required.

What we offer you

• This is a fully remote, home‑based role that gives you full autonomy over your diary and time, with travel across the UK as required.

A competitive basic salary

• Annual personal bonus scheme based on company and personal performance

• The option of a car/allowance (EV options are available)

• Private Medical Insurance

• 33 days annual leave.

• Defined pension contributions.

• Access to Medicash helping you cover everyday health costs like dental optical and physiotherapy plus a range of wellbeing perks.

• Confidential support via Employee Assistance Programmes.

• Access to discounts on shopping entertainment lifestyle plus opportunity to apply for Costco membership.

• Discounted personal car leasing for you your family and friends.

• Long Service Awards celebrating your commitment.

• Continuous learning opportunities through Sulzer Learning Pathways.

• Were proud to support those whove served. Sulzer is a Bronze Award holder under the MoDs Defence Employer Recognition Scheme meaning we actively welcome and support ex-military personnel and reservists in building successful careers with us.

.

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canad

Sulzer è una società di ingegneria leader con un orgoglioso patrimonio di innovazione. Unisciti al nostro team globale per far crescere la tua esperienza e sviluppare soluzioni innovative che consentano una società prospera e più sostenibile.

Informazioni sul ruolo

Per supportare i nostri piani di crescita, stiamo cercando un'autorità tecnica del campo di Turbina di vapore che svolgerà un ruolo critico e di alto impatto nello sviluppo, fornitura e modellazione della nostra offerta di turbine a vapore attraverso Sulzer. UK Service Network. Se si desidera aumentare la vostra carriera, affrontare complesse sfide delle turbine, e essere supportati da investimenti reali e capacità reali, questo è dove si.ll prosperare.

Su Sulzer, farai parte di un team con una delle più avanzate capacità di bilanciamento ad alta velocità del Regno Unito, che gestisce rotori fino a 50 tonnellate, supportati da 14 Centri Assistenza specializzati dotati di attrezzature rotanti all'avanguardia.

Questo non è solo un altro ruolo sul campo. Questa è una posizione chiave dell'autorità tecnica al centro di Sulzer.S espansione della capacità di Turbina di vapore, lavorando direttamente con i clienti, influenzando la portata del progetto, e supportando importanti revisioni delle turbine a vapore, aggiornamenti, riparazioni e mobilitazione dei servizi sul campo.

Sarai l'esperto tecnico su cui i nostri team si affidano.La persona su cui i clienti si fidano.E la forza trainante del successo dei progetti di turbine a vapore in tutto il Regno Unito.

Cosa farai?

- Scope and expert technical guideing to Sulzer Service Centres a livello nazionale, garantendo l'allineamento agli standard di ingegneria e alle migliori pratiche delle turbine a vapore. - Supporto alla fornitura di progetti complessi, dalle importanti revisioni al bilanciamento di precisione, alle valutazioni dei rotori, alla risoluzione dei problemi, ai miglioramenti delle prestazioni e al supporto di interruzione. - Interfaccia direttamente con i clienti, consulenza su condizioni, rischi, opzioni di riparazione e pianificazione dei progetti.

- Guidare il miglioramento continuo, lavorando con ingegneria, operazioni e team di assistenza sul campo per migliorare la nostra offerta di turbine e competitività sul mercato.

Cosa stavamo cercando?

- Forte esperienza nell'ingegneria della turbina a vapore, idealmente all'interno di ambienti di servizio sul campo, di revisione o di apparecchiature rotanti. - Esperienza professionale in ispezioni in loco, rilevazioni di guasti e valutazione tecnica. - Fiducia nel lavorare direttamente con i clienti per esaminare, consigliare e condurre soluzioni tecniche. - La capacità di agire come autorità per le turbine a vapore è importante in più team. - Una passione per l'eccellenza ingegneristica, la risoluzione dei problemi e il miglioramento continuo. - La volontà di viaggiare in tutto il Regno Unito come richiesto.

Cosa ti offriamo

- Questo è un ruolo completamente remoto, basato sulla casa che ti dà piena autonomia sul tuo diario e tempo, con viaggi attraverso il Regno Unito come richiesto. - Un salario base competitivo - Programma di bonus personali annuali basati sulla società e le prestazioni personali - L'opzione di un auto / indennità (sono disponibili opzioni EV) - Assicurazione medica privata - 33 giorni di congedo annuale. - Contributi pensionistici definiti. - L'accesso a Medicash aiuta a coprire i costi sanitari quotidiani come ottica dentale e fisioterapia più una serie di benefici benessere. - Assistenza riservata attraverso i programmi di assistenza ai dipendenti.

- Accesso agli sconti sullo shopping lifestyle di intrattenimento più opportunità di richiedere l'iscrizione Costco. - Noleggio auto personali scontati per voi la vostra famiglia e amici. - Long Service Awards celebra il vostro impegno. - Le opportunità di apprendimento continuo attraverso Sulzer Learning Pathways. - Erano orgogliosi di sostenere coloro che hanno servito. descriptionByLocale.de:
Warenbezeichnung

Sulzer ist ein führendes Ingenieurunternehmen mit einem stolzen Innovationserbe. Steigern Sie mit unserem globalen Team Ihre Expertise aus und entwickeln Sie innovative Lösungen, die eine wohlhabende und nachhaltigere Gesellschaft ermöglichen.

Über die Rolle

Um unsere Wachstumspläne zu unterstützen, suchen wir eine technische Feldbehörde für Dampfturbinen, die eine kritische, hochwirksame Rolle bei der Entwicklung, Lieferung und Gestaltung unseres Dampfturbinenangebots in Sulzer, dem britischen Servicenetzwerk, spielen wird. Wenn Sie Ihre Karriere weiter ausbauen, komplexe Turbinenherausforderungen annehmen und durch echte Investitionen und reale Fähigkeiten unterstützt werden wollen, dann werden Sie hier gedeihen.

Bei Sulzer werden Sie Teil eines Teams mit einem der modernsten Hochgeschwindigkeits-Balancing-Funktionen Großbritanniens sein, das Rotoren bis zu 50 Tonnen verarbeitet, unterstützt von 14 spezialisierten Servicezentren mit modernster Erfahrung in rotierenden Geräten.

Dies ist nicht nur eine weitere Feldrolle. Dies ist eine wichtige technische Autoritätsposition im Zentrum von Sulzer, die die Dampfturbinenkapazität erweitert, direkt mit Kunden zusammenarbeitet, den Projektumfang beeinflusst und große Dampfturbinenüberholungen, Upgrades, Reparaturen und die Mobilisierung von Außendienstdiensten unterstützt.

Sie sind der technische Experte, auf den unsere Teams vertrauen. Kunden vertrauen. Und die treibende Kraft hinter dem Erfolg von britischen Dampfturbinenprojekten.

Was du tun wirst

- Umfang und Auswertung der Arbeiten an Kundenstandorten in ganz Großbritannien, die als technische Führung für Inspektionen, Diagnosen und Reparaturempfehlungen dienen. - Geben Sie Sulzer Service Centern bundesweit fachkundige technische Beratung, um die Anpassung an technische Standards und bewährte Verfahren für Dampfturbinen sicherzustellen. - Unterstützung der Lieferung komplexer Projekte, von der großen Überholung bis hin zu Präzisionsausgleich, Rotorbewertungen, Fehlerbehebung, Leistungsverbesserungen und Ausfallunterstützung. - Schnittstelle direkt mit Kunden, Beratung zu Zustand, Risiko, Reparaturoptionen und Projektplanung.

- Antrieb kontinuierliche Verbesserung, Arbeit mit Engineering, Betrieb und Außendienst-Teams, um unser Turbinenangebot und Markt Wettbewerbsfähigkeit zu verbessern.

Was wir, suchen

- Starker Hintergrund in der Dampfturbinentechnik, idealerweise im Außendienst, in Überholungen oder in rotierenden Anlagenumgebungen. - Bewährte Erfahrung in standortbezogenen Inspektionen, Fehlerbehebungen und technischen Bewertungen. - Vertrauen, das direkt mit Kunden zusammenarbeitet, um technische Lösungen zu erfassen, zu beraten und zu leiten. - Die Fähigkeit, als,go-to' zu agieren, Autorität für Dampfturbinenangelegenheiten in mehreren Teams. - Leidenschaft für technische Exzellenz, Problemlösung und kontinuierliche Verbesserung. - Bereitschaft, UK-weit nach Bedarf zu reisen.

Was wir Ihnen anbieten

- Eine sehr abgelegene, auf dem Heim basierende Rolle, die Ihnen volle Autonomie über Ihr Tagebuch und Ihre Zeit gibt, wobei Sie nach Bedarf durch Großbritannien reisen. - Ein wettbewerbsfähiges Grundgehalt - Jährliches persönliches Bonussystem auf der Grundlage von Unternehmen und persönlicher Leistung - Die Option eines Autos/eine Genehmigung (EV-Optionen sind verfügbar) - Private medizinische Versicherung - 33 Tage Jahresurlaub. - Definierte Rentenbeiträge. - Zugang zu Medicash, die Ihnen helfen, die Kosten für die tägliche Gesundheit wie die Zahnoptik und Physiotherapie zu decken, sowie eine Reihe von Wellness-Perks. - Vertrauliche Unterstützung über Employee Assistance Programme.

- Zugang zu Rabatten auf Shopping-Entertainment-Lifestyle plus Möglichkeit, sich für Costco-Mitgliedschaft zu bewerben. - Ermäßigtes persönliches Leasing für Sie Ihre Familie und Freunde. - Long Service Awards feiern Ihr Engagement. - Continuous Learning Opportunities durch Sulzer Learning Pathways. - Wir waren stolz, diejenigen zu unterstützen, die gedient haben. Sulzer ist ein Bronze Award Inhaber unter dem MoDs Defence Employer Recognition Scheme, was bedeutet, dass wir Ex-Militärpersonal und Reservisten aktiv beim Aufbau erfolgreicher Karrieren mit uns willkommen heißen und unterstützen.

Sulzer ist ein Arbeitgeber mit gleicher Chancenstellung. Wir glauben an die Stärke einer vielfältigen Belegschaft und sind bestrebt, ein inklusives Arbeitsumfeld zu bieten.

Wir sind stolz darauf, als Top Arbeitgeber 2026 in Brasilien, Canad, anerkannt zu werden
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Désignation des marchandises

Sulzer est une entreprise d'ingénierie de premier plan avec un riche héritage d'innovation. Rejoignez notre équipe mondiale pour développer votre expertise et développer des solutions innovantes qui permettent une société prospère et plus durable.

Sur le rôle

Pour soutenir nos plans de croissance, nous cherchons une Autorité de terrain technique de la turbine à vapeur qui jouera un rôle critique et à fort impact dans le développement, la livraison et la mise en forme de notre offre de turbine à vapeur dans l'ensemble de Sulzer, le réseau de services du Royaume-Uni. Si vous voulez développer votre carrière, relever des défis complexes en turbine, et être soutenu par un investissement réel et une capacité réelle, c'est là que vous allez prospérer.

Chez Sulzer, vous ferez partie d'une équipe avec l'une des plus avancées du Royaume-Uni, des capacités d'équilibrage à grande vitesse, des rotors de manutention jusqu'à 50 tonnes, soutenues par 14 centres de services spécialisés dotés d'une expertise en matière d'équipement rotatif de pointe.

À propos du rôle

Il s'agit d'un poste d'autorité technique clé au centre de Sulzer, qui élargit la capacité de la turbine à vapeur, travaille directement avec les clients, influe sur la portée du projet et soutient les révisions majeures des turbines à vapeur, les mises à niveau, les réparations et la mobilisation des services sur le terrain.

Vous serez l'expert technique sur lequel nos équipes comptent. La personne en qui les clients font confiance. Et la force motrice du succès des projets de turbine à vapeur à l'échelle du Royaume-Uni.

Ce que tu feras

- Fournir des conseils techniques spécialisés aux centres de service Sulzer dans tout le pays, en assurant l'alignement sur les normes techniques et les meilleures pratiques en matière de turbine à vapeur. - Soutenir la réalisation de projets complexes, depuis les révisions majeures jusqu'à l'équilibrage de précision, l'évaluation du rotor, le dépannage, l'amélioration des performances et l'assistance aux pannes. - Interagir directement avec les clients, conseiller sur l'état, les risques, les options de réparation et la planification du projet.

- Favoriser l'amélioration continue, en travaillant avec les équipes d'ingénierie, d'exploitation et de service sur le terrain pour améliorer notre offre de turbine et notre compétitivité sur le marché.

Ce que nous, sommes à la recherche

jobs.title: Machinist
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Lead Machine Operator is responsible for overseeing the operation of machinery and equipment on the production floor, ensuring optimal performance and adherence to safety and quality standards. This role provides guidance to other machine operators and supports troubleshooting and maintenance activities.
This job profile is intended for professional-level staff that works autonomously and may coordinate the activities of other professional-level staff, especially in non-routine situations. Machinist

Company: Sulzer Pump Services (US) Inc.

Job Summary

Sulzer Pump Services (US) Inc. is seeking a skilled Machinist to operate and maintain various machine tools, producing precision components and parts for our industrial pump systems. This role is crucial for ensuring the quality and timely delivery of our products.

Job Responsibilities

* Set up, operate, and maintain a variety of machine tools such as lathes, milling machines, grinders, and drill presses to fabricate or repair metallic and non-metallic parts.
* Read and interpret blueprints, technical drawings, and engineering specifications to determine machining operations, sequences, and dimensions.
* Select appropriate tools, cutting speeds, and feed rates based on material type and part specifications.
* Inspect finished products for conformance to specifications using precision measuring instruments such as micrometers, calipers, and gauges.
* Perform routine maintenance on machinery and equipment to ensure optimal performance and longevity.
* Identify and troubleshoot issues with machinery or parts, making necessary adjustments or repairs.
* Maintain a clean and organized work area, adhering to all safety regulations and company policies.
* Collaborate with engineers and other team members to optimize machining processes and improve product quality.
* Document work performed, including measurements, materials used, and any issues encountered.

Job Qualifications

* High school diploma or equivalent; completion of a vocational program or apprenticeship in machining is highly preferred.
* Proven experience as a Machinist, with a strong understanding of various machine tools and machining principles.
* Proficiency in reading and interpreting blueprints, technical drawings, and schematics.
* Strong knowledge of various materials (e.g., steel, aluminum, brass, plastics) and their machining properties.
* Expertise in using precision measuring instruments (micrometers, calipers, depth gauges, etc.) and maintaining tight tolerances.
* Ability to perform mathematical calculations relevant to machining operations.
* Excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
* Strong commitment to safety protocols and procedures.
* Ability to work independently and as part of a team in a fast-paced manufacturing environment.
* Physical ability to lift and move heavy objects, stand for extended periods, and perform repetitive tasks.

What we offer you

• 15 days of paid time off and 12 company-paid holidays

• 401k plan with a 6% match

• Comprehensive health plan including medical, dental, vision, Life, short-term & long-term disability

• Health savings account matching

• Motivating wellness program

• Employee Assistance Program

• Paid paternal leave

• Gym re-imbursement

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Siemens V84 Specialist Superintendent EG
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The SGTS Superintendent oversees the daily operations of the SGTS GT Division with a focus on safety, quality, and efficiency. They cultivate a positive work environment, drive technical advancement, and ensure effective collaboration with customers and stakeholders. This role also involves optimizing processes, managing budgets, and leading Health and Safety initiatives to promote a culture of excellence and continuous improvement. Responsibilities

• Manage day-to-day operations, prioritizing safety, environmental compliance, and adherence to quality standards.

• Manage the Profit and Loss (P&L) of the division, ensuring financial targets are met or exceeded by effectively managing costs, maximizing revenue streams, and implementing strategies to enhance profitability.

• Cultivate a positive work environment by actively engaging with employees, setting clear expectations, and promoting teamwork.

• Drive technical advancement within the division by staying abreast of industry trends and continuously improving coating solutions.

• Optimize work processes to enhance efficiency and profitability, ensuring alignment with monthly budgets.

• Collaborate with customers, Sales Department, and vendors to meet project requirements and maintain strong relationships.

• Coordinate scheduling and project timelines, regularly updating task status and completion dates for effective project management.

• Conduct performance evaluations for Direct Reports and manage salary adjustments in line with company policies.
Qualifications:
The ideal candidate will possess the following:

• 15-20 plus years of Siemens V84 gas turbine field technical execution experience in project management and/or technical direction

• BS in Mechanical Engineering a plus

• Ability to manage a team of Siemens Technical specialists to execute all levels of scheduled and non-scheduled outage activities

• Travel required to quote pending or executing projects

• Sulzer in person office interface required on a balanced basis

• Additional Siemens gas turbine experience a plus

• Strong communication and leadership skills imperative

• Fluent in business and project relative software’s

What we offer you

• 12 Paid Holidays

• 15 Paid Time Off (PTO) Days

• Medical, dental, vision, life & disability

• 401K with 6% company match

• Employee Assistance Program

• Employee Wellness Program

• New onsite cafeteria, all meals subsidized (La Porte Service Center)

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Production Worker / Technician
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Production Worker / Technician is responsible for assembling, testing, and inspecting products to ensure they meet quality and safety standards. This role supports the manufacturing process by identifying defects, maintaining equipment, and following production protocols.
This job profile is intended for support staff that follows established procedures and works under close supervision. Smaller/easier decisions are made autonomously.
SUMMARY:
Performs sandblast and paint application tasks in accordance with SPSI standard procedure processes as well as specific customer requirements.
ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS: % OF TIME

 Operates sandblast equipment to provide required surface preparation 35%

 Performs mixing of various types of paint materials. 5%
 Operates conventional spray equipment, including brush to provide a high quality industrial finish to parts and components 35%
 Moves parts and components as needed with forklift or overhead pendant crane 5%
 Dispose of paint waste materials as required by company, state and federal regulations 5%

 Adheres to Safety and Take 5 culture 5%
 Supports and cooperates with Four Principles 5%
SECONDARY RESPONSIBILITIES:
 Other duties as assigned 5%

TOTAL PERCENT OF TIME: 100%
QUALIFICATIONS:
 High School graduate or equivalent
 Minimum of 1 year experience operating sandblast equipment
 Minimum of 2 years of experience operating conventional spray equipment
 Forklift and pendant crane experience is helpful
 Minimum 1 year of experience mixing and applying epoxies, polyurethane, inorganic zinc and alkyd enamel paints.

What we offer you

• Competitive Paid Time Off (3 weeks to start)

• 12 Company Paid Holidays per year

• Annual Bonus Program

• Full Medical, Dental, and Vision benefits

jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Machine Operator is responsible for operating and monitoring machinery used in the manufacturing process. This role ensures that machines run efficiently, products meet quality standards, and safety protocols are followed.
This job profile is intended for support staff that follows established procedures and works under close supervision. Smaller/easier decisions are made autonomously. Dans le cadre de son activité industrielle, notre entreprise recherche un Technicien d'Usinage (H/F) pour renforcer ses équipes de production.
Vous aurez pour mission principale de réaliser des opérations de tournage et/ou de fraisage sur machines conventionnelles, à commande semi-numérique et numérique, dans le respect des exigences qualité, sécurité et délais.
Vous intervenez sur la fabrication de pièces en lien avec les besoins de production et de développement.

Les activités significatives :

• Préparer la zone de travail ainsi que les équipements nécessaires à la réalisation des pièces

• Analyser les contraintes techniques liées aux pièces à fabriquer

• Lire et interpréter des plans ou schémas techniques mécaniques

• Identifier les différentes phases d’usinage

• Élaborer ou ajuster les programmes et régler les paramètres d’usinage

• Ajuster, monter et modifier les outils de coupe

• Choisir les montages adaptés et régler les machines-outils

• Usiner des pièces unitaires, prototypes ou petites séries en conformité avec les plans et spécifications

• Contrôler la qualité et la conformité des pièces usinées

• Réaliser la maintenance préventive et corrective de premier niveau des équipements

Le profil recherché :

• Formation en usinage / mécanique / productique (CAP, Bac Pro, BTS ou équivalent)

• Expérience sur machines conventionnelles et/ou à commande numérique

• Bonne capacité de lecture de plans mécaniques

• Connaissances en programmation et réglage machines

• Rigueur, précision et sens de la qualité

• Autonomie, esprit d’analyse et respect des consignes de sécurité

What we offer you

Ce que nous vous proposons

• Avantage 1 : Evoluer sur des projets dimensionnants et stratégiques pour le Groupe

• Avantage 2 : Buchelay : référence nucléaire au sein du Groupe SULZER

• et bien d'autres...

About the role

Job Summary
The Machine Operator is responsible for operating and monitoring machinery used in the manufacturing process. This role ensures that machines run efficiently, products meet quality standards, and safety protocols are followed.
This job profile is intended for support staff that follows established procedures and works under close supervision. Smaller/easier decisions are made autonomously. Dans le cadre de son activité industrielle, notre entreprise recherche un Technicien d'Usinage (H/F) pour renforcer ses équipes de production.
Vous aurez pour mission principale de réaliser des opérations de tournage et/ou de fraisage sur machines conventionnelles, à commande semi-numérique et numérique, dans le respect des exigences qualité, sécurité et délais.
Vous intervenez sur la fabrication de pièces en lien avec les besoins de production et de développement.

Les activités significatives :

• Préparer la zone de travail ainsi que les équipements nécessaires à la réalisation des pièces

• Analyser les contraintes techniques liées aux pièces à fabriquer

• Lire et interpréter des plans ou schémas techniques mécaniques

• Identifier les différentes phases d’usinage

• Élaborer ou ajuster les programmes et régler les paramètres d’usinage

• Ajuster, monter et modifier les outils de coupe

• Choisir les montages adaptés et régler les machines-outils

• Usiner des pièces unitaires, prototypes ou petites séries en conformité avec les plans et spécifications

• Contrôler la qualité et la conformité des pièces usinées

• Réaliser la maintenance préventive et corrective de premier niveau des équipements

Le profil recherché :

• Formation en usinage / mécanique / productique (CAP, Bac Pro, BTS ou équivalent)

• Expérience sur machines conventionnelles et/ou à commande numérique

• Bonne capacité de lecture de plans mécaniques

• Connaissances en programmation et réglage machines

• Rigueur, précision et sens de la qualité

• Autonomie, esprit d’analyse et respect des consignes de sécurité

What we offer you

Ce que nous vous proposons

• Avantage 1 : Evoluer sur des projets dimensionnants et stratégiques pour le Groupe

• Avantage 2 : Buchelay : référence nucléaire au sein du Groupe SULZER

• Avantage 3 : Avantages d'une "PME" au sein d'un grand Groupe

• Avantage 4 : Accès au Comité Social et Economique (CSE)

• Avantage 5 : Carte Ticket restaurant - Mutuelle Avantageuse - Prime d'intéressement & Participation - RTT

• et bien d'autres...

jobs.title: Receptionist
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary

The Administrator is responsible for providing basic administrative support by following established procedures. This role works under close supervision and handles routine tasks to support office operations.

Will answer phones, greet and check in all visitors.

This job profile is intended for support staff that follows established procedures and work under close supervision. Smaller/easier decisions are made autonomously. SC: Phoenix, Arizona

PRIMARY FUNCTIONS:

• Upon arriving make sure necessary lights are on and the TV with the safety message is turned on

• Answer / screen / forward incoming phone calls using a multi-line telephone system

• Personably greet and welcome walk-in customers / visitors; ensure they are signed in accordingly then direct them to the appropriate staff member

• Direct visitors to the appropriate person and office

• Ensure reception desk is manned and the main telephone line has coverage at all times during business hours

• Perform brief safety orientation accordingly with customers / visitors entering the premises, where applicable

• Manage inventory and purchase office supplies

• Create and maintain inventory spreadsheet for admin and sales supplies

• Manage and update the conference room calendar as needed

• Organize, set-up, break down and maintain conference room for all operations and executive meetings

• Organize and order lunch on an as needed basis

• Oversee sorting and distribution of mail to both the administration and shop buildings

• Prepare outgoing mail / UPS / FedEx (envelopes, packages, etc.)

• Perform other clerical receptionist duties such a filing, photocopying, data entry, etc.

• Keep common area clean and organized

• Provide assistance to other departments as needed and per supervisor approval

EXPERIENCE/SKILLS:

• Knowledge and proficient use of Microsoft Word, Excel, and Power Point

• Maintain a professional attitude and appearance

• Excellent communication and organizational skills

• Customer service quality

• Independently perform substantial clerical and office work

• The ability to proficiently use a multi-line telephone system, computer, copier and other office equipment

• Be a self-motivated individual with initiative and the ability to multi-task

• Team oriented and able to interact with multiple departments

• Bilingual is required (English & Spanish)

WORK ENVIRONMENT & PHYSICAL DEMANDS:

• Office environment

• While performing duties of this job, would occasionally be required to stand, walk, sit, reach with hands and arms, climb or balance, stoop or kneel, talk and hear, and use fingers and hands to feel objects.

• May occasionally lift and/or move up to 25 pounds

What we offer you

Paid parental leave
Parental leave
Health insurance
401(k) matching
Paid time off
Vision insurance
Health savings account
Dental insurance
Gym membership
Employee assistance program
Disability insurance
401(k) 6% Match
Paid holidays
Wellness program
