We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Sales Manager
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Sales Manager is responsible for managing a team of sales representatives, setting sales goals, and ensuring the team meets performance targets. This role supports the execution of sales strategies and provides coaching and development to team members.
This job profile is intended for People Managers of 4+ experienced to senior expert-level employees.
Key Responsibilities
Supervise and support the sales team in achieving targets.
Set sales goals and monitor performance metrics.
Train and mentor sales representatives.
Develop and implement sales plans and strategies.
Handle key customer accounts and resolve escalations.
Collaborate with marketing and operations teams.
Report sales performance to senior leadership.
Skills & Qualifications
Typically a University degree (or equivalent work experience) and 9+ years of relevant work experienceare minimally required to be able to manage and coordinate one or more expert-level teams.
Experience in sales team management.
Strong leadership and coaching skills.
Excellent communication and interpersonal abilities.
Proficiency in CRM systems and reporting tools.

jobs.title: Field Service Supervisor
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The (Field) Service Machinist Supervisor is responsible for managing on-site machining operations in demanding industrial environments. This role is responsible for supervising field personnel, ensuring precision machining work meets strict tolerances, and delivering projects safely, on time, and within budget. The ideal candidate combines strong technical machining expertise with proven leadership and customer-facing skills. Key Responsibilities
Set up and operate portable machining equipment lathes, line boring, flange facing, milling, drilling, and tapping.
Interpret blueprints, technical drawings, and specifications.
Measure and inspect components using, calipers, dial indicators, etc.
Ensure proper alignment and tolerances are achieved.
Maintain field equipment and tooling.
Communicate with clients and supervisors regarding job progress and issues.

Skills & Qualifications
High school diploma or equivalent technical training.
Proven experience as a machinist, preferably in field or industrial environment.
Ability to read and interpret blueprints and schematics.
Mechanical aptitude and problem-solving skills.
Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.
Willingness to travel frequently and work in varying conditions outdoors, confined spaces, and heights.
Physical ability to lift heavy equipment and stand for long periods.

What we offer you

• 12 Paid Holidays

• 15 Paid Time Off (PTO) Days

• Medical, dental, vision, life & disability

• 401K with 6% company match

• Employee Assistance Program

• Employee Wellness Program

• New onsite cafeteria, all meals subsidized (La Porte Service Center)

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Clean Line Operatives
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

At Sulzer GT Aero, we specialize in the repair, overhaul, and field service of industrial, marine, and power gas turbines. With over two decades of expertise, our team delivers tailored solutions to clients worldwide, ensuring reliability, performance, and rapid turnaround. From spare parts and consultancy to full turbine refurbishment, we’re the trusted partner for critical rotating equipment.

This role is based at our Netherley facility near Stonehaven in Aberdeenshire, a key hub for our turbine operations and customer support.

As a Process / Clean Line Operative, you’ll be responsible for preparing and cleaning turbine components to the highest standards, supporting the delivery of world-class engineering services. Job Responsibilities

• Clean and process turbine components using chemical tanks, grit blasting, vapour blasting, and hand cleaning.

• Operate specialist equipment such as ball burnishing machines.

• Maintain high standards of quality and safety in all tasks.

• Support continuous improvement initiatives within the workshop.

• Follow all health, safety, and environmental procedures.

Job Qualifications

• A flexible, team-oriented approach with the ability to work independently.

• Ability to follow technical instructions and safe working practices.

• Previous experience in a cleanline or workshop environment is preferred, but full training will be provided.

What we offer you

• A competitive hourly rate

• Paid overtime opportunities

• 9-day fortnight working pattern (every other Friday off)

• 33 days of annual leave

• Access to retail and entertainment discounts — including Costco membership

• Discounted personal car leasing for employees, family, and friends

• Confidential support via our Employee Assistance Programme

• Ongoing learning and development through Sulzer Learning Pathways

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

About the role

At Sulzer GT Aero, we specialize in the repair, overhaul, and field service of industrial, marine, and power gas turbines. With over two decades of expertise, our team delivers tailored solutions to clients worldwide, ensuring reliability, performance, and rapid turnaround. From spare parts and consultancy to full turbine refurbishment, we’re the trusted partner for critical rotating equipment.

This role is based at our Netherley facility near Stonehaven in Aberdeenshire, a key hub for our turbine operations and customer support.

Your Role:

As a Fitter, you’ll be responsible for the hands-on repair and overhaul of gas turbines, power turbines, and associated equipment. You’ll work as part of a skilled workshop team, ensuring high standards of engineering, safety, and documentation throughout the build process. Job Responsibilities

• Strip, inspect, sub-assemble, and rebuild turbine components.

• Accurately record critical measurements and report non-conformances.

• Maintain clean and organised workstations, ensuring tooling and chemicals are stored correctly.

• Complete all build documentation and submit for review.

• Support apprentice training and contribute to a culture of safety and quality.

• Input working hours into company systems and assist with non-conformance reporting

Job Qualifications

• Previous experience in a similar workshop or engineering role.

• Knowledge of gas turbine repair and refurbishment (advantageous).

• Experience in fabrication, repair, or construction environments.

• Strong attention to detail and commitment to quality.

• Good communication and organisational skills.

• A team-oriented, adaptable approach.

What we offer you

• A competitive salary

• Paid overtime opportunities

• 9-day fortnight working pattern (every other Friday off)

• Annual performance-based bonus

• Private medical insurance

• 33 days of annual leave

• Access to retail and entertainment discounts — including Costco membership

• Discounted personal car leasing for employees, family, and friends

• Confidential support via our Employee Assistance Programme

• Ongoing learning and development through Sulzer Learning Pathways

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Principal Structure Engineer
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The (Mechanical) Engineering Expert is responsible for leading the design, development, and optimization of mechanical systems and components. This role provides expert-level technical leadership in mechanical engineering, ensuring that products meet performance, reliability, and cost targets. The expert collaborates across departments to drive innovation and resolve complex engineering challenges.
This job profile is intended for recognized subject matter experts in a job area. Required to manage large projects or processes with limited oversight from manager. Coaches, reviews and delegates work to lower level professionals. 设置该岗位的目的:
Purpose of the Job:

This position is part of the Engineering department.
As a Structural Engineer, you will participate in Sulzer projects at all execution stages (Conceptual design, Skid and Modular design, DD, Procurement / Construction / Commissioning support etc.).
Structural Engineer reports to Engineering Manager.

主要任务与职责:
Main tasks and responsibilities:

• Design and 3D modeling of main metal structures of skids.

• Calculation of main metal structures of skids

• Development of the drawings and other design documents within discipline

• Material selection within discipline

• Value engineering within discipline

• Participate in the development of technical specifications for design, technical requirements for supply, etc.

• Supervision and support of subcontractors' activities

• Checking and approval documentation from subcontractors.

• Participation in the development of design philosophy and internal standards within the discipline

• Participation in the project meetings, 3D models review etc.

• Contribute to development of the overall project schedule.

• Tracking and managing changes within discipline.

职位要求：
Qualifications:
Education and Experience

• Bachelor in Civil Structure Engineering

• 8 years’ experience in the oil and gas industries.

• Good knowledge of applicable industrial standards and best practices. (China & International)

• Good knowledge of designing methods and economic analysis.

• General knowledge of oil and gas plant construction.

Language

• Fluent in Mandarin and English

Others

• Ability to work under tight deadlines with multiple tasks.

• Ability to work in multiple projects.

• Ability to travel on business trips including lengthy business trips to site during construction and commissioning.

What we offer you

target bonus：18.33% of annual income

About the role

Job Summary
The Production Planner is responsible for scheduling and coordinating production activities to ensure timely delivery of products. This role works closely with procurement, manufacturing, and logistics to align production plans with demand forecasts and resource availability.
This job profile is intended for experienced professionals who apply practical knowledge of a job area and work independently with general supervision. Key Responsivities:

• Analyze manufacturing capacity, workload, and resource utilization(labor, equipment) to identify constraints and bottlenecks.

• Collaborate with production, engineering and procurement teams to resolve scheduling conflicts and implement corrective actions.

• Monitor master schedule progress and adjust plans proactively to achieve sales target.

• Maintain accurate planning data, documentation, and generate regular performance reports(e.g., schedule adherence, capacity utilization).

• Continuously improve scheduling processes to increase efficiency, reduce lead times, and support lean manufacturing initiatives.

Skills & Qualifications:
Typically a University degree (or equivalent work experience) and at least of 3-4 years of relevant experience (or equivalent skills) are minimally required to carry out the role.
Strong analytical and organizational skills. Experience with ERP/MRP systems. Knowledge of master planning and scheduling. Effective communication and collaboration abilities. Ability to manage multiple priorities.

jobs.title: Journey Level Machinist
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary

Set up and operate machine tools, including HBM, VBM, lathes, milling machines, ID/OD grinders, planers, and bore, without assistance, following department policy and procedures manual, to manufacture and recondition component parts to customer, OEM and industry standards. Interprets mechanical drawings, blueprints, and sketches and performs precision metal cutting, grinding, shaping and fitting. Measures components, parts, and raw materials with precision measuring instruments, gauges, and tools. Works under limited supervision. ​

• Performs layouts, sets up, and operates machines.

• Read and interpret procedures, work orders, and technical drawings to meet specifications.

• Apply knowledge of metals and alloys, including stainless and carbon steels.

• Improves set ups and methods for higher quality and improved cost.

• Operate overhead crane and forklifts safely as directed by Supervisor. Perform other duties as necessary.

• Maintain regular and reliable attendance.

• Maintains a safe, neat, and orderly workstation

• Assists in the disassembly, inspection, and re-assembly of pump equipment when required

• Communicate effectively to ensure smooth workflow transitions between team members.

• Support and assist coworkers, including training and collaboration.

• Supports, cooperates with, and participates in company-wide safety program which includes following all safety policies and procedures

• Supports and cooperates in Sulzer Nuclear Quality Program

• Performs other duties as assigned

• Works overtime as requested

• Operates forklifts, overhead cranes, man lifts, and scissor lifts

QUALIFICATIONS:

• Completion of a machinist apprentice program or equivalent training.

• Minimum of five (5) years of experience in machining.

• Ability to hold close tolerances and conduct component inspection.

• Ability to read and interpret technical drawings.

• Basic math skills.

What we offer you

• 15 days of paid time off and 12 company-paid holidays

• 401k plan with a 6% match

• Comprehensive health plan including medical, dental, vision, Life, short-term & long-term disability

• Health savings account matching

• Motivating wellness program

• Employee Assistance Program

• Paid paternal leave

• Gym re-imbursement

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Sr. Tendering Lead is responsible for providing technical support to sales teams and conducting detailed analysis of product configurations to determine customer-specific pricing. This includes preparing technical sales briefings, evaluating customer specifications, and ensuring proposals meet quality standards.
This job profile is intended for experienced professionals who apply practical knowledge of a job area and work independently with general supervision. Key
• Responsibilities
Analyze customer requirements and prepare accurate technical proposals.
Estimate costs, resources, and timelines for customized product solutions.
Conduct technical briefings and presentations for internal and external stakeholders.
Collaborate with engineering and sales teams to ensure proposal feasibility.
Ensure compliance with company standards and customer expectations.
Support troubleshooting and initial training during implementation phases.
Skills &
• Qualifications
Typically a University degree (or equivalent work experience) and at least 3–4 years of relevant experience (or equivalent skills) are minimally required to carry out the role.

Required Skills:

Strong technical knowledge of industrial products and systems.
Experience in tendering, proposal development, and cost estimation.
Excellent communication and presentation skills.
Ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines.
Familiarity with CRM and ERP systems.

What we offer you

target bonus:18.33% of annual income

jobs.title: Lead Piping Engineer
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The (Mechanical) Engineering Supervisor is responsible for supervising a team of mechanical engineers and support staff engaged in the design, development, and testing of mechanical systems and components. This role ensures that engineering projects are executed efficiently, meet technical and quality standards, and align with organizational goals. The supervisor also plays a key role in mentoring junior engineers, managing project timelines, and fostering innovation in mechanical design and manufacturing processes.
This job profile is intended for People Managers of 4+ junior to experienced expert-level roles. 设置该岗位的目的:
Purpose of the Job:

As a Principal Piping Engineer, you will participate in Sulzer projects at all execution stages (Conceptual design, Skid and Modular design, DD, Procurement / Construction / Commissioning support etc.).
Principal Piping Engineer reports to the Chief Piping Engineer and/or Engineering Manager.
主要任务与职责:
Main tasks and responsibilities:

• Take lead in overall piping design of skid

• Act as overall mechanical engineering IC in skid projects

• Train and guide piping engineers

• Design, 3D modeling and review of main metal structures of skids and modules

• Piping stress analysis

• Development of the drawings and other design documents within discipline

• Material selection within discipline

• Value engineering within discipline

• Interface management

• Participate in the development of technical specifications for design, technical requirements for supply, etc.

• Supervision and support of subcontractors' activities

• Checking and approval documentation from subcontractors.

• Participation in the development of design philosophy and internal standards within the discipline

• Participation in the project meetings, 3D models review etc.

• Contribute to development of the overall project schedule.

• Tracking and managing changes within discipline

• Participation in the project progress report development.

职位要求：
Qualifications:
Education and Experience

• Bachelor in Mechanical Engineering

• 10 years’ experience in the oil and gas industries.

• Good knowledge of applicable industrial standards and best practices. (China & International)

• Good knowledge of designing methods and economic analysis.

• Extensive experience in skid and modular design

• General knowledge of oil and gas plant construction.

Language

• Fluent in Mandarin and English

Others

• Ability to work under tight deadlines with multiple tasks.

• Ability to work in multiple projects.

• Ability to travel on business trips including lengthy business trips to site during construction and commissioning.

What we offer you

target bonus：18.33% of annual income

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

About the role

Job Summary
The (Mechanical) Engineering Specialist is responsible for researching, designing, and developing mechanical systems and components. This role applies advanced engineering knowledge to support the development and testing of mechanical and electromechanical systems.
This job profile is intended for specialist professionals that apply advanced knowledge of a job area. Required to manage projects / processes independently with limited supervision. Typically coaches and reviews the work of lower level professionals. 设置该岗位的目的:

• Interface management between disciplines

jobs.title: Senior Supply Chain Management & Purchasing Engineer

titleByLocale.it: Senior Supply Chain Management & Purchasing Ingegnere
titleByLocale.en: Senior Supply Chain Management & Purchasing Engineer
titleByLocale.fr: Senior Chaîne d'approvisionnement Management & Purchasing Ingénieur

jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Procurement Supervisor is responsible for supervising procurement professionals and ensuring the effective sourcing and acquisition of goods and services. This includes managing supplier relationships and ensuring compliance with procurement policies.
This job profile is intended for People Managers of 4+ junior to experienced expert-level roles. The Senior Supply Chain Management & Purchasing Engineer is responsible for driving strategic sourcing while applying procurement engineering expertise in Supply Chain Management. The role focuses on identifying and securing cost‑optimized products and services required for Process Solutions’ own production and project execution.

Depending on workload, this position will be assigned to functions in the Strategic Sourcing, Vendor Management and Advanced Procurement function. The role works closely with all cross‑functional teams across the organization, supporting their sourcing needs to ensure timely, cost‑effective, and quality‑compliant delivery aligned with project and business objectives.

A background in EPC environments is an advantage, along with experience in site procurement, construction, or working within an engineering‑driven setting. Exposure to international procurement is also a plus.

设置该岗位的目的:

The Senior SCM & Purchasing Engineer is responsible for driving strategic sourcing while applying procurement engineering expertise in Supply Chain Management. The role focuses on identifying and securing cost‑optimized products and services required for Process Solutions’ own production and project execution.

主要任务与职责:
Main tasks and responsibilities:

• Identify and develop qualified best-fit suppliers for various demands of engineered equipment, materials, subcontracting need for Sulzer packages

• Conduct market research, TCO analysis (within Sulzer Scope coverage), and supply chain risk assessments.

• Support sourcing initiatives on product line development and source for the most cost‑effective sources.

• Maintain up‑to‑date knowledge of industry trends, technologies, and supplier capabilities, lesson learns to support team innovation

• Vendor Management

• Evaluate, qualify, and assess suppliers' technical capability, quality standards, and capacity Manage supplier performance, conduct audits, and drive corrective actions where needed. Maintain accurate supplier records (credentials, ISO, Financial, audit records, performance in Sulzer digital dashboard, and other files. Support Quality team in the corrective actions for in case of NCR and tracking of COPQ

• Project Procurement Support (when activated)

• Will be working in Advanced Procurement team while collaborate with Engineering, Quality, Project Management, Workshop to meet project procurement needs and timelines. Provide regular procurement status reports, risk assessments, and mitigation plans. Manage end-to-end procurement cycle including RFQ’s, commercial bid evaluations. Lead negotiations to achieve competitive pricing, favorable terms, while aligned to the total cost of ownership (within Sulzer scope). Issue purchase orders, monitor order progress for buy outs, work with Quality and Project Manag

jobs.title: ESH Engineer
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The ESH Engineer is responsible for supporting basic environmental, safety, and health activities, including inspections, data collection, and compliance monitoring. This job profile is intended for early-career professionals who apply broad theoretical knowledge and require the ability to investigate and analyse problems. Solutions are typically discussed/verified with a more senior member. Main tasks and responsibilities:
- Implement applicable national workplace safety laws and regulations, standards and specifications, and the company’s safety management system; implement the safety production responsibility system.
- Conduct daily on-site safety inspections and hazard identification and rectification. Focus on high-risk activities such as machinery operations, welding, chemical use, dust-related work, working at height, hot work, temporary electrical work, and heavy lifting/handling.
- Supervise workers correct wearing and use of personal protective equipment (PPE) and promptly stop the “three violations” (unauthorized command, unsafe/unauthorized operation, and violation of work discipline).
- Organize three-level safety induction training for new employees, pre-job/toolbox safety briefings, special safety training, and emergency drills to enhance safety awareness and emergency response capability.
- Participate in permit-to-work approvals and on-site monitoring for hazardous operations; verify work conditions, control measures, and personnel qualifications to ensure compliant execution.
- Conduct periodic inspection, maintenance, and management of fire-fighting facilities, emergency equipment, and protective supplies to ensure they are in good condition and effective.
- Improve safety signs, warning boards, and safety communication materials, and promote on-site safety culture.
- Participate in the investigation and handling of safety incidents/accidents; perform root-cause analysis, record and report findings, and track implementation of corrective actions.
- Establish and maintain safety records, inspection logs, training files, and hazard rectification closure records to ensure they are standardized and complete.
- Complete other workplace safety management tasks assigned by supervisors.

What we offer you

target bonus：15% of annual income

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

Main tasks and responsibilities: - Implement applicable national workplace safety laws and regulations, standards and specifications, and the company’s safety management system; implement the safety production responsibility system. - Conduct daily on-site safety inspections and hazard identification and rectification. Focus on high-risk activities such as machinery operations, welding, chemical use, dust-related work, working at height, hot work, temporary electrical work, and heavy lifting/handling. - Supervise workers correct wearing and use of personal protective equipment (PPE) and promptly stop the “three violations” (unauthorized command, unsafe/unauthorized operation, and violation of work discipline). - Organize three-level safety induction training for new employees, pre-job/toolbox safety briefings, special safety training, and emergency drills to enhance safety awareness and emergency response capability. - Participate in permit-to-work approvals and on-site monitoring for hazardous operations; verify work conditions, control measures, and personnel qualifications to ensure compliant execution. - Conduct periodic inspection, maintenance, and management of fire-fighting facilities, emergency equipment, and protective supplies to ensure they are in good condition and effective. - Improve safety signs, warning boards, and safety communication materials, and promote on-site safety culture. - Participate in the investigation and handling of safety incidents/accidents; perform root-cause analysis, record and report findings, and track implementation of corrective actions. - Establish and maintain safety records, inspection logs, training files, and hazard rectification closure records to ensure they are standardized and complete. - Complete other workplace safety management tasks assigned by supervisors.

jobs.description:

About the role

Job Summary
The Sr. Tendering Lead is responsible for providing technical support to sales teams and conducting detailed analysis of product configurations to determine customer-specific pricing. This includes preparing technical sales briefings, evaluating customer specifications, and ensuring proposals meet quality standards.
This job profile is intended for experienced professionals who apply practical knowledge of a job area and work independently with general supervision. Key
• Responsibilities
Analyze customer requirements and prepare accurate technical proposals.
Estimate costs, resources, and timelines for customized product solutions.
Conduct technical briefings and presentations for internal and external stakeholders.
Collaborate with engineering and sales teams to ensure proposal feasibility.
Ensure compliance with company standards and customer expectations.
Support troubleshooting and initial training during implementation phases.

• Qualifications
Typically a University degree (or equivalent work experience) and at least 3–4 years of relevant experience (or equivalent skills) are minimally required to carry out the role.

Required Skills:

Strong technical knowledge of industrial products and systems.
Experience in tendering, proposal development, and cost estimation.
Excellent communication and presentation skills.
Ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines.
Familiarity with CRM and ERP systems.

jobs.title: Sales Engineer
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Sales Engineer is responsible for supporting the sales process by providing technical expertise, assisting with product demonstrations, and preparing proposals. This role works closely with senior engineers and sales teams to ensure customer requirements are met.
This job profile is intended for early-career professionals who apply broad theoretical knowledge and require the ability to investigate and analyse problems. Solutions are typically discussed/verified with a more senior member. Main tasks and responsibilities

• Deliver annual Order Intake targets, ensuring both revenue and expected margin objectives are met.

• To plan and undertake regular customer visits, maximizing enquiry generation and driving order intake to deliver the growth plan.

• Prepare, submit and follow up all enquiries to customers in a timely and professionally manner.

• Ensure that defined long-term and short-term objectives, strategies and plans are achieved.

• Follow-up regularly on submitted proposals and to update in Sulzer Customer Relationship Management system.

• Co-ordinate projects with Head Office, Regional Offices and Agents, as applicable.

• Provide regular reporting on market, projects, market analysis and sales forecasts.

• Ensure that all business activities conform to local laws and regulations and are following company policies and procedures.

• Any other duties that are assigned by superiors.

Competencies and behaviour required

• Frequent travel to domestic customers

• Fluent in written & spoken English in addition to local language

• Excellent interpersonal skills, initiative and proactive.

• Good communicator and good leadership skills.

• · Good negotiation, planning, coordination & monitoring skills.

Qualifications/Experience and Knowledge Required

• Bachelor degree in Chemical Engineering or equivalent from reputable university.

• Minimum 5 years process equipment selling in Oil & Gas / Oleochemical Industry.

• Proven track record in achieving YoY (Year on Year) sales growth with strong penetration and success in Indonesia Oil & Gas, Petrochemicals & Oleochemical segment.

• Strong network of established contacts with decision makers / influencers in end user and engineering companies from Oil & Gas, Petrochemicals & Oleochemical market will be advantageous.

• Experience working with international, multi-ethnic and cultural teams.

What we offer you

Career Opportunities
Saving Plan
Medical Benefit

jobs.title: Senior QC Engineer
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary

Ensures quality and technical compliance in servicing rotating equipment, including pumps, turbines, and compressors. Ensures adherence to Sulzer OEM, customer, and international standards, while supporting inspections, repair solutions, and quality procedures. Provides technical feedback, prepares inspection reports, and develops and implements required standards.

Key Responsibilities

• Conduct incoming, in-process, and final inspections of rotating equipment and components.

• Prepare and review overhaul reports with technical recommendations.

• Develop work instructions, drawings, and repair methods based on findings.

• Maintain job packs, checklists, inspection records, and SOPs.

• Prepare and execute Inspection & Test Plans (ITPs) with stakeholders.

• Provide technical quality support, including WPS/PQR review and material selection.

• Perform dimensional, geometric, and disassembly inspections.

• Manage NCRs, including RCA, CAPA, and lessons learned.

• Coordinate and oversee NDT and specialized testing with third parties.

• Ensure calibration, control, and traceability of inspection equipment.

• Support operations/projects, including progress updates and resolving technical issues.

• Train staff on quality standards and support LEAN and continuous improvement.

• Ensure compliance with EHS, quality procedures, and 5S practices.

• Promote a safe, clean, and positive work environment.

Qualifications / Requirements

• Bachelor’s degree in engineering

• Minimum of 7 years of experience in a similar or related role

• Strong centrifugal pump background required; compressor/turbine experience is an advantage.

• Ability to interpret engineering drawings, manuals, and technical specifications

• Experience in procedure development and NCR handling

• Proficient in precision measurement and workshop inspection

• Solid understanding of pump hydraulics, mechanical seals, and rotating equipment

• NDT certification (LPT/MPI/UT Level 2); LEAA lifting/rigging certification is a plus

• Knowledge of OEM standards and practices preferred

What we offer you

• Excellent opportunities for development, along with a competitive salary and company bonus scheme.

• A great working environment.

• Work Location: Riyadh- Industrial Area 2

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Mechanic
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary

Repair various kinds of electro-mechanical equipment. PHOENIX, ARIZONA, USA

RESPONSIBILTIES

• Read job cards to determine; job status, work authorization/limitations, estimate, description of problems and/or expected serviceability.

• Test electro-mechanical equipment to troubleshoot known or suspected problems using various methods (ac or de).

• Disassemble electro-mechanical equipment noting parts identifications, configuration and condition.

• Clean electro-mechanical equipment assemblies as needed using various methods and steps, including but not limited to: parts washer/steamers, caustic tanks, glass beaders, etc.

• Measure for or note proper replacement parts. Correctly requisition needed items from storekeeper, as approved by supervisor.

• Replace or repair worn or defective mechanical or electro-mechanical assemblies, including but not limited to: bearings, brushes, brush holders, motors leads gears seals, impellers, mechanical switches, brakes clutches, clutch rotors, tachs, fans, end shield,, etc.

• Retest reassembled electro-mechanical equipment for proper output and operation.

• Complete required paperwork for each job accurately and on a timely basis.

• Operate specialized repair and testing equipment and other equipment as needed

• Observe all safety procedures and use proper protective gear (especially eye and car protection).

• Lift, tighten, adjust and/or secure heavy objects in order to perform work duties.

• Keep work area neat and clean as directed by supervisor.

• Assisted other mechanics or other shop personnel in skilled or –non-skilled duties as directed by supervisor or shop manager.

• Perform other skilled or not-skilled duties as directed by supervisor

QUALIFICATIONS

• High school diploma or equivalent

• Basic mechanical aptitude

• Ability to understand, perform and retain various skill related training and operational and safety procedures demonstrated by supervisor.

PHYSICAL DEMANDS

• While performing duties of this job, would occasionally be required to stand, walk, sit, reach with hands and arms, climb or balance, stoop or kneel, talk and hear, and use fingers and hands to feel objects.

• Ability to lift and/or move up to 50 pounds

The above is intended to describe the general content of, and requirements for, the performance of this job. It is not to be construed as an exhaustive statement of duties, responsibilities, or requirements.

What we offer you

Health insurance
Health savings account
Flexible spending account
Vision insurance
Dental insurance
401(k) 6% match
Paid time off
Paid parental leave
Gym membership
Employee assistance program
Disability insurance
Paid holidays
Wellness program

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Coordenador de Contratos PL
Credit and Collection Coordinator
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

The Order to Cash (OTC) Credit & Collections Coordinator is responsible for assessing the creditworthiness of current and potential customers and advice on the setup of new customers, managing credit risk, and supporting the overall OTC process in close collaboration with the country Project Managers and Credit Control Managers. Moreover, the professional is responsible for managing and executing the collections process to ensure timely payments from customers, maintaining healthy cash flow and minimizing risk of bad debts. The Credit & Collections Accountant will play a crucial role in maintaining financial stability of the organization by ensuring that receivables are collected in a timely manner.

Key Responsibilities:

• Evaluate customer credit applications using credit scoring models and financial analysis to determine the degree of risk involved in extending the credit

• Analyze new customer and advise on the acceptance/rejection for the setup in the Master Data

• Conduct thorough financial analysis, including reviewing financial statements, credit reports and payment history to set and adjust credit limits

• Monitor and analyze customers’ credit exposures and make recommendations to minimize risk and optimize accounts receivables

• Collaborate closely with the Senior Credit & Collection Accountants, local Project Managers, sales and customer service teams to resolve credit issues and support business growth while managing credit risk as well as to address any disputes or issues that delay payments

• Execute collections strategies to reduce Days of Sales Outstanding (DSO) and improve cash flow

• Engage with customers via phone, email or other communication channels to negotiate timely payments and resolve outstanding receivables

• Maintain accurate and up-to-date records of all credit & collections-related activities, including credit review, limits and terms

• Communicate credit policies and procedures to relevant stakeholders within the organization

• Support the collections process, ensuring timely payments from customers

• Prepare credit & collections reports and risk assessments for management, highlighting trends, potential risks and opportunities for improvement

• Support the OTC and Reporting & Analytics team with the month-end closing activities, ensuring accurate and timely financial reporting related to credit and accounts receivable

• Participate in continuous improvement initiatives to enhance credit processes and systems

• Ensure OTC internal controls are in place in the CoE and followed for the processes performed by this role

Minimum Job Requirements/Skillset:

• University degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration or related field

• Minimum of 1-2 years of experience in OTC, credit analysis, risk assessment or a similar role

• Experience within the manufacturing or industrial sectors is preferred

• Strong understanding of financial analysis, credit scoring, and risk management principles as well as the collection processes

• Proficiency in financial statement analysis and interpreting credit reports

• Excellent analytical, problem-solving and decision-making skills

• Proficient in ERP systems (relevant to your business unit; SAP, Microsoft Dynamics 365 or iScala )

• Strong MS Office (Excel, PowerPoint) skills

• Experience with Tagetik and Qlik Sense is a plus

What we offer you

• 30 days Christmas Bonus ( Aguinaldo )

• Savings Fund: 8% monthly matching

• Pension Plan & Seniority Recognition

• Major Medical Insurance (Individual)

• Life, Dental, and Vision Insurance

• 12 days of vacation to start with a 50% vacation premium

Sulzer è una società di ingegneria leader con un patrimonio orgoglioso di innovazione. Unisciti al nostro team globale per accrescere le tue competenze e sviluppare soluzioni innovative che consentano una società prospera e più sostenibile.

Informazioni sul ruolo

Il Coordinatore Credit & Collections Order to Cash (OTC) Ã ̈ responsabile della valutazione dell'affidabilitÃ creditizia dei clienti attuali e potenziali e della consulenza sulla configurazione dei nuovi clienti, sulla gestione del rischio di credito e sul supporto del processo OTC complessivo in stretta collaborazione con i Project Manager del paese e i Credit Control Manager. Inoltre, il professionista è responsabile della gestione e dell'esecuzione del processo di raccolta per garantire pagamenti tempestivi da parte dei clienti, mantenendo un flusso di cassa sano e riducendo al minimo il rischio di debiti cattivi. Il Credit & Collections Accountant svolgerà un ruolo cruciale nel mantenere la stabilità finanziaria dell'organizzazione assicurando che i crediti siano raccolti in modo tempestivo.

Responsabilità chiave:

• Valutare le applicazioni di credito del cliente utilizzando modelli di punteggio di credito e analisi finanziaria per determinare il grado di rischio coinvolto nell'estensione del credito

• Analizzare nuovi clienti e consigliare l'accettazione/rigetto per l'installazione nei Dati Master

• Condurre analisi finanziarie approfondite, tra cui la revisione dei bilanci, i rapporti di credito e la cronologia dei pagamenti per impostare e regolare i limiti di credito

• Monitorare e analizzare le esposizioni di credito dei clienti e fare raccomandazioni per minimizzare il rischio e ottimizzare i crediti dei conti

• Collabora a stretto contatto con gli Accountants Senior Credit & Collection, i Project Manager locali, i team di vendita e assistenza clienti per risolvere i problemi di credito e sostenere la crescita aziendale, gestendo i rischi di credito e per affrontare eventuali controversie o problemi che ritardano i pagamenti

• Eseguire le strategie di raccolta per ridurre i giorni di vendite eccezionale (DSO) e migliorare il flusso di cassa

• Impegnarsi con i clienti tramite telefono, e-mail o altri canali di comunicazione per negoziare pagamenti tempestivi e risolvere i crediti in sospeso

• Mantenere registri accurati e aggiornati di tutte le attività relative al credito e alle collezioni, tra cui la revisione del credito, i limiti e i termini

• Comunicare le politiche e le procedure di credito alle parti interessate pertinenti all'interno dell'organizzazione

• Supporta il processo delle collezioni, assicurando pagamenti tempestivi da parte dei clienti

• Preparare rapporti di credito e collezioni e valutazioni dei rischi per la gestione, evidenziando tendenze, potenziali rischi e opportunità di miglioramento

• Sostenere il team OTC e Reporting & Analytics con le attività di chiusura di fine mese, assicurando una reportistica finanziaria accurata e tempestiva relativa al credito e ai conti crediti

• Partecipa a iniziative di miglioramento continuo per migliorare i processi e i sistemi di credito

• Assicurarsi che i controlli interni OTC siano in vigore nel CoE e seguiti per i processi eseguiti da questo ruolo

Requisiti minimi di lavoro/Skillset:

• Laurea in finanza, contabilità, amministrazione aziendale o campo relativo

• Minimo 1-2 anni di esperienza in OTC, analisi del credito, valutazione del rischio o un ruolo simile

• L'esperienza nel settore manifatturiero o industriale è preferita

• Forte comprensione dei principi di analisi finanziaria, di valutazione dei crediti e di gestione dei rischi e dei processi di raccolta

• Competenza nell'analisi del bilancio e nell'interpretazione dei rapporti di credito

• Eccellente analitica, problem solving e competenze decisionali

• Proficiente nei sistemi ERP (rilevante all'unità aziendale; SAP, Microsoft Dynamics 365 o iScala)

• Forte MS Office (Excel, PowerPoint) competenze

• Esperienza con Tagetik e Qlik Sense è un plus

Cosa ti offriamo

• 30 giorni Bonus di Natale (Aguinaldo)

• Fondo di risparmio: 8% corrispondenza mensile

• Piano pensione e riconoscimento degli anziani

• Maggiore assicurazione medica (individuo)

• Assicurazione vita, dentale e visione

• 12 giorni di vacanza per iniziare con un premio di vacanza del 50%

Sulzer ist ein führendes Ingenieurunternehmen mit einem stolzen Erbe an Innovationen. Schließen Sie sich unserem globalen Team an, um Ihr Fachwissen zu erweitern und innovative Lösungen zu entwickeln, die eine prosperierende und nachhaltigere Gesellschaft ermöglichen.

Über die Rolle

Der Order to Cash (OTC) Credit & Collections Coordinator ist verantwortlich für die Bewertung der Kreditwürdigkeit aktueller und potenzieller Kunden und die Beratung bei der Einrichtung neuer Kunden, dem Management des Kreditrisikos und der Unterstützung des gesamten OTC-Prozesses in enger Zusammenarbeit mit den Projektmanagern und Credit Control Managern des Landes. Darüber hinaus ist der Fachmann für die Verwaltung und Durchführung des Inkassoprozesses verantwortlich, um rechtzeitige Zahlungen von Kunden zu gewährleisten, einen gesunden Cashflow aufrechtzuerhalten und das Risiko von Fehlschulden zu minimieren. Der Credit & Collections Accountant wird eine entscheidende Rolle bei der Aufrechterhaltung der finanziellen Stabilität der Organisation spielen, indem er sicherstellt, dass Forderungen rechtzeitig erhoben werden.

Wichtigste Aufgaben:

• Bewerten Sie Kundenkreditanträge mit Kredit-Scoring-Modellen und Finanzanalysen, um den Grad des Risikos bei der Kreditverlängerung zu bestimmen

• Analysieren Sie neue Kunden und beraten Sie bei der Annahme/Ablehnung für die Einrichtung in den Stammdaten

• Durchführung einer gründlichen Finanzanalyse, einschließlich der Überprüfung von Abschlüssen, Kreditberichten und Zahlungshistorie, um Kreditlimits festzulegen und anzupassen

• Überwachen und analysieren Sie die Kreditrisikopositionen von Kunden und geben Sie Empfehlungen zur Minimierung des Risikos und zur Optimierung der Forderungen

• Enge Zusammenarbeit mit den Senior Credit & Collection Accountants, lokalen Projektmanagern, Vertriebs- und Kundenserviceteams, um Kreditprobleme zu lösen und das Geschäftswachstum bei der Verwaltung des Kreditrisikos zu unterstützen sowie Streitigkeiten oder Probleme anzugehen, die Zahlungen verzögern

• Führen Sie Inkassostrategien aus, um Days of Sales Outstanding (DSO) zu reduzieren und den Cashflow zu verbessern

• Engagieren Sie sich mit Kunden über Telefon, E-Mail oder andere Kommunikationskanäle, um rechtzeitige Zahlungen auszuhandeln und offene Forderungen zu lösen

• Pflegen Sie genaue und aktuelle Aufzeichnungen aller Kredit- und Inkassoaktivitäten, einschließlich Kreditprüfung, Limits und Bedingungen

• Kommunikation von Kreditrichtlinien und -verfahren an relevante Stakeholder innerhalb der Organisation

• Unterstützen Sie den Inkassoprozess und gewährleisten Sie rechtzeitige Zahlungen von Kunden

• Erstellung von Kredit- und Inkassoberichten und Risikobewertungen für das Management, wobei Trends, potenzielle Risiken und Verbesserungsmöglichkeiten hervorgehoben werden

• Unterstützen Sie das OTC- und Reporting & Analytics-Team bei den Abschlussaktivitäten zum Monatsende und gewährleisten Sie eine genaue und zeitnahe Finanzberichterstattung in Bezug auf Kredit- und Debitorenkonten

• Teilnahme an kontinuierlichen Verbesserungsinitiativen zur Verbesserung der Kreditprozesse und -systeme

• Sicherstellen, dass interne OTC-Kontrollen im CoE vorhanden sind und für die von dieser Rolle durchgeführten Prozesse befolgt werden

descriptionByLocale.fr:
Sulzer est une entreprise d'ingénierie de premier plan avec un fier héritage d'innovation. Rejoignez notre équipe mondiale pour développer votre expertise et développer des solutions innovantes qui permettent une société prospère et plus durable.

Sur le rôle

Le coordonnateur du crédit et des recouvrements de l'Ordre d'encaissement est chargé d'évaluer la solvabilité des clients actuels et potentiels et de fournir des conseils sur la configuration des nouveaux clients, la gestion du risque de crédit et l'appui au processus global de l'OTC en étroite collaboration avec les gestionnaires de projet et de contrôle du crédit du pays. De plus, le professionnel est responsable de la gestion et de l'exécution du processus de recouvrement afin d'assurer le paiement en temps opportun des clients, de maintenir des flux de trésorerie sains et de réduire le risque de créances douteuses. Le comptable des créances et recouvrements jouera un rôle crucial dans le maintien de la stabilité financière de l'organisation en veillant à ce que les créances soient perçues en temps opportun.

Principales responsabilités :

• Évaluer les demandes de crédit à la clientèle à l'aide de modèles de notation et d'analyse financière pour déterminer le degré de risque associé à l'extension du crédit

• Analyser le nouveau client et conseiller sur l'acceptation/rejection de l'installation dans le Master Data

• Effectuer une analyse financière approfondie, notamment en examinant les états financiers, les rapports de crédit et les antécédents de paiement afin de fixer et d'ajuster les limites de crédit

• Surveiller et analyser les expositions de crédit des clients et faire des recommandations pour minimiser les risques et optimiser les comptes débiteurs

• Collaborer étroitement avec les comptables principaux du crédit et de la perception, les gestionnaires de projet locaux, les équipes de vente et de service à la clientèle pour résoudre les problèmes de crédit et soutenir la croissance des entreprises tout en gérant le risque de crédit ainsi que pour régler les différends ou les problèmes qui retardent les paiements

• Exécuter des stratégies de recouvrement pour réduire les jours de vente en circulation et améliorer les flux de trésorerie

• Faire appel aux clients par téléphone, par courriel ou par d'autres moyens de communication pour négocier les paiements en temps opportun et régler les créances impayées

• Tenir des registres précis et à jour de toutes les activités liées au crédit et aux recouvrements, y compris l'examen du crédit, les limites et les modalités

• Communiquer les politiques et les procédures de crédit aux intervenants pertinents de l'organisation

• Soutenir le processus de collecte, en assurant le paiement en temps opportun des clients

• Préparer des rapports de crédit et de recouvrement et des évaluations des risques pour la gestion, en mettant en évidence les tendances, les risques potentiels et les possibilités d'amélioration

• Appuyer l'équipe du CTO et de l'analyse et des rapports dans les activités de clôture de fin de mois, en veillant à ce que les rapports financiers relatifs au crédit et aux comptes débiteurs soient exacts et opportuns

• Participer à des initiatives d'amélioration continue pour améliorer les processus et les systèmes de crédit

• S'assurer que les contrôles internes de l'OTC sont en place dans le Conseil de l'Europe et suivis pour les processus exécutés par ce rôle

Exigences et compétences minimales en matière d'emploi :

• Diplôme universitaire en finance, comptabilité, administration des affaires ou domaine connexe

• Minimum de 1 à 2 ans d'expérience en CTO, en analyse de crédit, en évaluation des risques ou dans un rôle similaire

• L'expérience dans les secteurs manufacturier ou industriel est privilégiée

• Connaissance approfondie des principes d'analyse financière, de notation et de gestion du risque ainsi que des processus de collecte

• Compétence en analyse des états financiers et en interprétation des rapports de crédit

• Excellente capacité d'analyse, de résolution de problèmes et de prise de décisions

• Compétence en systèmes ERP (pertinents pour votre unité commerciale; SAP, Microsoft Dynamics 365 ou iScala)

• Fortes compétences de MS Office (Excel, PowerPoint)

• Expérience avec Tagetik et Qlik Sense est un plus

Ce que nous vous offrons

• 30 jours Bonus de Noël ( Aguinaldo )

• Caisse d'épargne : 8 % par mois

• Reconnaissance du régime de retraite et de l'ancienneté

• Assurance maladie majeure (individuelle)

• Assurance vie, soins dentaires et assurance vision

• 12 jours de vacances pour commencer avec une prime de 50 %

jobs.title: AP Coordinator
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

We are looking for a dynamic Accounts Payable Coordinator to join our Finance & Accounting team in Polanco, Mexico. This is an exciting opportunity to collaborate with international and external stakeholders, leverage your expertise in accounts payable. If you enjoy creating impact and eager to advance your career within a global and mission-led organization, we want to hear from you! In this position you will be a member of our Accounts Payable Controls team based in our Mexico office. Furthermore, you will closely work other country Finance functions, Procurement, and external vendors.

Key Responsibilities

• Manage escalations in incoming accounts payable related queries from suppliers SULZER CONFIDENTIAL

• Review payment proposals and ensure a complete alignment with the country’s compliance requirements.

• Monitor and control accounts payable aging.

• Assist in the preparation of monthly, quarterly, and annual financial statements according to IFRS.

• Drive process standardization and reduce inefficiencies, acting as a guide for the shared services teams.

• Actively support various projects, such as system implementations and process optimizations.

Skills & Qualifications

• Degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, or related fields

• 4 years of experience in Accounts Payable

• Very good written and verbal communication skills

• Knowledge of ERP systems (preferable SAP or D365)

• Fluent English skills

• Analytical and problem-solving skills

What we offer you

• 30 days Christmas Bonus ( Aguinaldo )

• Savings Fund: 8% monthly matching

• Pension Plan & Seniority Recognition

• Major Medical Insurance (Individual)

• Life, Dental, and Vision Insurance

• 12 days of vacation to start with a 50% vacation premium

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

jobs.title: Lead Repair Engineer
Business Controller
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

The Controller is responsible for supporting the financial integrity of the organization through accurate reporting, compliance, and internal controls. This role involves preparing financial statements, assisting with audits, and ensuring adherence to accounting standards and policies.
This job profile is intended for experienced professionals who apply practical knowledge of a job area and work independently with general supervision. The Business Controller will serve as the primary financial liaison between local manufacturing operations and the Center of Excellence (CoE), ensuring seamless coordination and effective execution of key
financial and project management activities. Also ensure seamless coordination and effective execution of key financial processes.

Key responsibilities:

• Ensure accurate tracking and management of sales and backlogs

• Monitor customer order contract profitability and utilization metrics

• Link strategic plans to operational and financial drivers, aligning sales and operations planning, resource management, capital projects, other expenses, and working capital planning.

• Generate, model, and execute action plans to address performance gaps and improve overall site performance

• Provide business planning, forecasting, and budgeting know how and support to the relevant stakeholders

• Supervision and coordination of tasks with the Coe & BPO team.

• Variance analysis

• Responsible for managing internal reports.

• Support to the Head Office on financial matters.

What you need you to succeed:

• University degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration or related field

• Minimum of 2 years of experience in Controlling

• Proven track record in inventory management, cost control, and project management

• Experience within the manufacturing sectors is preferred

• Strong Knowledge of cost controlling, budgeting, and financial planning

• Excellent communication skills to liaise between local operations, BPO and CoE

• Ability to work effectively with cross-functional teams

• Capacity to remain flexible and effective when facing challenges

• Continuous improvement mindset

• Experience with Tagetik and Qlik Sense is a plus

• Understanding of integrated ERP systems is a plus

• Strong MS Office (Excel, PowerPoint) skills

• Used to work with databases and reporting tools

• Proficiency in English (C1)

What we offer you

• A permanent contract.

• A competitive salary as well as participation in the variable remuneration system based on personal and financial objectives.

• Meal vouchers.

• Access to a voluntary flexible compensation scheme allowing employees to optimize their salary package (e.g. health insurance, transport, childcare)

• Be part of an experienced and international team.

• A Good vibe working environment.

• The opportunity to grow your career within a solid and well-established international company.

• Be part of a dynamic organization undergoing continuous transformation and improvement.

• Offices location: Rivas (Madrid)

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Record to Report accountant
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Accounting Officer is responsible for supporting accounting operations including data entry, reconciliations, and assisting with financial reporting. This role ensures accuracy in financial records and supports compliance with accounting standards. This job profile is intended for early-career professionals who apply broad theoretical knowledge and require the ability to investigate and analyse problems. Solutions are typically discussed/verified with a more senior member. The RTR Senior Accountant in the Center of Excellence (CoE) works in a RTR team assigned to multiple countries, supporting the Record to Report (RTR) teams for example with various ad hoc tasks, complex bookings, or the maintenance of the chart of accounts.

Key responsibilities

• Serve as a member of the RTR team in the CoE, providing support on ad hoc topics and accounting issues

• Support with financial booking activities, ensuring accuracy and compliance with International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS) and Sulzer regulations

• Manage clearing, including reconciliations and adjustments, to maintain accurate financial records

• Utilize advanced knowledge of ERP systems to streamline accounting processes

• Support the Global Process Owner (GPO) with system implementations

• Maintain and update the chart of accounts and hierarchies, ensuring it reflects the current business structure and reporting requirements

• Collaborate closely with local Finance Teams in countries and Finance Shared Services teams / Business Process Outsourcing (BPO) provider

• Coordinate with other departments and the Finance Shared Services teams to ensure all financial transactions are properly accounted for and reflected in the general ledger

• Supports the period end close, including closing the accounts receivable/payable subledger and reconcile with the general ledger; close general ledger, open new financial period, close Asset Accounting (AA)

• Support with the preparation of journal entries, balance sheet reconciliations and variance analysis

• Contribute to the continuous improvement of the RTR process, leveraging technology and best practices; maintain policies, procedures and templates

• Ensure financial internal controls are in place and followed for the processes performed by this role

• Do all technical Year End Closing activities such as balance carry forward, number range creations, close of AA

• Support Intercompany reconciliation process in Coprocess and Tagetik (fix variances)

Education and experience

• University degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration or related field

• Minimum of 2-3 years of experience in Accounting with a strong focus on general ledger and financial reporting

• CPA, ACCA, CMA or equivalent certification preferred

Critical success factors

• Strong analytical, problem-solving and management skills

• Excellent attention to detail and commitment to accuracy and integrity in financial reporting

• Proven ability to manage multiple priorities in a deadline-driven environment

• Strong communication skills for delivering key insights to senior leadership

Technical & language skills

• Proficient in ERP systems (relevant to your business unit; SAP, Microsoft Dynamics 365 or iScala) and accounting software

• Strong MS Office (Excel, PowerPoint) skills

• Experience with Tagetik, Coprocess and Qlik Sense is a plus

• Proficiency in English

Interfaces with

• Accounting teams

• Reporting & Analytics team

• Local Accounting Managers

• Country Finance Heads

• RTR GPO

• External stakeholders (i.e. auditors, tax authorities etc.)

What we offer you

Medical insurance for self and family
Company sponsored transportation facility during week days

About the role

Job Summary
The Accounting Officer is responsible for supporting accounting operations including data entry, reconciliations, and assisting with financial reporting. This role ensures accuracy in financial records and supports compliance with accounting standards. This job profile is intended for early-career professionals who apply broad theoretical knowledge and require the ability to investigate and analyse problems. Solutions are typically discussed/verified with a more senior member. The RTR Senior Accountant in the Center of Excellence (CoE) works in a RTR team assigned to multiple countries, supporting the Record to Report (RTR) teams for example with various ad hoc tasks, complex bookings, or the maintenance of the chart of accounts.

Key responsibilities

• Serve as a member of the RTR team in the CoE, providing support on ad hoc topics and accounting issues

• Support with financial booking activities, ensuring accuracy and compliance with International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS) and Sulzer regulations

• Manage clearing, including reconciliations and adjustments, to maintain accurate financial records

• Utilize advanced knowledge of ERP systems to streamline accounting processes

• Support the Global Process Owner (GPO) with system implementations

• Maintain and update the chart of accounts and hierarchies, ensuring it reflects the current business structure and reporting requirements

• Collaborate closely with local Finance Teams in countries and Finance Shared Services teams / Business Process Outsourcing (BPO) provider

• Coordinate with other departments and the Finance Shared Services teams to ensure all financial transactions are properly accounted for and reflected in the general ledger

• Supports the period end close, including closing the accounts receivable/payable subledger and reconcile with the general ledger; close general ledger, open new financial period, close Asset Accounting (AA)

• Support with the preparation of journal entries, balance sheet reconciliations and variance analysis

• Contribute to the continuous improvement of the RTR process, leveraging technology and best practices; maintain policies, procedures and templates

• Ensure financial internal controls are in place and followed for the processes performed by this role

• Do all technical Year End Closing activities such as balance carry forward, number range creations, close of AA

• Support Intercompany reconciliation process in Coprocess and Tagetik (fix variances)

Education and experience

• University degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration or related field

• Minimum of 2-3 years of experience in Accounting with a strong focus on general ledger and financial reporting

• CPA, ACCA, CMA or equivalent certification preferred

Critical success factors

• Strong analytical, problem-solving and management skills

• Excellent attention to detail and commitment to accuracy and integrity in financial reporting

• Proven ability to manage multiple priorities in a deadline-driven environment

• Strong communication skills for delivering key insights to senior leadership

Technical & language skills

• Proficient in ERP systems (relevant to your business unit; SAP, Microsoft Dynamics 365 or iScala) and accounting software

• Strong MS Office (Excel, PowerPoint) skills

• Proficiency in English

jobs.title: ServiceNow Development Lead

titleByLocale.fr: Chef de file du développement ServiceNow

jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Sulzer is transforming its IT operating model to better meet business needs and achieve operational excellence. The ServiceNow Development Lead is a key role within the IT Service Management function, responsible for the technical leadership, governance, and delivery of development activities on the ServiceNow platform.

The role ensures that ServiceNow solutions are designed and built in a scalable, secure, and upgrade‑safe manner, aligned with platform strategy, enterprise architecture, and business priorities. Acting as the technical lead for ServiceNow development, the incumbent provides hands‑on expertise, sets development standards, mentors internal developers, and ensures high‑quality delivery across ITSM and other ServiceNow capabilities. Main Tasks and Responsibilities

• Provide technical leadership and end to end ownership of ServiceNow development activities across the platform. ‑to‑end ownership of ServiceNow development activities across the platform.

• Translate functional and business requirements into robust technical designs, ensuring alignment with ServiceNow best practices and platform strategy.

• Define, implement, and enforce development standards, guidelines, and guardrails (coding standards, scoped applications, update set management, CI/CD, documentation).

• Lead solution design for ServiceNow customizations, configurations, integrations, and automation, ensuring upgrade safety and long-term maintainability. ‑term maintainability.

• Act as the technical authority for ServiceNow development, performing design and code reviews to ensure quality and consistency.

• Guide and mentor internal ServiceNow developers and administrators, supporting capability building and knowledge sharing.

• Coordinate and oversee development work delivered by external partners, ensuring adherence to Sulzer standards and quality expectations.

• Collaborate closely with ServiceNow platform owners, product owners, process owners, architects, and ITSM stakeholders.

• Ensure effective use of ServiceNow platform capabilities, promoting “configuration over customization” and reuse of standard functionality.

• Own the technical lifecycle of developments across environments (development, test, production), supporting release and deployment activities.

• Support integration design and implementation (REST, APIs, middleware, MID Server), ensuring reliable and secure data exchange.

• Monitor and continuously improve platform performance, stability, and technical debt.

• Maintain technical documentation, design artefacts, and development of runbooks.

• Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives, automation, and innovation across IT Service Management and adjacent domains.

To Succeed in This Role, You Will Need:

• 5+ years of hands-on experience with ServiceNow development in large, complex enterprise environments. ‑on experience with ServiceNow development in large, complex enterprise environments.

• ServiceNow certifications (e.g., Certified System Administrator, Certified Application Developer, CIS certifications).

• Proven experience in a technical lead or senior developer role, guiding development teams and delivery (internal and external).

• Strong expertise in ServiceNow development and configuration, including:

• JavaScript (server‑side and client‑side)

• Business Rules, Script Includes, UI Policies, Client Scripts

• Flow Designer and IntegrationHub

• Service Portal / UI Builder

• ACLs, data policies, and security model

• PowerShell scripting

• Solid experience with ServiceNow ITSM, CSM, SPM; exposure to additional modules (ITOM, ITAM, HRSD) is an advantage.

• Experience designing and managing integrations using REST/SOAP APIs and MID Servers.

• Strong understanding of Servi

jobs.title: Field Service Technician Pumps (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

As a Field Service Technician, you will be responsible for the installation, commissioning, maintenance and repair of pump systems both at customer sites and in the workshop. Working in a hands-on environment, you will ensure reliable operation of equipment, support troubleshooting activities and contribute to high service quality and customer satisfaction. This role requires a practical mindset, technical expertise and a strong commitment to safety, as well as the flexibility to work across different locations and applications.
Key Responsibilities

• Installation, commissioning, maintenance and repair of pumps and associated equipment at customer sites as well as in the workshop

• Disassembly, inspection and reassembly of machinery based on defined work scopes or independently in case of unplanned repairs or troubleshooting

• Execution of work in line with specified tolerances and manufacturer guidelines or established engineering standards

• Performing safety assessments at the worksite (e.g. when changing activities)

• On-site activities including coordination and supervision of customer-provided personnel when required

• Preparation of service and repair reports as well as required documentation after completion of work

• Ensuring compliance with health, safety and environmental standards – both internally and at customer sites

Your Profile

• Experience in installation, commissioning and maintenance of pumps and associated equipment

• Hands-on experience in assembly, repair and testing of machinery – ideally also in a workshop environment

• Good command of English and confident use of common IT tools

• Independent, structured and solution-oriented way of working

• Strong customer and service orientation

• Flexible and adaptable with willingness to travel

• Team player with good communication skills and a confident presence on site

• Ideally VCA certification and initial experience in supervising or guiding others

What we offer you

• 8% holiday allowance and up to 40 days of annual leave

• A solid pension scheme with attractive employer contribution

• Travel allowance for commuting (EUR 0.23/km, tax-free)

• Free coffee, tea and water , plus access to an on-site canteen with fresh and affordable meals

• Free parking on-site

• Employee benefit programs such as Bike leasing with tax advantages and Gym contribution

• A staff association offering social activities and seasonal gifts

• Training and development opportunities aligned with your role and personal development plan

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.
