jobs.title: Credit & Collections Accountant
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Accounting Officer is responsible for supporting accounting operations including data entry, reconciliations, and assisting with financial reporting. This role ensures accuracy in financial records and supports compliance with accounting standards. This job profile is intended for early-career professionals who apply broad theoretical knowledge and require the ability to investigate and analyse problems. Solutions are typically discussed/verified with a more senior member. The Order to Cash (OTC) Credit & Collections Accountant is responsible for assessing the creditworthiness of current and potential customers and advice on the setup of new customers, managing credit risk, and supporting the overall OTC process in close collaboration with the country Project Managers and Credit Control Managers. Moreover, the professional is responsible for managing and executing the collections process to ensure timely payments from customers, maintaining healthy cash flow and minimizing risk of bad debts. The Credit & Collections Accountant will play a crucial role in maintaining financial stability of the organization by ensuring that receivables are collected in a timely manner

Key responsibilities

• Evaluate customer credit applications using credit scoring models and financial analysis to determine the degree of risk involved in extending the credit

• Analyze new customer and advise on the acceptance/rejection for the setup in the Master Data

• Conduct thorough financial analysis, including reviewing financial statements, credit reports and payment history to set and adjust credit limits

• Monitor and analyze customers’ credit exposures and make recommendations to minimize risk and optimize accounts receivables

• Collaborate closely with the Senior Credit & Collection Accountants, local Project Managers, sales and customer service teams to resolve credit issues and support business growth while managing credit risk as well as to address any disputes or issues that delay payments

• Execute collections strategies to reduce Days of Sales Outstanding (DSO) and improve cash flow

• Engage with customers via phone, email or other communication channels to negotiate timely payments and resolve outstanding receivables

• Maintain accurate and up-to-date records of all credit & collections-related activities, including credit review, limits and terms

• Communicate credit policies and procedures to relevant stakeholders within the organization

• Support the collections process, ensuring timely payments from customers

• Prepare credit & collections reports and risk assessments for management, highlighting trends, potential risks and opportunities for improvement

• Support the OTC and Reporting & Analytics team with the month-end closing activities, ensuring accurate and timely financial reporting related to credit and accounts receivable

• Participate in continuous improvement initiatives to enhance credit processes and systems

• Ensure OTC internal controls are in place in the CoE and followed for the processes performed by this role

Education and experience

• University degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration or related field

• Minimum of 1-2 years of experience in OTC, credit analysis, risk assessment or a similar role

• Experience within the manufacturing or industrial sectors is preferred

Critical success factors

• Strong understanding of financial analysis, credit scoring, and risk management principles as well as the collection processes

• Proficiency in financial statement analysis and interpreting credit reports

• Excellent analytical, problem-solving and decision-making skills

• Excellent communication skills for delivering key insights to i.e. CoE Accounting Mana

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sulzer è una società di ingegneria leader con un patrimonio orgoglioso di innovazione. Unisciti al nostro team globale per accrescere le tue competenze e sviluppare soluzioni innovative che consentano una società prospera e più sostenibile. Informazioni sul ruolo Sintesi del lavoro L'Accounting Officer è responsabile del supporto alle operazioni contabili, tra cui l'ingresso dei dati, la riconciliazione e l'assistenza alla rendicontazione finanziaria. Questo ruolo garantisce l'accuratezza nei registri finanziari e supporta il rispetto degli standard contabili. Questo profilo di lavoro è destinato a professionisti precoci che applicano una vasta conoscenza teorica e richiedono la capacità di indagare e analizzare i problemi. Le soluzioni sono tipicamente discusse/verificati con un membro più anziano. L'Accountant Order to Cash (OTC) Credit & Collections è responsabile della valutazione dell'affidabilità creditizia dei clienti attuali e potenziali e della consulenza sulla configurazione di nuovi clienti, sulla gestione del rischio di credito e sul supporto del processo OTC complessivo in stretta collaborazione con i Project Managers e i Credit Control Managers del paese. Inoltre, il professionista è responsabile della gestione e dell'esecuzione del processo di raccolta per garantire pagamenti tempestivi da parte dei clienti, mantenendo un flusso di cassa sano e riducendo al minimo il rischio di debiti cattivi. Il Credit & Collections Accountant svolgerà un ruolo cruciale nel mantenere la stabilità finanziaria dell'organizzazione assicurando che i crediti siano raccolti in modo tempestivo Responsabilità chiave
• Valutare le applicazioni di credito del cliente utilizzando modelli di punteggio di credito e analisi finanziaria per determinare il grado di rischio coinvolto nell'estensione del credito
• Analizzare nuovi clienti e consigliare l'accettazione/rigetto per l'installazione nei Dati Master
• Condurre analisi finanziarie approfondite, tra cui la revisione dei bilanci, i rapporti di credito e la cronologia dei pagamenti per impostare e regolare i limiti di credito
• Monitorare e analizzare le esposizioni di credito dei clienti e fare raccomandazioni per minimizzare il rischio e ottimizzare i crediti dei conti
• Collabora a stretto contatto con gli Accountants Senior Credit & Collection, i Project Manager locali, i team di vendita e assistenza clienti per risolvere i problemi di credito e sostenere la crescita aziendale, gestendo i rischi di credito e per affrontare eventuali controversie o problemi che ritardano i pagamenti
• Eseguire le strategie di raccolta per ridurre i giorni di vendite eccezionale (DSO) e migliorare il flusso di cassa
• Impegnarsi con i clienti tramite telefono, e-mail o altri canali di comunicazione per negoziare pagamenti tempestivi e risolvere i crediti in sospeso
• Mantenere registri accurati e aggiornati di tutte le attività relative al credito e alle collezioni, tra cui la revisione del credito, i limiti e i termini
• Comunicare le politiche e le procedure di credito alle parti interessate pertinenti all'interno dell'organizzazione
• Supporta il processo delle collezioni, assicurando pagamenti tempestivi da parte dei clienti
• Preparare rapporti di credito e collezioni e valutazioni dei rischi per la gestione, evidenziando tendenze, potenziali rischi e opportunità di miglioramento
• Sostenere il team OTC e Reporting & Analytics con le attività di chiusura di fine mese, assicurando una reportistica finanziaria accurata e tempestiva relativa al credito e ai conti crediti
• Partecipa a iniziative di miglioramento continuo per migliorare i processi e i sistemi di credito
• Assicurarsi che i controlli interni OTC siano in vigore nel CoE e seguiti per i processi eseguiti da questo ruolo Istruzione ed esperienza
• Laurea in finanza, contabilità, amministrazione aziendale o campo relativo
• Minimo 1-2 anni di esperienza in OTC, analisi del credito, valutazione del rischio o un ruolo simile
• L'esperienza nel settore manifatturiero o industriale è preferita Fattori di successo critici
• Forte comprensione dei principi di analisi finanziaria, di valutazione dei crediti e di gestione dei rischi e dei processi di raccolta
• Competenza nell'analisi del bilancio e nell'interpretazione dei rapporti di credito
• Eccellente analitica, problem solving e competenze decisionali
• Eccellente capacità di comunicazione per fornire informazioni chiave a CoE Accounting Mana

Rejoignez notre équipe mondiale pour développer votre expertise et développer des solutions innovantes qui permettent une société prospère et plus durable. Sur le rôle Résumé de l'emploi Le comptable est chargé d'appuyer les opérations comptables, y compris la saisie des données, les rapprochements et l'établissement de rapports financiers. Ce rôle assure l'exactitude des documents financiers et appuie la conformité aux normes comptables. Ce profil d'emploi est destiné aux professionnels en début de carrière qui appliquent de vastes connaissances théoriques et qui ont besoin de la capacité d'étudier et d'analyser les problèmes. Les solutions sont généralement discutées/vérifiées avec un membre plus âgé. Le comptable de l'Ordre d'encaisser (OTC) est chargé d'évaluer la solvabilité des clients actuels et potentiels et de fournir des conseils sur la configuration de nouveaux clients, la gestion du risque de crédit et l'appui au processus global de l'OTC en étroite collaboration avec les gestionnaires de projet et de contrôle du crédit du pays. De plus, le professionnel est responsable de la gestion et de l'exécution du processus de recouvrement afin d'assurer le paiement en temps opportun des clients, de maintenir des flux de trésorerie sains et de réduire le risque de créances douteuses. Le comptable des créances et recouvrements jouera un rôle crucial dans le maintien de la stabilité financière de l'organisation en veillant à ce que les créances soient perçues en temps opportun. Principales responsabilités
• Évaluer les demandes de crédit à la clientèle à l'aide de modèles de notation et d'analyse financière pour déterminer le degré de risque associé à l'extension du crédit
• Analyser le nouveau client et conseiller sur l'acceptation/rejection de l'installation dans le Master Data
• Effectuer une analyse financière approfondie, notamment en examinant les états financiers, les rapports de crédit et les antécédents de paiement afin de fixer et d'ajuster les limites de crédit
• Surveiller et analyser les expositions de crédit des clients et faire des recommandations pour minimiser les risques et optimiser les comptes débiteurs
• Collaborer étroitement avec les comptables principaux du crédit et de la perception, les gestionnaires de projet locaux, les équipes de vente et de service à la clientèle pour résoudre les problèmes de crédit et soutenir la croissance des entreprises tout en gérant le risque de crédit ainsi que pour régler les différends ou les problèmes qui retardent les paiements
• Exécuter des stratégies de recouvrement pour réduire les jours de vente en circulation et améliorer les flux de trésorerie
• Faire appel aux clients par téléphone, par courriel ou par d'autres moyens de communication pour négocier les paiements en temps opportun et régler les créances impayées
• Tenir des registres précis et à jour de toutes les activités liées au crédit et aux recouvrements, y compris l'examen du crédit, les limites et les modalités

• Préparer des rapports de crédit et de recouvrement et des évaluations des risques pour la gestion, en mettant en évidence les tendances, les risques potentiels et les possibilités d'amélioration
• Appuyer l'équipe du CTO et de l'analyse et des rapports dans les activités de clôture de fin de mois, en veillant à ce que les rapports financiers relatifs au crédit et aux comptes débiteurs soient exacts et opportuns
• Participer à des initiatives d'amélioration continue pour améliorer les processus et les systèmes de crédit
• S'assurer que les contrôles internes de l'OTC sont en place dans le Conseil de l'Europe et suivis pour les processus exécutés par ce rôle Éducation et expérience
• Diplôme universitaire en finance, comptabilité, administration des affaires ou domaine connexe
• Minimum de 1 à 2 ans d'expérience en CTO, en analyse de crédit, en évaluation des risques ou dans un rôle similaire
• L'expérience dans les secteurs manufacturier ou industriel est privilégiée Facteurs de succès essentiels
• Connaissance approfondie des principes d'analyse financière, de notation et de gestion du risque ainsi que des processus de collecte
• Compétence en analyse des états financiers et en interprétation des rapports de crédit
• Excellente capacité d'analyse, de résolution de problèmes et de prise de décisions
• Excellentes compétences en communication pour fournir des idées clés à Mana, la comptabilité du Conseil de l'Europe

jobs.title: Mechanic
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Machinery Mechanic is responsible for performing routine maintenance and minor repairs on industrial machinery to ensure smooth and safe operations. This role supports the maintenance team by identifying mechanical issues and assisting in equipment upkeep.
This job profile is intended for support staff that follows established procedures and works under close supervision. DUTIES

• Read job cards to determine; job status, work authorization/limitations, estimate, description of problems and/or expected serviceability.

• Test electro-mechanical equipment to troubleshoot known or suspected problems using various methods (ac or de).

• Disassemble electro-mechanical equipment noting parts identifications, configuration and condition.

• Clean electro-mechanical equipment assemblies as needed using various methods and steps, including but not limited to: parts washer/steamers, caustic tanks, glass beaders, etc.

• Measure for or note proper replacement parts. Correctly requisition needed items from storekeeper, as approved by supervisor.

• Replace or repair worn or defective mechanical or electro-mechanical assemblies, including but not limited to: bearings, brushes, brush holders, motors leads gears seals, impellers, mechanical switches, brakes clutches, clutch rotors, tachs, fans, end shield,, etc.

• Retest reassembled electro-mechanical equipment for proper output and operation.

• Complete required paperwork for each job accurately and on a timely basis.

• Operate specialized repair and testing equipment and other equipment as needed

• Observe all safety procedures and use proper protective gear (especially eye and car protection).

• Lift, tighten, adjust and/or secure heavy objects in order to perform work duties.

• Keep work area neat and clean as directed by supervisor.

• Assisted other mechanics or other shop personnel in skilled or –non-skilled duties as directed by supervisor or shop manager.

• Perform other skilled or not-skilled duties as directed by supervisor

QUALIFICATIONS

• High school diploma or equivalent

• Basic mechanical aptitude

• Ability to understand, perform and retain various skill related training and operational and safety procedures demonstrated by supervisor.

PHYSICAL DEMANDS

• While performing duties of this job, would occasionally be required to stand, walk, sit, reach with hands and arms, climb or balance, stoop or kneel, talk and hear, and use fingers and hands to feel objects.

• Ability to lift and/or move up to 50 pounds

What we offer you

• Paid parental leave

• Parental leave

• Health insurance

• 401(k) matching

• Paid time off

• Vision insurance

• Health savings account

• Dental insurance

• Gym membership

• Employee assistance program

• Disability insurance

• 401(k) 6% Match

• Paid holidays

• Wellness program

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

• Esegui altri compiti qualificati o non qualificati, diretti dal supervisore QUALIFICA

Sulzer ist ein führendes Ingenieurunternehmen mit einem stolzen Erbe an Innovationen. Schließen Sie sich unserem globalen Team an, um Ihr Fachwissen zu erweitern und innovative Lösungen zu entwickeln, die eine prosperierende und nachhaltigere Gesellschaft ermöglichen. Über die Rolle Stellenbeschreibung Der Maschinenmechaniker ist für die routinemäßige Wartung und kleinere Reparaturen an Industriemaschinen verantwortlich, um einen reibungslosen und sicheren Betrieb zu gewährleisten. Diese Rolle unterstützt das Wartungsteam, indem es mechanische Probleme identifiziert und die Wartung der Ausrüstung unterstützt. Dieses Stellenprofil richtet sich an Support-Mitarbeiter, die etablierte Verfahren befolgen und unter strenger Aufsicht arbeiten. ZÖLLE
• Lesen Sie Jobkarten, um zu bestimmen; Jobstatus, Arbeitserlaubnis / Einschränkungen, Schätzung, Beschreibung von Problemen und / oder erwartete Bedienbarkeit.
• Testen Sie elektromechanische Geräte, um bekannte oder vermutete Probleme mit verschiedenen Methoden (ac oder de) zu beheben.
• Demontage der elektromechanischen Ausrüstung unter Angabe der Teileidentifikation, Konfiguration und Zustand.
• Elektromechanische Geräte nach Bedarf mit verschiedenen Methoden und Schritten reinigen, einschließlich, aber nicht beschränkt auf: Teile Waschmaschine/Dämpfer, Ätzbehälter, Glasperlen usw.
• Maß für oder Notiz richtige Ersatzteile. Richtig Requisition benötigte Artikel vom Lagerinhaber, wie vom Vorgesetzten genehmigt.
• Ersatz oder Reparatur verschlissener oder defekter mechanischer oder elektromechanischer Baugruppen, einschließlich, aber nicht beschränkt auf: Lager, Bürsten, Bürstenhalter, Motorräder, Dichtungen, Laufräder, mechanische Schalter, Bremskupplungen, Kupplungsrotoren, Lenker, Ventilatoren, Lagerschild usw.
• Wieder zusammengebaute elektromechanische Ausrüstung für den ordnungsgemäßen Ausgang und Betrieb.
• Füllen Sie die erforderlichen Unterlagen für jeden Auftrag genau und rechtzeitig aus.
• Betrieb von spezialisierten Reparatur- und Prüfgeräten und anderen Geräten nach Bedarf
• Befolgen Sie alle Sicherheitsverfahren und verwenden Sie die richtige Schutzausrüstung (insbesondere Augen- und Autoschutz).
• Heben, straffen, justieren und/oder sichern Sie schwere Gegenstände, um Arbeitsaufgaben zu erfüllen.
• Halten Sie den Arbeitsbereich sauber und sauber, wie vom Vorgesetzten angeordnet.
• Unterstützte andere Mechaniker oder anderes Ladenpersonal in qualifizierten oder nicht qualifizierten Aufgaben, wie vom Vorgesetzten oder Ladenleiter angewiesen.
• Führen Sie andere qualifizierte oder nicht qualifizierte Aufgaben aus, wie vom Vorgesetzten angewiesen QUALIFIKATIONEN
• Schulabschluss oder gleichwertiges Diplom
• Grundlegende mechanische Eignung
• Fähigkeit, verschiedene fähigkeitsbezogene Schulungen und Betriebs- und Sicherheitsverfahren zu verstehen, durchzuführen und beizubehalten, die von der Aufsichtskraft nachgewiesen werden. Physische Forderungen
• Während der Ausführung von Aufgaben dieses Jobs, würde gelegentlich erforderlich sein, zu stehen, zu gehen, zu sitzen, mit Händen und Armen zu erreichen, zu klettern oder zu balancieren, sich zu beugen oder zu knien, zu sprechen und zu hören und Finger und Hände zu benutzen, um Objekte zu fühlen.

Sur le rôle Résumé de l'emploi Le mécanicien de machines est responsable de l'entretien de routine et des réparations mineures sur les machines industrielles afin d'assurer un fonctionnement en douceur et en sécurité. Ce rôle appuie l'équipe d'entretien en identifiant les problèmes mécaniques et en aidant à l'entretien du matériel. Ce profil d'emploi est destiné au personnel de soutien qui suit les procédures établies et travaille sous étroite supervision. DROITS

• Remplir les documents requis pour chaque emploi avec exactitude et en temps opportun.

• Observer toutes les procédures de sécurité et utiliser un équipement de protection approprié (surtout la protection des yeux et des voitures).
• Soulevez, serrez, ajustez et/ou sécurisez des objets lourds afin d'effectuer des tâches de travail.
• Garder l'aire de travail propre et propre conformément aux directives du superviseur.
• Il a aidé d'autres mécaniciens ou d'autres membres du personnel d'atelier à accomplir des tâches qualifiées ou non, conformément aux directives du superviseur ou du directeur d'atelier.

• Diplôme d'études secondaires ou équivalent
• Aptitude mécanique de base
• Capacité de comprendre, d'exécuter et de conserver diverses formations et procédures opérationnelles et de sécurité liées aux compétences démontrées par le superviseur. DEMANDES PHYSIQUES

About the role

Job Summary

The Machinery Mechanic is responsible for performing routine maintenance and minor repairs on industrial machinery to ensure smooth and safe operations. This role supports the maintenance team by identifying mechanical issues and assisting in equipment upkeep.
This job profile is intended for support staff that follows established procedures and works under close supervision. o Test electro-mechanical equipment to troubleshoot known or suspected problems using various methods (ac or de).
• o Disassemble electro-mechanical equipment noting parts identifications, configuration and condition.

• o Operate specialized repair and testing equipment and other equipment as needed
• o Observe all safety procedures and use proper protective gear (especially eye and car protection).
• o Lift, tighten, adjust and/or secure heavy objects in order to perform work duties.

• o Assisted other mechanics or other shop personnel in skilled or –non-skilled duties as directed by supervisor or shop manager.

jobs.title: Final Inspection Lead
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

At Sulzer, we don't just manufacture pumps—we engineer and build critical equipment that keeps vital industries moving across the globe. From power generation and water infrastructure to energy, chemicals and industrial processing, our pumps are trusted in some of the world's most demanding applications. Our Leeds facility is one of Sulzer's flagship pump manufacturing centres, combining decades of engineering expertise with modern manufacturing technology following significant investment and refurbishment.

We're looking for an experienced Final Inspection Lead to join our recently refurbished, state-of-the-art manufacturing facility in Leeds, where you'll play a pivotal role in ensuring every pump package leaves our site meeting the highest standards of quality, safety and customer satisfaction. This is not a typical inspection role. You'll be working alongside teams who design, manufacture, assemble and test some of the largest and most technically advanced pumps in the industry. Some of our products weigh up to 150 tonnes, requiring exceptional coordination, precision and engineering excellence to take them from concept to customer delivery. What You'll Be Doing

• Leading final inspection activities for complete pump packages and rotating equipment.

• Coordinating the final assembly verification process before customer dispatch.

• Reviewing and approving final manufacturing records and quality documentation.

• Ensuring products comply with ISO 9001 standards and internal quality requirements.

• Verifying that all customer specifications, technical requirements and contractual obligations have been fulfilled.

• Overseeing and signing off complete pump packages and bareshaft assemblies.

• Working closely with Manufacturing, Engineering, Project Management and Quality teams to resolve issues and ensure on-time delivery.

• Supporting customer inspections and witness activities where required.

• Driving a culture of quality, accountability and continuous improvement across the operation.

What We're Looking For

• Experience within heavy engineering, rotating equipment, pumps, turbines, motors or similar manufacturing environments.

• Strong understanding of final inspection, quality assurance and documentation control processes.

• Knowledge of ISO 9001 quality management systems.

• Ability to interpret engineering drawings, specifications and manufacturing documentation.

• Experience coordinating inspections involving large, complex engineered products.

• Excellent communication and organisational skills.

• A proactive approach with the confidence to make critical quality decisions.

What we offer you

Core Benefits

• A competitive salary

• A company wide bonus scheme

• 33 days’ holiday

• You will be eligible to join the Company’s Medicash health cash plan, which allows you to claim back the cost of everyday healthcare expenses such as dental, optical and GP services.

• Defined pension contribution

• Employee Assistance Programmes

• Discounts on shopping, entertainment & lifestyle

• Costco membership option

• Discounted personal car leasing for you, family & friends

• Long Service Awards

• Ongoing learning through Sulzer Learning Pathways

• Armed Forces Support – As a Silver Award holder of the MoD Defence Employer Recognition Scheme, we actively support veterans, reservists and Cadet Adult Volunteers. This includes policies that enable time for training, camps and deployment, alongside access to a growing internal military network.

Onsite Perks

• Free, secure parking with EV charging

• Multi-faith prayer room

• Newly modernised work areas

• Community & Wellbeing

• Lively Sports & Social Club with events & prize draws

• 24/7 onsite gym

• Subsidised vending machines

Sulzer è una società di ingegneria leader con un patrimonio orgoglioso di innovazione. Unisciti al nostro team globale per accrescere le tue competenze e sviluppare soluzioni innovative che consentano una società prospera e più sostenibile. Informazioni sul ruolo A Sulzer, non produciamo solo pompe: progettiamo e costruiamo attrezzature critiche che mantengono industrie vitali in movimento in tutto il mondo. Dalla produzione di energia e dalle infrastrutture idriche all'energia, ai prodotti chimici e alla lavorazione industriale, le nostre pompe sono affidabili in alcune delle applicazioni più esigenti del mondo. La nostra struttura Leeds è uno dei centri di produzione di pompe di punta di Sulzer, che combina decenni di esperienza ingegneristica con la moderna tecnologia di produzione a seguito di significativi investimenti e ristrutturazione. Siamo alla ricerca di un'esperta struttura di produzione di Leeds, dove potrai svolgere un ruolo fondamentale nel garantire che ogni pacchetto di pompe lasci il nostro sito rispettando i più elevati standard di qualità, sicurezza e soddisfazione del cliente. Questo non è un tipico ruolo di ispezione. Potrai lavorare insieme a team che progettano, producono, assemblano e testano alcune delle più grandi e più tecnicamente avanzate pompe del settore. Alcuni dei nostri prodotti pesano fino a 150 tonnellate, richiedendo un coordinamento eccezionale, precisione e eccellenza ingegneristica per portarli dal concetto alla consegna del cliente. Cosa farai

• Coordinamento del processo di verifica del montaggio finale prima dell'invio del cliente.
• Revisione e approvazione dei record di produzione finali e documentazione di qualità.
• Garantire i prodotti conformi agli standard ISO 9001 e ai requisiti di qualità interna.
• Verificare che siano state soddisfatte tutte le specifiche del cliente, i requisiti tecnici e gli obblighi contrattuali.
• Sorvegliare e firmare pacchetti di pompa completa e assemblaggi a albero nudo.
• Lavorare a stretto contatto con i team Manufacturing, Engineering, Project Management e Quality per risolvere i problemi e garantire la consegna in tempo reale.
• Sostenere le ispezioni dei clienti e le attività di testimone ove necessario.

• Esperienza all'interno di ingegneria pesante, attrezzature rotanti, pompe, turbine, motori o ambienti di produzione simili.
• Forte comprensione dei processi di controllo finale, garanzia della qualità e controllo della documentazione.
• Conoscenza dei sistemi di gestione della qualità ISO 9001.
• Capacità di interpretare disegni di ingegneria, specifiche e documentazione di fabbricazione.
• Esperienza di coordinamento ispezioni che coinvolgono prodotti di grandi dimensioni e complessi ingegnerizzati.

jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
Responsible for achieving revenue (new unit & service) and pricing quality objectives for a given territory on a quarterly basis through strategic and tactical management of the representative/distribution firms within the given geography, through active management of existing partners and upgrading to new partners, when appropriate. The strategy must address the motivation factors, investment (staffing & activity level versus other lines) and competency (training and willingness) of the representative firms. The tactical aspect of the position includes directing and attending field appointments at wastewater plants and engineering firms, hosting regional training/sales meetings and understanding requirements to win opportunities. This person must be respected as a peer-level by representative firms’ principles and seen as adding value when in the field. Principle Duties and Responsibilities:

• Positively impact representative behavior and hold themselves and the representative firm accountable to the agreed upon forecast.

• Develop internal and external relationships to create an atmosphere of comradery, influence and accountability.

• Hold strategic monthly meetings with the principles of the representative firms to discuss MTD and YTD performance, as well as expected performance for the coming months. Document meetings and develop action plans, where appropriate. Follow-up on action items and counsel firms, where appropriate.

• Develop budgets and strategic plans with the representative firms to achieve objectives

• Develop a pipeline of prospects large enough to support revenue expectations. Directs representative firms’ activity and supports accordingly through internal resources.

• Assess market trends that affect JWC’s current products or future opportunities in order to drive innovation

• Thoroughly understands all of JWC’s products and is seen as an expert

• Provides timely feedback to senior management regarding market performance, representative firm performance and potential opportunities or threats during the weekly sales meetings and updates the CRM accordingly

• Coordinate complete resolution of customer service issues that rise to the level of this position because of size, pervasiveness or egregiousness

• Represent the Company at selected regional and national trade shows and conferences by driving leads

• Maintain a professional image as a representative of the Company

• Performs other duties and special projects as assigned.

Experience, Education & Skills:

• Bachelor’s Degree

• History of consistently achieving revenue targets through representative and distribution firms

• 5+ years of experience in municipal wastewater equipment sales

• Ability to speak intelligently about JWC products, services and company

• Must be able to travel 50%-75% of the time

• Ability to hold monthly performance meetings and hold under-performers accountable

• Strong interpersonal personal skills

• High degree of likeability to drive rep firm openness and partnering

• Expert organizational and time management skills

• Ability to use technology and analysis tools (CRM, Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Outlook, etc.),

• Self-driven and entrepreneurial with a high sense of urgency and responsiveness

• Ability to be able to work out of a home satellite office effectively

What we offer you

• 15 days of paid time off and 12 company-paid holidays

• 401k plan with a 6% match

• Comprehensive health plan including medical, dental, vision, Life, short-term & long-term disability

• Health savings account matching

• Motivating wellness program

• Employee Assistance Program

• Paid paternal leave

• Gym reimbursement

Sulzer è una società di ingegneria leader con un patrimonio orgoglioso di innovazione. Unisciti al nostro team globale per accrescere le tue competenze e sviluppare soluzioni innovative che consentano una società prospera e più sostenibile.

Informazioni sul ruolo

Sintesi del lavoro
Responsabile del raggiungimento dei ricavi (nuove unità e servizi) e degli obiettivi di qualità dei prezzi per un determinato territorio su base trimestrale attraverso la gestione strategica e tattica delle imprese rappresentative/distribuzioni all'interno della data geografia, attraverso la gestione attiva dei partner esistenti e l'aggiornamento a nuovi partner, se del caso. La strategia deve affrontare i fattori di motivazione, gli investimenti (livello di lavoro e di attività rispetto ad altre linee) e la competenza (formazione e disponibilità) delle imprese rappresentative. L'aspetto tattico della posizione comprende la regia e la presenza di appuntamenti sul campo presso impianti di acque reflue e aziende di ingegneria, ospitando incontri di formazione/vendita regionali e requisiti di comprensione per vincere opportunità. Questa persona deve essere rispettata come un livello paritario dai principi delle imprese rappresentative e vista come valore aggiunto quando nel settore. Duties e responsabilità del principio:

• Positivamente impatto comportamento rappresentativo e tenere se stessi e l'azienda rappresentativa responsabile per le previsioni concordate.

• Sviluppare relazioni interne ed esterne per creare un'atmosfera di compagni, influenza e responsabilità.

• Tenere riunioni mensili strategiche con i principi delle aziende rappresentative per discutere le prestazioni MTD e YTD, così come le prestazioni previste per i prossimi mesi. Riunioni di documenti e piani d'azione, se del caso. Seguire le attività e le società di consulenza, se del caso.

• Sviluppi e piani strategici con le imprese rappresentative per raggiungere gli obiettivi

• Sviluppare una pipeline di prospettive abbastanza grande da sostenere le aspettative dei ricavi. Dirige l’attività delle imprese rappresentative e sostiene di conseguenza attraverso le risorse interne.

• Valuta le tendenze del mercato che influiscono sui prodotti attuali di JWC o sulle opportunità future per guidare l'innovazione

• Capisce bene tutti i prodotti di JWC ed è visto come un esperto

• Fornisce un feedback tempestivo alla gestione senior per quanto riguarda le prestazioni del mercato, le prestazioni aziendali rappresentative e le potenziali opportunità o minacce durante le riunioni di vendita settimanali e aggiorna il CRM di conseguenza

• Coordinate la risoluzione completa dei problemi del servizio clienti che si innalzano al livello di questa posizione a causa delle dimensioni, della pervasività o dell'egregiousness

• Rappresentare la Società in selezionati fiere e conferenze regionali e nazionali guidando

• Mantenere un'immagine professionale come rappresentante della Società

• Esegui altri compiti e progetti speciali assegnati.

Esperienza, Istruzione e competenze:

• Corso di laurea

• Storia del raggiungimento costante degli obiettivi di reddito attraverso aziende rappresentative e di distribuzione

• 5+ anni di esperienza nella vendita di attrezzature per le acque reflue comunali

• Capacità di parlare in modo intelligente di prodotti, servizi e società JWC

• Deve essere in grado di viaggiare 50%-75% del tempo

• Capacità di tenere riunioni mensili di performance e tenere sotto-performer responsabili

• Forti competenze personali interpersonali

• Alto grado di somiglianza per guidare l'apertura e la collaborazione di rep

• Competenze organizzative e di gestione del tempo

• Capacità di utilizzare strumenti di tecnologia e analisi (CRM, Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Outlook, ecc.),

• Autodidatta e imprenditoriale con un elevato senso di urgenza e reattività

• Capacità di essere in grado di lavorare fuori di un ufficio satellitare di casa in modo efficace

Cosa ti offriamo

• 15 giorni di tempo libero e 12 giorni festivi

• 401k piano con una partita del 6%

• Piano sanitario completo tra cui medico, dentale, visione, vita, disabilità a breve e a lungo termine

• Conto di risparmio sanitario corrispondente

• Programma benessere stimolante

• Programma di assistenza dei dipendenti

Sur le rôle

Résumé de l'emploi
Responsable de l'atteinte des objectifs en matière de recettes (nouvelle unité et service) et de qualité des prix pour un territoire donné sur une base trimestrielle grâce à la gestion stratégique et tactique des entreprises représentatives/distributrices dans la géographie donnée, à la gestion active des partenaires existants et à la mise à niveau de nouveaux partenaires, le cas échéant. L'aspect tactique du poste consiste à diriger et à assister aux nominations sur le terrain dans les usines d'épuration des eaux usées et les cabinets d'ingénierie, à organiser des réunions régionales de formation et de vente et à comprendre les exigences pour gagner des occasions. Cette personne doit être respectée en tant que pair par des entreprises représentatives et considérée comme une valeur ajoutée dans le domaine. Principales fonctions et responsabilités :

• Impact positif comportement représentatif et se tenir eux-mêmes et l'entreprise représentative responsable à la prévision convenue.

• Développer des relations internes et externes pour créer une atmosphère de camaraderie, d'influence et de responsabilité.

• Organiser des réunions mensuelles stratégiques avec les principes des entreprises représentatives pour discuter du rendement de la DMT et de la DJA, ainsi que du rendement prévu pour les prochains mois. Documenter les réunions et élaborer des plans d'action, le cas échéant. Suivi des mesures à prendre et conseils aux entreprises, le cas échéant.

jobs.title: Workplace AI Architect
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Define and govern the adoption of AI across Workplace and platform-based solutions, with a strong focus on out-of-the-box capabilities, integrations, and security. Act as the orchestration point across Software Development, Data & Analytics, business users, and platform owners, ensuring consistent routing of AI initiatives. Drive the transition from ad-hoc usage to controlled, scalable adoption through clear governance, measurement, and chargeback, positioning AI as an extension of existing platforms rather than a parallel capability. The role focuses on Workplace AI platforms and embedded capabilities such as Microsoft 365 Copilot, AI assistants, and collaboration tools.

Main accountabilities and tasks

• AI Roadmap & Out-of-the-Box Ownership: Own the AI roadmap for Workplace and platform-based AI capabilities and the adoption of out-of-the-box solutions; contribute to the cross-functional definition of AI architecture; establish AI as a coherent enterprise capability.

• Platform-First, Preview & Early-Access Ownership: Prioritise out-of-the-box capabilities over new builds; own the evaluation, piloting, and rollout of preview features and vendor early-access programmes; track and govern AI features increasingly embedded in existing enterprise services.

• Governance of Services, Integrations & Agents: Establish a single enterprise entry point and a risk-based approval process, supported by self-service guardrails and clear approval timelines so the front door enables rather than blocks; govern AI services, integrations, APIs, and the lifecycle of AI agents; ensure every AI asset is inventoried, owned, and operated within agreed controls.

• Routing of AI Initiatives Across Delivery Tracks: Define and govern how AI initiatives are routed across delivery tracks - out-of-the-box, preview, and early-access (this role); citizen development (business users, against standards set by this role); custom development and advanced integrations (Software Development); and analytics-driven solutions (Data & Analytics).

• Security, Risk & Compliance (with Infosec): Together with Infosec, define and enforce AI-specific controls under a clear split of accountability for who defines, approves, and enforces; ensure compliance with GDPR and the EU AI Act; govern third-party AI usage and minimise shadow-AI risk.

• AI Lifecycle Management: Govern the full lifecycle covering build, publish, operate, and retire; ensure ownership, inventory, and transparency for every AI solution; enforce environment-based controls across experiment, managed, and production.

• Business Value, Chargeback & Adoption: Define how AI business value is measured; build and operate a chargeback model so consumption is transparent and costs sit with the consuming business; drive adoption and track it against value realisation.

• User Support, Enablement & Training: Act as the primary point of contact for AI adoption; provide patterns, guardrails, and reusable templates so users can build safely; deliver training, documentation, and onboarding paths that build AI literacy across the organisation.

Desired experience and qualifications

• Work experience: 8-10+ years in enterprise IT, architecture, or transformation roles, with experience in governance, platform strategy, or large-scale adoption.

• Expertise: Senior expert / enterprise architect level. Strong understanding of enterprise AI platforms (e.g. Microsoft 365 Copilot) and assistant and agent-based tooling, and of GenAI / agent-based architectures; deep knowledge of platform vs. custom-development trade-offs and licensing models; experience defining operating models and governance standards.

• Governance & regulation: Proven experience defining and rolling out enterprise AI governance

descriptionByLocale.en:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Define and govern the adoption of AI across Workplace and platform-based solutions, with a strong focus on out-of-the-box capabilities, integrations, and security. Act as the orchestration point across Software Development, Data & Analytics, business users, and platform owners, ensuring consistent routing of AI initiatives. Drive the transition from ad-hoc usage to controlled, scalable adoption through clear governance, measurement, and chargeback, positioning AI as an extension of existing platforms rather than a parallel capability. The role focuses on Workplace AI platforms and embedded capabilities such as Microsoft 365 Copilot, AI assistants, and collaboration tools.

Main accountabilities and tasks

• AI Roadmap & Out-of-the-Box Ownership: Own the AI roadmap for Workplace and platform-based AI capabilities and the adoption of out-of-the-box solutions; contribute to the cross-functional definition of AI architecture; establish AI as a coherent enterprise capability.

• Platform-First, Preview & Early-Access Ownership: Prioritise out-of-the-box capabilities over new builds; own the evaluation, piloting, and rollout of preview features and vendor early-access programmes; track and govern AI features increasingly embedded in existing enterprise services.

• Governance of Services, Integrations & Agents: Establish a single enterprise entry point and a risk-based approval process, supported by self-service guardrails and clear approval timelines so the front door enables rather than blocks; govern AI services, integrations, APIs, and the lifecycle of AI agents; ensure every AI asset is inventoried, owned, and operated within agreed controls.

• Routing of AI Initiatives Across Delivery Tracks: Define and govern how AI initiatives are routed across delivery tracks - out-of-the-box, preview, and early-access (this role); citizen development (business users, against standards set by this role); custom development and advanced integrations (Software Development); and analytics-driven solutions (Data & Analytics).

• Security, Risk & Compliance (with Infosec): Together with Infosec, define and enforce AI-specific controls under a clear split of accountability for who defines, approves, and enforces; ensure compliance with GDPR and the EU AI Act; govern third-party AI usage and minimise shadow-AI risk.

• AI Lifecycle Management: Govern the full lifecycle covering build, publish, operate, and retire; ensure ownership, inventory, and transparency for every AI solution; enforce environment-based controls across experiment, managed, and production.

• Business Value, Chargeback & Adoption: Define how AI business value is measured; build and operate a chargeback model so consumption is transparent and costs sit with the consuming business; drive adoption and track it against value realisation.

• User Support, Enablement & Training: Act as the primary point of contact for AI adoption; provide patterns, guardrails, and reusable templates so users can build safely; deliver training, documentation, and onboarding paths that build AI literacy across the organisation.

Desired experience and qualifications

• Work experience: 8-10+ years in enterprise IT, architecture, or transformation roles, with experience in governance, platform strategy, or large-scale adoption.

• Expertise: Senior expert / enterprise architect level. Strong understanding of enterprise AI platforms (e.g. Microsoft 365 Copilot) and assistant and agent-based tooling, and of GenAI / agent-based architectures; deep knowledge of platform vs. custom-development trade-offs and licensing models; experience defining operating models and governance standards.

• Governance & regulation: Proven experience defining and rolling out enterprise AI governance

jobs.title: Gas Compressor Technician
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

At Sulzer, we specialise in delivering top-tier service to our customers across the oil & gas, power generation, and renewable sectors. With our recent £1 million investment, our Ellon facility is now a Centre of Excellence, providing cutting-edge support for electric motors, pumps, gearboxes, and turbo-compressors. We are looking for a skilled Gas Compressor Technician to join our team.

As a Gas Compressor Technician, you will be working directly on the repair, overhaul, and maintenance of gas compressors. You will play a key role in ensuring that our customers' equipment is serviced to the highest standards, meeting industry specifications and maintaining operational efficiency Your Main Tasks and Responsibilities:

• Disassembling, inspecting, and rebuilding gas compressors and their components

• Diagnosing and repairing mechanical faults in a variety of compressor types

• Precision fitting, machining, and assembly work as required

• Performing dynamic and functional testing on overhauled equipment

• Collaborating with engineering and quality teams to ensure compliance with technical specifications

• Maintaining a clean and safe working environment in line with HSE requirements

To succeed in this role, you will need:

• Experience in the overhaul and maintenance of gas compressors or similar rotating equipment

• Proficiency in mechanical fitting, assembly, and fault diagnosis

• Strong attention to detail and commitment to quality

• Ability to read and interpret engineering drawings and technical manuals

• Good communication skills and a proactive attitude to teamwork

• Awareness of Health, Safety, and Environmental regulations

What we offer you

• Competitive basic salary.

• 33 days of annual leave.

• Defined pension contribution.

• Confidential support and guidance through our Employee Assistance Programmes.

• Access to a wide range of discounts on everyday shopping, entertainment, and lifestyle.

• Discounted Personal Car Leasing - available for you, your family, and friends.

• Long Service Awards to celebrate your dedication.

• Ongoing learning and development through Sulzer Learning Pathways.

• Free and secure onsite parking, with electric charging facilities.

• We're proud to support those who've served. Sulzer is a Bronze Award holder under the MoDs Defence Employer Recognition Scheme meaning we actively welcome and support ex-military personnel and reservists in building successful careers with us.

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

At Sulzer, innovation and excellence are at the heart of everything we do. Our Ellon Service Centre is one of Sulzer's flagship rotating equipment service facilities, providing world-class repair, maintenance and engineering solutions for critical turbomachinery and gas compression equipment across a wide range of industries.

As the Technical Focal Point for Gas Compression, you will serve as the first point of contact for technical guidance relating to gas compression equipment and workshop procedures. You will work closely with customers, workshop personnel, field service teams and engineering colleagues to deliver technically sound recommendations and exceptional customer support.

This is a highly visible role requiring strong technical knowledge, excellent communication skills and a customer-focused approach. Your Responsibilities

• Act as the primary technical focal point for gas compression activities within the service centre.

• Provide technical guidance to workshop teams regarding repair methods, procedures and best practices.

• Support the wider engineering team in determining the optimum approach to work execution.

• Provide troubleshooting expertise for complex repair and operational issues.

• Liaise closely with engineering colleagues and other technical specialists when required.

• Attend customer meetings as the technical representative for gas compression projects.

• Accompany customers during witness testing activities, providing technical advice and support.

• Present technical findings, recommendations and repair solutions to customers.

• Build strong customer relationships through professional technical support and expertise.

• Review workshop findings and provide recommendations for repair solutions.

• Participate in failure investigations within Sulzer service centres and at customer sites.

• Deliver technical advice, coaching and training to internal teams where required.

What You Bring

Qualifications

• HNC, HND or Degree in Mechanical Engineering or a related discipline.

Experience & Technical Knowledge

• Significant experience with gas compression equipment.

• Previous engineering experience within rotating equipment, turbomachinery or related industries.

• Understanding of vibration analysis and machinery diagnostics.

• Experience preparing technical reports and presenting engineering recommendations.

• Knowledge of repair methodologies and failure investigation practices.

Skills & Behaviours

• Strong influencing and persuasion skills.

• Comfortable engaging with customers and presenting technical information.

• Excellent interpersonal and communication skills with the ability to interact at all levels.

• Strong organisational skills and ability to manage multiple priorities.

• Effective time management skills with flexibility to adapt to changing business demands.

• High attention to detail and commitment to quality.

• Ability to work collaboratively across multidisciplinary teams.

• Competent user of Microsoft Office, including Word, Excel and Outlook.

• Committed to adhering to company standards, procedures and safety requirements.

Travel Requirements
The successful candidate must be willing to travel to customer sites and Sulzer locations as required, both within the UK and occasionally internationally.

What we offer you

• A competitive basic salary

• Annual bonus scheme

• Car/Car Allowance

• 33 days annual leave.

• Defined pension contributions.

• Access to Medicash helping you cover everyday health costs like dental optical and physiotherapy plus a range of wellbeing perks.

• Confidential support via Employee Assistance Programmes.

• Access to discounts on shopping entertainment lifestyle plus opportunity to apply for Costco member

jobs.title: Global BU Operations Controller
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

As Global BU Operations Controller , you will drive and coordinate operational controlling activities across our global manufacturing footprint, acting as a trusted business partner to Operations leadership. You will provide financial insights, performance analysis, and strategic guidance to support decision-making, while leading the Operations Controlling team and ensuring alignment with business objectives.

In this role you will:

• Drive operational and cost analysis for the BU at the Operations (factory) level (be responsible end-to-end for all controlling/business partnering aspects of the BU at Operations level); support cost accounting, assist in actuals and forecast analysis, develop and maintain the overall reporting framework for the BU at Operations level, support the resolution of complex issues, be ultimately responsible for the Controlling team for all factory LEs, support ERP system developments, and ensure compliance with global policies.

• Oversee and coordinate the planning, budgeting, and forecasting processes at Operations level.

• Deliver effective and timely communication to the BU FICO Head and other internal or external stakeholders.

• Create and monitor governance procedures to maintain a core set of management reports (e.g. DOA, control matrix, etc.).

• Be accountable for the production of core finance management reporting and analysis.

• Coordinate with Legal to ensure that risk management policies and procedures are implemented and managed appropriately.

• Identify and manage continuous improvement initiatives for the controlling function.

• Monitor and develop monthly reports for revenues and expenditures of a factory and all factory sites consolidated; manage and steer factory costs; assist in the analysis of NWC balances.

• Perform continuous project improvement analysis, new product development analysis, strategic sourcing analysis, and other ad-hoc analyses.

• Provide production and cost information required to perform the end-to-end financial close and internal reporting process.

• Provide inputs for the planning, budgeting, and forecasting processes for the Finance organization.

• Provide key operational decision-makers with accurate and timely financial information, leading to the minimization of costs and the maximization of profitability.

• Empower the Operations Team to manage the day-to-day aspects of the processes, providing operational steering.

• Liaise with Procurement regarding order intake.

• Allocate resources to the production process.

• Support the GPOs in establishing procedures for the Cost Accounting function, including the selection and implementation of relevant reporting and tools.

• Deliver effective and timely communication on all relevant issues to internal and external stakeholders.

• Identify and manage continuous improvement initiatives for the Cost Accounting function.

• Drive the implementation of DXC and Financial Services within Operational LEs.

To succeed you need:

Experience & Education

• Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, or a related field.

• Minimum of 9 years of relevant professional experience in Finance, Controlling, or Business Partnering roles.

• Previous management experience, with a proven ability to lead and develop high-performing teams.

• Prior experience in an Engineering and/or Manufacturing environment is essential.

• Fluent English language skills, both written and spoken.

Skills & Competencies

• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to engage effectively with stakeholders at all levels, both internally and externally.

• Strong negotiation, influencing, and presentation skills.

• Excellent analytical capabilities, combined with stron

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sulzer è una società di ingegneria leader con un patrimonio orgoglioso di innovazione. Unisciti al nostro team globale per accrescere le tue competenze e sviluppare soluzioni innovative che consentano una società prospera e più sostenibile.

Informazioni sul ruolo

Come Global BU Operations Controller , guiderai e coordinerai le attività di controllo operativo attraverso la nostra impronta produttiva globale, agendo come partner commerciale di fiducia nella leadership Operazioni. Fornirai informazioni finanziarie, analisi delle prestazioni e guida strategica per supportare il processo decisionale, mentre guiderai il team Operations Controlling e garantirai l'allineamento con gli obiettivi aziendali.

In questo ruolo sarete:

• Guidare l'analisi operativa e dei costi per la BU a livello Operazioni (fattoria) (essere responsabile end-to-end per tutti gli aspetti di controllo/business partnering della BU a livello Operazioni); sostenere la contabilità dei costi, assistere in effetti e analisi delle previsioni, sviluppare e mantenere il quadro generale di reporting per il BU a livello Operazioni, sostenere la risoluzione di problemi complessi, essere in ultima analisi responsabile per il team di controllo di tutte le LEs di fabbrica, sostenere gli sviluppi del sistema ERP e garantire la conformità a livello globale.

• Controllare e coordinare i processi di pianificazione, di bilancio e di previsione a livello Operazioni.

• Fornisci una comunicazione efficace e tempestiva al BU FICO Head e ad altri stakeholder interni o esterni.

• Creare e monitorare le procedure di governance per mantenere un insieme centrale di rapporti di gestione (ad esempio DOA, matrice di controllo, ecc.).

• Essere responsabile per la produzione di core finanza gestione reporting e analisi.

• Coordinamento con Legale per garantire che le politiche e le procedure di gestione dei rischi siano implementate e gestite in modo appropriato.

• Identificare e gestire iniziative di miglioramento continuo per la funzione di controllo.

• Monitorare e sviluppare relazioni mensili per le entrate e le spese di una fabbrica e di tutti i siti di fabbrica consolidati; gestire e sostenere i costi di fabbrica; assistere nell'analisi dei bilanci NWC.

• Eseguire l'analisi continua del miglioramento del progetto, la nuova analisi dello sviluppo del prodotto, l'analisi strategica di approvvigionamento e altre analisi ad-hoc.

• Fornire informazioni di produzione e di costo necessarie per eseguire il processo di reporting finanziario end-to-end chiuso e interno.

• Fornire input per la pianificazione, il bilancio e i processi di previsione per l'organizzazione Finance.

• Fornire i decisori operativi chiave con informazioni finanziarie accurate e tempestive, portando alla minimizzazione dei costi e alla massimizzazione della redditività.

• Favorire il Team Operazioni per gestire gli aspetti quotidiani dei processi, fornendo sterzo operativo.

• Liaise with Procurement about the order intake.

• Allocare le risorse al processo di produzione.

• Sostenere i GPO nell'elaborazione di procedure per la funzione Accounting Cost, compresa la selezione e l'implementazione di report e strumenti pertinenti.

• Fornisci una comunicazione efficace e tempestiva su tutte le questioni rilevanti per gli stakeholder interni ed esterni.

• Identificare e gestire iniziative di miglioramento continuo per la funzione Cost Accounting.

• Guidare l'implementazione di DXC e servizi finanziari all'interno di LE Operative.

Per avere successo è necessario:

Esperienza e istruzione

• Laurea in finanza, contabilità, amministrazione aziendale, o un campo relativo.

• Minimo di 9 anni di esperienza professionale rilevante nei ruoli di finanza, controllo o Business Partnering.

• Esperienza di gestione precedente, con una comprovata capacità di guidare e sviluppare team di alto livello.

• L'esperienza prioritaria in un ambiente di Ingegneria e/o Produzione è essenziale.

• Capacità linguistiche fluenti, sia scritte che parlate.

Competenze e competenze

• Ottima comunicazione e competenze interpersonali, con la capacità di impegnarsi efficacemente con gli stakeholder a tutti i livelli, sia internamente che esternamente.

• Forte negoziazione, influenza e capacità di presentazione.

• Eccellente capacità analitiche, combinato con stron

Über die Rolle

Als Global BU Operations Controller werden Sie die operativen Controlling-Aktivitäten in unserer globalen Fertigung vorantreiben und koordinieren und als vertrauenswürdiger Geschäftspartner für die Unternehmensführung fungieren. Sie bieten finanzielle Einblicke, Leistungsanalysen und strategische Leitlinien zur Unterstützung der Entscheidungsfindung, während Sie das Operations Controlling-Team leiten und die Ausrichtung auf die Geschäftsziele sicherstellen.

In dieser Rolle werden Sie:

• Betriebs- und Kostenanalyse für die BU auf der Ebene des Betriebs (Fabrik) vorantreiben (Ende-zu-Ende für alle Controlling- / Business-Partnering-Aspekte der BU auf Betriebsebene verantwortlich sein); Kostenrechnung unterstützen, bei der Ist- und Prognoseanalyse unterstützen, den gesamten Berichtsrahmen für die BU auf Betriebsebene entwickeln und pflegen, die Lösung komplexer Probleme unterstützen, letztlich für das Controlling-Team für alle Werks-LEs verantwortlich sein, ERP-Systementwicklungen unterstützen und die Einhaltung globaler Richtlinien sicherstellen.

• Beaufsichtigen und koordinieren Sie die Planungs-, Budgetierungs- und Prognoseprozesse auf operativer Ebene.

• Liefern Sie effektive und zeitnahe Kommunikation an den BU FICO Head und andere interne oder externe Stakeholder.

• Erstellen und Überwachen von Governance-Verfahren, um einen Kernsatz von Managementberichten zu verwalten (z. B. DOA, Kontrollmatrix usw.).

• Seien Sie rechenschaftspflichtig für die Erstellung von Berichten und Analysen zum Kernfinanzmanagement.

• Koordination mit Legal, um sicherzustellen, dass Risikomanagementrichtlinien und -verfahren angemessen umgesetzt und verwaltet werden.

• Identifizieren und verwalten Sie kontinuierliche Verbesserungsinitiativen für die Controlling-Funktion.

• Überwachung und Entwicklung monatlicher Berichte über Einnahmen und Ausgaben einer Fabrik und aller Fabrikstandorte konsolidiert; Verwaltung und Steuerung der Fabrikkosten; Unterstützung bei der Analyse der NWC-Salden.

• Führen Sie kontinuierliche Projektverbesserungsanalysen, neue Produktentwicklungsanalysen, strategische Beschaffungsanalysen und andere Ad-hoc-Analysen durch.

• Bereitstellung von Produktions- und Kosteninformationen, die für die Durchführung des End-to-End-Finanzabschlusses und des internen Berichterstattungsprozesses erforderlich sind.

• Geben Sie Inputs für die Planungs-, Budgetierungs- und Prognoseprozesse für die Finanzorganisation.

• Geben Sie wichtigen operativen Entscheidungsträgern genaue und zeitnahe Finanzinformationen, die zur Kostenminimierung und Maximierung der Rentabilität führen.

• Befähigen Sie das Operations-Team, die täglichen Aspekte der Prozesse zu verwalten und die operative Steuerung bereitzustellen.

jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Join Sulzer’s global Marketing team and shape how a CHF 3.5 billion industrial leader positions its solutions across the world’s most critical markets.
We are seeking a senior and strategic Head of Product & Solution Marketing to lead how Sulzer’s portfolio of pumps, separation technologies, services and sustainability solutions is positioned and activated globally. This role will drive commercial growth by developing compelling value propositions, leading go-to-market strategy and enabling Sales across Flow, Services and Chemtech.

You will own the product marketing agenda — spanning portfolio positioning, solution launches, sales enablement and market intelligence — while building a high-performing team and embedding a customer-centric, insight-driven culture across the marketing function.
In this role you will be accountable for:

Product & Solution Marketing Strategy and Plan

• Define and own the global product and solution marketing strategy, aligned with Sulzer’s corporate strategy and divisional and BU priorities across Flow, Services and Chemtech

• Develop clear value propositions and positioning frameworks for core product lines including pumps, separation technologies, rotating equipment services, bioplastics (PLA) and digital monitoring

• Lead One Sulzer targeting for priority verticals: water/wastewater, oil & gas, chemical processing, energy, food & beverage, and green hydrogen

• Translate Sulzer’s sustainability narrative — decarbonisation, green hydrogen, CCUS, circular economy — into credible, differentiated market positioning

Marketing Execution

• Lead the marketing of solution launch plans for new products, technologies and market entries, coordinating across divisions, regions and functions

• Ensure consistent and compelling positioning across all customer-facing channels: digital, events, sales tools, technical literature and campaigns

• Partner with Sales and Commercial Excellence to develop sales enablement materials, competitive battlecards, customer case studies, ROI tools and technical value-selling content

• Drive differentiated messaging for Sulzer’s aftermarket and service offerings, leveraging the expanding global service network and long-term customer partnerships

• Define yearly marketing plans and lead execution of marketing campaigns in alignment w regional and digital marketing

Marketing Insights

• Work closely with Product Management to influence roadmap priorities based on market trends, customer needs and competitive dynamics

• Monitor developments in decarbonisation, industrial digitalisation and sustainable process technologies to identify positioning opportunities

Team Leadership & Capability Development

• Lead, inspire and develop a team of product and solution marketers across geographies, fostering a culture of commercial creativity, analytical rigour and customer centricity

• Set clear goals, KPIs and development plans for direct reports; build capability in product storytelling, digital marketing and data-driven decision-making

• Establish best-practice processes for product launch, content development and campaign execution across divisions

Stakeholder Engagement & Cross-Functional Collaboration

• Act as the key marketing interface with Division Presidents, BU & Region Heads, VP Sales and Product Management leaders across Flow, Services and Chemtech

• Work closely with Corporate Communications to integrate product and solution narratives into employer brand, investor messaging and corporate reputation activities

• Collaborate with Digital Marketing and Regional marketing to ensure solution content is optimised for digital channels, SEO and lead generation; manage external agencies and specialist content partners

Unisciti al team di Marketing globale di Sulzer e plasma come un leader industriale di CHF 3,5 miliardi posiziona le sue soluzioni nei mercati più critici del mondo.
Siamo alla ricerca di un Head of Product & Solution Marketing senior e strategico per guidare come il portafoglio di pompe, tecnologie di separazione, servizi e soluzioni di sostenibilità sia posizionato e attivato a livello globale. Strategia di marketing e piano di prodotto e soluzioni

• Piombo Uno Sulzer mirante per i verticali prioritari: acqua/acqua, petrolio e gas, lavorazione chimica, energia, cibo e bevande, e idrogeno verde

• Tradurre la narrativa di sostenibilità di Sulzer — decarbonizzazione, idrogeno verde, CCUS, economia circolare — in posizione di mercato credibile e differenziato

Esecuzione del marketing

• Guidare la commercializzazione dei piani di lancio di soluzioni per nuovi prodotti, tecnologie e voci di mercato, coordinando tra divisioni, regioni e funzioni

• Assicurare un posizionamento coerente e convincente in tutti i canali di customer-facing: digitale, eventi, strumenti di vendita, letteratura tecnica e campagne

• Partner con Vendite ed Eccellenza Commerciale per sviluppare materiali di abilitazione delle vendite, cartoline da battaglia competitive, studi sui casi dei clienti, strumenti ROI e contenuti tecnici di vendita del valore

• Guida messaggi differenziati per le offerte di post-vendita e servizi di Sulzer, sfruttando l'espansione della rete di servizi globale e partnership con clienti a lungo termine

• Definire piani di marketing annuali e condurre l'esecuzione di campagne di marketing in allineamento con il marketing regionale e digitale

Insights di marketing

• Monitorare gli sviluppi della decarbonizzazione, della digitalizzazione industriale e delle tecnologie di processo sostenibili per individuare le opportunità di posizionamento

Leadership del team & Capability Development

• Leader, ispirare e sviluppare un team di marketing di prodotti e soluzioni attraverso geografie, promuovendo una cultura della creatività commerciale, rigore analitico e centricità dei clienti

• Impostare obiettivi chiari, KPI e piani di sviluppo per rapporti diretti; costruire capacità nella narrazione dei prodotti, nel marketing digitale e nel processo decisionale basato sui dati

• Stabilire processi best practice per il lancio del prodotto, lo sviluppo dei contenuti e l'esecuzione delle campagne attraverso le divisioni

Stakeholder Engagement & Cross-Functional Collaboration

• Atto come l'interfaccia di marketing chiave con i presidenti di Divisione, i capi BU & Region, i leader VP Sales e Product Management di Flow, Services e Chemtech

• Lavorare a stretto contatto con Corporate Communications per integrare le narrazioni di prodotto e di soluzione nel marchio datore di lavoro, messaggistica degli investitori e attività di reputazione aziendale

jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Position Summary

Sulzer is a non-OEM rotating equipment repair facility located in the Houston area. Sulzer is comprised of several divisions that include the Component Repair Division. Departments within the Component Repair division include Combustion, Stationary, Mechanical, Rotating, Fuel/Flow and Inspection departments. Each department is dedicated to refurbishment of gas turbine components and sub-assembly parts. The Gas Turbine Component Repair Project Engineer is responsible for developing inspection and repair workscopes for stationary and rotating gas turbine components and managing multiple repair projects from receipt through delivery. The engineer works closely with operations, sales and external vendors to define repair methods, generate purchase orders, control cost, and resolve technical issues throughout the repair cycle. Responsibilities

• Develop estimates for overhauls of gas turbine components.
· Generate repair quotations and work scopes using Dynamics 365(hours & material).
· Inspection and repair work scope development, review, evaluation, and periodic adjustment.

Job Summary
The Senior Business Controller services as the primary financial liasion between local manufacturing operations and the Center of Excellence (CoE), ensuring seamless coordination and effective execution of key financial and project management activities. This position has responsibility for all of Latin America. Key Responsibilities:

• Overseeing the accuracy and productivity of day-to-day activities for inventory management, backlog tracking, customer order profitability, and utilization metrics.

jobs.title: Senior Accountant
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Accounting Sr. Officer is responsible for supporting accounting operations including journal entries, reconciliations, and financial reporting. This role ensures compliance with accounting standards and supports audits and month-end close activities. This job profile is intended for experienced professionals who apply practical knowledge of a job area and work independently with general supervision. Le comptable senior apporte son soutien à l'équipe financière dans le cadre de diverses tâches et responsabilités. Il est chargé de gérer la comptabilité de l'ensemble du processus « Record to Report » (RTR) au sein des sociétés du groupe en France, en veillant à l'exactitude des données et au respect des normes comptables ainsi que des règles internes de Sulzer. En outre, il apporte son soutien aux processus comptables généraux dans les domaines « Purchase to Pay » (PTP) et « Order to Cash » (OTC), lorsque cela est nécessaire.

Participer à la clôture de période, notamment en clôturant le grand livre auxiliaire des comptes clients et fournisseurs et en effectuant le rapprochement avec le grand livre général
Superviser les processus de clôture de fin de mois et de fin d’exercice ; participer à la préparation des écritures comptables, aux rapprochements du bilan et à l’analyse des écarts
Établir des états financiers précis et dans les délais, notamment les comptes de résultat, les bilans et les tableaux de flux de trésorerie
Participer à la saisie comptable des factures sans bon de commande
Assister l’équipe des services financiers partagés dans les activités liées à la gestion des immobilisations
Collaborer étroitement avec l’équipe Reporting & Analytics pour analyser les données financières et fournir des informations sur la performance financière, identifier les tendances et les écarts afin d’étayer les décisions opérationnelles
Assurer la coordination avec les autres services et les équipes des services financiers partagés afin de garantir que toutes les transactions financières sont correctement comptabilisées et reflétées dans le grand livre
Participer aux processus de budgétisation et de prévision, en apportant son expertise sur les aspects financiers et les projections ; collaborer étroitement avec le responsable financier national
Assurer la liaison avec les experts fiscaux afin de garantir l’exactitude et la ponctualité des déclarations fiscales et de la conformité
Suivre les indicateurs clés de performance (KPI) afin d’évaluer l’efficacité des processus comptables et de mettre en œuvre des initiatives d’amélioration continue
Contribuer à l’amélioration continue des processus financiers, en tirant parti des technologies et des meilleures pratiques ; veiller au respect des politiques, procédures et modèles
Fournir des rapports financiers précis et en temps opportun à la direction générale et aux parties prenantes
Veiller à ce que tous les rapports et processus financiers soient conformes aux normes internationales d’information financière (IFRS) et à la réglementation de Sulzer
Assurer la liaison avec les auditeurs et veiller à ce que les audits soient menés à bien avec un minimum d’ajustements
Veiller à ce que des contrôles internes financiers soient en place et respectés pour les processus relevant de cette fonction
Assister le responsable national de la comptabilité dans la gestion des demandes des auditeurs internes et externes et s’assurer que l’équipe comptable fournit les informations requises

• Formation et expérience
Diplôme universitaire en finance, comptabilité, gestion d’entreprise ou dans un domaine connexe
Au moins 5 à 7 ans d’expérience en comptabilité, avec une spécialisation marquée dans la comptabilité générale et le reporting financier dans un environnement industrie

Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

We are looking for a RTR Accountant to join our Accounting team in Spain to help us take our Record to Report (RTR) area to the next level. • Proven ability to manage multiple priorities in a deadline-driven environment

• Proficient in ERP systems (relevant to your business unit; SAP, Microsoft Dynamics 365 or iScala) and accounting software

• Enjoy great office facilities and a perfect location in Madrid Nuevos Ministerios, making your work experience both comfortable and convenient.

• Sostegno alle attività di prenotazione finanziaria, garanzia di accuratezza e conformità alle normative internazionali di reporting finanziario (IFRS) e Sulzer
