• Utilizzare la conoscenza avanzata dei sistemi ERP per semplificare i processi contabili

• Supporta il Global Process Owner (GPO) con implementazioni di sistema

• Mantenere e aggiornare il grafico dei conti e delle gerarchie, assicurando che riflette la struttura aziendale attuale e i requisiti di reporting

• Collabora a stretto contatto con i team di finanza locali nei paesi e i team di servizi condivisi di finanza / fornitore di Business Process Outsourcing (BPO)

• Coordinare con gli altri dipartimenti e i team dei Servizi Condizionati di Finanza per garantire che tutte le transazioni finanziarie siano debitamente contabilizzate e riflesse nel registro generale

• Sostiene il termine chiuso, compresa la chiusura dei conti crediti/pagabili sommergibile e riconciliarsi con il registro generale; chiudere il registro generale, aprire nuovo periodo finanziario, chiudere Asset Accounting (AA)

• Sostegno alla preparazione delle voci della rivista, alla riconciliazione del bilancio e all'analisi della varianza

• Contribuire al miglioramento continuo del processo RTR, sfruttando la tecnologia e le migliori pratiche; mantenere politiche, procedure e modelli

• Assicurarsi che i controlli interni finanziari siano in vigore e seguiti per i processi svolti da questo ruolo

• Fare tutte le attività di chiusura dell'Anno tecnico come l'equilibrio portare avanti, le creazioni della gamma di numeri, chiusura di AA

• Sostenere il processo di riconciliazione intercompany in Coprocess e Tagetik (fisso varianze)

È necessario avere successo:

• Laurea in finanza, contabilità, amministrazione aziendale o campo relativo

• Minimo 2-3 anni di esperienza in Contabilità con una forte attenzione al registro generale e alla rendicontazione finanziaria

• CPA, ACCA, CMA o certificazione equivalente

• Forte capacità analitiche, di problem solving e di gestione

• Ottima attenzione ai dettagli e all'impegno per l'accuratezza e l'integrità nel reporting finanziario

• Capacità comprovata di gestire più priorità in un ambiente a scadenza

• Forte capacità di comunicazione per fornire informazioni chiave alla leadership senior

• Proficiente nei sistemi ERP (rilevante all'unità aziendale; SAP, Microsoft Dynamics 365 o iScala) e software di contabilità

• Forte MS Office (Excel, PowerPoint) competenze

• Esperienza con Tagetik, Coprocess e Qlik Sense è un plus

• Competenza in inglese e francese

Cosa ti offriamo

• Un contratto permanente.

• Uno stipendio competitivo e la partecipazione al sistema di remunerazione variabile basato su obiettivi personali e finanziari.

• Biglietti del ristorante.

• Fai parte di un team esperto e internazionale.

• Una buona atmosfera ambiente di lavoro.

• Godetevi ottimi servizi di ufficio e una posizione perfetta a Madrid Nuevos Ministerios, rendendo la vostra esperienza di lavoro sia confortevole e conveniente.

• Altri benefici.

Sur le rôle

Nous sommes à la recherche d'un comptable RTR pour rejoindre notre équipe de comptabilité en Espagne pour nous aider à porter notre secteur Record to Report (RTR) au niveau suivant. En tant que comptable, vous collaborerez avec de nombreux pays et vous engagerez avec divers intervenants dans divers domaines, notamment la comptabilité, les rapports, l'analyse, les chefs des finances par pays, les propriétaires de processus mondiaux (OPG) et les parties externes telles que les vérificateurs et les autorités fiscales. Responsabilités clés :

• Servir en tant que membre de l'équipe RTR au sein du Conseil de l'Europe, fournir un appui sur des sujets spéciaux et des questions comptables

• Appui aux activités de réservation financière, en veillant à l'exactitude et au respect des normes internationales d'information financière (IFRS) et des règlements Sulzer

• Gérer la compensation, y compris les rapprochements et les ajustements, pour tenir des dossiers financiers exacts

• Utiliser les connaissances avancées des systèmes PGI pour rationaliser les processus comptables

• Soutenir le propriétaire du processus mondial (GPO) avec les implémentations du système

• Maintenir et mettre à jour le plan comptable et les hiérarchies, en veillant à ce qu'il reflète la structure opérationnelle actuelle et les exigences en matière de rapports.

• Collaborer étroitement avec les équipes des finances locales dans les pays et les équipes des services partagés des finances / fournisseur d'externalisation des processus d'affaires

• Coordonner avec les autres ministères et les équipes des Services partagés des finances pour s'assurer que toutes les opérations financières sont dûment comptabilisées et reflétées dans le grand livre

• Appuie la clôture de l'exercice, y compris la clôture des comptes débiteurs/sous-registres à payer et le rapprochement avec le grand livre général;

• Appui à la préparation des entrées de journaux, rapprochements des bilans et analyse des écarts

• Contribuer à l'amélioration continue du processus de RTR, en tirant parti de la technologie et des pratiques exemplaires; maintenir les politiques, les procédures et les modèles

• S'assurer que des contrôles internes financiers sont en place et suivis pour les processus exécutés par ce rôle

• Faire toutes les activités techniques de clôture de fin d'année telles que le report de l'équilibre, les créations de gamme de nombres, la fermeture de l'AA

• Soutien au processus de rapprochement interentreprises dans Coprocess et Tagetik (variations fixes)

• Diplôme universitaire en finance, comptabilité, administration des affaires ou domaine connexe

• Minimum de 2 à 3 ans d'expérience en comptabilité, l'accent étant mis sur le grand livre et l'information financière

• CPA, ACCA, CMA ou certification équivalente préférée

• Fortes compétences en analyse, résolution de problèmes et gestion

• Excellente attention aux détails et à l'engagement en faveur de l'exactitude et de l'intégrité des rapports financiers

• Capacité éprouvée de gérer de multiples priorités dans un environnement axé sur les échéances

• Capacités de communication solides pour fournir des renseignements clés aux cadres supérieurs

• Compétence en systèmes ERP (pertinents pour votre unité d'affaires; SAP, Microsoft Dynamics 365 ou iScala) et logiciel de comptabilité

• Fortes compétences de MS Office (Excel, PowerPoint)

• Expérience avec Tagetik, Coprocess et Qlik Sense est un plus

jobs.title: Head of Digital Marketing
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Group Marketing & Communications Expert is responsible for managing large-scale communication and branding projects across the organization. This role ensures consistency in messaging, supports executive communications, and drives strategic initiatives in both internal and external communications.
This job profile is intended for recognized subject matter experts in a job area. Required to manage large projects or processes with limited oversight from manager. Coaches, reviews and delegates work to lower level professionals. Join our Sulzer Marketing team and help us take Digital Marketing to the next level.
We are seeking a strategic and hands-on Head of Digital Marketing to lead Sulzer’s global digital marketing agenda from Madrid. This role will drive demand generation, digital transformation, and customer engagement across
multiple business units and regions.

You will own the digital ecosystem—spanning web, performance marketing, marketing automation, and analytics—while building a high-performing team and embedding a data-driven culture.

Key Responsibilities:

Digital Strategy & Transformation

• Define and execute a global digital marketing strategy aligned with business growth priorities (incl. full ownership of campaign execution)

• Lead digital transformation initiatives across channels, platforms, and customer journeys

• Partner with commercial and product teams to align digital programs with sales objectives

Demand Generation & Performance Marketing

• Drive qualified pipeline through integrated campaigns (SEO/SEM, paid media, ABM, A/B testing, email, social)

• Optimize conversion funnels and lead lifecycle management

• Own digital KPIs: traffic, engagement, MQLs, SQLs, opportunities, OI pipeline contribution, ROI

Customer Experience & Web Ecosystem

• Oversee global website strategy, UX/UI, personalization, and content performance

• Ensure consistent, high-quality digital experiences across touchpoints

• Champion customer-centricity and journey optimization

Marketing Technology & Data

• Own and evolve the Martech stack (e.g., marketing automation (Hubspot), analytics tools (GA4, etc., demand generation tools, etc.)

• Leverage data and insights to continuously improve campaign performance

• Implement scalable tracking, attribution, and reporting frameworks

Leadership & Stakeholder Management

• Build, lead, and develop a global digital marketing team mainly based in Madrid

• Collaborate with regional marketing teams and team of Product Marketing managers and business counterparts to ensure alignment and execution excellence

• Manage external agencies and technology partners

To succeed you need :

• Bachelor in Business / Marketing

• 10+ years in digital marketing, with at least 5 years in a leadership role

• Proven success in B2B, ideally in industrial, engineering, or technology sectors

• Strong track record in demand generation and digital transformation

• Hands-on knowledge in Digital campaign set-up / Martech, AI experience

• Deep expertise in performance marketing, SEO/SEM, and marketing automation

• Strong analytical mindset with experience in data-driven decision-making

• Experience managing complex, multi-region digital ecosystems

• Familiarity with CRM platforms (e.g., Salesforce) and marketing tools (e.g., HubSpot, Apollo, Cognism, Canva, etc)

• Strategic thinker with a hands-on approach

• Strong stakeholder management and communication skills

• Change agent with the ability to influence across a matrix organization

• Fluent in English

What we offer you

• A permanent contract.

• A competitive salary as well as participation in the variable remuneration system based on personal and financial objectives.

• Meal vouchers.

• Access to

• Gestione di agenzie esterne e partner tecnologici

Sulzer est une entreprise d'ingénierie de premier plan avec un fier héritage d'innovation. Rejoignez notre équipe mondiale pour développer votre expertise et développer des solutions innovantes qui permettent une société prospère et plus durable.

Sur le rôle

Résumé de l'emploi
Le Groupe Marketing & Communications Expert est responsable de la gestion de projets de communication et de marque à grande échelle dans l'ensemble de l'organisation. Ce rôle assure l'uniformité des messages, appuie les communications des cadres et dirige les initiatives stratégiques dans les communications internes et externes.
Ce profil d'emploi est destiné aux experts reconnus dans un domaine d'emploi. Requis pour gérer de grands projets ou processus avec une surveillance limitée de la part du gestionnaire. Les entraîneurs, les critiques et les délégués travaillent pour les professionnels de niveau inférieur. Rejoignez notre équipe de marketing Sulzer et aidez-nous à porter le marketing numérique au niveau supérieur.
Nous cherchons un responsable stratégique et pratique du marketing numérique pour diriger l'agenda mondial du marketing numérique de Sulzer de Madrid. Ce rôle favorisera la génération de la demande, la transformation numérique et l'engagement des clients dans l'ensemble du Canada.
plusieurs unités d'affaires et régions.

Vous posséderez l'écosystème numérique – le web, le marketing de performance, l'automatisation du marketing et l'analyse – tout en créant une équipe performante et en intégrant une culture axée sur les données.

Principales responsabilités :

Stratégie numérique et transformation

• Définir et exécuter une stratégie globale de marketing numérique alignée sur les priorités de croissance des entreprises (y compris la pleine propriété de l'exécution de campagne)

• Diriger les initiatives de transformation numérique à travers les canaux, les plateformes et les parcours clients

• Partenaire avec des équipes commerciales et de produits pour aligner les programmes numériques sur les objectifs de vente

Production de demande et marketing de performance

• Conduire un pipeline qualifié au moyen de campagnes intégrées (SEO/SEM, médias payants, ABM, tests A/B, courriel, social)

• Optimiser les entonnoirs de conversion et la gestion du cycle de vie

• Les propres KPI numériques: trafic, engagement, MQL, SQL, opportunités, contribution du pipeline OI, ROI

Expérience client et écosystème Web

• Superviser la stratégie globale du site Web, l'UX/UI, la personnalisation et la performance du contenu

• Assurer des expériences numériques cohérentes et de haute qualité à travers les points de contact

• Champion centreur client et optimisation du parcours

Technologie et données de commercialisation

• Propre et évoluer la pile Martech (par exemple, l'automatisation du marketing (Hubspot), les outils d'analyse (GA4, etc., les outils de génération de la demande, etc.)

• Tirer parti des données et des idées pour améliorer continuellement la performance de la campagne

• Mettre en place des cadres de suivi, d'attribution et de rapport évolutives

Leadership et gestion des intervenants

• Construire, diriger et développer une équipe mondiale de marketing numérique basée principalement à Madrid

• Collaborer avec les équipes régionales de marketing et l'équipe des gestionnaires de marketing de produits et des homologues commerciaux pour assurer l'alignement et l'excellence de l'exécution

• Gérer les organismes externes et les partenaires technologiques

Pour réussir vous avez besoin :

• Licence en affaires / marketing

• 10 ans et plus dans le marketing numérique, avec au moins 5 ans dans un rôle de leader

• Succès prouvé en B2B, idéalement dans les secteurs industriel, ingénierie ou technologique

• Fort bilan en matière de production de demande et de transformation numérique

• Connaissance pratique de la mise en place de campagnes numériques / Martech, expérience de l'IA

• Expertise approfondie en marketing de performance, SEO/SEM et automatisation marketing

• Un état d'esprit analytique fort avec l'expérience de la prise de décision axée sur les données

• Expérience de gestion d'écosystèmes numériques complexes et multi-régions

• Familiarité avec les plateformes CRM (par exemple Salesforce) et les outils de marketing (par exemple HubSpot, Apollo, Cognism, Canva, etc.)

• Penseur stratégique avec une approche pratique

• Fortes compétences en gestion des parties prenantes et en communication

• Agent de changement ayant la capacité d'influencer une organisation matricielle

• Fluent en anglais

Ce que nous vous offrons

• Un contrat permanent.

• Un salaire compétitif ainsi que la participation au système de rémunération variable fondé sur des objectifs personnels et financiers.

• Des bons de repas.

• Accès

jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Water Treatment Application Leader
Vill du leda ett högkompetent team och spela en nyckelroll i utvecklingen av innovativa vattenreningslösningar för kunder över hela världen?
Vi söker nu en Application Engineering and Tendering Leader som vill ta ett övergripande ansvar för vårt team inom applikationsteknik och anbud. I rollen kommer du att vara en strategisk och operativ ledare som stödjer vår globala säljorganisation med tekniskt avancerade och kommersiellt konkurrenskraftiga lösningar inom vattenrening.
Det här är en central roll där du får möjlighet att påverka både affärsutveckling och teknisk innovation genom att leda arbetet med komplexa anbud, kundprojekt och applikationslösningar i nära samarbete med kollegor och kunder världen över.
Dina ansvarsområden
Som Application Engineering & Tendering Leader kommer du att:

• Leda och utveckla teamet inom Application Engineering och Tendering som stödjer våra globala säljenheter.

• Driva utvecklingen av tekniska lösningar, processkoncept, layouter och systemkonfigurationer för kundspecifika applikationer.

• Ansvara för planering, koordinering och genomförande av anbudsarbete samt säkerställa leverans av högkvalitativa anbud inom uppsatta tidsramar.

• Utvärdera tekniska, kommersiella och avtalsrelaterade risker samt ge rekommendationer för affärsbeslut.

• Fungera som en central länk mellan försäljning, teknik, produktledning och andra viktiga intressenter.

• Prioritera resurser och aktiviteter för att säkerställa bästa möjliga stöd till verksamheten och våra kunder.

• Bidra till utvecklingen av framgångsrika tekniska och kommersiella strategier för strategiskt viktiga affärsmöjligheter.

• Följa marknadsutveckling, kundbehov och konkurrentaktiviteter för att stärka vår konkurrenskraft.

• Säkerställa efterlevnad av interna processer, kvalitetskrav och kundspecifikationer.

• Presentera lösningsstrategier, anbudsstatus och affärsinsikter för ledning och andra beslutsfattare.

Vem är du?
Vi söker dig som kombinerar teknisk expertis med ett tydligt ledarskap och ett starkt affärsdriv.
Du har:

• Akademisk examen inom kemiteknik, miljöteknik eller annat relevant tekniskt område.

• Gedigen erfarenhet av vattenreningsprocesser, applikationsteknik och anbudsarbete.

• Dokumenterad erfarenhet av att leda och utveckla team inom teknik, applikationer, anbud eller närliggande områden.

• Erfarenhet av komplexa tekniska offerter och kundanpassade lösningar.

• God förståelse för kommersiella och avtalsrelaterade risker.

• Stark förmåga att leda projekt, bygga relationer och hantera flera intressenter samtidigt.

• Erfarenhet av att arbeta i en internationell och tvärfunktionell organisation.

• Mycket goda kunskaper i engelska, både muntligt och skriftligt.
Som person är du strukturerad, lösningsorienterad och kundfokuserad. Du trivs i en ledande roll där du får kombinera strategiskt tänkande med operativt genomförande och har förmågan att skapa engagemang, samarbete och resultat även i komplexa situationer.

Vi erbjuder
Hos oss får du möjlighet att:

• Ta en strategiskt viktig ledarroll i en internationell och växande organisation.

• Bidra till utvecklingen av hållbara och innovativa lösningar inom vattenrening.

• Arbeta nära kunder och påverka affärskritiska projekt och investeringar.

• Delaktig i att utveckla organisationen, dess arbetssätt för att att driva effektiv och lönsam affär.

• Leda ett engagerat och kompetent team med stort tekniskt kunnande.

• Utvecklas vidare i en organisation som präglas av samarbete, innovation och entreprenörsanda.

• Vara med och göra verklig skillnad inom ett område som är avgörande för en hållbar framtid.

Placeringsort: Nordic Water – Center of Excellence, Mölndal (Göteborg), Sverige.

What we offer you

jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Mechanical Engineer is responsible for researching, planning, designing, and developing mechanical products and systems. This includes instruments, controls, engines, and machines used in energy production, transmission, and measurement.
This job profile is intended for early-career professionals who apply broad theoretical knowledge and require the ability to investigate and analyze problems. Solutions are typically discussed/verified with a more senior member. Sulzer is offering a unique opportunity for early-career engineers to jumpstart their professional journey through a dynamic two-year rotational program. This immersive experience provides direct exposure across key departments within Sulzer’s Services Division, with the goal of permanent department placement upon program completion.

Position Summary: The Rotational Engineer program is a two-year rotational program designed to attract, develop, and retain high-potential, transformative engineers through best-in-industry rotational experience and professional development. This program supports the Services Division in the Americas by leading hands-on and strategic initiatives that enhance commercial and operational excellence. Acts as a bridge between engineering, commercial, and operations – designing and implementing shop-floor solutions, automation, supporting technical documentation, collaborating with vendors, and driving continuous improvement. Participants will rotate through four specialized areas, focusing on sales, operations, or engineering, each lasting six months:

• Steam Turbines and Compressor: Overhauls and assembly, rotor and component repairs, reverse engineering and parts manufacturing, performance rerates, performance qualification tests, custom engineering solutions, and field service

• Gas Turbine (Industrial and Aeroderivative): Overhauls and assembly, rotor and component repairs, metallurgical evaluations, performance testing, and field service

• Pumps: Overhauls and assembly, rotor and component repairs, reverse engineering and parts manufacturing, performance optimization, retrofits, hydraulic testing, and field service

• Electro-Mechanical Services: Overhauls and repairs of motors and generators, generator rewind, high voltage coil manufacturing, engineering services, and field services

Rotations I & II : Carefully selected to match your current skills and future ambitions, ensuring a personalized and enriching start to the program.

Rotations III & IV : You take the wheel—choose from a range of opportunities across departments to deepen expertise, explore new interests, and shape your unique path.

Candidates will be considered for all hiring Service Center locations which include but not limited to the following cities:

Houston, TX, Margate, FL, Chattanooga, TN, Barboursville, WV, Los Angeles, CA, Joliet, IL, Aurora, CO, Baton Rouge, LA, Piedmont, SC, Odessa, TX, Mobile, AL, Salt Lake City, UT, Phoenix, AZ, Gillette, WY, Colton, CA, and Orange, TX.

All candidates must be willing to relocate to any of these locations, or other Sulzer sites while in the program. Sulzer provides a locally adjusted housing allowance and mileage reimbursement to next rotation location, along with five business days of transfer time (excluding home-based placements).

Functions

• Participate or lead job tasks, production duties, and process improvement initiatives identified and assigned by Supervisor.

• Design, develop, implement, or upgrade drawings, work instructions, procedures, technical documentation, tooling and fixturing improvements.

• Collaborate with internal teams and external vendors to source and qualify solutions.

• Balance immediate troubleshooting support with long-term strategic projects.

Sulzer è una società di ingegneria leader con un patrimonio orgoglioso di innovazione. Unisciti al nostro team globale per accrescere le tue competenze e sviluppare soluzioni innovative che consentano una società prospera e più sostenibile.

Informazioni sul ruolo

Sintesi del lavoro
L'ingegnere meccanico è responsabile per la ricerca, la pianificazione, la progettazione e lo sviluppo di prodotti e sistemi meccanici. Questo include strumenti, controlli, motori e macchine utilizzate nella produzione, trasmissione e misura di energia.
Questo profilo di lavoro è destinato a professionisti precoci che applicano una vasta conoscenza teorica e richiedono la capacità di indagare e analizzare i problemi. Le soluzioni sono tipicamente discusse/verificati con un membro più anziano. Sulzer offre un'opportunità unica per gli ingegneri di pronto soccorso per avviare il loro viaggio professionale attraverso un programma di rotazione biennale dinamico. Questa esperienza immersiva fornisce un'esposizione diretta tra i principali dipartimenti della divisione Servizi di Sulzer, con l'obiettivo di un posizionamento permanente del reparto al completamento del programma.

Riepilogo della posizione: Il programma Rotational Engineer è un programma rotazionale di due anni progettato per attirare, sviluppare e mantenere ingegneri altamente potenziali e trasformativi attraverso l'esperienza rotazionale migliore in industria e lo sviluppo professionale. Questo programma supporta la Divisione Servizi nelle Americhe con importanti iniziative pratiche e strategiche che valorizzano l'eccellenza commerciale e operativa. Agisce come un ponte tra ingegneria, commerciale e operazioni – progettazione e realizzazione di soluzioni per il pavimento del negozio, automazione, supporto della documentazione tecnica, collaborazione con i fornitori e miglioramento continuo. I partecipanti ruotano attraverso quattro aree specializzate, concentrandosi su vendite, operazioni o ingegneria, ogni sei mesi:

• Turbine di vapore e compressore: revisioni e riparazioni, rotore e componenti, reverse engineering e parti di produzione, rerate di prestazioni, test di qualificazione delle prestazioni, soluzioni di ingegneria personalizzate e servizio di campo

• Turbina a gas (Industrial and Aeroderivative): revisioni e riparazioni, rotore e componenti, valutazioni metallurgiche, test delle prestazioni e assistenza sul campo

• Pompe: revisioni e riparazioni, rotore e componenti, reverse engineering e parti di produzione, ottimizzazione delle prestazioni, retrofit, collaudo idraulico e servizio di campo

• Servizi elettromeccanici: revisioni e riparazioni di motori e generatori, rewind generatore, produzione di bobina ad alta tensione, servizi di ingegneria e servizi di campo

Rotazioni I & II: accuratamente selezionati per abbinare le tue attuali competenze e future ambizioni, garantendo un inizio personalizzato e arricchinte al programma.

Rotazioni III & IV: Si prende la ruota - scegliere da una serie di opportunità tra i dipartimenti per approfondire le competenze, esplorare nuovi interessi e modellare il vostro percorso unico.

I candidati saranno considerati per tutti i luoghi del Service Center di assunzione che includono ma non limitato alle seguenti città:

Houston, TX, Margate, FL, Chattanooga, TN, Barboursville, WV, Los Angeles, CA, Joliet, IL, Aurora, CO, Baton Rouge, LA, Piemonte, SC, Odessa, TX, Mobile, AL, Salt Lake City, UT, Phoenix, AZ, Gillette, WY, Colton, CA e Orange, TX.

Tutti i candidati devono essere disposti a trasferirsi in uno di questi luoghi, o altri siti Sulzer mentre nel programma. Sulzer fornisce una indennità di alloggio regolata localmente e un rimborso di chilometraggio alla prossima posizione di rotazione, insieme a cinque giorni lavorativi di tempo di trasferimento (esclusi i posizionamenti a casa).

Funzioni

• Partecipare o condurre compiti di lavoro, doveri di produzione e iniziative di miglioramento del processo identificate e assegnate dal Supervisore.

• Progettare, sviluppare, implementare o aggiornare disegni, istruzioni di lavoro, procedure, documentazione tecnica, strumenti e miglioramenti di correzione.

• Collabora con i team interni e i fornitori esterni per la fonte e qualificare le soluzioni.

• Equilibrare immediatamente il supporto per la risoluzione dei problemi con progetti strategici a lungo termine.

• Gas Turbine (Industrial and Aeroderivative): Overhauls and assembly, rotor and component repairs, metallurgical evaluations, performance testing, and field service

• Pumps: Overhauls and assembly, rotor and component repairs, reverse engineering and parts manufacturing, performance optimization, retrofits, hydraulic testing, and field service

Rotations I & II : Carefully selected to match your current skills and future ambitions, ensuring a personalized and enriching start to the program.

Candidates will be considered for all hiring Service Center locations which include but not limited to the following cities:

Houston, TX, Margate, FL, Chattanooga, TN, Barboursville, WV, Los Angeles, CA, Joliet, IL, Aurora, CO, Baton Rouge, LA, Piedmont, SC, Odessa, TX, Mobile, AL, Salt Lake City, UT, Phoenix, AZ, Gillette, WY, Colton, CA, and Orange, TX.

All candidates must be willing to relocate to any of these locations, or other Sulzer sites while in the program. Sulzer provides a locally adjusted housing allowance and mileage reimbursement to next rotation location, along with five business days of transfer time (excluding home-based placements).

Functions

• Participate or lead job tasks, production duties, and process improvement initiatives identified and assigned by Supervisor.

• Design, develop, implement, or upgrade drawings, work instructions, procedures, technical documentation, tooling and fixturing improvements.

• Collaborate with internal teams and external vendors to source and qualify solutions.

• Balance immediate troubleshooting support with long-term strategic projects.

descriptionByLocale.de:
Sulzer ist ein führendes Ingenieurunternehmen mit einem stolzen Erbe an Innovationen. Schließen Sie sich unserem globalen Team an, um Ihr Fachwissen zu erweitern und innovative Lösungen zu entwickeln, die eine prosperierende und nachhaltigere Gesellschaft ermöglichen.

Über die Rolle

Stellenbeschreibung
Der Maschinenbauer ist verantwortlich für die Erforschung, Planung, Konstruktion und Entwicklung mechanischer Produkte und Systeme. Dazu gehören Instrumente, Steuerungen, Motoren und Maschinen, die bei der Energieerzeugung, -übertragung und -messung eingesetzt werden.
Dieses Stellenprofil richtet sich an Berufseinsteiger, die ein breites theoretisches Wissen anwenden und die Fähigkeit benötigen, Probleme zu untersuchen und zu analysieren. Lösungen werden in der Regel mit einem älteren Mitglied diskutiert / verifiziert. Sulzer bietet jungen Ingenieuren eine einzigartige Gelegenheit, ihre berufliche Reise durch ein dynamisches zweijähriges Rotationsprogramm zu beginnen. Diese immersive Erfahrung bietet eine direkte Präsenz in wichtigen Abteilungen innerhalb der Sulzer Services Division, mit dem Ziel der dauerhaften Abteilung Platzierung nach Abschluss des Programms.

Das Rotational Engineer Programm ist ein zweijähriges Rotationsprogramm, das entwickelt wurde, um hochkarätige, transformative Ingenieure durch branchenführende Rotationserfahrung und berufliche Entwicklung anzuziehen, zu entwickeln und zu halten. Dieses Programm unterstützt die Services Division in Amerika durch praktische und strategische Initiativen, die die kommerzielle und operative Exzellenz verbessern. Agiert als Brücke zwischen Engineering, Commercial und Operations - Design und Implementierung von Shopfloor-Lösungen, Automatisierung, Unterstützung der technischen Dokumentation, Zusammenarbeit mit Anbietern und kontinuierliche Verbesserung. Die Teilnehmer werden sich durch vier spezialisierte Bereiche drehen, die sich auf den Verkauf, den Betrieb oder das Engineering konzentrieren und jeweils sechs Monate dauern:

• Dampfturbinen und Kompressor: Überholungen und Montage, Rotor- und Komponentenreparaturen, Reverse Engineering und Teileherstellung, Leistungsbewertungen, Leistungsqualifikationstests, kundenspezifische Engineering-Lösungen und Außendienst

• Gasturbine (Industrielle und Aeroderivative): Überholungen und Montage, Rotor- und Komponentenreparaturen, metallurgische Auswertungen, Leistungsprüfungen und Außendienst

• Pumpen: Überholungen und Montage, Rotor- und Komponentenreparaturen, Reverse Engineering und Teileherstellung, Leistungsoptimierung, Nachrüstungen, hydraulische Prüfungen und Außendienst

• Elektromechanische Dienstleistungen: Überholungen und Reparaturen von Motoren und Generatoren, Generatorrückwicklung, Herstellung von Hochspannungsspulen, technische Dienstleistungen und Außendienste

Rotationen I & II: Sorgfältig ausgewählt, um Ihre aktuellen Fähigkeiten und zukünftigen Ambitionen zu entsprechen, um einen personalisierten und bereichernden Start in das Programm zu gewährleisten.

Rotations III & IV: Sie nehmen das Steuer – wählen Sie aus einer Reihe von Möglichkeiten in allen Abteilungen, um Fachwissen zu vertiefen, neue Interessen zu erkunden und Ihren einzigartigen Weg zu gestalten.

Kandidaten werden für alle mietenden Servicecenter-Standorte berücksichtigt, die folgende Städte umfassen, aber nicht darauf beschränkt sind:

Houston, TX, Margate, FL, Chattanooga, TN, Barboursville, WV, Los Angeles, CA, Joliet, IL, Aurora, CO, Baton Rouge, LA, Piemont, SC, Odessa, TX, Mobile, AL, Salt Lake City, UT, Phoenix, AZ, Gillette, WY, Colton, CA und Orange, TX.

Alle Kandidaten müssen bereit sein, an einen dieser Standorte oder andere Sulzer-Standorte umzuziehen, während sie sich im Programm befinden. Sulzer bietet eine lokal angepasste Wohnzulage und Kilometererstattung an den nächsten Rotationsstandort sowie fünf Werktage Transferzeit (ausgenommen Heimplatzierungen).

Funktionen

• Beteiligen oder leiten Sie Jobaufgaben, Produktionsaufgaben und Prozessverbesserungsinitiativen, die vom Supervisor identifiziert und zugewiesen wurden.

• Entwerfen, Entwickeln, Implementieren oder Aktualisieren von Zeichnungen, Arbeitsanweisungen, Verfahren, technischer Dokumentation, Werkzeug- und Befestigungsverbesserungen.

• Arbeiten Sie mit internen Teams und externen Anbietern zusammen, um Lösungen zu finden und zu qualifizieren.

• Balance sofortiger Troubleshooting-Unterstützung mit langfristigen strategischen Projekten.

descriptionByLocale.fr:
Sulzer est une entreprise d'ingénierie de premier plan avec un fier héritage d'innovation. Rejoignez notre équipe mondiale pour développer votre expertise et développer des solutions innovantes qui permettent une société prospère et plus durable.

Sur le rôle

Résumé de l'emploi
L'ingénieur mécanique est responsable de la recherche, de la planification, de la conception et du développement de produits et de systèmes mécaniques. Cela comprend les instruments, les commandes, les moteurs et les machines utilisés dans la production, la transmission et la mesure de l'énergie.
Ce profil d'emploi est destiné aux professionnels en début de carrière qui appliquent de vastes connaissances théoriques et qui ont besoin de la capacité d'étudier et d'analyser les problèmes. Les solutions sont généralement discutées/vérifiées avec un membre plus âgé. Sulzer offre une occasion unique aux ingénieurs en début de carrière de démarrer leur parcours professionnel à travers un programme de rotation dynamique de deux ans. Cette expérience immersive offre une visibilité directe dans les principaux ministères de la Division des services de Sulzer, dans le but de placer un ministère permanent au terme du programme.

Sommaire du poste : Le programme d'ingénieur rotatif est un programme de rotation de deux ans conçu pour attirer, développer et retenir des ingénieurs transformateurs à fort potentiel grâce à la meilleure expérience de rotation dans l'industrie et au perfectionnement professionnel. Ce programme appuie la Division des services dans les Amériques en dirigeant des initiatives concrètes et stratégiques qui favorisent l'excellence commerciale et opérationnelle. Agit comme un pont entre l'ingénierie, le commerce et les opérations – concevoir et mettre en œuvre des solutions d'atelier, l'automatisation, soutenir la documentation technique, collaborer avec les fournisseurs, et conduire à l'amélioration continue. Les participants feront une rotation dans quatre domaines spécialisés, axés sur les ventes, les opérations ou l'ingénierie, qui dureront chacun six mois :

• Turbines et compresseurs à vapeur : révision et montage, réparation de rotors et de composants, fabrication de pièces et d'inversions, rerates de performance, tests de qualification de performance, solutions d'ingénierie personnalisées et service sur le terrain

• Turbine à gaz (industrielle et aérodérivative) : révision et montage, réparations du rotor et des composants, évaluations métallurgiques, essais de performance et service sur le terrain

• Pompes: révision et montage, réparation de rotors et de composants, fabrication de pièces, optimisation des performances, modernisations, essais hydrauliques et service sur le terrain

• Services électro-mécaniques : Régulation et réparation de moteurs et de générateurs, remontage de générateurs, fabrication de bobines haute tension, services d'ingénierie et services sur le terrain

Rotations I & II : soigneusement sélectionnées pour correspondre à vos compétences actuelles et vos ambitions futures, assurant ainsi un démarrage personnalisé et enrichissant au programme.

Rotation III & IV : Vous prenez le volant – choisissez parmi une gamme d'opportunités à travers les départements pour approfondir l'expertise, explorer de nouveaux intérêts et façonner votre parcours unique.

Les candidats seront pris en considération pour tous les lieux d'embauche des centres de services qui comprennent, sans s'y limiter, les villes suivantes :

Houston, TX, Margate, FL, Chattanooga, TN, Barboursville, WV, Los Angeles, CA, Joliet, IL, Aurora, CO, Baton Rouge, LA, Piedmont, SC, Odessa, TX, Mobile, AL, Salt Lake City, UT, Phoenix, AZ, Gillette, WY, Colton, CA et Orange, TX.

Tous les candidats doivent être prêts à déménager à l'un de ces endroits ou à d'autres sites Sulzer pendant le programme. Sulzer verse une indemnité de logement ajustée localement et un remboursement du kilométrage au prochain lieu de rotation, ainsi que cinq jours ouvrables de transfert (sauf les placements à domicile).

Fonctions

• Participer ou diriger les tâches, les tâches de production et les initiatives d'amélioration des processus identifiées et assignées par le superviseur.

• Conception, élaboration, mise en œuvre ou mise à niveau de dessins, instructions de travail, procédures, documentation technique, outillage et améliorations de fixation.

• Collaborer avec des équipes internes et des fournisseurs externes pour trouver et qualifier des solutions.

• Équilibrer le soutien immédiat au dépannage avec les projets stratégiques à long terme.

Compétences

jobs.title: Regional Sales Manager
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

We are looking for an autonomous, results-driven Regional Sales Manager with a strong "hunter" mindset to accelerate the growth of our industrial wastewater business and hit aggressive 2026 performance objectives. This role bridges complex chemical and process engineering with high-stakes commercial negotiations, driving order intake, expanding market reach, and converting technical opportunities into closed business.

Joining the FRC Team at Sulzer
You will be joining FRC Systems International , a specialized business within Sulzer’s water treatment portfolio and Center of Excellence. FRC is a recognized leader in custom industrial wastewater treatment solutions—including Dissolved Air Flotation (DAF) systems, industrial screens, and biological treatment systems. In this role, you will be a vital part of Sulzer's end-to-end water treatment portfolio, providing lifecycle-optimized solutions that help heavy industries meet environmental regulations and sustainability commitments.

Job Details & Logistics

• Drive sales visits, client presentations, and project initiations across the assigned market.

• Review customer Requests for Quotation (RFQs) to ensure specifications match company capabilities.

• Take ownership of the commercial proposal, determining pricing guidelines and negotiating final terms.

• Provide technical expertise and answer customer inquiries regarding complex wastewater problems.

Work Arrangement: Open to candidate relocation, with strong potential for remote/home-office flexibility supported by heavy regular travel to conduct on-site customer visits.

Qualifications

• Bachelor’s Degree in Chemical, Industrial, Process Engineering, or Physics.

• Minimum of 5 years of experience working within water or water-related industries.

• Minimum of 5 years of experience in sales or business development, ideally involving capital equipment or complex technical systems.

What we offer you

• 15 days of paid time off and 12 company-paid holidays

• 401k plan with a 6% match

• Comprehensive health plan including medical, dental, vision, Life, short-term & long-term disability

• Health savings account matching

• Motivating wellness program

• Employee Assistance Program

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: National Sales Manager (Pulp and Paper Industry)

titleByLocale.en: National Sales Manager (Pulp and Paper Industry)

jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

We are seeking a dynamic, hands-on National Sales Manager to lead and develop our Direct and Regional Sales Managers while implementing aggressive sales strategies across the United States. This role carries direct accountability for all direct and indirect PPI sales activities, requiring close collaboration with operations, procurement, quality, and other key departments.

Ideal Candidate Profile & Core Expertise
Beyond strong leadership qualities, we are looking for a proven industry expert who brings deep, hands-on experience in the Pulp and Paper (PPI) market . Specifically, the ideal candidate must possess direct technical and commercial background with pumps, mixers, screens, or specific application experience directly inside pulp and paper mills . They will use this deep industry fluency to lead teams, manage major corporate and OEM accounts, and forge partnerships.

Core Responsibilities:

• Achieve sales growth targets by developing and executing annual sales plans for the US PPI market.

• Lead, coach, mentor, and monitor the performance of Regional Sales Managers and Application Specialists.

• Own and manage direct corporate accounts, building solid partnerships and negotiating OEM/corporate agreements.

• Analyze market trends and competitor activity to expand sales of new and existing products.

Travel Expectation: High travel requirement of 60%-70% , primarily targeting Atlanta, Georgia, the Carolinas, and the broader Southeast region of the US.

Qualifications

• Bachelor’s degree in engineering or a similar technical degree preferred; MBA is a plus.

• 10 to 15 years of regional sales experience, with a mandatory background in the Pulp and Paper industry featuring hands-on application experience with mill equipment such as pumps, mixers, or screens.

• At least 5 years of people management experience leading sales teams.

What we offer you

• Competitive Paid Time Off

• 12 Company Paid Holidays per year

• Annual Bonus Program

• Full Medical, Dental, and Vision benefits

• Company Paid Short Term and Long Term Disability, Company Paid Life Insurance

• 6% 401K or Roth Company Match with Immediate Vesting

• Company Paid Retirement Security Contributions following 1 year of employment

• Tuition Reimbursement/Educational Assistance

• Quarterly Gym Reimbursement

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Sr. Machinery Mechanic
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Senior Industrial Motor & Generator Mechanic is a hands-on technical leader who independently disassembles, inspects, troubleshoots, repairs, reassembles, and supports testing of heavy-industrial motors, generators, pumps, gearboxes, and related rotating equipment. This role supports mission-critical equipment for utilities, water, mining, manufacturing, semiconductor, aerospace, agriculture, food production, and other industrial markets.

Senior mechanics serve as trusted technical resources in a skilled, team-oriented shop, working with mechanics, winders, machinists, welders, test technicians, engineers, project managers, and supervisors to solve challenging repairs safely, correctly, and efficiently.

Ideal candidates bring strong rotating equipment, industrial maintenance, millwright, field service, heavy equipment, aviation, military, power generation, mining, pump, turbine, compressor, or similar mechanical repair experience, with the judgment, communication, and ownership expected from a senior shop resource. Essential Duties and Responsibilities

• Independently perform and guide complex teardown, inspection, repair, reassembly, and testing support for industrial motors, generators, pumps, gearboxes, and related equipment.

• Diagnose mechanical and electromechanical failures using inspection results, measurements, operating history, test results, and observed equipment condition.

• Work on high-value rotating equipment serving power, water, mining, manufacturing, semiconductor, aerospace, agriculture, food production, and other industrial markets.

• Inspect bearings, journals, fits, shafts, housings, end shields, fans, couplings, seals, brush rigging, rotors, stators, and related assemblies.

• Determine repair requirements, identify practical options, and communicate concerns affecting scope, quality, schedule, safety, or customer approval.

• Read and apply job cards, drawings, specifications, repair procedures, customer requirements, and technical documentation.

• Support root cause analysis, failure analysis, and repair planning.

• Coordinate repair work with shop trades, supervisors, project managers, and engineering support.

• Perform balancing, vibration analysis, alignment, final inspection, and testing activities as assigned.

• Identify when machining, welding, replacement parts, engineering review, or customer approval may be required.

• Mentor developing mechanics while modeling safe work habits, documentation discipline, and high workmanship standards.

• Promote safe work practices, high-quality workmanship, and efficient job execution.

• Communicate clearly across departments, stay calm under changing priorities, and support a culture of safety, respect, accountability, and problem-solving.

• Maintain accurate inspection notes, repair documentation, measurement records, and job status updates.

• Perform other related duties as assigned.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

• Advanced mechanical and electromechanical troubleshooting ability.

• Strong understanding of industrial rotating equipment repair practices.

• Strong knowledge of bearings, fits, shafts, housings, seals, couplings, fans, and related assemblies.

• Ability to inspect worn, damaged, overheated, contaminated, or failed components and identify likely causes.

• Ability to use precision measuring tools accurately.

• Ability to work from drawings, specifications, procedures, and customer requirements.

• Ability to train and mentor less experienced mechanics.

• Ability to communicate technical findings clearly across departments.

• Ability to remain calm and productive under changing priorities, emergency jobs, and customer-driven schedules.

• Willingness to teach, share knowledge, ask g

Informazioni sul ruolo

Sintesi del lavoro
Il Senior Industrial Motor & Generator Mechanic è un leader tecnico pratico che disassembla in modo indipendente, ispezioni, risoluzione dei problemi, riparazioni, riassemblaggi, e supporta il test di motori, generatori, pompe, riduttori e attrezzature rotanti correlate. Questo ruolo supporta le attrezzature mission-critical per utenze, acqua, estrazione mineraria, produzione, semiconduttore, aerospaziale, agricoltura, produzione alimentare e altri mercati industriali.

I meccanici senior servono come risorse tecniche di fiducia in un negozio specializzato, orientato al team, lavorando con meccanica, ventilatori, macchinisti, saldatori, tecnici di test, ingegneri, project manager e supervisori per risolvere le riparazioni impegnative in modo sicuro, corretto ed efficiente.

I candidati ideali portano attrezzature rotanti forti, manutenzione industriale, fresatura, servizio di campo, attrezzature pesanti, aviazione, militare, generazione di potenza, estrazione mineraria, pompa, turbina, compressore, o simile esperienza di riparazione meccanica, con la sentenza, comunicazione e la proprietà prevista da una risorsa di negozio senior. Duità e responsabilità essenziali

• Eseguire in modo indipendente e guidare la rimozione complessa, ispezione, riparazione, riassemblaggio e il supporto di test per motori industriali, generatori, pompe, riduttori e attrezzature correlate.

• Diagnosi guasti meccanici ed elettromeccanici utilizzando i risultati di ispezione, le misurazioni, la storia operativa, i risultati di test e le condizioni di apparecchiature osservate.

• Lavorare su attrezzature rotanti ad alto valore che servono potenza, acqua, estrazione mineraria, produzione, semiconduttore, aerospaziale, agricoltura, produzione alimentare e altri mercati industriali.

• Ispezione di cuscinetti, diari, si adatta, alberi, alloggiamenti, scudi finali, ventilatori, accoppiamenti, guarnizioni, spazzole, rotori, statiri e assemblaggi correlati.

• Determinare i requisiti di riparazione, identificare le opzioni pratiche e comunicare le preoccupazioni che riguardano la portata, la qualità, il programma, la sicurezza o l'approvazione del cliente.

• Leggere e applicare schede di lavoro, disegni, specifiche, procedure di riparazione, requisiti del cliente e documentazione tecnica.

• Supporto radice causa analisi, analisi guasti e pianificazione di riparazione.

• Coordinate lavori di riparazione con negozi, supervisori, project manager e supporto ingegneristico.

• Eseguire il bilanciamento, l'analisi delle vibrazioni, l'allineamento, l'ispezione finale e le attività di test assegnate.

• Identificare quando si lavora, saldatura, parti di ricambio, revisione di ingegneria, o l'approvazione del cliente può essere richiesto.

• Mentore che sviluppa meccanica durante la modellazione abitudini di lavoro sicure, disciplina di documentazione e elevati standard di lavorazione.

• Promuovere pratiche di lavoro sicure, lavorazione di alta qualità, e l'esecuzione di lavoro efficiente.

• Comunicare chiaramente attraverso i dipartimenti, rimanere calmi sotto le priorità mutevoli e sostenere una cultura di sicurezza, rispetto, responsabilità e problem-solving.

• Mantenere note di ispezione accurate, documentazione di riparazione, record di misura e aggiornamenti di stato del lavoro.

• Eseguire altri compiti correlati come assegnato.

Conoscenza, abilità e abilità

• Avanzate capacità di risoluzione dei problemi meccanici ed elettromeccanici.

• Forte comprensione delle pratiche di riparazione di attrezzature rotanti industriali.

• Forte conoscenza di cuscinetti, montature, alberi, alloggiamenti, guarnizioni, accoppiamenti, ventilatori e assemblaggi correlati.

• Capacità di ispezionare componenti usurati, danneggiati, sovrariscaldati, contaminati o guasti e identificare cause probabili.

• Capacità di utilizzare con precisione strumenti di misura di precisione.

• Capacità di lavorare da disegni, specifiche, procedure e requisiti del cliente.

• Capacità di formare e mentore meccanica meno esperta.

• Capacità di comunicare i risultati tecnici chiaramente in tutti i reparti.

• Capacità di rimanere calmo e produttivo in base alle priorità mutevoli, ai posti di lavoro di emergenza e agli orari dei clienti.

• Volontà di insegnare, condividere la conoscenza, chiedere g

Sulzer ist ein führendes Ingenieurunternehmen mit einem stolzen Erbe an Innovationen. Schließen Sie sich unserem globalen Team an, um Ihr Fachwissen zu erweitern und innovative Lösungen zu entwickeln, die eine prosperierende und nachhaltigere Gesellschaft ermöglichen.

Über die Rolle

Stellenbeschreibung
Der Senior Industrial Motor & Generator Mechanic ist ein praktischer technischer Führer, der selbstständig zerlegt, inspiziert, Fehlerbehebungen, Reparaturen, Neumontage und unterstützt das Testen von Schwerindustriemotoren, Generatoren, Pumpen, Getrieben und verwandten rotierenden Geräten. Diese Rolle unterstützt unternehmenskritische Ausrüstung für Versorgungsunternehmen, Wasser, Bergbau, Fertigung, Halbleiter, Luft- und Raumfahrt, Landwirtschaft, Lebensmittelproduktion und andere industrielle Märkte.

Senior Mechaniker dienen als vertrauenswürdige technische Ressourcen in einem qualifizierten, teamorientierten Shop und arbeiten mit Mechanikern, Windern, Maschinisten, Schweißern, Testtechnikern, Ingenieuren, Projektmanagern und Vorgesetzten zusammen, um anspruchsvolle Reparaturen sicher, korrekt und effizient zu lösen.

Ideale Kandidaten bringen starke rotierende Ausrüstung, industrielle Wartung, Millwright, Außendienst, schwere Ausrüstung, Luftfahrt, Militär, Stromerzeugung, Bergbau, Pumpe, Turbine, Kompressor oder ähnliche mechanische Reparaturerfahrung mit dem Urteil, der Kommunikation und dem Eigentum, das von einer Senior-Shop-Ressource erwartet wird. Wesentliche Pflichten und Verantwortlichkeiten

• Führen Sie unabhängig eine komplexe Zerkleinerung, Inspektion, Reparatur, Wiedermontage und Testunterstützung für Industriemotoren, Generatoren, Pumpen, Getriebe und verwandte Geräte durch.

• Diagnostizieren Sie mechanische und elektromechanische Fehler unter Verwendung von Inspektionsergebnissen, Messungen, Betriebshistorie, Testergebnissen und beobachtetem Gerätezustand.

• Arbeiten an hochwertigen rotierenden Geräten für Strom, Wasser, Bergbau, Fertigung, Halbleiter, Luft- und Raumfahrt, Landwirtschaft, Lebensmittelproduktion und andere industrielle Märkte.

• Prüfen Sie Lager, Zapfen, Passungen, Wellen, Gehäuse, Lagerschilde, Ventilatoren, Kupplungen, Dichtungen, Bürstengestelle, Rotoren, Statoren und zugehörige Baugruppen.

• Bestimmen Sie Reparaturanforderungen, identifizieren Sie praktische Optionen und kommunizieren Sie Bedenken bezüglich Umfang, Qualität, Zeitplan, Sicherheit oder Kundengenehmigung.

• Lesen und Anwenden von Jobkarten, Zeichnungen, Spezifikationen, Reparaturverfahren, Kundenanforderungen und technische Dokumentation.

• Unterstützung der Ursachenanalyse, der Fehleranalyse und der Reparaturplanung.

• Koordinieren Sie Reparaturarbeiten mit Werkstätten, Vorgesetzten, Projektmanagern und technischem Support.

• Führen Sie Balancing-, Vibrationsanalyse-, Ausrichtungs-, Endinspektions- und Testaktivitäten wie zugewiesen durch.

• Identifizieren Sie, wann Bearbeitung, Schweißen, Ersatzteile, technische Überprüfung oder Kundengenehmigung erforderlich sind.

• Mentor entwickelt Mechanik und modelliert gleichzeitig sichere Arbeitsgewohnheiten, Dokumentationsdisziplin und hohe Verarbeitungsstandards.

• Förderung sicherer Arbeitspraktiken, hochwertiger Verarbeitung und effizienter Ausführung von Aufträgen.

• Kommunizieren Sie über Abteilungen hinweg klar, bleiben Sie bei sich ändernden Prioritäten ruhig und unterstützen Sie eine Kultur der Sicherheit, des Respekts, der Rechenschaftspflicht und der Problemlösung.

• Pflegen Sie genaue Inspektionshinweise, Reparaturdokumentationen, Messaufzeichnungen und Aktualisierungen des Jobstatus.

• Führen Sie andere damit verbundene Aufgaben wie zugewiesen aus.

Wissen, Fähigkeiten und Fähigkeiten

• Fortschrittliche mechanische und elektromechanische Fehlerbehebungsfähigkeit.

• Ein fundiertes Verständnis der industriellen Rotationsausrüstung Reparaturpraktiken.

• Ein fundiertes Wissen über Lager, Passungen, Wellen, Gehäuse, Dichtungen, Kupplungen, Lüfter und verwandte Baugruppen.

• Fähigkeit, abgenutzte, beschädigte, überhitzte, kontaminierte oder ausgefallene Komponenten zu untersuchen und mögliche Ursachen zu identifizieren.

• Fähigkeit, Präzisionsmessgeräte genau zu verwenden.

• Fähigkeit, aus Zeichnungen, Spezifikationen, Verfahren und Kundenanforderungen zu arbeiten.

• Fähigkeit, weniger erfahrene Mechaniker zu trainieren und zu betreuen.

• Fähigkeit, technische Erkenntnisse über Abteilungen hinweg klar zu kommunizieren.

• Fähigkeit, unter wechselnden Prioritäten, Notfalljobs und kundenorientierten Zeitplänen ruhig und produktiv zu bleiben.

descriptionByLocale.fr:
Sulzer est une entreprise d'ingénierie de premier plan avec un fier héritage d'innovation. Rejoignez notre équipe mondiale pour développer votre expertise et développer des solutions innovantes qui permettent une société prospère et plus durable.

Sur le rôle

Résumé de l'emploi
Le Mécanicien principal du moteur industriel et du générateur est un chef de file technique qui démonte, inspecte, dépanne, répare, réassemble et supporte les essais de moteurs industriels lourds, de générateurs, de pompes, de boîtes de vitesses et d'équipements rotatifs connexes. Ce rôle appuie l'équipement essentiel pour les services publics, l'eau, les mines, la fabrication, les semi-conducteurs, l'aérospatiale, l'agriculture, la production alimentaire et d'autres marchés industriels.

Les mécaniciens chevronnés servent de ressources techniques de confiance dans un magasin compétent et axé sur l'équipe, travaillant avec des mécaniciens, des éoliennes, des machinistes, des soudeurs, des techniciens d'essai, des ingénieurs, des gestionnaires de projet et des superviseurs pour résoudre les réparations difficiles en toute sécurité, correctement et efficacement.

Les candidats idéaux apportent de l'équipement rotatif solide, l'entretien industriel, le service sur le terrain, l'équipement lourd, l'aviation, l'armée, la production d'énergie, l'exploitation minière, la pompe, la turbine, le compresseur ou une expérience similaire de réparation mécanique, avec le jugement, la communication et la propriété attendue d'une ressource de magasin senior. Fonctions et responsabilités essentielles

• Effectuer et guider de façon indépendante des opérations de démontage, d'inspection, de réparation, de montage et d'essai complexes pour les moteurs industriels, les générateurs, les pompes, les boîtes de vitesses et les équipements connexes.

• Diagnostiquer les défaillances mécaniques et électromécaniques en utilisant les résultats d'inspection, les mesures, l'historique de fonctionnement, les résultats d'essais et l'état de l'équipement observé.

• Travaux sur des équipements rotatifs de grande valeur servant à l'électricité, à l'eau, aux mines, à la fabrication, aux semi-conducteurs, à l'aérospatiale, à l'agriculture, à la production alimentaire et à d'autres marchés industriels.

jobs.title: Sales Account Manager
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

We have an exciting opportunity for an Account Manager to join our dynamic Benelux Sales team. In this key commercial role, you will help drive growth within the water and wastewater market in Flanders, strengthening customer relationships and delivering tailored technical solutions across our rotating equipment portfolio.

If you combine strong commercial instincts with technical affinity and enjoy working closely with customers in an industrial and municipal environment, this role offers a chance to make a real impact at Sulzer.

Your main tasks and responsibilities:

• Develop and grow the customer base by nurturing existing relationships and actively acquiring new customers.

• Meet sales and order‑intake targets in line with market expectations and business objectives.

• Provide accurate technical advice and select the right products for applications within your region.

• Prepare proposals, quotations, and pricing decisions to support successful commercial outcomes.

• Conduct effective lead qualification in close collaboration with relevant internal teams.

• Serve as the primary internal point of contact for your customers and translate their needs clearly within the organization.

• Execute timely follow‑up of leads, pipelines, and quotations while maintaining accurate CRM data (Salesforce).

• Participate in customer meetings, internal order reviews, and relevant training programs.

• Collaborate effectively with colleagues across departments in line with Sulzer’s values, ensuring a consistent and high‑quality customer experience.

To succeed in this role, you will need:

• A bachelor’s or Masters degree in a relevant technical field.

• 3–5 years of experience in sales or service within rotating machinery or a comparable industrial environment.

• A strong commercial mindset paired with a service‑oriented, optimistic, and proactive approach.

• Fluency in Dutch and English; French is an advantage.

• Good MS Office skills; experience with Salesforce is beneficial.

• Willingness to travel within Flanders to visit customers and partners.

• Ability to communicate clearly, manage multiple priorities, and build trust with both internal and external stakeholders.

What we offer you:

• A collaborative, forward‑thinking environment with a strong emphasis on technical excellence and customer value.

• The opportunity to shape market presence in a strategically important region.

• Broad opportunities for professional development within a global, innovative organization.

• A role where your technical insight and commercial drive directly contribute to Sulzer’s success.

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

I vostri compiti principali e responsabilità:

Per avere successo in questo ruolo, avrete bisogno di:

Cosa ti offriamo:

Um in dieser Rolle erfolgreich zu sein, benötigen Sie:

• 3-5 Jahre Erfahrung im Vertrieb oder Service in rotierenden Maschinen oder einem vergleichbaren industriellen Umfeld.

• Eine starke kommerzielle Denkweise gepaart mit einem serviceorientierten, optimistischen und proaktiven Ansatz.

jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Industrial Motor & Generator Mechanic disassembles, inspects, cleans, repairs, reassembles, and supports testing of heavy-industrial motors, generators, pumps, and related rotating equipment. This role supports mission-critical equipment for utilities, water infrastructure, mining, manufacturing, semiconductor, aerospace, agriculture, food production, and other industrial markets.

Mechanically inclined candidates from developing technicians to experienced mechanics are encouraged to apply; direct motor shop experience is helpful but not required for all candidates.

Mechanics work in a skilled, team-oriented shop alongside winders, machinists, welders, test technicians, engineers, and supervisors to solve challenging repair problems together. Phoenix, Arizona

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

• Disassemble, inspect, repair, test, and reassemble mission-critical industrial motors, generators, pumps, gearboxes, and related electromechanical equipment used in heavy industry.

• Work on high-value rotating equipment serving power, water, mining, manufacturing, semiconductor, aerospace, agriculture, food production, and other industrial markets.

• Inspect and evaluate equipment condition, damage, failure evidence, repair requirements, and serviceability.

• Perform low-voltage and high-voltage electrical diagnostic testing and related electrical inspections on motors and generators.

• Troubleshoot mechanical and electromechanical problems using test results, inspection findings, drawings, repair history, and hands-on experience.

• Remove, install, fit, adjust, and repair mechanical components during disassembly, reassembly, shop repair, and on-site service.

• Inspect mechanical and electrical components for wear, damage, overheating, tracking, contamination, fit issues, and other repair concerns.

• Measure, verify, and record critical dimensions using micrometers, calipers, dial indicators, bore gauges, and other precision measuring tools.

• Identify, match-mark, organize, protect, clean, and document parts during teardown and repair.

• Perform alignment, fit checks, mechanical inspection, electrical checks, operational checks, and final inspection.

• Operate industrial motor repair tools and equipment after proper training.

• Read and apply work instructions, repair scopes, drawings, customer specifications, and quality requirements.

• Work directly with skilled teams to complete repairs correctly and efficiently.

• Document inspection results, test results, measurements, repair findings, and work performed.

• Follow all safety, quality, environmental, electrical test, lifting, rigging, and shop procedures.

• Maintain tools, equipment, parts, and work areas in a clean, organized, and safe condition.

• Perform other related duties as assigned.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

• Strong mechanical aptitude.

• Safe use of hand tools, power tools, and measuring instruments.

• Ability to follow verbal and written instructions, work instructions, and safety procedures.

• Strong organization, documentation habits, and attention to detail.

• Ability to work independently and as part of a team after proper training.

• Clear communication with supervisors and coworkers.

• Strong attention to safety, quality, and workmanship.

Minimum Qualifications

• High school diploma or equivalent.

• Mechanical aptitude and strong willingness to learn.

• Ability to safely perform physical work in an industrial shop environment.

• Ability to follow safety procedures, work instructions, and quality requirements.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience in industrial maintenance, mechanical repair, rotating equipment repair, automotive, diesel, heavy equipment, aviation, military, manufact

Sulzer è una società di ingegneria leader con un patrimonio orgoglioso di innovazione. Unisciti al nostro team globale per accrescere le tue competenze e sviluppare soluzioni innovative che consentano una società prospera e più sostenibile.

Informazioni sul ruolo

Sintesi del lavoro
L'Industrial Motor & Generator Mechanic disassembla, ispezioni, pulisce, ripara, riassembla e supporta la sperimentazione di motori, generatori, pompe e relative attrezzature rotanti. Questo ruolo supporta le attrezzature mission-critical per utenze, infrastrutture idriche, estrazione mineraria, produzione, semiconduttore, aerospaziale, agricoltura, produzione alimentare e altri mercati industriali.

I candidati meccanicamente inclinati dallo sviluppo di tecnici a meccanica esperta sono incoraggiati ad applicare; esperienza di negozio di motori diretti è utile ma non richiesto per tutti i candidati.

I meccanici lavorano in un negozio specializzato e orientato al team insieme a ventilatori, macchinisti, saldatori, tecnici di test, ingegneri e supervisori per risolvere insieme problemi di riparazione impegnativi. Phoenix, Arizona

Duità e responsabilità essenziali

• Disassemblare, ispezionare, riparare, testare e riassemblare motori industriali mission-critical, generatori, pompe, riduttori e apparecchiature elettromeccaniche correlate utilizzate nell'industria pesante.

• Lavorare su attrezzature rotanti ad alto valore che servono potenza, acqua, estrazione mineraria, produzione, semiconduttore, aerospaziale, agricoltura, produzione alimentare e altri mercati industriali.

• Ispezionare e valutare le condizioni dell'apparecchiatura, danni, prove di guasto, requisiti di riparazione e di manutenzione.

• Eseguire test diagnostici elettrici a bassa tensione e ad alta tensione e ispezioni elettriche correlate su motori e generatori.

• Risoluzione dei problemi meccanici ed elettromeccanici utilizzando i risultati dei test, i risultati delle ispezioni, i disegni, la cronologia delle riparazioni e l'esperienza pratica.

• Rimuovere, installare, adattare, regolare e riparare componenti meccanici durante smontaggio, riassemblaggio, riparazione negozio e servizio in loco.

• Ispezionare componenti meccanici ed elettrici per usura, danni, surriscaldamento, monitoraggio, contaminazione, problemi di vestibilità e altre preoccupazioni di riparazione.

• Misurare, verificare e registrare dimensioni critiche utilizzando micrometri, pinze, indicatori di linea, manometri e altri strumenti di misura di precisione.

• Identificare, match-mark, organizzare, proteggere, pulire e documentare le parti durante la rimozione e la riparazione.

• Eseguire l'allineamento, i controlli fit, l'ispezione meccanica, i controlli elettrici, i controlli operativi e l'ispezione finale.

• Operare strumenti di riparazione e attrezzature motori industriali dopo una corretta formazione.

• Leggere e applicare le istruzioni di lavoro, gli ambiti di riparazione, disegni, specifiche del cliente e requisiti di qualità.

• Lavorare direttamente con team qualificati per completare le riparazioni in modo corretto ed efficiente.

• Risultati di ispezione del documento, risultati di prova, misurazioni, risultati di riparazione e lavoro svolto.

• Seguire tutte le procedure di sicurezza, qualità, ambiente, test elettrico, sollevamento, rigging e negozio.

• Mantenere strumenti, attrezzature, parti e aree di lavoro in una condizione pulita, organizzata e sicura.

• Eseguire altri compiti correlati come assegnato.

Conoscenza, abilità e abilità

• Forte attitudine meccanica.

• Utilizzo sicuro di strumenti a mano, strumenti di potenza e strumenti di misura.

• Capacità di seguire istruzioni verbali e scritte, istruzioni di lavoro e procedure di sicurezza.

• Forte organizzazione, abitudini di documentazione e attenzione ai dettagli.

• Capacità di lavorare in modo indipendente e come parte di un team dopo una corretta formazione.

• Comunicazione chiara con supervisori e colleghi.

• Forte attenzione alla sicurezza, alla qualità e alla lavorazione.

Qualifiche minime

• Diploma di scuola superiore o equivalente.

• attitudine meccanica e forte disponibilità ad imparare.

• Capacità di svolgere in modo sicuro il lavoro fisico in un ambiente di negozio industriale.

• Capacità di seguire procedure di sicurezza, istruzioni di lavoro e requisiti di qualità.

Qualificazioni predestinate

• Esperienza nella manutenzione industriale, riparazione meccanica, riparazione attrezzature rotanti, automotive, diesel, attrezzature pesanti, aviazione, militare, manufatto
