Sur le rôle

Résumé de l'emploi
Le mécanicien industriel de moteurs et de générateurs démonte, inspecte, nettoie, répare, réassemble et supporte les essais de moteurs, de générateurs, de pompes et d'équipements rotatifs connexes. Ce rôle appuie l'équipement essentiel de la mission pour les services publics, l'infrastructure de l'eau, l'exploitation minière, la fabrication, les semi-conducteurs, l'aérospatiale, l'agriculture, la production alimentaire et d'autres marchés industriels.

On encourage les candidats qui ont l'inclination mécanique, du perfectionnement des techniciens aux mécaniciens expérimentés, à présenter leur candidature; l'expérience d'un atelier automobile direct est utile, mais pas requise pour tous les candidats.

Les mécaniciens travaillent dans une boutique spécialisée, axée sur l'équipe, aux côtés des éoliennes, des machinistes, des soudeurs, des techniciens d'essai, des ingénieurs et des superviseurs pour résoudre ensemble des problèmes de réparation difficiles. Phoenix, Arizona

Fonctions et responsabilités essentielles

• Démonter, inspecter, réparer, tester et réassembler des moteurs industriels, des générateurs, des pompes, des boîtes de vitesses et des équipements électromécaniques connexes utilisés dans l'industrie lourde.

• Travaux sur des équipements rotatifs de grande valeur servant à l'électricité, à l'eau, aux mines, à la fabrication, aux semi-conducteurs, à l'aérospatiale, à l'agriculture, à la production alimentaire et à d'autres marchés industriels.

• Examiner et évaluer l'état de l'équipement, les dommages, les preuves de défaillance, les exigences en matière de réparation et la facilité d'entretien.

• Effectuer des tests de diagnostic électrique à basse tension et haute tension et des inspections électriques connexes sur les moteurs et les générateurs.

• Dépanner les problèmes mécaniques et électromécaniques à l'aide des résultats d'essais, des résultats d'inspection, des dessins, des antécédents de réparation et de l'expérience pratique.

• Retirez, installez, installez, ajustez et réparez les composants mécaniques pendant le démontage, le remontage, la réparation de l'atelier et le service sur place.

• Inspecter les composants mécaniques et électriques pour l'usure, les dommages, la surchauffe, le suivi, la contamination, les problèmes d'ajustement et d'autres problèmes de réparation.

• Mesurer, vérifier et enregistrer les dimensions critiques à l'aide de micromètres, de coulisses, d'indicateurs de cadran, de jauges de forage et d'autres outils de mesure de précision.

• Identifier, marquer, organiser, protéger, nettoyer et documenter les pièces pendant le démontage et la réparation.

• Effectuer l'alignement, les contrôles d'ajustement, l'inspection mécanique, les contrôles électriques, les contrôles opérationnels et l'inspection finale.

• Utiliser des outils et des équipements de réparation de moteurs industriels après une formation appropriée.

• Lisez et appliquez les instructions de travail, les champs de réparation, les dessins, les spécifications du client et les exigences de qualité.

• Travailler directement avec des équipes compétentes pour effectuer les réparations correctement et efficacement.

• Documenter les résultats de l'inspection, les résultats des essais, les mesures, les résultats des réparations et les travaux effectués.

• Suivez toutes les procédures de sécurité, de qualité, d'environnement, d'essai électrique, de levage, de gréement et d'atelier.

• Maintenir les outils, l'équipement, les pièces et les aires de travail dans un état propre, organisé et sécuritaire.

• Exécuter d'autres fonctions connexes telles qu'elles sont assignées.

Connaissances, compétences et capacités

• Forte aptitude mécanique.

• Utilisation sécuritaire des outils à main, des outils électriques et des instruments de mesure.

• Capacité de suivre des instructions verbales et écrites, des instructions de travail et des procédures de sécurité.

• Forte organisation, habitudes de documentation et attention aux détails.

• Capacité de travailler de façon indépendante et en équipe après une formation appropriée.

• Communication claire avec les superviseurs et les collègues.

• Une grande attention à la sécurité, la qualité et l'exécution.

Qualités minimales

• Diplôme d'études secondaires ou équivalent.

• Aptitude mécanique et forte volonté d'apprendre.

• Capacité d'effectuer du travail physique en toute sécurité dans un environnement industriel.

• Capacité de suivre les procédures de sécurité, les instructions de travail et les exigences de qualité.

Qualifications privilégiées

• Expérience en entretien industriel, réparation mécanique, réparation d'équipement rotatif, automobile, diesel, équipement lourd, aviation, militaire, fabrication

jobs.title: Business Development Director
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

We are seeking a high-impact, results-driven Business Development Director with a deep, hands-on comprehension of the pumping world, industrial markets, and municipal space to lead growth initiatives and commercial operations for our FLOW division. Operating in a strict Business-to-Business (B2B) environment, this leader will drive strategic Growth Driver Plans (GDP), champion channel partner and distributor networks, and directly oversee and mentor our Regional Marketing Team and our Order Entry/Sales Support Processing Team .

If you possess a strong commercial background rooted in pumps and fluid handling, combined with process optimization (LEAN/VBSS) and team leadership—and are based within practical traveling distance of our Easley, SC facility—we want to hear from you.

Key Accountabilities & Responsibilities:

• Spearhead business development tailored specifically to the municipal and industrial water/pumping markets, partnering with Regional Sales Heads and Segment Heads to execute monthly Growth Driver Plans (GDP).

• Optimize, support, and expand our network of distributors and channel partners across the industrial and municipal space to maximize market reach.

• Direct, mentor, and align the Regional Marketing team and the Order Entry Processing team to ensure seamless workflow, high morale, and tight coordination between marketing, sales operations, and order fulfillment.

• Drive the execution and high user adoption of sales optimization tools (Salesforce CRM, CPQ, SAPConf), monitoring utilization and resolving roadblocks to internal efficiency.

• Apply LEAN, VBSS, or similar continuous improvement methodologies to identify and remove waste in internal business processes, order entry, and customer-facing workflows.

• Oversee data mining, ERP data accessibility, and management-level dashboards to track Order Intake (OI), Sales, and rolling forecasts.

• Liaise with Finance and Strategy to support budgeting, regular pipeline reviews, CRM maintenance, and the preparation of high-level corporate presentations.

Job Requirements & Qualifications:

• Bachelor’s Degree in Business Administration, Engineering, Marketing, or a related commercial/technical field (Master’s / MBA preferred).

• 8+ years of progressive commercial experience— with a mandatory, hands-on background in the municipal or industrial pumping world (B2B) . Must possess a thorough, practical comprehension of industrial channel partners, manufacturer's reps, and equipment distributors.

• Proven track record of managing, developing, and motivating cross-functional teams (specifically including marketing professionals and order entry/processing or customer service operations).

Location & Travel Requirements:

• Residency: Must reside within regional proximity and manageable traveling distance to our Easley, SC facility (preferred states: South Carolina, Georgia, Florida, or the Midwest).

• Work Style: Remote-compatible role with the flexibility for routine travel to the Easley, SC office and key regional locations as business needs dictate.

What we offer you

• Competitive Paid Time Off

• 12 Company Paid Holidays per year

• Annual Bonus Program

• Full Medical, Dental, and Vision benefits

• Company Paid Short Term and Long-Term Disability, Company Paid Life Insurance

• 6% 401K or Roth Company Match with Immediate Vesting

• Company Paid Retirement Security Contributions following 1 year of employment

• Tuition Reimbursement/Educational Assistance

• Quarterly Gym Reimbursement

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Ger

• Partner con le teste del segmento per sviluppare, tracciare e segnalare i vari piani di azione
• Lavorare con il personale degli analisti aziendali per automatizzare la raccolta dei dati TTI
• Raccogliere e comunicare i dati delle prestazioni, le intuizioni di mercato e le opportunità per assistere i team di vendita e servizi (collegare i dati di KPI, struttura, gestione visiva, ecc.)
• Coordinare le attività dei responsabili del marketing regionale
• Combinare la promozione del marketing, l'analisi e il PIL/iniziativa insieme per coordinare e concentrare le risorse
• Superare la gestione della comunicazione di marketing e iniziative di marketing
• Supporta programmi di sviluppo dei partner
• Sostenere la leadership di vendita per creare e gestire il flusso di comunicazione sul principale interno sociale ed esterno
• Concentrati sull'esecuzione e sulla rimozione dei rifiuti nei processi aziendali, principalmente nelle attività di Vendite e Servizi, Drive Sales Support dipartimento che fornisce informazioni ai leader di vendita per facilitare le aziende.
• Organizzare e supervisionare l'estrazione dati, l'accessibilità ai dati in vari sistemi (ERP)
• Creazione e manutenzione del cruscotto di livello di gestione
• Supporta la raccolta e l'analisi dei dati di Business Intelligence.
• Coordinare con altre funzioni che SalesForce CRM, CPQ, SAPConf e altri sistemi principali sono sviluppati in base alle esigenze aziendali.
• Liaise with Finance e with Strategy (Processo di costruzione, per segmento, per Regione, per prodotto)
• Regolare revisione della Pipeline e manutenzione CRM
• Trainer per SalesForce
• Gestione delle previsioni, sia per OI (Order Intake) che per Vendite
• Partner con i leader di vendita e il personale di sviluppo aziendale per monitorare l'esecuzione tempestiva dei compiti chiave
• Assistere con preparazione per presentazioni e report aziendali Cosa ti offriamo
• Tempo a pagamento competitivo
• 12 Azienda Pagamenti all'anno
• Programma bonus annuale
• Vantaggi medici, dentali e di visione completi
• Società pagata a breve termine e disabilità a lungo termine, Azienda pagato vita assicurazione
• 6% 401K o Roth Company Match con gilet immediato
• Contributi di sicurezza a carico della società a seguito di 1 anno di occupazione
• Rimborso/Assistenza educativa

Siamo orgogliosi di essere riconosciuti come Top Employer 2026 in Brasile, Canada, Cina, Finlandia, Germania, Irlanda, Messico, Svizzera, Sud Africa, Regno Unito e Stati Uniti.

jobs.title: Mechanic
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary

The Sr. Machinery Mechanic is responsible for maintaining and repairing industrial machinery and mechanical systems. This role performs complex diagnostics, preventive maintenance, and repairs, ensuring equipment reliability and operational efficiency.

This job profile is intended for experienced support-level staff that generally works autonomously and only requires closer supervision in non-routine situations. This job and its associated grade are specifically aligned with roles that have the following scope of responsibility: Small, Medium, Large, Division / Extra Large organization.

Key Responsibilities:
Inspect, troubleshoot, and repair mechanical equipment.
Perform preventive maintenance and document findings.
Replace or fabricate parts as needed.
Maintain tools and ensure safe working conditions.
Collaborate with production teams to minimize downtime.
Train and support junior mechanics.
Follow safety and operational procedures.

Skills & Qualifications:
Typically requires vocational training (or equivalent experience) and several years of relevant work experience to carry out the role.
Strong mechanical aptitude and diagnostic skills.
Experience with industrial machinery and tools.
Ability to read technical manuals and schematics.
Knowledge of safety regulations and maintenance procedures.
Good communication and teamwork skills.

What we offer you

• 15 days of paid time off and 12 company-paid holidays

• 401k plan with a 6% match

• Comprehensive health plan including medical, dental, vision, Life, short-term & long-term disability

• Health savings account matching

• Motivating wellness program

• Employee Assistance Program

• Paid paternal leave

• Gym reimbursement

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

Allenamento e supporto meccanica junior.

jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Join Sulzer’s Flow Equipment division and play a key role in delivering competitive and technically robust solutions for large-scale infrastructure and energy projects. Working closely with Sales, Engineering, Project Management, and our global manufacturing network, you will lead the preparation of complex tenders, develop technical solutions, assess project risks, and support customers throughout the bidding process. This is an excellent opportunity for an engineering professional who enjoys combining technical expertise with commercial insight in an international environment. Main responsibilities:

• Prepare high-quality technical and commercial tenders for infrastructure and energy projects, ensuring accuracy, competitiveness, and on-time delivery.

• Review customer specifications and analyze technical requirements to develop optimal pumping solutions.

• Collaborate with specialist departments and manufacturing sites to define and configure pumps, accessories, and related systems.

• Evaluate technical and commercial project risks and develop mitigation strategies during the bidding phase.

• Support customers and sales teams with technical consultations, specifications, and proposal presentations.

• Manage supplier and subcontractor enquiries, evaluate quotations, and lead technical discussions when required.

• Coordinate cross-functional stakeholders throughout the tender preparation process to ensure a competitive and compliant offer.

• Participate in customer negotiations and ensure a smooth handover from tendering to project execution teams after contract award.

• Maintain accurate data and documentation within sales and tendering systems.

What you need to succeed:

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Process Engineering, or a related technical discipline.

• Minimum 5 years of experience in tendering, sales engineering, project management, pump engineering, or a related field.

• Strong technical knowledge of pumps, rotating equipment, and associated systems.

• Experience in complex technical tenders and commercial proposal preparation.

• Knowledge of desalination and water transport applications will be considered a strong advantage.

• Excellent communication and negotiation skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across international and multidisciplinary teams.

• Strong commercial awareness combined with a customer-focused mindset.

• Ability to work independently, manage multiple priorities, and solve complex technical challenges.

• Fluent English.

• Availability to travel within Spain and internationally when required

What we offer you

• A permanent contract.

• A competitive salary as well as participation in the variable remuneration system based on personal and financial objectives.

• Meal vouchers.

• Access to a voluntary flexible compensation scheme allowing employees to optimize their salary package (e.g. health insurance, transport, childcare)

• Be part of an experienced and international team.

• A good vibe working environment.

• The opportunity to grow your career within a solid and well-established international company.

• Be part of a dynamic organization undergoing continuous transformation and improvement.

• Offices location: Chamartín, Madrid.

* Additional benefits may apply depending on the position and location.

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

Sur le rôle

Rejoignez la division de l'équipement de flux de Sulzer et jouez un rôle clé dans la fourniture de solutions compétitives et techniquement robustes pour les grands projets d'infrastructure et d'énergie. En étroite collaboration avec Sales, Engineering, Project Management et notre réseau mondial de fabrication, vous dirigerez la préparation d'offres complexes, développerez des solutions techniques, évaluerez les risques du projet et accompagnerez les clients tout au long du processus d'appel d'offres. C'est une excellente occasion pour un professionnel de l'ingénierie qui aime combiner expertise technique et perspectives commerciales dans un environnement international. Principales responsabilités :

• Préparer des appels d'offres techniques et commerciaux de haute qualité pour les projets d'infrastructure et d'énergie, en assurant la précision, la compétitivité et la livraison à temps.

• Examiner les spécifications du client et analyser les exigences techniques pour développer des solutions de pompage optimales.

• Collaborer avec les départements spécialisés et les sites de fabrication pour définir et configurer les pompes, les accessoires et les systèmes connexes.

• Évaluer les risques liés aux projets techniques et commerciaux et élaborer des stratégies d'atténuation pendant la phase de soumission.

• Accompagner les clients et les équipes de vente par des consultations techniques, des spécifications et des présentations de propositions.

• Gérer les demandes de renseignements des fournisseurs et des sous-traitants, évaluer les devis et diriger les discussions techniques au besoin.

• Coordonner les intervenants interfonctionnels tout au long du processus de préparation des appels d'offres afin d'assurer une offre concurrentielle et conforme.

• Participer aux négociations avec les clients et assurer un transfert sans heurt de l'appel d'offres aux équipes d'exécution du projet après l'attribution du contrat.

• Tenir à jour des données et des documents exacts au sein des systèmes de vente et d'appel d'offres.

Ce que vous devez réussir:

• Baccalauréat ou maîtrise en génie mécanique, en génie industriel, en génie des procédés ou dans une discipline technique connexe.

• Au moins 5 ans d'expérience dans l'appel d'offres, l'ingénierie des ventes, la gestion de projet, l'ingénierie des pompes ou un domaine connexe.

• Forte connaissance technique des pompes, de l'équipement rotatif et des systèmes associés.

• Expérience dans la préparation d'offres techniques complexes et de propositions commerciales.

• La connaissance des applications du dessalement et du transport par eau sera considérée comme un avantage important.

• Excellentes compétences en communication et en négociation, avec la capacité de collaborer efficacement entre les équipes internationales et multidisciplinaires.

• Forte sensibilisation commerciale associée à un état d'esprit axé sur le client.

• Capacité de travailler de façon indépendante, de gérer plusieurs priorités et de résoudre des défis techniques complexes.

• Anglais.

• Disponibilité pour voyager en Espagne et à l'étranger au besoin

Ce que nous vous offrons

• Un contrat permanent.

• Un salaire compétitif ainsi que la participation au système de rémunération variable fondé sur des objectifs personnels et financiers.

• Des bons de repas.

Um in dieser Rolle erfolgreich zu sein, müssen Sie

• Bachelor-Abschluss in Finanzen, Rechnungswesen, Wirtschaft, Betriebswirtschaft oder einem verwandten Bereich.

• Ein fundiertes Wissen über Budgetierung, Prognose, Finanzmodellierung und Leistungsanalyse.

• Hervorragende analytische und problemlösende Fähigkeiten mit einer starken Liebe zum Detail.

• Weitere europäische Sprachen sind ein Plus.

• Proaktive, kollaborative Denkweise mit der Fähigkeit, unabhängig zu arbeiten und mehrere Prioritäten zu verwalten.

jobs.description:

About the role

Job Description Summary
Sie packen gerne selbst mit an, haben Freude an Technik und gehen Ursachen von Störungen systematisch auf den Grund? Dann sind Sie bei uns genau richtig. In dieser abwechslungsreichen Position arbeiten Sie an Pumpen, Getrieben, Kompressoren, Turbinen und weiteren rotierenden Maschinen. Dabei übernehmen Sie sowohl Instandhaltungs- und Reparaturarbeiten als auch Einsätze direkt bei unseren Kunden vor Ort.
Ihre Aufgaben

• Wartung, Reparatur und Instandsetzung von Pumpen, Getrieben, Kompressoren, Turbinen und anderem Rotating Equipment

• Störungen und Schäden analysieren, Ursachen feststellen und passende Lösungen umsetzen

• Demontage, Prüfung und Montage von Bauteilen bis hin zu kompletten Aggregaten inklusive Gleitringdichtungen und Peripherie

• Service- und Instandhaltungsarbeiten in der Werkstatt sowie direkt beim Kunden vor Ort durchführen

• Anlagen und Maschinen nach abgeschlossenen Arbeiten wieder in Betrieb nehmen und auf ihre Funktion prüfen

• Kunden bei technischen Fragestellungen mit Fachwissen und Praxiserfahrung unterstützen

• Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Kollegen, um Erfahrungen auszutauschen und gemeinsam die beste Lösung zu finden

• Sicherstellen, dass Qualitäts- und Sicherheitsstandards jederzeit eingehalten werden

• Technische Ausbildung, beispielsweise als Industriemechaniker (m/w/d), Mechatroniker (m/w/d) oder in einem vergleichbaren Beruf

• Erfahrung im Service, in der Instandhaltung oder bei der Reparatur von rotierenden Maschinen

• Freude an Fehlersuche, Ursachenanalyse und technischen Herausforderungen

• Praktische und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise

• Teamgeist und die Bereitschaft, Wissen und Erfahrungen mit Kollegen zu teilen

• Kundenorientiertes Auftreten und ein hoher Qualitätsanspruch an die eigene Arbeit

jobs.title: Project Manager
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Are you an experienced Project Manager looking to join a global engineering leader where you'll play a critical role in delivering complex projects across some of the world's most important industries? At Sulzer, we're specialists in fluid engineering, helping customers maximise the reliability, performance and efficiency of their operations. With annual sales exceeding CHF 3.6 billion, approximately 13,000 employees worldwide and a strong global reputation for innovation and excellence, Sulzer offers the opportunity to build a rewarding career within a business that keeps critical industries moving.

Based at our Birmingham Service Centre, you'll work from one of the most advanced facilities of its kind in the UK. Opened in 2021 following a major investment, this 82,000 sq. ft purpose-built Centre of Excellence has been designed around lean manufacturing principles and is equipped with cutting-edge digital technologies, advanced machining capabilities and state-of-the-art additive manufacturing. Operating 24/7, the site delivers world-class maintenance, repair and overhaul solutions for pumps, motors, generators, compressors, turbines and other critical rotating equipment across all industries. If you're looking to make a real impact in a fast-paced environment where engineering expertise, innovation and customer focus come together, Sulzer offers the platform to take your career to the next level. What You'll Be Doing

• Managing multiple engineering and service projects simultaneously from initiation through to completion.

• Acting as the primary point of contact for customers throughout the project lifecycle.

• Coordinating cross-functional teams including engineering, production, procurement and operations.

• Developing and maintaining project schedules, budgets and resource plans.

• Monitoring project performance, identifying risks and implementing mitigation plans.

• Ensuring projects are delivered in compliance with safety, quality and contractual requirements.

• Managing project reporting and providing regular updates to internal and external stakeholders.

What You'll Bring

• Proven experience in a Project Manager role within engineering, manufacturing, industrial services or a related technical environment.

• Strong project planning and organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities.

• Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills.

• Experience managing project budgets, schedules and commercial performance.

• Ability to work effectively within a fast-paced operational environment.

• Strong problem-solving and decision-making capabilities.

• Proficiency in Microsoft Office and project management tools.

• Project Management qualification (APM, PRINCE2, PMP or equivalent) – desirable, not essential.

• Experience within rotating equipment, maintenance, repair and overhaul (MRO), manufacturing or industrial engineering sectors.

What we offer you

• A competitive basic salary

• Annual personal bonus scheme based on company and personal performance

• Private Medical Insurance

• 33 days annual leave.

• Defined pension contributions.

• Access to Medicash helping you cover everyday health costs like dental optical and physiotherapy plus a range of wellbeing perks.

• Confidential support via Employee Assistance Programmes.

• Access to discounts on shopping entertainment lifestyle plus opportunity to apply for Costco membership.

• Discounted personal car leasing for you your family and friends.

• Long Service Awards celebrating your commitment.

• Continuous learning opportunities through Sulzer Learning Pathways.

• As a Silver Award holder of the MoD Defence Employer Recognition Scheme, we welcome and support veterans, reservists and Cadet Adult

With annual sales exceeding CHF 3.6 billion, approximately 13,000 employees worldwide and a strong global reputation for innovation and excellence, Sulzer offers the opportunity to build a rewarding career within a business that keeps critical industries moving.

jobs.description:

About the role

Job Summary

Under limited supervision, performs all necessary tasks in the repair and maintenance of Sulzer Pumps’ and all other manufacturers’ pumping equipment while strictly adhering to customer, OEM and industry standard specifications. Follows department policy and procedures manual. Key Responsibilities

• Assembling all types of pump equipment to customers, OEM and industry standard specifications

• Disassembling equipment to gain access remove, clean and inspect components

• Inspecting & recording component measurements using instruments, tools and gages and providing inspection report

• Investigating and determining root cause failure

• Determining proper materials for repairs as per BOM

• Contouring impellers and pump casings to meet hydraulic requirements

• Setting and operating dynamic balancing equipment

• Performing final testing and inspections

• Attention to detail

• Extensive knowledge of and ability to use hand tools, precision measuring and testing equipment and machine shop equipment

• Ability to work with limited supervision

• Ability to travel to and work at customer sites

• Ability to work overtime

jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Sr. Machine Operator is responsible for operating and maintaining production machinery, ensuring efficient and safe operations. This role performs advanced machine setup, monitors production quality, and may assist in training junior operators.
This job profile is intended for experienced support-level staff that generally works autonomously and only requires closer supervision in non-routine situations. This job and its associated grade are specifically aligned with roles that have the following scope of responsibility: Small, Medium, Large, Division / Extra Large organization. Key Responsibilities Set up and operate machinery according to specifications. Monitor machine performance and product quality. Perform routine maintenance and troubleshooting. Ensure compliance with safety and operational procedures. Document production data and report issues. Train and support junior machine operators. Skills & Qualifications Typically requires vocational training (or equivalent experience) and several years of relevant work experience to carry out the role. Proficiency in operating industrial machinery. Understanding of safety and quality standards. Mechanical aptitude and problem-solving skills. Ability to work independently and as part of a team. Good communication and documentation skills.

Journey Level Machinist

SUMMARY:

Under limited supervision, the Journey Level Machinist is responsible for setting up and operating Machining equipment in accordance with departmental policies and procedures. This role involves manufacturing, and reconditioning components to meet OEM and industry standards. This role involves using manual and CNC controlled lathes and mills, and interprets mechanical drawings and sketches to execute high-quality work.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

· Performs layouts, sets up, and operates machines.

· Read and interpret procedures, work orders, and technical drawings to meet specifications.

· Apply knowledge of metals and alloys, including stainless and carbon steels.
· Improves set ups and methods for higher quality and improved cost.
· Operate overhead crane and forklifts safely as directed by Supervisor.

· Perform other duties as necessary.
· Maintain regular and reliable attendance.

SECONDARY RESPONSIBILITIES:

· Maintains a safe, neat, and orderly workstation

· Assists in the disassembly, inspection, and re-assembly of pump equipment when required
· Communicate effectively to ensure smooth workflow transitions between team members.
· Support and assist coworkers, including training and collaboration.
· Supports, cooperates with, and participates in company-wide safety program which includes following all safety policies and procedures
· Supports and cooperates in Sulzer Nuclear Quality Program
· Performs other duties as assigned
· Works overtime as requested
· Operates forklifts, overhead cranes, man lifts, and scissor lifts

QUALIFICATIONS:
· Completion of a machinist apprentice program or equivalent training.
· Minimum of five (5) years of experience in machining.
· Ability to hold close tolerances and conduct component inspection.
· Ability to read and interpret technical drawings.

jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary

A winder disassembles, repairs, rewinds, and reassembles electric motors, and generators. Key Responsibilities

• Read job cards to determine; job status, work authorization/limitations, estimate, description of problems and/or expected serviceability.

• Test electro-mechanical equipment to troubleshoot known or suspected problems using various methods (ac or de).

• Disassemble electro-mechanical equipment noting parts identifications, configuration and condition.

• Clean electro-mechanical equipment assemblies as needed using various methods and steps, including but not limited to: parts washer/steamers, caustic tanks, glass beaders, etc.

• Measure for or note proper replacement parts. Correctly requisition needed items from storekeeper, as approved by supervisor.

• Replace or repair worn or defective mechanical or electro-mechanical assemblies, including but not limited to: bearings, brushes, brush holders, motors leads gears seals, impellers, mechanical switches, brakes clutches, clutch rotors, tachs, fans, end shield,, etc.

• Retest reassembled electro-mechanical equipment for proper output and operation.

• Complete required paperwork for each job accurately and on a timely basis.

• Operate specialized repair and testing equipment and other equipment as needed

• Observe all safety procedures and use proper protective gear (especially eye and car protection).

• Lift, tighten, adjust and/or secure heavy objects in order to perform work duties.

• Keep work area neat and clean as directed by supervisor.

• Assisted other mechanics or other shop personnel in skilled or –non-skilled duties as directed by supervisor or shop manager.

• Perform other skilled or not-skilled duties as directed by supervisor

QUALIFICATIONS:

• High school diploma or equivalent

• Basic mechanical aptitude

PHYSICAL DEMANDS

• While performing duties of this job, would occasionally be required to stand, walk, sit, reach with hands and arms, climb or balance, stoop or kneel, talk and hear, and use fingers and hands to feel objects.

• Ability to lift and/or move up to 50 pounds

• Aptitude meccanica di base

jobs.title: Field Service Engineer
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Sulzer is a global leader in fluid engineering and rotating equipment services, with a proud history dating back to 1834. Through our Rotating Equipment Services division, we deliver world-class maintenance, repair, and upgrade solutions for critical turbomachinery, including steam turbines, industrial gas turbines, aeroderivatives, and large compressors. Our Services team specializes in ensuring the reliability and longevity of rotating equipment and turbomachinery assets for customers in oil & gas, power generation, and industrial sectors.

As a Field Service Engineer, you will be at the forefront of delivering these solutions. Working on rotating equipment across diverse client sites worldwide, you’ll ensure critical assets operate at peak performance. Location: Flexible – Can be based anywhere in the UK
Travel: Domestic and international travel, both onshore and offshore

Key Responsibilities

• Install, remove, repair, commission, and maintain rotating equipment onshore and offshore.

• Dismantle, inspect, and report on equipment condition using standard field service documentation.

• Compile detailed inspection and commissioning reports, liaising with internal teams and clients.

• Reassemble and test equipment following engineering best practices and OEM standards.

• Ensure compliance with client and company safety procedures at all times.

• Provide professional client interaction to minimize downtime and maintain strong relationships.

What We’re Looking For

• We’re seeking a time-served mechanical engineer with proven practical experience in the maintenance and overhaul of rotating equipment,

• Flexibility and willingness to travel, both domestically and internationally, including offshore assignments.

• Ability to work independently and as part of a team in challenging environments.

• Excellent problem-solving skills, with a proactive approach to troubleshooting and delivering solutions under pressure.

• Strong communication and interpersonal skills to liaise effectively with clients and internal teams.

What we offer you

• A competitive basic salary

• Company-wide bonus scheme

• Paid overtime opportunities

• Offshore allowances

• 33 days annual leave.

• Defined pension contributions.

• Access to Medicash helping you cover everyday health costs like dental optical and physiotherapy plus a range of wellbeing perks.

• Confidential support via Employee Assistance Programmes.

• Access to discounts on shopping entertainment lifestyle plus opportunity to apply for Costco membership.

• Discounted personal car leasing for you your family and friends.

• Long Service Awards celebrating your commitment.

• Continuous learning opportunities through Sulzer Learning Pathways.

jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Based at our Birmingham Service Centre, you'll work from one of the most advanced facilities of its kind in the UK. Opened in 2021 following a major investment, this 82,000 sq. ft purpose-built Centre of Excellence has been designed around lean manufacturing principles and is equipped with cutting-edge digital technologies, advanced machining capabilities and state-of-the-art additive manufacturing.

Operating 24/7, the site delivers world-class maintenance, repair and overhaul solutions for pumps, motors, generators, compressors, turbines and other critical rotating equipment across a wide range of industries.

Due to continued growth, we're looking for a skilled Winder/Fitter to join our team. As a Winder/Fitter, you will play a key role in the repair, refurbishment, manufacture and assembly of electrical rotating equipment and components, ensuring all work is completed safely, efficiently and to the highest quality standards.

Key responsibilities include:

• Carrying out winding, fitting and assembly activities on a range of electrical equipment.

• Manufacturing and installing coils and windings to specification.

• Stripping, inspecting and rebuilding motors, generators and associated equipment.

• Reading and interpreting engineering drawings and technical documentation.

• Supporting electrical and mechanical testing activities.

• Identifying faults and assisting with repair solutions.

• Maintaining high levels of quality, housekeeping and safety within the workshop.

• Supporting continuous improvement initiatives and best practice across the business.
What We're Looking For

• Previous experience in an engineering, fitting, manufacturing or repair environment.

• Strong mechanical aptitude and practical problem-solving skills.

• Ability to interpret engineering drawings and technical instructions.

• Attention to detail with a commitment to delivering high-quality work.

• A positive attitude and willingness to work as part of a team.

• Wire winding experience would be a distinct advantage.

• Experience working on motors, generators or other rotating equipment.

• Coil manufacturing or rewind experience.

• Electrical testing knowledge and experience.

• Engineering apprenticeship or equivalent technical qualification.

jobs.title: Material Handler
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Material Handler is responsible for the accurate management, tracking, movement, staging, and distribution of raw materials, components, and finished parts throughout the shop. This position supports production operations by ensuring materials are available when needed, maintaining inventory accuracy, processing material transactions in SAP, and coordinating with production personnel, planners, and coordinators. The Material Handler also transports materials, tools, and equipment between the facility and outside vendors using company vehicles, including trucks and trailers. Essential Duties and Responsibilities

• Release and issue materials to production jobs in accordance with work orders and manufacturing schedules.

• Track and maintain accurate inventory records for raw materials, components, consumables, and finished parts.

• Process inventory transactions, material movements, and work order activities using SAP.

• Coordinate with Operations, Production Coordinators, Planners, Supervisors, and other departments regarding material requirements and job status.

• Communicate effectively through Outlook email, telephone, and other communication platforms to support shop activities.

• Move, organize, stage, and deliver materials to designated workstations to ensure efficient workflow and uninterrupted production.

• Verify quantities, part numbers, and material specifications before issuing materials to jobs.

• Maintain accurate records of material receipts, transfers, returns, and inventory adjustments.

• Conduct cycle counts and assist with physical inventory activities to ensure inventory accuracy.

• Receive and inspect incoming materials and verify shipments against purchase orders, packing slips, and receiving documentation.

• Operate forklifts, pallet jacks, cranes, and other material handling equipment as required.

• Operate company trucks and trailers to transport parts, tools, and materials between company facilities and external vendors.

• Pick up and deliver materials, tooling, and supplies from suppliers and outside service providers as needed.

• Ensure materials are properly identified, labeled, stored, and protected from damage.

• Maintain clean, organized, and safe material storage and staging areas.

• Follow all company safety policies, quality requirements, and operating procedures.

• Assist with continuous improvement initiatives related to inventory control, material flow, and production support.

Required Qualifications

• High school diploma or equivalent.

• Experience in material handling, inventory control, warehouse operations, or manufacturing support environments.

• Working knowledge of SAP or similar enterprise resource planning (ERP) systems.

• Proficiency with Microsoft Outlook and general computer applications.

• Ability to read and interpret work orders, inventory records, and production documentation.

• Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.

• Excellent communication and coordination skills.

• Valid driver's license with an acceptable driving record.

• Ability to operate or become certified on forklifts and other material handling equipment.

• Experience operating trucks and trailers for material transportation.

Physical Requirements

• Ability to frequently lift, carry, push, and pull materials up to 50 pounds.

• Ability to stand, walk, bend, stoop, and reach for extended periods.

• Ability to safely operate forklifts, trucks, trailers, and material handling equipment.

• Ability to work indoors and outdoors in varying weather conditions when making vendor deliveries and pickups.

What we offer you

• 15 days of paid time off and 12 company-paid holidays

• 401k plan with a 6% match

• Comprehensive health plan incl

Sulzer è una società di ingegneria leader con un patrimonio orgoglioso di innovazione. Unisciti al nostro team globale per accrescere le tue competenze e sviluppare soluzioni innovative che consentano una società prospera e più sostenibile.

Informazioni sul ruolo

Sintesi del lavoro
Il Material Handler è responsabile per la gestione accurata, il monitoraggio, il movimento, la messa in scena e la distribuzione di materie prime, componenti e parti finite in tutto il negozio. Questa posizione supporta le operazioni di produzione assicurando che i materiali siano disponibili quando necessario, mantenendo l'accuratezza dell'inventario, elaborando transazioni materiali in SAP, e coordinando con personale di produzione, pianificatori e coordinatori. Il Material Handler trasporta anche materiali, strumenti e attrezzature tra la struttura e i fornitori esterni utilizzando veicoli aziendali, compresi camion e rimorchi. Doveri e responsabilità essenziali

• Rilasciare ed emettere materiali ai lavori di produzione in conformità con gli ordini di lavoro e gli orari di produzione.

• Tracciare e mantenere i record di inventario accurate per materie prime, componenti, materiali di consumo e parti finite.

• Elaborare operazioni di inventario, movimenti materiali e attività di ordine di lavoro utilizzando SAP.

• Coordinate con Operazioni, Coordinatori di Produzione, Pianificatori, Supervisori e altri dipartimenti per quanto riguarda i requisiti materiali e lo stato di lavoro.

• Comunicare efficacemente attraverso Outlook e-mail, telefono e altre piattaforme di comunicazione per supportare le attività del negozio.

• Sposta, organizza, organizza e consegna materiali a postazioni di lavoro designate per garantire un flusso di lavoro efficiente e una produzione ininterrotta.

• Verificare quantitÃ, numeri di parte e specifiche materiali prima di emettere materiali per lavori.

• Mantenere registri accurati di ricevute di materiale, trasferimenti, ritorni e modifiche di inventario.

• Condurre il ciclo conta e assistere con attività di inventario fisico per garantire l'accuratezza dell'inventario.

• Ricevi e ispezionare i materiali in arrivo e verificare le spedizioni contro gli ordini di acquisto, le schede di imballaggio e la documentazione di ricezione.

• Operare carrelli elevatori, martinetti per pallet, gru e altre attrezzature per la movimentazione dei materiali come richiesto.

• Operare camion aziendali e rimorchi per trasportare parti, strumenti e materiali tra strutture aziendali e fornitori esterni.

• Raccogliere e fornire materiali, utensili e forniture da fornitori e fornitori di servizi esterni, come necessario.

• Assicurare che i materiali siano adeguatamente identificati, etichettati, memorizzati e protetti da danni.

• Mantenere aree pulite, organizzate e sicure di stoccaggio materiale e di staging.

• Seguire tutte le politiche di sicurezza aziendale, requisiti di qualità e procedure operative.

• Assistere con iniziative di miglioramento continuo relative al controllo dell'inventario, al flusso materiale e al supporto di produzione.

Qualificazioni richieste

• Diploma di scuola superiore o equivalente.

• Esperienza nella gestione dei materiali, nel controllo delle scorte, nelle operazioni di magazzino o negli ambienti di supporto di produzione.

• Conoscenze di lavoro dei sistemi SAP o simili per la pianificazione delle risorse aziendali (ERP).

• Proficienza con Microsoft Outlook e applicazioni di computer generali.

• Capacità di leggere e interpretare gli ordini di lavoro, i registri di inventario e la documentazione di produzione.

• Forte capacità organizzative e attenzione ai dettagli.

• Ottima capacità di comunicazione e coordinamento.

• Patente di guida valida con un record di guida accettabile.

• Capacità di operare o diventare certificato su carrelli elevatori e altre attrezzature di movimentazione dei materiali.

• Scopri camion e rimorchi operativi per il trasporto di materiale.

Requisiti fisici

• Capacità di sollevare, trasportare, spingere e tirare materiali fino a 50 libbre.

• Capacità di stare, camminare, piegare, poggiare e raggiungere per lunghi periodi.

• Capacità di operare in modo sicuro carrelli elevatori, camion, rimorchi e attrezzature per la movimentazione dei materiali.

• Capacità di lavorare all'interno e all'aperto in condizioni atmosferiche variabili quando si effettuano consegne e pickup dei fornitori.

Cosa ti offriamo

• 15 giorni di tempo libero e 12 giorni festivi

• 401k piano con una partita del 6%

• Piano sanitario completo incl

Sulzer ist ein führendes Ingenieurunternehmen mit einem stolzen Erbe an Innovationen. Schließen Sie sich unserem globalen Team an, um Ihr Fachwissen zu erweitern und innovative Lösungen zu entwickeln, die eine wohlhabende und nachhaltigere Gesellschaft ermöglichen.

Über die Rolle

Stellenbeschreibung
Der Material Handler ist für die genaue Verwaltung, Nachverfolgung, Bewegung, Staging und Verteilung von Rohstoffen, Komponenten und Fertigteilen im gesamten Shop verantwortlich. Diese Position unterstützt den Produktionsbetrieb, indem sie sicherstellt, dass bei Bedarf Materialien verfügbar sind, die Bestandsgenauigkeit aufrechterhalten, Materialtransaktionen in SAP verarbeitet und sich mit Produktionspersonal, Planern und Koordinatoren koordiniert. Der Material Handler transportiert auch Materialien, Werkzeuge und Ausrüstung zwischen der Einrichtung und externen Anbietern mit Firmenfahrzeugen, einschließlich Lastwagen und Anhängern. Wesentliche Pflichten und Zuständigkeiten

• Freigabe und Ausgabe von Materialien für Produktionsaufträge gemäß Arbeitsaufträgen und Fertigungsplänen.

• Verfolgen und pflegen Sie genaue Bestandsaufzeichnungen für Rohstoffe, Komponenten, Verbrauchsmaterialien und Fertigteile.

• Inventartransaktionen, Materialbewegungen und Auftragsaktivitäten mit SAP verarbeiten.

• Koordinieren Sie sich mit Operations, Produktionskoordinatoren, Planern, Supervisoren und anderen Abteilungen in Bezug auf Materialanforderungen und Stellenstatus.

• Kommunizieren Sie effektiv über Outlook E-Mail, Telefon und andere Kommunikationsplattformen, um Shop-Aktivitäten zu unterstützen.

• Bewegen, organisieren, inszenieren und liefern Sie Materialien an bestimmte Workstations, um einen effizienten Workflow und eine unterbrechungsfreie Produktion zu gewährleisten.

• Überprüfen Sie Mengen, Teilenummern und Materialspezifikationen, bevor Sie Materialien für Jobs ausgeben.

• Führen Sie genaue Aufzeichnungen über Materialbelege, Transfers, Rücksendungen und Bestandsanpassungen.

• Führen Sie Zykluszählungen durch und unterstützen Sie bei physischen Inventaraktivitäten, um die Inventargenauigkeit zu gewährleisten.

• Empfangen und inspizieren Sie eingehende Materialien und verifizieren Sie Sendungen gegen Bestellungen, Packzettel und erhalten Sie Unterlagen.

• Gabelstapler, Palettenheber, Kräne und andere Materialfördergeräte nach Bedarf betreiben.

• Betreiben Sie Firmenlastwagen und -anhänger, um Teile, Werkzeuge und Materialien zwischen den Einrichtungen des Unternehmens und externen Anbietern zu transportieren.

• Abholen und liefern Sie Materialien, Werkzeuge und Lieferungen von Lieferanten und externen Dienstleistern nach Bedarf.

• Stellen Sie sicher, dass Materialien ordnungsgemäß identifiziert, gekennzeichnet, gelagert und vor Beschädigungen geschützt sind.

• Pflegen Sie saubere, organisierte und sichere Lager- und Staging-Bereiche.

• Befolgen Sie alle Sicherheitsrichtlinien, Qualitätsanforderungen und Betriebsverfahren des Unternehmens.

• Unterstützung bei kontinuierlichen Verbesserungsinitiativen im Zusammenhang mit Bestandskontrolle, Materialfluss und Produktionsunterstützung.

Benötigte Qualifikationen

• High-School-Diplom oder gleichwertig.

• Erfahrung in Materialhandling, Bestandskontrolle, Lagerbetrieb oder Produktionsunterstützungsumgebungen.

• Kenntnisse in SAP oder ähnlichen Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) Systemen.

• Kenntnisse mit Microsoft Outlook und allgemeinen Computeranwendungen.

• Fähigkeit, Arbeitsaufträge, Inventaraufzeichnungen und Produktionsdokumentation zu lesen und zu interpretieren.

• Starke organisatorische Fähigkeiten und Liebe zum Detail.

• Hervorragende Kommunikations- und Koordinationsfähigkeiten.

• Gültiger Führerschein mit einer akzeptablen Fahraufzeichnung.

• Fähigkeit zum Betrieb oder zur Zertifizierung von Gabelstaplern und anderen Materialfördergeräten.

• Erleben Sie die Bedienung von Lastwagen und Anhängern für den Materialtransport.

Physikalische Anforderungen

• Fähigkeit, Materialien bis zu 50 Pfund häufig zu heben, zu tragen, zu schieben und zu ziehen.

• Fähigkeit zu stehen, zu gehen, sich zu beugen, sich zu beugen und für längere Zeiträume zu erreichen.

• Fähigkeit zum sicheren Betrieb von Gabelstaplern, Lastwagen, Anhängern und Materialfördergeräten.

Sulzer est une entreprise d'ingénierie de premier plan avec un fier héritage d'innovation. Rejoignez notre équipe mondiale pour développer votre expertise et développer des solutions innovantes qui permettent une société prospère et plus durable.

Sur le rôle

Résumé de l'emploi
Le Matériau Handler est responsable de la gestion, du suivi, du mouvement, de la mise en scène et de la distribution des matières premières, des composants et des pièces finies dans tout le magasin. Ce poste appuie les opérations de production en veillant à ce que les matériaux soient disponibles au besoin, en maintenant l'exactitude des stocks, en traitant les transactions dans le SAP et en coordonnant avec le personnel de production, les planificateurs et les coordonnateurs. Il transporte également des matériaux, des outils et du matériel entre l'établissement et les fournisseurs extérieurs qui utilisent des véhicules d'entreprise, y compris des camions et des remorques. Fonctions et responsabilités essentielles

• Remettre et distribuer les matériaux aux emplois de production conformément aux ordres de travail et aux calendriers de fabrication.

• Suivre et tenir des registres d'inventaire précis pour les matières premières, les composants, les consommables et les pièces finies.

• Traiter les transactions d'inventaire, les mouvements de matériel et les activités d'ordre de travail en utilisant SAP.

• Coordonner avec les opérations, les coordonnateurs de la production, les planificateurs, les superviseurs et d'autres ministères en ce qui a trait aux exigences matérielles et à l'état de l'emploi.

• Communiquer efficacement par courriel Outlook, téléphone et autres plateformes de communication pour soutenir les activités des magasins.

• Déplacer, organiser, mettre en scène et livrer du matériel aux postes de travail désignés afin d'assurer un flux de travail efficace et une production ininterrompue.

• Vérifier les quantités, les numéros de pièces et les spécifications des matériaux avant de délivrer des matériaux aux emplois.

• Tenir des registres exacts des recettes, des transferts, des déclarations et des rajustements des stocks.

• Effectuer des dénombrements de cycles et aider aux activités d'inventaire physique pour assurer l'exactitude de l'inventaire.

• Recevoir et inspecter les documents reçus et vérifier les expéditions en fonction des commandes, des bordereaux d'emballage et des documents de réception.

• Utiliser des chariots élévateurs, des vérins à palettes, des grues et d'autres équipements de manutention des matériaux au besoin.

• Utiliser des camions et des remorques d'entreprise pour transporter des pièces, des outils et des matériaux entre les installations de l'entreprise et les fournisseurs externes.

• Ramassez et livrez les matériaux, les outils et les fournitures des fournisseurs et des fournisseurs de services extérieurs au besoin.

• S'assurer que les matériaux sont correctement identifiés, étiquetés, entreposés et protégés contre les dommages.

• Maintenir des aires d'entreposage et de rassemblement propres, organisées et sécuritaires.

• Suivez toutes les politiques de sécurité de l'entreprise, les exigences de qualité et les procédures d'exploitation.

• Appuyer les initiatives d'amélioration continue liées au contrôle des stocks, au flux de matières et au soutien à la production.

Qualifications requises

• Diplôme d'études secondaires ou équivalent.

• Expérience de la manutention des matériaux, du contrôle des stocks, des opérations d'entrepôt ou des environnements de soutien à la fabrication.

• Connaissance pratique des systèmes SAP ou de progiciels de gestion intégrés (PGI).

• Compétence avec Microsoft Outlook et applications informatiques générales.

• Capacité de lire et d'interpréter les ordres de travail, les registres d'inventaire et la documentation de production.

• Fortes compétences organisationnelles et attention aux détails.

• Excellentes compétences en communication et coordination.

• Permis de conduire valide avec un dossier de conduite acceptable.

• Capacité d'utiliser ou de devenir certifié sur les chariots élévateurs à fourche et autres équipements de manutention des matériaux.

• Expérience de l'exploitation de camions et de remorques pour le transport de matériel.

Exigences physiques

• Capacité à soulever, transporter, pousser et tirer des matériaux jusqu'à 50 livres.

• Aptitude à se tenir debout, à marcher, à plier, à s'abaisser et à atteindre pendant de longues périodes.

• Capacité d'utiliser en toute sécurité des chariots élévateurs, des camions, des remorques et du matériel de manutention.

• Capacité de travailler à l'intérieur et à l'extérieur dans des conditions météorologiques variables lors de la livraison des vendeurs et des ramassage.

Ce que nous vous offrons

• 15 jours de congé payé et 12 jours fériés payés par l'entreprise

• Plan 401k avec un match de 6%

• Plan de santé global

jobs.title: Journeylevel Machinist
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary

The Journey Level Machinist is responsible for setting up and operating Machining equipment in accordance with departmental policies and procedures. This role involves manufacturing, and reconditioning components to meet OEM and industry standards. This role involves using manual and CNC controlled lathes and mills, and interprets mechanical drawings and sketches to execute high-quality work. Key Responsibilities:

• Performs layouts, sets up, and operates machines.

• Read and interpret procedures, work orders, and technical drawings to meet specifications.

• Apply knowledge of metals and alloys, including stainless and carbon steels.

• Improves set ups and methods for higher quality and improved cost.

• Operate overhead crane and forklifts safely as directed by Supervisor.

• Perform other duties as necessary.

• Maintain regular and reliable attendance.

• Maintains a safe, neat, and orderly workstation

• Assists in the disassembly, inspection, and re-assembly of pump equipment when required

• Communicate effectively to ensure smooth workflow transitions between team members.

• Support and assist coworkers, including training and collaboration.

• Supports, cooperates with, and participates in company-wide safety program which includes following all safety policies and procedures

• Supports and cooperates in Sulzer Nuclear Quality Program

• Performs other duties as assigned

• Works overtime as requested

• Operates forklifts, overhead cranes, man lifts, and scissor lifts

QUALIFICATIONS:

• Completion of a machinist apprentice program or equivalent training.

• Minimum of five (5) years of experience in machining.

• Ability to hold close tolerances and conduct component inspection.

• Ability to read and interpret technical drawings.

• Basic math skills.

What we offer you

• 15 days of paid time off and 12 company-paid holidays

• 401k plan with a 6% match

• Comprehensive health plan including medical, dental, vision, Life, short-term & long-term disability

• Health savings account matching

• Motivating wellness program

• Employee Assistance Program

• Paid paternal leave

• Gym reimbursement

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

• Führen Sie bei Bedarf andere Aufgaben aus.

• Halten Sie regelmäßige und zuverlässige Teilnahme.

• Unterhält eine sichere, ordentliche und geordnete Workstation

• Unterstützung und Unterstützung von Mitarbeitern, einschließlich Schulungen und Zusammenarbeit.

• Unterstützt, kooperiert und beteiligt sich am unternehmensweiten Sicherheitsprogramm, das die Einhaltung aller Sicherheitsrichtlinien und -verfahren umfasst

• Unterstützt und kooperiert im Sulzer Nuclear Quality Program

• Führt andere Aufgaben wie zugewiesen aus

• Arbeitet Überstunden wie gewünscht

• Betreibt Gabelstapler, Überkopfkrane, Mannlifte und Scherenlifte

QUALIFIKATIONEN:

• Abschluss eines Maschinistenlehrlingsprogramms oder einer gleichwertigen Ausbildung.

• Mindestens fünf (5) Jahre Erfahrung in der Bearbeitung.

• Fähigkeit, enge Toleranzen einzuhalten und eine Bauteilprüfung durchzuführen.

• Fähigkeit, technische Zeichnungen zu lesen und zu interpretieren.

• Grundlegende mathematische Fähigkeiten.

Was wir Ihnen bieten

• 15 Tage bezahlte Freizeit und 12 bezahlte Firmenferien

• Matching des Sparkontos

• Motivierendes Wellnessprogramm

• Mitarbeiterunterstützungsprogramm

• Bezahlter Vaterschaftsurlaub

• Gymnastikerstattung

Sulzer ist ein Arbeitgeber für Chancengleichheit. Wir glauben an die Stärke einer vielfältigen Belegschaft und setzen uns für ein integratives Arbeitsumfeld ein.

Wir sind stolz darauf, als Top Employer 2026 in Brasilien, Kanada, China, Finnland, Deutschland, Irland, Mexiko, der Schweiz, Südafrika, Großbritannien und den USA anerkannt zu werden.

jobs.title: Inside Sales Support (Aftermarket)
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

The Inside Sales (Aftermarket) Support will be responsible for supporting FRC Wastewater treatment systems after they have been commissioned for operation. You will be responsible for proactively reaching out to customers to ensure they have a stock of spare parts. You will assist customers with ordering spare parts and answering questions about performance or technical issues.
Essential Functions: (80%)

• Call customers with FRC equipment to assist them with ordering spare parts.

• Assemble detailed project specific spare parts list, provide to Project Manager.

• Respond to customer questions regarding spare parts and upgrades.

• Function as entry point for questions from customers and sales representatives regarding technical and performance questions for installations provided by FRC.

• Follow up to confirm customer questions have been answered.

• When required, forward questions to the right person within organization and ensure adherence to FRC's 24-hour response philosophy.

• Maintain positive relationships with customers, FRC representatives, consultants, engineers and managers through responsive, effective and honest communications.

• Proactive communication with customers about the need for and functionality of spare parts, (Discontinued items, Upgrades, etc.)

• Contact vendors for specific project/non-standard part quotes.

• Generate Spare parts quotes for customers.

• Calculate the mark-up of the spare parts, based on the margin schedule.

• Create and Process sales Orders on Purchase orders received for Spare Parts.

• Organize / Process customer's order shipment details.

Secondary Functions: (20%)

• Capture and maintain detailed notes related to customer contacts, conversations about spares, warranty issues, and upgrades.

• Prepare a monthly report providing a structured overview of all documented notes and communications concerning spares, warranty matters, and system upgrades.

• Coordinate with QA/Logistics manager and Project Manager(s) to resolve warranty complaints.

Qualifications:

• 2-year technical diploma or degree

• or

• Minimum of 2 years of work experience in a related industrial field (mechanical/manufacturing)

• Preferable experience with shipping

Key Skills, Knowledge and Competencies:

• Proficient computer skills: Microsoft Office, knowledge of an inventory / bookkeeping program, and online freight management (i.e., UPS, FedEx).

• A strong customer focus is essential, working with both internal and external customers.

• Fluent English skills verbally and written.

• Mechanical aptitude.

• Preferable basic mechanical and/or electrical knowledge.

• Highly self-motivated

• Good organizational and time management skills.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to listen and understand others.

• Team player with strong interpersonal skills with the ability to foster strong working relationships.

• Ability to work independently and follow through on work assignments with minimal direction.

• Detail oriented.

• Positive attitude towards change and growth

• Has cultural flexibility. Is capable to deal with the different corporate cultures and cultures of production plants of FRC's clients.

• Is allowed to legally work in the U.S.

Environmental, safety & health requirements:

• Complies with QESH policy

• Complies and participates with SBP (Safety Behavior Program)

• Performs its functions following and understanding the Job Safety Analysis (JSA), is aware of the workplace hazards

• Avoids and reports unsafe behaviors and unsafe conditions

• Uses and maintains personal protective equipment

• Reports accidents and near accidents

• Complies with environmental and safety rules, policies, work instructions, manuals, etc.

jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Strategic Account Manager is responsible for managing and growing relationships with key clients. This role ensures that client needs are met, identifies new business opportunities, and coordinates with internal teams to deliver tailored solutions that drive long-term value.
This job profile is intended for recognized subject matter experts in a job area. Required to manage large projects or processes with limited oversight from manager. Coaches, reviews and delegates work to lower level professionals. This job and its associated grade are specifically aligned with roles that have the following scope of responsibility: Small, Medium organization.

Key
• Responsibilities
Serve as the primary point of contact for strategic clients.
Develop and maintain long-term relationships with key accounts.
Understand client needs and align solutions accordingly.
Coordinate with internal teams to ensure service delivery.
Identify upselling and cross-selling opportunities.
Monitor account performance and satisfaction.
Prepare and present account reviews and growth plans.
Skills &
• Qualifications
Typically a University degree (or equivalent work experience) and at least of 8-10 years of relevant experience (or equivalent skills) are minimally required to carry out the role.

Strong relationship management and negotiation skills.
Experience in B2B account management.
Excellent communication and presentation abilities.
Strategic thinking and problem-solving skills.
Proficiency in CRM tools and data analysis.

What we offer you

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

Lo Strategic Account Manager è responsabile della gestione e della crescita delle relazioni con i clienti chiave. Sulzer ist ein führendes Ingenieurunternehmen mit einem stolzen Erbe an Innovationen. Schließen Sie sich unserem globalen Team an, um Ihr Fachwissen zu erweitern und innovative Lösungen zu entwickeln, die eine prosperierende und nachhaltigere Gesellschaft ermöglichen.

Über die Rolle

Der Strategic Account Manager ist für die Verwaltung und den Ausbau der Beziehungen zu wichtigen Kunden verantwortlich. Diese Rolle stellt sicher, dass die Kundenbedürfnisse erfüllt werden, identifiziert neue Geschäftsmöglichkeiten und koordiniert sich mit internen Teams, um maßgeschneiderte Lösungen zu liefern, die langfristig Wert schaffen.
Dieses Stellenprofil richtet sich an anerkannte Fachexperten in einem Stellenbereich. Erforderlich zur Verwaltung großer Projekte oder Prozesse mit begrenzter Aufsicht durch den Manager. Coaches, Rezensionen und Delegierte arbeiten mit Fachleuten auf niedrigerer Ebene. Dieser Job und die damit verbundene Klasse sind speziell auf Rollen ausgerichtet, die folgenden Verantwortungsbereich haben: Kleine, mittlere Organisation.

Schlüssel
• Zuständigkeiten
Dienen Sie als primärer Ansprechpartner für strategische Kunden.
Aufbau und Pflege langfristiger Beziehungen zu Key Accounts.
Kundenbedürfnisse verstehen und Lösungen entsprechend ausrichten.
Koordinieren Sie sich mit internen Teams, um die Servicebereitstellung sicherzustellen.
Identifizieren Sie Upselling- und Cross-Selling-Möglichkeiten.
Überwachen Sie die Leistung und Zufriedenheit des Kontos.
Erstellen und präsentieren Sie Kontobewertungen und Wachstumspläne.
Fähigkeiten und
• Qualifikationen
Typischerweise sind ein Universitätsabschluss (oder eine gleichwertige Berufserfahrung) und mindestens 8-10 Jahre einschlägige Erfahrung (oder gleichwertige Fähigkeiten) minimal erforderlich, um die Rolle auszuüben.

Starke Beziehungsmanagement- und Verhandlungsfähigkeiten.
Erfahrung im B2B Account Management.
Hervorragende Kommunikations- und Präsentationsfähigkeiten.
Strategisches Denken und Problemlösungsfähigkeiten.
Kenntnisse in CRM-Tools und Datenanalyse.

Was wir Ihnen bieten

Sulzer ist ein Arbeitgeber für Chancengleichheit. Wir glauben an die Stärke einer vielfältigen Belegschaft und engagieren uns für ein integratives Arbeitsumfeld.

Wir sind stolz darauf, als Top Employer 2026 in Brasilien, Kanada, China, Finnland, Deutschland, Irland, Mexiko, der Schweiz, Südafrika, Großbritannien und den USA anerkannt zu werden.

jobs.title: Solutions Engineer - Compressors and Expanders
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
Responsible for provision of technical support to customer, sales & operations in the form of detailed Engineering analysis and design, feasibility study and solutions offering to support growth of repairs, spares, upgrades and retrofits of Centrifugal Compressors and Expanders. Main tasks and responsibilities

• Act as a subject matter expert and manage engineering requests associated to tendering and project execution for Turbo-machinery Services in the region.

• Conduct site equipment inspection, root cause analysis and technical forums to support sales team to identify repairs, upgrades and retrofit opportunities

• Challenge traditional Sulzer thinking to ensure we remain ahead of the competition without taking excessive risk

• Review Technical specifications, provide comments/exceptions, input Technical know-how as required to ensure proposals are technically fit for purpose

• Identify and document areas of technical risk and level of design review associated with Projects at an early Tender stage

• Liaise with oversea Sulzer competence centers, specialist functions (e.g. Aero, welding, rotor-dynamic, C&I, etc) and key sub-contractors to clarify client requirements and ensure technical aspects have been adequately addressed

• Consolidate technical offer and associated technical documentation (e.g. data sheets, calculations, technical bid assessment questionnaires) as necessary to satisfy client's Tender requirements

• Provide an Engineering presence, when required, on customer visits, for assessment, bid clarification, client kick off meetings, project execution etc

• Lead and coordinate the different engineering resources associated to the project for the execution on-time and on budget

• Review ITP, inspection reports, and closing report to ensure upmost quality of the work and deliverables

• Develop guidelines, procedures and work instructions to support continuous improvement of quality of Compressor and Expander Services in Oceania

• Be part of the large Sulzer Services specialist and experts community and Support development of Turbine Services capabilities in the Asia region to support the business growth strategy

• All other duties as relevant to the post

Competencies and behaviour required (what strengths are needed)

• Customer service skills

• Communication skills

• Influencing and persuasion skills

• Time management skills

• Ability to act independently

• Attention to details

• Culture of Continuous improvement

• Flexibility and ability to adapt to different team, culture and environment

Qualifications/Experience Required

• Bachelor or Master in Mechanical Engineering

• 5 years minimum experience in service of Centrifugal Compressors and/or Expanders

• Experience in Oil &Gas, Fertilizers and Petrochemical industry

• Design and drafting skills

• General computer skills

• Analytical skills

What we offer you

Career Opportunities
Saving Plan
Medical Benefit

jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Sulzer’s Leeds facility is a global centre of excellence for advanced design and manufacturing, delivering OEM pump technology and engineered solutions for critical industries including energy, water, chemicals and infrastructure. Following significant recent investment, the site is rapidly evolving, strengthening capabilities in advanced machining, digital engineering, testing and innovation—and serves as an end-to-end hub where new pumps are brought to life from concept and design through to manufacture, testing, delivery and full lifecycle support..

We are now looking for a Factored Buyer to join our Supply Chain team and play a key role in ensuring the seamless procurement of externally manufactured components, assemblies and engineered products that support our customer commitments across the globe. What you'll be doing

• Managing the end-to-end procurement process for factored and engineered products.

• Raising and managing purchase orders in line with business requirements.

• Developing strong relationships with suppliers to ensure delivery, quality and cost expectations are achieved.

• Monitoring supplier performance and proactively resolving shortages, delays and supply chain risks.

• Negotiating pricing, lead times and commercial terms to deliver value to the business.

• Supporting supplier selection, qualification and development activities.

• Working closely with Production Planning to ensure material availability aligns with customer demand.

• Collaborating with Engineering teams on technical sourcing requirements and new product introductions.

• Supporting inventory optimisation and working capital improvement initiatives.

What we're looking for

• Previous experience in a Buyer, Factored Buyer, Procurement or Supply Chain role within manufacturing, engineering or an OEM environment.

• Proven ability to manage supplier relationships and negotiate effectively.

• Experience purchasing engineered components, fabricated products, castings, machined parts or technical equipment would be advantageous.

• Strong commercial awareness and analytical skills.

• Ability to prioritise workload and work effectively in a fast-paced environment.

• Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

• Proficiency in ERP/MRP systems and Microsoft Office applications.

• CIPS qualification or working towards CIPS is desirable.

What we offer you

We’ve recently invested significantly in modernising our Leeds facility — creating a brighter, more efficient, and more advanced workspace designed to support high‑quality work and a great employee experience. Alongside our upgraded facilities, you’ll benefit from:

Core Benefits

• A competitive salary

• A company-wide bonus scheme

• Medicash Health Cash Plan (covering everyday healthcare expenses such as dental, optical and GP services)

• 33 days’ holiday

• Defined pension contribution

• Employee Assistance Programmes

• Discounts on shopping, entertainment & lifestyle

• Costco membership option

• Discounted personal car leasing for you, family & friends

• Long Service Awards

• Ongoing learning through Sulzer Learning Pathways

• Armed Forces Support – As a Silver Award holder of the MoD Defence Employer Recognition Scheme, we actively support veterans, reservists and Cadet Adult Volunteers. This includes policies that enable time for training, camps and deployment, alongside access to a growing internal military network.

Onsite Perks

• Free, secure parking with EV charging

• Multi-faith prayer room

• Newly modernised work areas

• Lively Sports & Social Club with events & prize draws

• 24/7 onsite gym

• Subsidised vending machines

• Subsidised Canteen offering hot and cold food

Working Pattern
This role is primarily site-base
