jobs.title: Gas Turbine Specialist
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

The Heavy-Duty Gas Turbine FA will contribute to the management of site activities including planning, organizing, integrating and monitoring of resources such as labor, tools and technical assistants as required to complete the work scope according to contractual requirements. Will work within defined parameters to make decisions, apply concepts to issues of great complexity, and resolve issues through immediate action or short-term planning at customer power generating facilities. Will be responsible for the installation and maintenance of Gas Turbines.
Main tasks and responsibilities

• Manage, perform, coordinate the management of HD Gas Turbine site activities

• Perform on-site installation of systems and equipment and ongoing preventive maintenance, repair and calibration after installation

• Respond to requests for emergency repairs and services to troublesome equipment

• Provide technical instruction and assistance to customer representatives regarding installation, operation, calibration, repair and maintenance at customer's sites

• Perform administrative functions such as: writing technical reports, ordering materials, securing quotations, preparing job status reports, reports to customers, time sheet and expense sheets on a complete timely, and thorough basis

• Signs off on all changes implemented.

• Knowledge to troubleshoot and provide routine maintenance checkout for wide range of equipment vintage

• Coach, mentor and train other team members as required, to impart and perpetuate field engineering and/or product knowledge.

• Prepare timely and accurate technical reports for customer records and a reference for future outages

• Ensure all parts needed for the job are shipped to the site

• Perform walk-downs during installation to ensure that the customer’s contractors are working properly.

• Ability and willingness to work holidays, weekends and overtime as required by field assignments

• Extensive travel to and from projects and various field assignments will be required

• May be assigned other duties to help proactively drive our Sulzer vision and align with our organization’s core values.

Competencies and behaviour required (What strengths needed?)

• Requirement: Min D3 engineering background: Mechanical.

• Possess General Knowledge of mechanical and overall Heavy Duty Gas Turbine maintenance. Familiar with tools, hand tools, and special tools.

• Familiar with technical drawing, symbols and legend, P&ID diagram.

• Familiar with safety code and procedure for startup and commissioning

• Behaviour requirement: Achievement Orientation, communication for result, teamwork, active learning, business awareness, problem solving and analytical thinking

Qualifications/Experience and Knowledge Required

• Relevant experience of minimum 15 years of working on Outage of Heavy-Duty Gas Turbine. Or came from customer power plant experience

• Proficient in English.

• Ability to read and comprehend engineering drawings and data

• Past worked in the OEM is preferable

• Solid understanding of Gas Turbine Operation & Controlling Parameters.

• Strong technical competence in reading and interpreting electrical/mechanical flow and instrument diagrams dial and laser alignment and thermal growth equipment

What we offer you

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Field Service Coordinator
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The (Field) Service Sr. Coordinator is responsible for coordinating field service activities including installation, configuration, calibration, and repair of technical products and systems at customer locations. This role supports service delivery and may guide other professional-level staff in non-routine situations.
This job profile is intended for professional-level staff that works autonomously and may coordinate the activities of other professional-level staff, especially in non-routine situations.
The Field Service Supervisor plays a key role in ensuring that all services are executed with quality, efficiency, and safety. This role acts as a bridge between the customer and the national technical team, working closely with the Operations Director, the Operations Backoffice and the Workshop Coordinator. The supervisor is responsible for the end‑to‑end management of all field activities (maintenance, incidents, breakdowns, commissioning, and supervision).

Key Responsibilities

• Technical team coordination: Assign daily tasks to field technicians based on priorities and workload, ensuring efficient execution.

• Materials and resources control: Ensure that technicians have the necessary tools, materials, and documentation to complete tasks quickly and effectively.

• Work order monitoring: Follow up on work orders, validate the technical closure, and ensure that all required information is included (photos, reports, readings, etc.).

• Direct customer communication: Plan and coordinate field activities with the customer, ensuring that work can be carried out safely and within the agreed timelines.

• Maintenance contract planning and tracking: Verify that all related documentation is up to date and that maintenance activities are carried out in accordance with contractual requirements.

• Continuous improvement: Propose operational and procedural improvements based on field reality, and analyze the causes of rework and recurring incidents.

What you need to succeed
Experience & Technical Background

• Proven experience in field service supervision or coordination within an industrial environment (e.g. civil construction, hydraulic installations, industrial maintenance).

• Strong technical knowledge and diagnostic skills , with the ability to support and guide field technicians.

• Experience working with field service management tools , work orders, and technical reporting.

• Hands‑on exposure to on‑site customer environments , managing incidents, breakdowns, and maintenance activities.

Skills & Competencies

• Ability to work autonomously while coordinating and prioritizing activities of a distributed field team.

• Strong communication and customer‑oriented mindset , with proven experience dealing directly with customers on site.

• Structured and proactive approach, with the ability to manage multiple tasks and priorities simultaneously.

• Problem‑solving mindset and continuous improvement orientation.

Languages & Mobility

• High level of English (able to communicate effectively with internal stakeholders and customers).

• Availability to travel across Iberia as required by field activities.

What we offer you

• A permanent contract.

• A competitive salary as well as participation in the variable remuneration system based on personal and financial objectives.

• Restaurant tickets

• Be part of an experienced, international team.

• A good vibe working environment.

• Company car as a tool of trade

• Other fringe benefits

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland

Unisciti al nostro team globale per accrescere le tue competenze e sviluppare soluzioni innovative che consentano una società prospera e più sostenibile. Informazioni sul ruolo Sintesi del lavoro Il Coordinatore (Field) Service Sr. è responsabile del coordinamento delle attività di servizio sul campo, tra cui installazione, configurazione, calibrazione e riparazione di prodotti e sistemi tecnici nelle sedi dei clienti. Questo ruolo supporta la fornitura di servizi e può guidare altri personale di livello professionale in situazioni non routine. Questo profilo di lavoro è destinato a personale di livello professionale che lavora autonomamente e può coordinare le attività di altri personale di livello professionale, soprattutto in situazioni non di routine. Il Field Service Supervisor svolge un ruolo chiave nel garantire che tutti i servizi siano eseguiti con qualità, efficienza e sicurezza. Questo ruolo funge da ponte tra il cliente e il team tecnico nazionale, lavorando a stretto contatto con il Direttore Operativo, il Backoffice Operativo e il Coordinatore Workshop. Il supervisore è responsabile della gestione end-to-end di tutte le attività sul campo (manutenzione, incidenti, guasti, messa in servizio e supervisione). Principali responsabilità
• Coordinamento tecnico del team: Assegnare compiti quotidiani ai tecnici di campo basati su priorità e carico di lavoro, garantendo un'esecuzione efficiente.
• Controllo dei materiali e delle risorse: Assicurarsi che i tecnici abbiano gli strumenti necessari, i materiali e la documentazione per completare i compiti in modo rapido ed efficace.
• Monitoraggio dell'ordine di lavoro: Seguire gli ordini di lavoro, convalidare la chiusura tecnica e garantire che tutte le informazioni richieste siano incluse (foto, report, letture, ecc.).
• Comunicazione diretta del cliente: pianificare e coordinare le attività sul campo con il cliente, assicurando che il lavoro possa essere effettuato in modo sicuro e entro i termini concordati.
• Pianificazione e tracciamento del contratto di manutenzione: verifica che tutta la documentazione relativa è aggiornata e che le attività di manutenzione sono svolte in conformità con i requisiti contrattuali.
• Miglioramento continuo: Proporre miglioramenti operativi e procedurali basati sulla realtà del campo, e analizzare le cause di rilavoro e incidenti ricorrenti. Cosa devi avere successo Esperienza & Sfondo tecnico
• Esperienza comprovata nella supervisione del servizio sul campo o nel coordinamento in un ambiente industriale (ad esempio costruzione civile, impianti idraulici, manutenzione industriale).
• Forte conoscenza tecnica e competenze diagnostiche, con la capacità di supportare e guidare i tecnici del campo.
• Esperienza di lavoro con strumenti di gestione dei servizi di campo , ordini di lavoro e reporting tecnico.
• Esposizione manuale agli ambienti dei clienti in loco, gestione di incidenti, guasti e attività di manutenzione. Competenze e competenze
• Capacità di lavorare autonomamente mentre coordina e privilegia le attività di un team di campo distribuito.
• Forte comunicazione e mentalità orientata al cliente , con esperienza comprovata che si occupa direttamente con i clienti in loco.
• Approccio strutturato e proattivo, con la capacità di gestire più compiti e priorità contemporaneamente.
• Mindset problem-solving e orientamento continuo miglioramento. Lingue e mobilità
• Alto livello di inglese (in grado di comunicare efficacemente con gli stakeholder interni e i clienti).
• Disponibilità per viaggiare attraverso Iberia come richiesto dalle attività sul campo. Cosa ti offriamo
• Un contratto permanente.

Sulzer ist ein führendes Ingenieurunternehmen mit einem stolzen Erbe an Innovationen. Schließen Sie sich unserem globalen Team an, um Ihr Fachwissen zu erweitern und innovative Lösungen zu entwickeln, die eine wohlhabende und nachhaltigere Gesellschaft ermöglichen. Über die Rolle Stellenbeschreibung Der (Feld-)Service Sr. Coordinator ist verantwortlich für die Koordination der Außendienstaktivitäten einschließlich Installation, Konfiguration, Kalibrierung und Reparatur von technischen Produkten und Systemen an Kundenstandorten. Diese Rolle unterstützt die Servicebereitstellung und kann andere professionelle Mitarbeiter in nicht routinemäßigen Situationen führen. Dieses Stellenprofil richtet sich an professionelle Mitarbeiter, die autonom arbeiten und die Aktivitäten anderer professioneller Mitarbeiter koordinieren können, insbesondere in nicht routinemäßigen Situationen. Der Field Service Supervisor spielt eine Schlüsselrolle bei der Sicherstellung, dass alle Dienste mit Qualität, Effizienz und Sicherheit ausgeführt werden. Diese Rolle bildet eine Brücke zwischen dem Kunden und dem nationalen technischen Team und arbeitet eng mit dem Operations Director, dem Operations Backoffice und dem Workshop-Koordinator zusammen. Der Betreuer ist verantwortlich für das Ende-zu-Ende-Management aller Vor-Ort-Aktivitäten (Wartung, Vorfälle, Pannen, Inbetriebnahme und Aufsicht). Wichtigste Zuständigkeiten
• Koordination des technischen Teams: Weisen Sie den Außendiensttechnikern tägliche Aufgaben zu, die auf Prioritäten und Arbeitsbelastung basieren, um eine effiziente Ausführung zu gewährleisten.
• Material- und Ressourcenkontrolle: Stellen Sie sicher, dass die Techniker über die notwendigen Werkzeuge, Materialien und Dokumentationen verfügen, um Aufgaben schnell und effektiv abzuschließen.
• Auftragsüberwachung: Weiterverfolgung von Arbeitsaufträgen, Validierung des technischen Abschlusses und Sicherstellung, dass alle erforderlichen Informationen (Fotos, Berichte, Lesungen usw.) enthalten sind.

Ce rôle sert de pont entre le client et l'équipe technique nationale, travaillant en étroite collaboration avec le directeur des opérations, le backoffice des opérations et le coordonnateur de l'atelier. Le superviseur est responsable de la gestion de bout en bout de toutes les activités sur le terrain (entretien, incidents, pannes, mise en service et supervision). Principales responsabilités
• Coordination de l'équipe technique: Assigner des tâches quotidiennes aux techniciens de terrain en fonction des priorités et de la charge de travail, en assurant une exécution efficace.

• Expérience éprouvée en matière de supervision ou de coordination des services sur le terrain dans un environnement industriel (p. ex. construction civile, installations hydrauliques, entretien industriel).
• De solides connaissances techniques et des compétences diagnostiques, avec la capacité de soutenir et de guider les techniciens de terrain.
• Expérience de travail avec les outils de gestion des services sur le terrain, les ordres de travail et les rapports techniques.
• Exposition directe aux environnements clients sur place, gestion des incidents, des pannes et des activités de maintenance. Compétences
• Capacité de travailler de manière autonome tout en coordonnant et en priorisant les activités d'une équipe de terrain distribuée.
• Une communication forte et une mentalité axée sur le client, avec une expérience éprouvée traitant directement avec les clients sur place.
• Approche structurée et proactive, capable de gérer simultanément plusieurs tâches et priorités.
• L'état d'esprit de résolution de problèmes et l'orientation de l'amélioration continue. Langues et mobilité
• Niveau élevé d'anglais (capacité de communiquer efficacement avec les intervenants internes et les clients).
• Disponibilité pour voyager à travers Iberia comme l'exigent les activités sur le terrain. Ce que nous vous offrons

• Un salaire compétitif ainsi que la participation au système de rémunération variable fondé sur des objectifs personnels et financiers.

• Un bon environnement de travail.
• Voiture d'entreprise comme outil de commerce

Nous sommes fiers d'être reconnus comme un employeur de premier plan 2026 au Brésil, au Canada, en Chine, en Finlande, en Allemagne, en Irlande

jobs.title: Mechanical Engineer, Sr.
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The (Mechanical) Engineering Expert is responsible for leading the design, development, and optimization of mechanical systems and components. This role provides expert-level technical leadership in mechanical engineering, ensuring that products meet performance, reliability, and cost targets. The expert collaborates across departments to drive innovation and resolve complex engineering challenges.
This job profile is intended for recognized subject matter experts in a job area. Required to manage large projects or processes with limited oversight from manager. Coaches, reviews and delegates work to lower level professionals. Position Summary:
Lead design, development, and testing and the implementation of innovative products and technologies. The roles is responsible for driving mechanical engineering solutions from product feasibility through implementation into production by collaborating with cross-functional teams. The position combines strong technical expertise, creativity, and project leadership skills to solve complex engineering challenges and deliver high quality products.

Principle Duties and Key Responsibilities:

• Lead mechanical design and development of new products and technologies.

• Lead mechanical design of product improvements for cost out or consolidation of similar technologies.

• Generate and evaluate engineering concepts, prototypes, and design alternatives.

• Performa engineering calculations, simulations, and tolerance analysis.

• Develop detailed #D CAD models, engineering drawings, and technical documentation.

• Conduct design verification, validation testing, and root cause analysis.

• Manage product development projects, schedules, budgets, and milestones.

• Review and check engineering documentation, specifications and change requests.

• Stay current with industry trends, emerging technologies, materials, and manufacturing processes.

• Perform other duties and special projects as assigned.

Skills & Qualifications
Education:
Required: BSME Bachelor of Science Mechanical Engineering or related discipline

Desirable: Master’s degree in mechanical engineering or related field.
Professional Engineer (PE) license

Experience:
Required:
8+ years of mechanical engineering in rotating equipment product development, R&D, or advanced engineering environments.
Proven experience leading complex engineering projects from feasibility through implementation.
Experience working with multidisciplinary teams in a development environment.
Knowledge of manufacturing processes such as machining, sheet metal fabrication, casting, and assembly.
Experience with engineering test methods, verification protocols, and data analysis.

Preferred: Project management within a Phase Gate process.
Product design of wastewater screening or treatment equipment.

Skills:
Technical

Required:
Advanced proficiency with CAD software, such as Inventor, SolidWorks, Creo, or NX.
Strong understanding of mechanical system design, material science and component selection.
Experience with FEA and other engineering simulation tools.
Knowledge of GD&T (Geometric Dimensioning & Tolerancing) and tolerance stack up analysis.
Strong troubleshooting and root cause analysis.
Proficiency in Microsoft Office with excellent formula and engineering tool creation in Excel spreadsheets.
Microsoft PowerPoint knowledge and presentation creation.

Preferred: ERP software (Visual or SAP) understanding of BOM structures
AutoDesk Vault
Programming ability in VBA (Visual Basic for Applications).

Leadership & Business
Required:
Strong written and verbal communication in English.
Ability to lead technical discussions and influence engineering decisions.
Ability to mentor and coach other team members.

Preferred: Ex

L'esperto di ingegneria (meccanico) è responsabile per la progettazione, lo sviluppo e l'ottimizzazione di sistemi e componenti meccanici. L'esperto collabora tra i dipartimenti per guidare l'innovazione e risolvere complesse sfide ingegneristiche.
Questo profilo di lavoro è destinato a esperti di materia tema riconosciuta in una zona di lavoro. Richiesto di gestire grandi progetti o processi con supervisione limitata dal gestore. Allenatori, recensioni e delegati lavorano per professionisti di livello inferiore. Posizione Riepilogo:
Lead design, sviluppo e test e l'implementazione di prodotti e tecnologie innovative. I ruoli sono responsabili della guida di soluzioni di ingegneria meccanica dalla fattibilità del prodotto attraverso l'implementazione in produzione collaborando con team interfunzionali. La posizione combina forti competenze tecniche, creatività e capacità di leadership di progetto per risolvere complesse sfide ingegneristiche e fornire prodotti di alta qualità.

Duties del principio e responsabilità chiave:

• Leader progettazione meccanica e sviluppo di nuovi prodotti e tecnologie.

• Progettazione meccanica di piombo dei miglioramenti del prodotto per il costo o il consolidamento di tecnologie simili.

• Generare e valutare concetti di ingegneria, prototipi e alternative di progettazione.

• Calcoli di ingegneria Performa, simulazioni e analisi di tolleranza.

• Sviluppa modelli CAD #D dettagliati, disegni ingegneristici e documentazione tecnica.

• Condurre la verifica della progettazione, il test di validazione e l'analisi delle cause della radice.

• Gestisci progetti di sviluppo dei prodotti, programmi, budget e pietre miliari.

• Verificare e controllare la documentazione ingegneristica, le specifiche e le richieste di cambiamento.

• Resta aggiornato con le tendenze del settore, le tecnologie emergenti, i materiali e i processi produttivi.

• Eseguire altri compiti e progetti speciali assegnati.

Competenze & Qualifiche
Istruzione:
Richiesto: BSME Bachelor of Science Ingegneria meccanica o disciplina relativa

Discesa: Laurea magistrale in ingegneria meccanica o campo correlato.
Licenza Professional Engineer (PE)

Esperienza:
Richiesto:
8+ anni di ingegneria meccanica nello sviluppo di prodotti di attrezzature rotanti, R&D o ambienti di ingegneria avanzati.
Esperienza comprovata che conduce complessi progetti di ingegneria dalla fattibilità attraverso l'implementazione.
Esperienza di lavoro con team multidisciplinari in un ambiente di sviluppo.
Conoscenza dei processi produttivi come la lavorazione, la fabbricazione di lamiera, la colata e il montaggio.
Esperienza con metodi di prova di ingegneria, protocolli di verifica e analisi dei dati.

Preferito: Gestione del progetto all'interno di un processo Phase Gate.
Progettazione del prodotto di apparecchiature di screening o trattamento delle acque reflue.

Competenze:
Tecnica

Richiesto:
Proficienza avanzata con software CAD, come Inventor, SolidWorks, Creo o NX.
Forte comprensione della progettazione meccanica del sistema, scienza materiale e selezione dei componenti.
Esperienza con FEA e altri strumenti di simulazione ingegneristica.
Conoscenza di GD&T (Geometric Dimensioning & Tolerancing) e analisi di stack up di tolleranza.
Forte risoluzione dei problemi e analisi causa radice.
Proficienza in Microsoft Office con eccellente formula e creazione di strumenti di ingegneria in fogli di calcolo Excel.
Microsoft PowerPoint conoscenza e creazione di presentazione.

Preferito: Software ERP (Visual o SAP) comprensione delle strutture BOM
AutoDesk Vault
Capacità di programmazione in VBA (Visual Basic for Applications).

Leadership e business
Richiesto:
Forte comunicazione scritta e verbale in inglese.
Capacità di condurre discussioni tecniche e di influenzare le decisioni di ingegneria.
Capacità di mentore e coach altri membri del team.

jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

The RTR Senior Accountant in the Center of Excellence (CoE) works in a RTR SWAT team assigned to multiple countries, supporting the Record to Report (RTR) teams for example with various ad hoc tasks, complex bookings, or the maintenance of the chart of accounts.
• Serve as a key member of the RTR SWAT team in the CoE , providing expert support on ad hoc topics and complex accounting issues

• Support with complicated financial booking activities, ensuring accuracy and compliance with International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS) and Sulzer regulations

• Manage complex clearing, including reconciliations and adjustments, to maintain accurate financial records

• Utilize advanced knowledge of ERP systems to streamline accounting processes and improve efficiency

• Support the Global Process Owner (GPO) with the definition of RTR processes and system implementation

• Maintain and update the chart of accounts and hierarchies, ensuring it reflects the current business structure and reporting requirements

• Collaborate closely with local Finance Teams in countries and Finance Shared Services teams / Business Process Outsourcing (BPO) provider

• Coordinate with other departments and the Finance Shared Services teams to ensure all financial transactions are properly accounted for and reflected in the general ledger

• Support where required with the period end close, including closing the accounts receivable/payable subledger and reconcile with the general ledger; close general ledger, open new financial period, close Asset Accounting (AA)

• Support with the preparation of complex journal entries, balance sheet reconciliations and variance analysis

• Contribute to the continuous improvement of the RTR process, leveraging technology and best practices; maintain policies, procedures and templates

• Ensure financial internal controls are in place and followed for the processes performed by this role

• Do all technical Year End Closing activities such as balance carry forward, number range creations, close of AA

• Support Intercompany reconciliation process in Coprocess and Tagetik (fix variances)

Education and experience

• University degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration or related field

• Minimum of 3-4 years of experience in Accounting with a strong focus on general ledger and financial reporting

• CPA, ACCA, CMA or equivalent certification preferred

Critical success factors

• Strong analytical, problem-solving and management skills

• Excellent attention to detail and commitment to accuracy and integrity in financial reporting

• Proven ability to manage multiple priorities in a deadline-driven environment

• Strong communication skills for delivering key insights to senior leadership

Technical & language skills

• Proficient in ERP systems (relevant to your business unit; SAP, Microsoft Dynamics 365 or iScala ) and accounting software

• Strong MS Office (Excel, PowerPoint) skills

• Experience with Tagetik, Coprocess and Qlik Sense is a plus

• Proficiency in English

What we offer you

• 12 days of vacation per year

• 50% vacation bonus

• Major medical expenses insurance for the employee

• 30 days Christmas bonus (aguinaldo)

• 8% savings fund

• Savings cooperative / savings bank

• Free cafeteria / free meals

• Seniority recognition every 5 years

• Pension plan

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sulzer è una società di ingegneria leader con un patrimonio orgoglioso di innovazione. Unisciti al nostro team globale per accrescere le tue competenze e sviluppare soluzioni innovative che consentano una società prospera e più sostenibile.

Informazioni sul ruolo

Il RTR Senior Accountant nel Center of Excellence (CoE) lavora in un team RTR SWAT assegnato a più paesi, supportando i team Record to Report (RTR) per esempio con varie attività ad hoc, prenotazioni complesse o la manutenzione del grafico dei conti.
• Serve come membro chiave del team RTR SWAT nel CoE , fornendo un supporto esperto su argomenti ad hoc e questioni contabili complesse

• Sostegno a complicate attività di prenotazione finanziaria, garantendo accuratezza e conformità ai regolamenti internazionali di reporting finanziario (IFRS) e Sulzer

• Gestire la compensazione complessa, comprese le conciliazioni e le regolazioni, per mantenere registri finanziari accurati

• Utilizzare conoscenze avanzate dei sistemi ERP per ottimizzare i processi contabili e migliorare l'efficienza

• Supporta il Global Process Owner (GPO) con la definizione dei processi RTR e l'implementazione del sistema

• Mantenere e aggiornare il grafico dei conti e delle gerarchie, assicurando che riflette la struttura aziendale attuale e i requisiti di reporting

• Collabora a stretto contatto con i team di finanza locali nei paesi e i team di servizi condivisi di finanza / fornitore di Business Process Outsourcing (BPO)

• Coordinare con gli altri dipartimenti e i team dei Servizi Condizionati di Finanza per garantire che tutte le transazioni finanziarie siano debitamente contabilizzate e riflesse nel registro generale

• Sostegno ove richiesto con il termine di chiusura, compresa la chiusura dei conti accreditati/pagabili sommergibile e riconciliarsi con il registro generale; chiudere il registro generale, aprire nuovo periodo finanziario, chiudere Asset Accounting (AA)

• Supporto con la preparazione di complesse voci di rivista, conciliazioni del bilancio e analisi della varianza

• Contribuire al miglioramento continuo del processo RTR, sfruttando la tecnologia e le migliori pratiche; mantenere politiche, procedure e modelli

• Assicurarsi che i controlli interni finanziari siano in vigore e seguiti per i processi svolti da questo ruolo

• Fare tutte le attività di chiusura dell'Anno tecnico come l'equilibrio portare avanti, le creazioni della gamma di numeri, chiusura di AA

• Sostenere il processo di riconciliazione intercompany in Coprocess e Tagetik (fisso varianze)

Istruzione ed esperienza

• Laurea in finanza, contabilità, amministrazione aziendale o campo relativo

• Minimo 3-4 anni di esperienza in Contabilità con una forte attenzione al registro generale e alla rendicontazione finanziaria

• CPA, ACCA, CMA o certificazione equivalente

Fattori di successo critici

• Forte capacità analitiche, di problem solving e di gestione

• Ottima attenzione ai dettagli e all'impegno per l'accuratezza e l'integrità nel reporting finanziario

• Capacità comprovata di gestire più priorità in un ambiente a scadenza

• Forte capacità di comunicazione per fornire informazioni chiave alla leadership senior

Capacità tecniche e linguistiche

• Proficiente nei sistemi ERP (rilevante al tuo business unit; SAP, Microsoft Dynamics 365 o iScala) e software di contabilità

• Forte MS Office (Excel, PowerPoint) competenze

• Esperienza con Tagetik, Coprocess e Qlik Sense è un plus

• Proficienza in inglese

Cosa ti offriamo

• 12 giorni di vacanza all'anno

• 50% di bonus di vacanza

• Maggiore assicurazione delle spese mediche per il dipendente

• 30 giorni bonus di Natale (aguinaldo)

• Fondo di risparmio dell'8%

• Risparmio cooperativo / banca di risparmio

• caffetteria gratuita / pasti gratuiti

• Riconoscimento degli anziani ogni 5 anni

• Piano pensione

Sulzer è un datore di lavoro pari opportunità. Crediamo nella forza di una forza lavoro diversificata e ci impegniamo ad offrire un ambiente di lavoro inclusivo.

Siamo orgogliosi di essere riconosciuti come Top Employer 2026 in Brasile, Canada, Cina, Finlandia, Germania, Irlanda, Messico, Svizzera, Sud Africa, Regno Unito e Stati Uniti.

descriptionByLocale.de:
Sulzer ist ein führendes Ingenieurunternehmen mit einem stolzen Erbe an Innovationen. Schließen Sie sich unserem globalen Team an, um Ihr Fachwissen zu erweitern und innovative Lösungen zu entwickeln, die eine prosperierende und nachhaltigere Gesellschaft ermöglichen.

Über die Rolle

Der RTR Senior Accountant im Center of Excellence (CoE) arbeitet in einem RTR SWAT-Team, das mehreren Ländern zugewiesen ist, und unterstützt die Record-to-Report-Teams (RTR) beispielsweise bei verschiedenen Ad-hoc-Aufgaben, komplexen Buchungen oder der Pflege des Kontenplans.
• Dienen Sie als wichtiges Mitglied des RTR SWAT-Teams im CoE und bieten Sie kompetente Unterstützung bei Ad-hoc-Themen und komplexen Buchhaltungsfragen

• Unterstützung bei komplizierten Finanzbuchungsaktivitäten, Gewährleistung der Genauigkeit und Einhaltung der International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS) und Sulzer Vorschriften

• Verwalten Sie komplexes Clearing, einschließlich Abstimmungen und Anpassungen, um genaue Finanzdaten zu führen

• Nutzen Sie fortgeschrittenes Wissen über ERP-Systeme, um Buchhaltungsprozesse zu optimieren und die Effizienz zu verbessern

• Unterstützung des Global Process Owners (GPO) bei der Definition von RTR-Prozessen und Systemimplementierung

• Pflegen und aktualisieren Sie den Kontenplan und die Hierarchien, um sicherzustellen, dass er die aktuelle Geschäftsstruktur und die Berichtspflichten widerspiegelt

• Enge Zusammenarbeit mit lokalen Finanzteams in Ländern und Finance Shared Services Teams / Business Process Outsourcing (BPO) Provider

• Koordinieren Sie sich mit anderen Abteilungen und den Finance Shared Services-Teams, um sicherzustellen, dass alle Finanztransaktionen ordnungsgemäß erfasst und im Hauptbuch ausgewiesen werden

• Unterstützung, wenn erforderlich, mit dem Periodenende, einschließlich des Schließens des Debitoren-/Zahlungsunterbuchs und des Abgleichs mit dem Hauptbuch; enges Hauptbuch, neue Finanzperiode eröffnen, schließen Asset Accounting (AA)

• Unterstützung bei der Erstellung komplexer Journaleinträge, Bilanzabstimmungen und Varianzanalysen

• Beitrag zur kontinuierlichen Verbesserung des RTR-Prozesses, Nutzung von Technologie und Best Practices; Aufrechterhaltung von Richtlinien, Verfahren und Vorlagen

• Gewährleistung der internen Finanzkontrollen für die von dieser Rolle durchgeführten Prozesse

• Führen Sie alle technischen Aktivitäten zum Jahresende durch, z. B. Bilanzvortrag, Erstellung von Zahlenbereichen, Abschluss von AA

• Unterstützung des Intercompany-Abgleichsprozesses in Coprocess und Tagetik (Fix-Varianzen)

Bildung und Erfahrung

• Universitätsabschluss in Finanzen, Rechnungswesen, Betriebswirtschaft oder verwandten Bereichen

• Mindestens 3-4 Jahre Erfahrung im Rechnungswesen mit einem starken Fokus auf General Ledger und Finanzberichterstattung

• CPA, ACCA, CMA oder eine gleichwertige Zertifizierung bevorzugt

Kritische Erfolgsfaktoren

• Starke analytische, Problemlösungs- und Managementfähigkeiten

• Ausgezeichnete Liebe zum Detail und Verpflichtung zu Genauigkeit und Integrität in der Finanzberichterstattung

• Bewährte Fähigkeit, mehrere Prioritäten in einer terminabhängigen Umgebung zu verwalten

• Starke Kommunikationsfähigkeiten für die Bereitstellung wichtiger Erkenntnisse für Führungskräfte

Technische und Sprachkenntnisse

• Proficient in ERP-Systemen (relevant für Ihre Business Unit; SAP, Microsoft Dynamics 365 oder iScala) und Buchhaltungssoftware

• Starke MS Office (Excel, PowerPoint) Fähigkeiten

• Erfahrung mit Tagetik, Coprocess und Qlik Sense ist ein Plus

• Englischkenntnisse

Was wir Ihnen bieten

• 12 Urlaubstage pro Jahr

• 50% Urlaubsbonus

• Hauptkrankenversicherung für den Arbeitnehmer

• 30 Tage Weihnachtsbonus (Aguinaldo)

• 8% Sparkasse

• Spargenossenschaft / Sparkasse

• Kostenlose Cafeteria / kostenlose Mahlzeiten

• Anerkennung des Dienstalters alle 5 Jahre

• Pensionsplan

Sulzer ist ein Arbeitgeber für Chancengleichheit. Wir glauben an die Stärke einer vielfältigen Belegschaft und engagieren uns für ein integratives Arbeitsumfeld.

Wir sind stolz darauf, als Top Employer 2026 in Brasilien, Kanada, China, Finnland, Deutschland, Irland, Mexiko, der Schweiz, Südafrika, Großbritannien und den USA anerkannt zu werden.
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Sulzer est une entreprise d'ingénierie de premier plan avec un fier héritage d'innovation. Rejoignez notre équipe mondiale pour développer votre expertise et développer des solutions innovantes qui permettent une société prospère et plus durable.

Sur le rôle

Le comptable principal RTR du Centre d'excellence (CdE) travaille dans une équipe RTR SWAT affectée à plusieurs pays, soutenant les équipes Record to Report (RTR) par exemple avec diverses tâches ad hoc, des réservations complexes ou la maintenance du plan comptable.
• Servir en tant que membre clé de l'équipe RTR SWAT au sein du Conseil de l'Europe, fournir un appui expert sur des sujets spéciaux et des questions comptables complexes

• Appui aux activités de réservation financière complexes, en veillant à l'exactitude et au respect des normes internationales d'information financière (IFRS) et des règlements Sulzer

• Gérer les opérations de compensation complexes, y compris les rapprochements et les ajustements, pour tenir des dossiers financiers exacts

• Utiliser les connaissances avancées des systèmes PGI pour rationaliser les processus comptables et améliorer l ' efficacité

• Soutenir le propriétaire du processus mondial (GPO) avec la définition des processus RTR et la mise en œuvre du système

• Maintenir et mettre à jour le plan comptable et les hiérarchies, en veillant à ce qu'il reflète la structure opérationnelle actuelle et les exigences en matière de rapports.

• Collaborer étroitement avec les équipes des finances locales dans les pays et les équipes des services partagés des finances / fournisseur d'externalisation des processus d'affaires

• Coordonner avec les autres ministères et les équipes des Services partagés des finances pour s'assurer que toutes les opérations financières sont dûment comptabilisées et reflétées dans le grand livre

• Soutien nécessaire à la clôture de l'exercice, y compris la clôture des comptes débiteurs/sous-levier à payer et le rapprochement avec le grand livre général;

• Appui à la préparation d'entrées de journaux complexes, de rapprochements de bilan et d'analyse des écarts

• Contribuer à l'amélioration continue du processus de RTR, en tirant parti de la technologie et des pratiques exemplaires; maintenir les politiques, les procédures et les modèles

• S'assurer que des contrôles internes financiers sont en place et suivis pour les processus exécutés par ce rôle

• Faire toutes les activités techniques de clôture de fin d'année telles que le report de l'équilibre, les créations de gamme de nombres, la fermeture de l'AA

• Soutien au processus de rapprochement interentreprises dans Coprocess et Tagetik (variations fixes)

Éducation et expérience

• Diplôme universitaire en finance, comptabilité, administration des affaires ou domaine connexe

• Minimum de 3-4 ans d'expérience en comptabilité avec un accent particulier sur le grand livre et l'information financière

• CPA, ACCA, CMA ou certification équivalente préférée

Facteurs de succès essentiels

• Fortes compétences en analyse, résolution de problèmes et gestion

• Excellente attention aux détails et à l'engagement en faveur de l'exactitude et de l'intégrité des rapports financiers

• Capacité éprouvée de gérer de multiples priorités dans un environnement axé sur les échéances

• Capacités de communication solides pour fournir des renseignements clés aux cadres supérieurs

Compétences techniques et linguistiques

• Compétence en systèmes ERP (pertinents pour votre unité d'affaires ; SAP, Microsoft Dynamics 365 ou iScala ) et logiciel de comptabilité

• Fortes compétences de MS Office (Excel, PowerPoint)

• Expérience avec Tagetik, Coprocess et Qlik Sense est un plus

• Compétence en anglais

Ce que nous vous offrons

• 12 jours de vacances par an

• 50 % de prime aux vacances

• Assurance maladie majeure pour l'employé

• 30 jours de bonus de Noël (aguinaldo)

• 8% fonds d'épargne

• Caisse d'épargne / caisse d'épargne

• Cafétéria gratuite / repas gratuits

• Reconnaissance de l'ancienneté tous les 5 ans

• Régime de retraite

Sulzer est un employeur à chances égales. Nous croyons en la force d'un effectif diversifié et sommes déterminés à offrir un milieu de travail inclusif.

Nous sommes fiers d'être reconnus comme l'un des meilleurs employeurs 2026 au Brésil, au Canada, en Chine, en Finlande, en Allemagne, en Irlande, au Mexique, en Suisse, en Afrique du Sud, au Royaume-Uni et aux États-Unis.

jobs.title: Industrial Machinery Project Manager
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

As an Industrial Machinery Project Manager, you will lead moderately complex projects from initiation through completion, ensuring the project will be delivered safely, on time, within scope, and within budget. You will serve as the primary point of contact for customers and stakeholders, while coordinating cross-functional teams to achieve high-quality outcomes and strong client satisfaction. Key Responsibilities

• Project Leadership
• Lead mid-sized projects, ensuring adherence to schedules, budgets, and quality standards.

• Serve as the primary point of contact for customers throughout project execution.

• Drive accountability across teams to meet project milestones and deliverables.

• Project Planning & Coordination
• Develop and manage detailed project plans, including timelines, budgets, and resource allocation.

• Lead estimating efforts, including takeoffs and input into the quoting system.

• Assign tasks and coordinate activities across internal teams, contractors, and vendors.

• Communication & Reporting
• Provide clear, consistent updates on project status, performance, and risks.

• Maintain accurate project documentation, including schedules, reports, and risk logs.

• Escalate issues that may impact cost, schedule, or quality.

• Safety & Compliance
• Ensure compliance with OSHA, NEC, and company safety standards.

• Conduct site audits and address safety concerns proactively.

• Support the integration of environmentally responsible and sustainable practices.

• Risk Management
• Identify potential project risks and develop mitigation strategies.

• Monitor project performance and implement corrective actions when needed.

• Team Collaboration
• Collaborate with customers, engineers, field teams, and contractors to resolve challenges.

• Promote teamwork and maintain alignment on project goals.

• Continuous Improvement
• Identify opportunities to improve efficiency, cost control, and project execution.

• Support the development and implementation of best practices.

• Additional Responsibilities
• Perform other duties as needed to support business objectives and project success.

• Pursuing ongoing learning and professional development opportunities

Qualifications & Competencies
Required:

• 2–4 years of experience in project management or project coordination

• Proficiency in Microsoft Office and project management software

• Ability to read and interpret electrical drawings and specifications.

• Knowledge of NEC standards, OSHA regulations, and environmental compliance

• Experience with estimating, quoting, and takeoff processes.
Preferred:

• Bachelor’s degree in engineering, Construction Management, Business Administration, Project Management, or related field

• Experience working with cross-functional teams.

• PMP, CAPM, or similar project management certification

What we offer you

• 15 days of paid time off and 12 company-paid holidays

• 401k plan with a 6% match

• Comprehensive health plan including medical, dental, vision, Life, short-term & long-term disability

• Motivating wellness program

• Employee Assistance Program

• Paid paternal leave

• Gym re-imbursement

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Inhouse Consultant BI&Analytics
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Are you passionate about transforming data into business value? Do you enjoy working closely with senior stakeholders and influencing business decisions through analytics, insights, and emerging technologies?
At Sulzer, we're embarking on an exciting journey from traditional Business Intelligence towards Artificial Intelligence-powered solutions. We're looking for an experienced Inhouse Consultant BI & Analytics to join our Global IT BI & Analytics team in Madrid and help drive our data-driven transformation.
This is not a pure IT development role. We are looking for someone who can combine strong technical expertise with business consulting skills, building trusted relationships with senior leaders across the business while delivering innovative analytics solutions.

What You'll Be Doing

As part of our global BI & Analytics team, you will work closely with business stakeholders across Sulzer to understand challenges, identify opportunities, and deliver solutions that drive better decision-making.
Key responsibilities include:

• Partnering with business leaders to understand requirements and translate them into scalable analytics solutions

• Designing, developing and enhancing enterprise BI applications using Qlik Sense

• Delivering meaningful insights and dashboards that support strategic and operational decision-making

• Working with Snowflake and modern data platforms to create trusted, scalable data solutions

• Supporting Sulzer's "One Sulzer" harmonisation strategy through standardised reporting and analytics

• Driving self-service analytics and data literacy across the organisation

• Exploring and implementing emerging technologies including AI, Generative AI, Copilots and Agentic AI solutions

• Building intelligent applications and data products that connect to Sulzer's modern data platform

• Collaborating with Data Engineering teams to develop robust data models and scalable solutions

• Acting as a trusted advisor to both business and IT stakeholders globally

Essential Skills & Experience

• Minimum 5 years' experience in a Business Intelligence, Analytics or Inhouse Consulting role

• Strong hands-on experience with Qlik Sense

• Advanced SQL skills

• Experience working with senior business stakeholders

• Strong business consulting and stakeholder management skills

• Experience gathering business requirements and translating them into technical solutions

• Excellent communication and presentation skills

Highly Desirable

• Experience with Snowflake

• Knowledge of modern data warehousing concepts

• Experience with dbt

• Exposure to Power BI, Tableau or Looker

• Experience in AI, Generative AI, Copilots or emerging analytics technologies

• Experience working within an international or global organisation

The Opportunity
This is a unique opportunity for someone who enjoys operating at the intersection of business, data, analytics and AI. You'll play a key role in helping Sulzer evolve from traditional reporting and dashboards towards intelligent, AI-enabled business solutions that create measurable value across the organisation.
If you're excited by modern analytics, emerging AI technologies, and partnering with senior business leaders to drive transformation, we'd love to hear from you.

What we offer you

• Permanent position within a globally recognised industrial technology leader

• Competitive salary

• Annual bonus scheme

• Meal vouchers

• Flexible benefits package including health insurance, transport and childcare options

• Opportunity to work with cutting-edge Data & AI technologies

• Be part of a highly experienced team

• International exposure working with stakeholders across multiple business domains

• Career growth opportunities within a global orga

• Lavorare con Snowflake e piattaforme di dati moderne per creare soluzioni di dati affidabili e scalabili

• Sostenere la strategia di armonizzazione "One Sulzer" di Sulzer attraverso report e analisi standardizzate

• Guidare l'analisi self-service e l'alfabetizzazione dei dati in tutta l'organizzazione

• Esplorare e implementare tecnologie emergenti tra cui AI, AI Generative, Copiloti e soluzioni AI Agentic

• Costruire applicazioni intelligenti e prodotti di dati che si collegano alla piattaforma di dati moderna di Sulzer

• Collaborare con i team di Data Engineering per sviluppare modelli di dati robusti e soluzioni scalabili

• Agire come consulente affidabile sia per gli stakeholder aziendali che per gli IT a livello globale

• Esperienza minima di 5 anni in un ruolo di Business Intelligence, Analytics o Inhouse Consulting

• Esperienza pratica forte con Qlik Sense

• Avanzate competenze SQL

• Esperienza di lavoro con gli stakeholder aziendali senior

• Forte consulenza aziendale e competenze di gestione degli stakeholder

• Provare a raccogliere i requisiti aziendali e traducerli in soluzioni tecniche

• Ottima capacità di comunicazione e presentazione

Altamente desiderabile

• Esperienza con Snowflake

• Conoscenza dei moderni concetti di memorizzazione dei dati

• Esperienza con dbt

• Esposizione al potere BI, Tableau o Looker

• Esperienza in AI, AI Generativo, Copiloti o tecnologie di analisi emergenti

• Esperienza di lavoro all'interno di un'organizzazione internazionale o globale

L'opportunità
Questa è un'opportunità unica per qualcuno che gode di operare all'incrocio di business, dati, analisi e AI. Svolgerai un ruolo chiave nell'aiutare Sulzer a evolversi da report e dashboard tradizionali verso soluzioni aziendali intelligenti e abilitate all'IA che creano un valore misurabile in tutta l'organizzazione.
Se sei emozionato dalle moderne tecnologie di analisi, dalle tecnologie emergenti dell'AI e partner con i leader di business senior per guidare la trasformazione, ci piacerebbe sentire da voi.

Cosa ti offriamo

• Posizione permanente all'interno di un leader tecnologico industriale riconosciuto a livello mondiale

• stipendio competitivo

• Schema di bonus annuale

• Buoni pasto

• Pacchetto di prestazioni flessibili tra cui assicurazione sanitaria, opzioni di trasporto e assistenza all'infanzia

• Opportunità di lavorare con tecnologie Data & AI all'avanguardia

• Partecipa a un team altamente esperto

• Esposizione internazionale che opera con le parti interessate attraverso più domini aziendali

• Opportunità di crescita di carriera all'interno di un orga globale

jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary

Responsible for driving business development, product specialization, sales enablement, and strategic opportunity leadership to strengthen Sulzer’s position as the leading independent service provider for industrial steam turbines and process gas compressors. Serving as the regional focal point for Steam Turbines & Compressors (ST&C) across Sub-Saharan Africa (SSA), the role implements the global Product Line strategy by translating strategic objectives into actionable regional go-to-market plans.

The position ensures alignment with Sulzer’s overall business strategy while adapting initiatives to local market dynamics, supporting growth, customer engagement, and sustainable market leadership. Business Development Manager & Product Specialist – Steam Turbine & Compressor Services (SSA)

Location: Johannesburg, South Africa
Region: Sub-Saharan Africa (SSA)
Division: Sulzer Services

Sulzer is a global leader in engineering and services, dedicated to delivering innovative and sustainable solutions for our customers. We are seeking an experienced and commercially driven Business Development Manager & Product Specialist – Steam Turbine & Compressor Services to lead the growth of our Steam Turbine & Compressor (ST&C) business across Sub-Saharan Africa.

This is a strategic regional role combining business development, product specialization, sales enablement, and opportunity leadership to strengthen Sulzer's position as the leading independent service provider for industrial steam turbines and process gas compressors. Acting as the regional focal point for ST&C, you will translate global product line strategies into impactful regional growth initiatives while building long-term customer relationships and expanding Sulzer's market presence across Africa.

What You Will Be Doing

• Drive profitable growth of Sulzer's Turbine & Compressor Services portfolio across Sub-Saharan Africa.

• Develop and execute regional go-to-market strategies aligned with global ST&C objectives.

• Identify, qualify, and convert opportunities across diverse industrial sectors and multi-OEM installed bases.

• Support and enable sales teams through technical-commercial expertise and opportunity development.

• Lead strategic, high-value pursuits and coordinate cross-functional teams to deliver winning customer solutions.

• Build strong relationships with customers, asset owners, operators, EPCs, and business partners across the region.

• Promote Sulzer's "One Sulzer" approach by leveraging global engineering, service centre, field service, and technical expertise.

• Monitor market trends, competitor activity, and emerging opportunities to support sustainable growth.

•
What We're Looking For

• Bachelor's degree in mechanical engineering or equivalent qualification.

• Minimum of 8 years' experience within the industrial turbomachinery service industry.

• Demonstrated experience with industrial steam turbines and/or process gas compressors.

• Strong technical and commercial acumen with the ability to develop and deliver customer-focused solutions.

• Proven track record in business development, opportunity management, and sales leadership.

• Experience operating within matrix organizations and emerging markets will be advantageous.

• Excellent stakeholder engagement, influencing, and relationship-building skills.

•
Travel Requirement
This role requires regular travel throughout Sub-Saharan Africa (approximately 40–60%) and the ability to work effectively in diverse and emerging market environments.

What Success Looks Like
The successful candidate will contribute to:

• Revenue and order intake growth.

• Increased installed base penetration and market share.

• Strategic opportunity wins and long-term ser

Responsabile per lo sviluppo aziendale, la specializzazione del prodotto, l'attivazione delle vendite e la leadership strategica di opportunità per rafforzare la posizione di Sulzer come fornitore di servizi indipendente leader per turbine a vapore industriali e compressori di gas di processo. La posizione garantisce l’allineamento con la strategia aziendale globale di Sulzer, adattando al contempo le iniziative alle dinamiche del mercato locale, sostenendo la crescita, l’impegno dei clienti e la leadership di mercato sostenibile. Business Development Manager & Product Specialist – Servizi di turbine e compressori di vapore (SSA)

Ubicazione: Johannesburg, Sudafrica
Regione: Africa subsahariana (SSA)
Divisione: Servizi Sulzer

Sulzer è leader globale nell'ingegneria e nei servizi, dedicato alla fornitura di soluzioni innovative e sostenibili per i nostri clienti. Siamo alla ricerca di un Business Development Manager & Product Specialist esperto e commercialmente guidato – Steam Turbine & Compressor Services per condurre la crescita del nostro business Steam Turbine & Compressor (ST&C) in tutta l'Africa subsahariana.

Si tratta di un ruolo strategico regionale che combina lo sviluppo aziendale, la specializzazione dei prodotti, il rendimento delle vendite e la leadership di opportunità per rafforzare la posizione di Sulzer come fornitore di servizi indipendente leader per turbine a vapore industriali e compressori di gas di processo. In qualità di punto focale regionale per ST&C, tradurrai strategie di linea di prodotti globali in iniziative di crescita regionale incisive, costruendo relazioni con i clienti a lungo termine e espandendo la presenza di mercato di Sulzer in tutta l'Africa.

Cosa farai

• Promuovere una crescita redditizia del portafoglio di Turbine & Compressor Services di Sulzer in tutta l'Africa subsahariana.

• Sviluppare ed eseguire strategie regionali di go-to-market allineate agli obiettivi globali di ST&C.

• Identificare, qualificare e convertire opportunità in diversi settori industriali e basi multi-OEM installate.

• Supporto e abilitare i team di vendita attraverso competenze tecnico-commerciali e lo sviluppo delle opportunità.

• Condurre inseguimenti strategici e di alto valore e coordinare team interfunzionali per fornire soluzioni clienti vincenti.

• Costruire relazioni forti con clienti, proprietari di asset, operatori, EPC e partner commerciali in tutta la regione.

• Promuovere l'approccio "One Sulzer" di Sulzer sfruttando l'ingegneria globale, il centro assistenza, il servizio sul campo e le competenze tecniche.

• Monitorare le tendenze del mercato, l'attività dei concorrenti e le opportunità emergenti per sostenere la crescita sostenibile.

•
Cosa stiamo cercando

• Laurea in ingegneria meccanica o qualifica equivalente.

• Esperienza minima di 8 anni nell'industria dei servizi turbomacchine industriali.

• Esperienza dimostrata con turbine a vapore industriali e/o compressori a gas di processo.

• Forte acume tecnico e commerciale con la capacità di sviluppare e fornire soluzioni orientate al cliente.

• Provato record di traccia in sviluppo aziendale, gestione delle opportunità e leadership di vendita.

• L'esperienza che opera all'interno di organizzazioni di matrice e mercati emergenti sarà vantaggiosa.

• Eccellente coinvolgimento delle parti interessate, influenzando e capacità di costruzione di relazioni.

•
Richiesta di viaggio
Questo ruolo richiede viaggi regolari in tutta l'Africa subsahariana (circa il 40-60%) e la capacità di lavorare efficacemente in ambienti di mercato diversi ed emergenti.

Che successo sembra
Il candidato di successo contribuirà a:

• Crescita delle entrate e dell'ordine.

• Aumentata penetrazione di base installata e quota di mercato.

• Opportunità strategica vince e ser a lungo termine

La position assure l'alignement avec la stratégie commerciale globale de Sulzer, tout en adaptant les initiatives à la dynamique du marché local, en soutenant la croissance, l'engagement des clients et le leadership durable du marché. Gestionnaire de développement des affaires et spécialiste des produits – Services de turbine à vapeur et compresseur (SSA)

Lieu: Johannesburg, Afrique du Sud
Région: Afrique subsaharienne
Division : Services Sulzer

Sulzer est un leader mondial de l'ingénierie et des services, dédié à fournir des solutions innovantes et durables pour nos clients. Nous sommes à la recherche d'un responsable du développement commercial et spécialiste des produits – Turbine à vapeur et compresseur Services pour diriger la croissance de notre entreprise de turbine à vapeur et compresseur (ST&C) dans toute l'Afrique subsaharienne.

Il s'agit d'un rôle stratégique régional combinant le développement des entreprises, la spécialisation des produits, la capacité de vente et le leadership d'opportunité pour renforcer la position de Sulzer en tant que premier fournisseur de services indépendant pour les turbines à vapeur industrielles et les compresseurs de gaz de procédé. En tant que point focal régional pour la ST&C, vous transformerez les stratégies globales de gamme de produits en initiatives de croissance régionale impactées tout en établissant des relations client à long terme et en élargissant la présence de Sulzer sur le marché en Afrique.

jobs.title: Assembly Fitter
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

At Sulzer Leeds, we don't just manufacture pumps. We engineer some of the world's most advanced pumping solutions for critical applications across energy, water, infrastructure, industrial processing and emerging technologies.

Our Leeds facility is a global centre of excellence for the design, engineering and manufacture of highly specialised pumps and pumping systems. From bespoke, large-scale engineered solutions to complex rotodynamic technologies, our teams tackle some of the most demanding technical challenges in the industry.

As we continue to invest in our people, technology and capabilities, we are looking for talented individuals who want to make a real impact and build a rewarding career within a world-class engineering environment. Key Duties

• Assemble, build and fit complex centrifugal pump assemblies and associated equipment in line with engineering drawings, specifications and quality standards.

• Carry out mechanical fitting activities including bearing installation, shaft assembly, impeller fitting, seal installation and final pump build.

• Interpret engineering drawings, assembly instructions and technical documentation to ensure accurate assembly of components.

• Use precision measuring equipment to verify dimensions, tolerances and alignment

What We're Looking For

• Time-served Mechanical Fitter, Mechanical Assembly Technician, or equivalent mechanical engineering apprenticeship.

• Experience assembling rotating equipment such as pumps, compressors, gearboxes, turbines or similar precision-engineered machinery.

• Ability to read and interpret engineering drawings and technical specifications.

• Skilled in the use of hand tools, mechanical assembly equipment and precision measuring instruments.

• Strong understanding of mechanical tolerances, fits, alignments and assembly techniques.

• Experience working within a manufacturing, engineering or heavy industrial environment.

• A proactive approach to problem-solving with excellent attention to detail.

What we offer you

We’ve recently invested significantly in modernising our Leeds facility — creating a brighter, more efficient, and more advanced workspace designed to support high‑quality work and a great employee experience. Alongside our upgraded facilities, you’ll benefit from:

Core Benefits

• A competitive salary

• A company-wide bonus scheme

• Paid overtime opportunities

• Medicash Health Cash Plan (covering everyday healthcare expenses such as dental, optical and GP services)

• 33 days’ holiday

• Defined pension contribution

• Employee Assistance Programmes

• Discounts on shopping, entertainment & lifestyle

• Costco membership option

• Discounted personal car leasing for you, family & friends

• Long Service Awards

• Ongoing learning through Sulzer Learning Pathways

• Armed Forces Support – As a Silver Award holder of the MoD Defence Employer Recognition Scheme, we actively support veterans, reservists and Cadet Adult Volunteers. This includes policies that enable time for training, camps and deployment, alongside access to a growing internal military network.

Onsite Perks

• Free, secure parking with EV charging

• Multi-faith prayer room

• Newly modernised work areas

• Lively Sports & Social Club with events & prize draws

• 24/7 onsite gym

• Subsidised vending machines

• Subsidised Canteen offering hot and cold food

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

Informazioni sul ruolo

A Sulzer Leeds, non produciamo solo pompe. Ingegneremo alcune delle soluzioni di pompaggio più avanzate al mondo per applicazioni critiche tra energia, acqua, infrastrutture, lavorazione industriale e tecnologie emergenti.

La nostra struttura Leeds è un centro di eccellenza globale per la progettazione, l'ingegneria e la produzione di pompe e sistemi di pompaggio altamente specializzati. Dalle soluzioni ingegnerizzate su larga scala alle tecnologie rotodinamiche complesse, i nostri team affrontano alcune delle sfide tecniche più impegnative del settore.

Mentre continuiamo a investire nella nostra gente, tecnologia e capacità, stiamo cercando individui di talento che vogliono fare un impatto reale e costruire una carriera gratificante in un ambiente di ingegneria di livello mondiale. Doveri chiave

• Assemblare, costruire e adattare complessi gruppi di pompe centrifughe e attrezzature associate in linea con disegni di ingegneria, specifiche e standard di qualità.

• Eseguire attività di montaggio meccanico, tra cui l'installazione del cuscinetto, l'assemblaggio dell'albero, il montaggio della girante, l'installazione della guarnizione e la costruzione della pompa finale.

• Interpretare disegni di ingegneria, istruzioni di montaggio e documentazione tecnica per garantire l'assemblaggio accurato dei componenti.

• Utilizzare apparecchiature di misura di precisione per verificare dimensioni, tolleranze e allineamento

• Imprenditoria meccanica, tecnica di assemblaggio meccanico, o equivalente apprendistato di ingegneria meccanica.

• Capacità di leggere e interpretare disegni di ingegneria e specifiche tecniche.

• Abilitato nell'uso di utensili manuali, attrezzature di assemblaggio meccanico e strumenti di misura di precisione.

• Forte comprensione delle tolleranze meccaniche, si adatta, allineamenti e tecniche di montaggio.

• Esperienza di lavoro all'interno di un ambiente produttivo, ingegneristico o industriale pesante.

jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

At Sulzer, we are driving exciting transformation projects across our manufacturing operations. As part of our SAP implementation journey, we are looking for a motivated MRP Controller to join our Burgos site and support the development of our planning capabilities.
This is an excellent opportunity for a planning professional who wants to build expertise in production planning, ERP systems, and manufacturing operations while contributing to a key business transformation project.
Key Responsibilities

• Run the MRP system on a daily basis, ensuring that planned production orders and requisitions are aligned with the Master Production Plan.

• Perform capacity analysis by regularly assessing workload versus the plant’s installed capacity, identifying bottlenecks and recommending additional shifts or resource reallocation through the system when needed.

• Monitor production plan compliance by tracking actual manufacturing progress against the scheduled plan, analyzing deviations such as scrap, mechanical failures, absenteeism or delays, and promptly rescheduling the system to keep it updated.

• Update and manage key performance indicators (KPIs).

To succeed in this role, you will need

• Bachelor's degree in Industrial Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Supply Chain Management, Manufacturing Engineering, or a related field.

• 1-3 years of experience in production planning, materials planning, supply chain, manufacturing operations, or similar environments.

• Experience working with ERP systems.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

• Ability to manage priorities in a dynamic manufacturing environment.

• Strong communication and collaboration skills.

• Good knowledge of Microsoft Excel.

About the role

At Sulzer, we are driving exciting transformation projects across our manufacturing operations. As part of our SAP implementation journey, we are looking for a motivated MRP Controller to join our Burgos site and support the development of our planning capabilities.

• Update and manage key performance indicators (KPIs).

• Bachelor's degree in Industrial Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Supply Chain Management, Manufacturing Engineering, or a related field.

• Experience working with ERP systems.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

• Ability to manage priorities in a dynamic manufacturing environment.

• Strong communication and collaboration skills.

• Good knowledge of Microsoft Excel.

• Fluent Spanish and a good level of English.

Are you passionate about engineering and looking for an exciting opportunity to grow your career? We have a vacancy at our Wexford Service Centre for a Service Engineer to join our dedicated team. This role involves servicing and installing industrial, municipal, and commercial wastewater and stormwater pumping equipment. Key Responsibilities:

• Planned Inspections & Maintenance : Conduct effective planned inspections, fault finding, and maintenance of pumping equipment at customer sites.

• Ownership & Initiative : Take an active role and ownership of your responsibilities.

• Computer Skills : Proficiency in computer skills for reporting and communication.

• Interpersonal Skills : Strong interpersonal and customer service skills.

• Team Player : Ability to work alone or as part of a team, under pressure and to deadlines.

jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

The Junior Manual Machinist is responsible for learning how to machine and refurbish turbine and rotating‑equipment components using conventional machine tools. You will be paired with a mentor to learn how to use manual lathes, HBM, VTL, 4‑jaw chuck setups, precision measuring tools, and consistently hold tight tolerances on critical turbine parts. Key Responsibilities

• Set up and operate manual lathes, mills, horizontal boring mills (HBM), vertical turret lathes (VTL), and related machining equipment.

• Perform advanced 4‑jaw chuck setups, indicating, and alignment of irregular, heavy, and split components.

• Machine turbine components including IGVs, diaphragms, rings, shafts, sleeves, and split casings.

• Achieve and verify tight machining tolerances (typically ±0.001" or as specified by drawings and procedures).

• Conduct dimensional inspections using micrometers, dial indicators, calipers, bore gauges, and other precision instruments.

• Read and interpret blueprints, repair drawings, travelers, and work instructions.

• Select correct tooling, speeds, feeds, and machining methods for each job.

• Safely handle large and heavy components using overhead cranes, lifts, and rigging equipment.

Required Qualifications

• Ability to work a 12‑day, 10‑hour minimum schedule with 12‑day, 12‑hour schedules during outage seasons .

• 1+ year of experience operating manual lathes, mills, and conventional machining equipment OR Machinist Training Program from a Technical College .

• Skilled in the use of precision measuring instruments (micrometers, indicators, bore gauges, etc.).

• Ability to read and interpret technical drawings, blueprints, and repair procedures.

Competencies

• Passionate about becoming a Senior Machinist

• Strong attention to detail and commitment to quality.

• Effective communication and problem‑solving skills.

• Strong commitment to safety and proper machining practices.

What we offer you

Country-specific benefits

• 15 days of paid time off and 12 company-paid holidays

• 401k plan with a 6% match

• Comprehensive health plan including medical, dental, vision, Life, short-term & long-term disability

• Motivating wellness program

• Employee Assistance Program

• Paid paternal leave

• Gym re-imbursement

• New onsite cafeteria, all meals subsidized (La Porte Service Center)

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Description Summary
Machinist is responsible for machining and refurbishing turbine and rotating‑equipment components using conventional machine tools. This role requires hands‑on experience with manual lathes, HBM, VTL, 4‑jaw chuck setups, precision measuring tools, and the ability to consistently hold tight tolerances on critical turbine parts. Key Responsibilities

• Set up and operate manual lathes, mills, horizontal boring mills (HBM), vertical turret lathes (VTL), and related machining equipment.

• Perform advanced 4‑jaw chuck setups, indicating, and alignment of irregular, heavy, and split components.

• Machine turbine components including IGVs, diaphragms, rings, shafts, sleeves, and split casings.

• Achieve and verify tight machining tolerances (typically ±0.001" or as specified by drawings and procedures).

• Conduct dimensional inspections using micrometers, dial indicators, calipers, bore gauges, and other precision instruments.

• Read and interpret blueprints, repair drawings, travelers, and work instructions.

• Select correct tooling, speeds, feeds, and machining methods for each job.

• Safely handle large and heavy components using overhead cranes, lifts, and rigging
equipment.

Required Qualifications

• Ability to work a 12‑day, 10‑hour minimum schedule with 12‑day, 12‑hour schedules during outage seasons .

• 3–5+ years of experience operating manual lathes, mills, and conventional machining equipment.

• Strong proficiency with 4‑jaw chuck setups and precision indicating.

• Skilled in the use of precision measuring instruments (micrometers, indicators, bore gauges, etc.).

• Ability to read and interpret technical drawings, blueprints, and repair procedures.

• Must supply basic personal hand tools.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience in turbine repair, power generation, or heavy‑industrial machining.

• Knowledge of machining tolerances, fits, and GD&T.

• Experience operating overhead cranes and/or forklifts.

• Ability to machine large, heavy, and split turbine components.

Competencies

• Strong attention to detail and commitment to quality.

• Ability to work independently as well as in a team environment.

• Effective communication and problem‑solving skills.

• Strong commitment to safety and proper machining practices.

What we offer you

• 15 days of paid time off and 12 company-paid holidays

• 401k plan with a 6% match

• Comprehensive health plan including medical, dental, vision, Life, short-term & long-term disability

• Motivating wellness program

• Employee Assistance Program

• Paid paternal leave

• Gym re-imbursement

• New onsite cafeteria, all meals subsidized (La Porte Service Center)

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

Informazioni sul ruolo

Descrizione del lavoro
Machinist è responsabile per la lavorazione e la ristrutturazione della turbina e dei componenti di equipaggiamento rotante utilizzando macchine utensili convenzionali. Questo ruolo richiede un'esperienza pratica con torni manuali, HBM, VTL, configurazioni di mandrino a 4 tempi, strumenti di misura di precisione e la capacità di tenere costantemente strette tolleranze sulle parti critiche della turbina. Principali responsabilità

• Impostare e utilizzare torni manuali, mulini, frese orizzontali (HBM), torni a torretta verticale (VTL), e relative attrezzature di lavorazione.

• Eseguire le impostazioni avanzate del mandrino 4-jaw, indicando e allineamento dei componenti irregolari, pesanti e divisi.

• Componenti della turbina della macchina tra cui IGV, diaframmi, anelli, alberi, maniche e involucri separati.

• Ottenere e verificare tolleranze di lavorazione strette (tipicamente ±0.001" o come specificato da disegni e procedure).

• Condurre ispezioni dimensionali utilizzando micrometri, indicatori di linea, pinze, bore e altri strumenti di precisione.

• Leggere e interpretare i progetti, riparare disegni, viaggiatori e istruzioni di lavoro.

• Selezionare strumenti corretti, velocità, feed e metodi di lavorazione per ogni lavoro.

• Maneggiare in modo sicuro componenti grandi e pesanti utilizzando gru, ascensori e rigging
attrezzature.

Qualificazioni richieste

• Possibilità di lavorare un programma minimo di 12 ore, di 10 ore con orari di 12 ore, 12 ore durante le stagioni in uscita.

• 3-5 anni di esperienza di tornio manuale operativo, mulini e attrezzature di lavorazione convenzionali.

• Forte competenza con configurazioni di mandrino 4-jaw e indicazione di precisione.

• Abilitato nell'uso di strumenti di misura di precisione (micrometri, indicatori, manometri, ecc.).

• Capacità di leggere e interpretare disegni tecnici, progetti e procedure di riparazione.

• Deve fornire strumenti di base della mano personale.

Qualificazioni predestinate

• Esperienza nella riparazione delle turbine, nella produzione di energia o nella lavorazione industriale pesante.

• Conoscenza delle tolleranze di lavorazione, si adatta e GD&T.

• Sperimenta le gru e/o i carrelli elevatori.

• Capacità di lavorare componenti a turbina grandi, pesanti e divisi.

Competenze

• Forte attenzione al dettaglio e all'impegno per la qualità.

• Capacità di lavorare in modo indipendente e in un ambiente di squadra.

• Efficace capacità di comunicazione e problem solving.

• Forte impegno per la sicurezza e le pratiche di lavorazione adeguate.

• Wählen Sie für jeden Auftrag die richtigen Werkzeuge, Geschwindigkeiten, Vorschub- und Bearbeitungsmethoden aus.

Ausrüstung.

• Geschickte in der Verwendung von Präzisionsmessgeräten (Mikrometer, Indikatoren, Bohrungsmesser, etc.).

• Fähigkeit, technische Zeichnungen, Blaupausen und Reparaturverfahren zu lesen und zu interpretieren.

• Kenntnis der Bearbeitungstoleranzen, Passungen und GD & T.

• Erfahrung im Betrieb von Überkopfkranen und/oder Gabelstaplern.

• Fähigkeit, große, schwere und geteilte Turbinenkomponenten zu bearbeiten.

• Apply paint and any additional finishes according to sales order and work instructions.

Requirements

• High school diploma or equivalent

• 1+ years of industrial or automotive painting experience

• Ability to wear a respirator

• Ability to read, write, and communicate in English

• Reliable transportation

• Ability to pass 7-year criminal history background check

Physical Requirements:

• Must be able to lift 50 lbs (excess of 50 lbs, use of slings, hoist or cranes required)
