jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Project Engineer is responsible for supporting technical project planning, execution, and monitoring. The role involves working independently with general supervision and contributing to project success through technical and analytical support.
This job profile is intended for experienced professionals who apply practical knowledge of a job area and work independently with general supervision. SUMMARY:
The project engineering position verifies that components and assemblies meet all applicable design requirements, engineering standards, customer specifications, and applicable ASME codes and standards. This role performs calculations, technical evaluations, and detailed drawing reviews to confirm compliance with engineering standards, design documentation, and ASME Codes. The engineer contributes to ensuring that the parts, materials, and assemblies selected satisfy the functional and regulatory requirements of the nuclear application.
ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:

• Verifies that replacement parts, new equipment, retrofit pumps, and refurbished pumps are designed & constructed in accordance with customer design specifications, applicable codes & standards, and Sulzer-internal Engineering standards.

• Generates, reviews, and maintains the design Bill of Materials and Drawings while adhering to Engineering Specifications, detailed documentation of design requirements, and ASME standards.

• Perform technical evaluations and justifications to resolve non-conformance reports, supplier deviations, and design changes.

• Perform design, material, and seismic reconciliations and/or reports for nuclear-safety-related components and ASME Code Components.

• Reviews and verifies cross-sectional and general arrangement drawings.

• Reviews component drawings to ensure adherence to Engineering Standards, design requirements, ASME Code requirements, and GD&T standards.

• Review and maintenance of special processes to ensure adherence to Engineering Standards and design requirements.
SECONDARY RESPONSIBILITIES:

• Adheres to company and department policies, procedures, and standards

• Supports, cooperates with, and participates in company-wide LEAN and Environmental Safety & Health (ESH) Management System which includes following all safety, health and environmental policies and procedures. Supports and cooperates in company-wide Quality Management effort.

• Performs other duties as assigned.
SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES: None
QUALIFICATIONS:

• Requires a minimum of three (3), in mechanical engineering of rotating equipment design experience preferred but not required.

• Bachelor's Degree in Mechanical Engineering or equivalent Engineering degree.

• Basic understanding of engineering principles, calculations, and design software.

• Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.

• Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Excel, Word) and CAD tools.

• FE Certification is desirable but not mandatory.

• Strong organizational and time-management skills, with the ability to balance multiple tasks

• Eagerness to learn and ability to work in a team environment.

• Must be a U.S. Citizen, U.S. National, or Lawful Permanent Resident

What we offer you

• 15 days of paid time off and 12 company-paid holidays

• 401k plan with a 6% match

• Comprehensive health plan including medical, dental, vision, Life, short-term & long-term disability

• Health savings account matching

• Motivating wellness program

• Employee Assistance Program

• Paid paternal leave

• Gym reimbursement

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in B

Il Project Engineer è responsabile del supporto alla pianificazione, esecuzione e monitoraggio dei progetti tecnici. Il ruolo consiste nel lavorare in modo indipendente con la supervisione generale e contribuire al successo del progetto attraverso il supporto tecnico e analitico.

• Eseguire valutazioni tecniche e giustificazioni per risolvere report non conformi, deviazioni dei fornitori e cambiamenti di progettazione.

• Eseguire la progettazione, le conciliazioni materiali e sismiche e/o le relazioni per i componenti relativi alla sicurezza nucleare e i componenti del codice ASME.

• Recensioni e verifica i disegni di disposizione trasversali e generali.

• Recensioni disegni dei componenti per garantire l'adesione a Engineering Standards, requisiti di progettazione, requisiti di codice ASME e standard GD&T.

• Revisione e manutenzione di processi speciali per garantire l'adesione a Engineering Standards e requisiti di progettazione.
RISPOSTE SECONDARI:

• Aderisce a politiche, procedure e standard aziendali e dipartimentali

• Supporta, collabora e partecipa al sistema di gestione LEAN e Environmental Safety & Health (ESH) di livello aziendale che comprende le seguenti politiche e procedure di sicurezza, salute e ambiente. Supporta e collabora nello sforzo aziendale di Gestione della Qualità.

• Esegui altri compiti come assegnato.
RISPOSTE SUPERVISORIA: Nessuno
QUALIFICA:

• Richiede un minimo di tre (3), in ingegneria meccanica dell'esperienza di progettazione di attrezzature rotanti preferita ma non richiesto.

• Laurea in ingegneria meccanica o equivalente grado di ingegneria.

• La comprensione di base dei principi di ingegneria, calcoli e software di progettazione.

• Forte capacità analitiche, di problem solving e di comunicazione.

• La competenza in Microsoft Office (Excel, Word) e strumenti CAD.

• La certificazione FE è desiderabile ma non obbligatoria.

• Forte capacità organizzative e di gestione del tempo, con la capacità di bilanciare più compiti

• La voglia di imparare e la capacità di lavorare in un ambiente di squadra.

• Deve essere un cittadino degli Stati Uniti, nazionale degli Stati Uniti, o residente permanente legale

Cosa ti offriamo

• 15 giorni di tempo libero e 12 giorni festivi

• 401k piano con una partita del 6%

• Piano sanitario completo tra cui medico, dentale, visione, vita, disabilità a breve e a lungo termine

Über die Rolle

Stellenbeschreibung
Der Projektingenieur ist für die Unterstützung der technischen Projektplanung, -durchführung und -überwachung verantwortlich. Die Rolle besteht darin, unabhängig mit der allgemeinen Aufsicht zu arbeiten und durch technische und analytische Unterstützung zum Projekterfolg beizutragen.
Dieses Jobprofil richtet sich an erfahrene Fachkräfte, die praktische Kenntnisse eines Jobbereichs anwenden und unabhängig mit allgemeiner Aufsicht arbeiten. ZUSAMMENFASSUNG:
Die Position des Projektingenieurs überprüft, ob Komponenten und Baugruppen alle anwendbaren Konstruktionsanforderungen, technischen Standards, Kundenspezifikationen und anwendbaren ASME-Codes und Standards erfüllen. Diese Rolle führt Berechnungen, technische Bewertungen und detaillierte Zeichnungsüberprüfungen durch, um die Einhaltung der technischen Standards, der Konstruktionsdokumentation und der ASME-Codes zu bestätigen. Der Ingenieur trägt dazu bei, dass die ausgewählten Teile, Materialien und Baugruppen die funktionalen und regulatorischen Anforderungen der Kernanwendung erfüllen.
WESENTLICHE FUNKTIONEN

• Vergewissert sich, dass Ersatzteile, neue Geräte, Nachrüstpumpen und überholte Pumpen gemäß den Spezifikationen des Kundendesigns, den geltenden Codes und Standards sowie den Sulzer-internen Engineering-Standards entworfen und gebaut werden.

• Generiert, überprüft und pflegt die Entwurfsliste für Materialien und Zeichnungen unter Einhaltung der technischen Spezifikationen, der detaillierten Dokumentation der Konstruktionsanforderungen und der ASME-Standards.

• Führen Sie technische Bewertungen und Begründungen durch, um Nichtkonformitätsberichte, Lieferantenabweichungen und Konstruktionsänderungen zu beheben.

• Führen Sie Konstruktions-, Material- und seismische Abgleiche und/oder Berichte für Komponenten mit nuklearer Sicherheit und ASME-Code-Komponenten durch.

• Überprüfung und Überprüfung von Querschnitts- und allgemeinen Anordnungszeichnungen.

• Überprüft Komponentenzeichnungen, um die Einhaltung von Engineering Standards, Designanforderungen, ASME Code-Anforderungen und GD & T-Standards sicherzustellen.

• Überprüfung und Wartung spezieller Prozesse, um die Einhaltung von Engineering-Standards und Konstruktionsanforderungen sicherzustellen.
ZWEITE ZUSTÄNDIGE VERANTWORTUNGEN:

Sur le rôle

Résumé de l'emploi
L'ingénieur de projet est responsable de la planification, de l'exécution et du suivi des projets techniques. Le rôle consiste à travailler de manière indépendante avec une supervision générale et à contribuer au succès du projet grâce à un soutien technique et analytique.
Ce profil d'emploi est destiné aux professionnels expérimentés qui appliquent les connaissances pratiques d'un domaine d'emploi et travaillent indépendamment avec une supervision générale. RÉSUMÉ
La position d'ingénierie du projet vérifie que les composants et les assemblages répondent à toutes les exigences de conception, normes d'ingénierie, spécifications du client et codes et normes ASME applicables. Ce rôle consiste à effectuer des calculs, des évaluations techniques et des examens détaillés des dessins pour confirmer la conformité aux normes techniques, à la documentation de conception et aux codes ASME. L'ingénieur contribue à s'assurer que les pièces, matériaux et assemblages sélectionnés satisfont aux exigences fonctionnelles et réglementaires de l'application nucléaire.
FONCTIONS ESSENTIELLES:

• Vérifie que les pièces de rechange, les nouveaux équipements, les pompes d'adaptation et les pompes rénovées sont conçus et construits conformément aux spécifications de conception du client, aux codes et normes applicables et aux normes d'ingénierie interne Sulzer.

• Génère, examine et tient à jour la facture de conception des matériaux et dessins tout en respectant les spécifications techniques, la documentation détaillée des exigences de conception et les normes ASME.

• Effectuer des évaluations techniques et des justifications pour résoudre les rapports de non-conformité, les écarts de fournisseur et les changements de conception.

• Effectuer des rapprochements ou des rapports de conception, de matériaux et de sismiques pour les composants liés à la sûreté nucléaire et les composants du code ASME.

• Examiner et vérifier les dessins de sections transversales et d'arrangements généraux.

• Examiner les dessins de composants afin d'assurer le respect des normes d'ingénierie, des exigences de conception, des exigences du Code ASME et des normes GD&T.

• Examen et maintenance des processus spéciaux pour assurer le respect des normes techniques et des exigences de conception.
DEUXIÈME RESPONSABILITÉS:

• Adhérer aux politiques, procédures et normes de l'entreprise et du ministère

• Soutient, coopère avec l'ensemble de l'entreprise et participe à son système de gestion de la sécurité et de la santé environnementales (ESH), qui comprend le suivi de toutes les politiques et procédures en matière de sécurité, de santé et d'environnement. Soutient et coopère aux efforts de gestion de la qualité à l'échelle de l'entreprise.

• Exécute d'autres fonctions selon l'affectation.
RESPONSABILITÉS DE SURVEILLANCE: Néant
QUALIFICATIONS:

• Nécessite un minimum de trois (3), en génie mécanique de l'expérience de conception d'équipement rotatif préféré mais non requis.

• Baccalauréat en génie mécanique ou diplôme équivalent en génie.

• Connaissance de base des principes d'ingénierie, des calculs et des logiciels de conception.

• Forte capacité d'analyse, de résolution de problèmes et de communication.

jobs.title: Senior Tendering Engineer
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Sulzer, is a global leader in the design, manufacture, and servicing of pumps and fluid handling systems. We supply utilities and industrial clients with advanced pump technology and aftermarket services. Our solutions deliver reliability, performance, and peace of mind, from clean water to wastewater, energy to chemicals.

We’re looking for a Senior Tendering Engineer to play a key role in our front-end operations, delivering both high-volume quotes and complex, high-value tenders that shape the future of our commercial success.
Your main tasks and responsibilities:

• Prepare and deliver a high volume of quick-turnaround quotes as well as detailed, multi-disciplinary bids for complex projects.

• Collaborate with engineering, hydraulics, costing, and sales teams to optimise technical and commercial solutions.

• Lead pricing strategy and commercial terms for UK tenders, ensuring competitive and profitable offers.

• Support contract negotiations with confidence and precision, protecting Sulzer’s interests.

• Drive process improvements to increase efficiency and win rates.

• Champion best practices in tendering, quoting, and customer service.

What You Bring

• Experience in the pump industry or a closely related engineering field.

• Proven ability to manage both high-volume quoting and complex, high-value tenders.

• Strong technical and commercial acumen, with a deep understanding of pricing strategies, contract terms, and margin protection.

• Excellent communication, negotiation, and relationship-building skills.

• Ability to act independently, manage multiple priorities, and make sound decisions under pressure.

What we offer you

• Competitive basic salary

• Car or car allowance – EV options available

• Annual bonus scheme, based on company and personal performance

• Private Medical Insurance

• The flexibility to balance your time between home and the office

• 33 days annual leave

• Defined contribution pension scheme

• Confidential Employee Assistance Programmes

• Wide range of retail and lifestyle discounts

• Discounted personal car leasing

• Long Service Awards

• Continuous learning and development through Sulzer Learning Pathways

jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

The Global Business Process Analyst will drive the optimization, harmonization, and digital enablement of commercial processes across Sulzer’s three divisions Flow, Services and Chemtech. This role supports strategic initiatives within the Sulzer 2028 Strategy, enabling agile, data-driven decision-making and scalable process improvements across global sales and commercial operations.

Key Responsibilities

• Lead a newly established global function to optimise end‑to‑end commercial processes—spanning lead‑to‑order, budgeting, forecasting, and performance management—using LEAN and Six Sigma principles.

• Design and govern enterprise‑wide commercial process standards, facilitating workshops to define challenges, capture requirements, and map global “as‑is” and “to‑be” processes.

• Act as the strategic link between business and IT, partnering across Commercial Excellence, Finance, Operations, and IT to shape solutions, support Salesforce CRM/CPQ initiatives, and manage UAT and deployment.

• Strengthen global commercial systems and data governance, overseeing Salesforce CRM, CPQ, master data, and champion networks across all business units.

• Drive change, adoption, and governance by delivering training, documentation, and stakeholder engagement while promoting compliance, accountability, and ethical business practices.

Your Profile

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Business Administration, Information Systems, Industrial Engineering, or related field

• 4–7 years of experience in business process analysis, preferably in B2B commercial environments

• Strong understanding of sales and service workflows across multiple business units

• Proficiency in process mapping and continuous improvement methodologies

• Hands-on experience with Salesforce, SAP SD, CPQ, and BI tools

• Any Salesforce Certification (Administration, Sales Cloud, Service Cloud or CPQ specialist) will be preferred.

• Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills in a global context

• Fluent in English; additional languages (e.g., German, French) are a plus

What we offer you

• Strategic role in shaping Sulzer’s global commercial transformation

• Exposure to diverse functions, cultures, and business units

• Opportunities for professional growth and innovation

• Competitive compensation and benefits

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

Informazioni sul ruolo

Il Global Business Process Analyst guiderà l'ottimizzazione, l'armonizzazione e l'attivazione digitale dei processi commerciali attraverso le tre divisioni Flow, Services e Chemtech di Sulzer. Questo ruolo supporta iniziative strategiche all'interno della Strategia Sulzer 2028, consentendo agili, processi decisionali basati sui dati e miglioramenti scalabili dei processi nelle vendite globali e nelle operazioni commerciali.

Principali responsabilità

• Conduci una nuova funzione globale per ottimizzare i processi commerciali end-to-end, passando per lead-to-order, budgeting, forecasting e performance management, utilizzando i principi LEAN e Six Sigma.

• Progettare e governare gli standard di processo commerciale a livello aziendale, facilitare i workshop per definire le sfide, catturare i requisiti e mappare i processi globali “as-is” e “to-be”.

• Guidare il cambiamento, l'adozione e la governance attraverso la formazione, la documentazione e l'impegno degli stakeholder, promuovendo al contempo la conformità, la responsabilità e le pratiche aziendali etiche.

Il tuo profilo

• Corso di laurea o master in Business Administration, sistemi informativi, ingegneria industriale, o campo relativo

• 4-7 anni di esperienza nell'analisi dei processi aziendali, preferibilmente in ambienti commerciali B2B

• Forte comprensione dei flussi di lavoro di vendita e di servizio in più unità aziendali

• Proficienza nella mappatura dei processi e metodi di miglioramento continuo

• Esperienza pratica con strumenti Salesforce, SAP SD, CPQ e BI

• Qualsiasi certificazione Salesforce (amministrazione, cloud di vendita, cloud di servizio o specialista CPQ) sarà preferito.

• Eccellente capacità di comunicazione e gestione degli stakeholder in un contesto globale

• Fluente in inglese; lingue aggiuntive (ad esempio, tedesco, francese) sono un plus

Cosa ti offriamo

• ruolo strategico nella definizione della trasformazione commerciale globale di Sulzer

• Esposizione a diverse funzioni, culture e unità aziendali

• Opportunità di crescita professionale e innovazione

• Compensazioni e vantaggi competitivi

jobs.title: PM Team Leader
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
Responsible for the successful execution, governance, commercial performance, and delivery of multiple projects within the organization.
The role provides leadership to Project Coordinators, Engineers and Project Managers, ensuring projects are delivered safely, on schedule, within budget, and in accordance with contractual obligations and customer expectations.
The incumbent acts as the primary escalation point for project-related matters, drives project readiness for Steering Committee reviews, manages commercial risks including Liquidated Damages (LDs), claims, and change orders, and ensures effective project close-out and lessons learned implementation.

Key Responsibilities

Team Management

• Lead, coach, and supervise a team of Project Engineers and Project Managers.

• Establish project execution strategies, priorities, and performance targets.

• Allocate resources and balance workloads across the project portfolio.

• Conduct performance reviews, development planning, and succession planning for project personnel.

• Serve as the first level of escalation for project-related issues.

• Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, safety, and continuous improvement.

Project Delivery Management

• Oversee the execution of multiple EPC, Energy, Infrastructure, or Industrial projects.

• Ensure projects are delivered within approved schedule, budget, quality, and HSE requirements.

• Monitor project KPIs, progress, risks, and resource utilization.

• Conduct weekly project reviews and monthly portfolio reviews.

• Ensure project plans, schedules, recovery plans, and execution strategies remain current and achievable.

• Drive proactive identification and mitigation of project risks.

Commercial & Contract Management

• Lead the management of contractual obligations and commercial exposures.

• Review and address Liquidated Damages (LDs) risks and develop mitigation strategies.

• Manage contract change orders, variation requests, extension of time (EOT) claims, and commercial negotiations.

• Support dispute avoidance and resolution activities.

• Ensure contractual compliance with customers, partners, and suppliers.

• Participate in commercial negotiations with clients and subcontractors when required.

• Coordinate with Legal and Finance departments regarding contractual matters.

Project Governance & Steering Committee Readiness

• Establish governance processes across all projects.

• Ensure project readiness for Steering Committee and Executive Management reviews.

• Validate project dashboards, forecasts, risk registers, commercial updates, and mitigation plans before presentation.

• Present project performance, risks, opportunities, and corrective actions to senior management.

• Ensure management decisions are effectively implemented and tracked.

Project Close-Out & Lessons Learned

• Lead formal project close-out activities.

• Ensure completion of punch lists, final documentation, and handover requirements.

• Oversee final account settlements and commercial closure.

• Capture and institutionalize lessons learned and best practices.

Stakeholder Management

• Act as the senior interface between customers and internal stakeholders.

• Maintain strong relationships with clients, consultants, suppliers, and subcontractors.

• Coordinate activities among Engineering, Procurement, Production, Planning, QA/QC, HSE, and Finance.

• Ensure customer concerns are addressed promptly and professionally.

• Drive customer satisfaction and repeat business opportunities.

Operational Excellence

• Drive implementation of project management standards and best practices.

• Monitor project KPIs and portfolio metrics.

• Ensure compliance with company procedures and requirements.

• P

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sulzer è una società di ingegneria leader con un patrimonio orgoglioso di innovazione. Unisciti al nostro team globale per accrescere le tue competenze e sviluppare soluzioni innovative che consentano una società prospera e più sostenibile.

Informazioni sul ruolo

Sintesi del lavoro
Responsabile per l'esecuzione di successo, la governance, le prestazioni commerciali e la consegna di più progetti all'interno dell'organizzazione.
Il ruolo fornisce la leadership ai Coordinatori del Progetto, agli Ingegneri e ai Project Manager, garantendo che i progetti vengano consegnati in modo sicuro, puntuale, entro il budget e in conformità agli obblighi contrattuali e alle aspettative dei clienti.
L'incumbent agisce come punto di escalation primario per le questioni relative al progetto, guida la prontezza del progetto per le recensioni del comitato direttivo, gestisce i rischi commerciali tra cui i danni liquidati (LD), i reclami e gli ordini di cambiamento, e assicura un'efficace chiusura del progetto e le lezioni apprese implementazione.

Principali responsabilità

Gestione del team

• Guida, coach e supervisiona un team di ingegneri e manager di progetti.

• Stabilire strategie di esecuzione del progetto, priorità e obiettivi di performance.

• Allocare le risorse e i carichi di lavoro di bilancio attraverso il portafoglio di progetto.

• Condurre le recensioni delle prestazioni, la pianificazione dello sviluppo e la pianificazione di successione per il personale di progetto.

• Servire come primo livello di escalation per i problemi legati al progetto.

• Promuovere una cultura di responsabilità, collaborazione, sicurezza e miglioramento continuo.

Gestione della consegna del progetto

• Superare l'esecuzione di più progetti EPC, Energia, Infrastrutture o Industriali.

• Assicurare che i progetti vengano consegnati entro i requisiti di pianificazione, budget, qualità e HSE approvati.

• Monitorare i KPI, i progressi, i rischi e l'utilizzo delle risorse.

• Condurre le recensioni settimanali del progetto e le recensioni mensili del portafoglio.

• Assicurare piani di progetto, programmi, piani di recupero e strategie di esecuzione rimangono attuali e realizzabili.

• Guidare l'identificazione proattiva e la mitigazione dei rischi di progetto.

Gestione commerciale e dei contratti

• Condurre la gestione degli obblighi contrattuali e delle esposizioni commerciali.

• Review and address Liquidated Damages (LDs) rischi e sviluppare strategie di mitigazione.

• Gestire gli ordini di cambio del contratto, le richieste di variazione, l'estensione dei reclami del tempo (EOT) e i negoziati commerciali.

• Sostenere le attività di evitamento e risoluzione delle controversie.

• Assicurare la conformità contrattuale con clienti, partner e fornitori.

• Partecipare a trattative commerciali con clienti e subappaltatori quando necessario.

• Coordinamento con i dipartimenti Legali e Finanza in materia contrattuale.

Governance del progetto e Comitato direttivo

• Stabilire processi di governance in tutti i progetti.

• Assicurare la disponibilità del progetto per le recensioni del comitato direttivo e della direzione esecutiva.

• Convalida dashboard di progetto, previsioni, registri di rischio, aggiornamenti commerciali e piani di mitigazione prima della presentazione.

• Prestazioni, rischi, opportunità e azioni correttive per la gestione senior.

• Assicurarsi che le decisioni di gestione siano effettivamente implementate e tracciate.

Progetto Close-Out e lezioni

• Guidare attività di chiusura del progetto formale.

• Assicurare il completamento di elenchi di pugni, documentazione finale e requisiti di consegna.

• Controllare gli insediamenti dei conti finali e la chiusura commerciale.

• Catturare e istituzionalizzare le lezioni apprese e le migliori pratiche.

Gestione Stakeholder

• Agire come interfaccia senior tra i clienti e gli stakeholder interni.

• Mantenere forti relazioni con clienti, consulenti, fornitori e subappaltatori.

• Coordinare le attività tra Ingegneria, Procurement, Produzione, Pianificazione, QA/QC, HSE e Finanza.

• Assicurarsi che le preoccupazioni dei clienti siano affrontate prontamente e professionalmente.

• Guidare la soddisfazione del cliente e ripetere le opportunità di business.

Eccellenza operativa

• Guidare l'implementazione di standard di gestione del progetto e le migliori pratiche.

• Monitorare i parametri del progetto KPI e del portafoglio.

• Assicurare il rispetto delle procedure e dei requisiti aziendali.

• P

Über die Rolle

Stellenbeschreibung
Verantwortlich für die erfolgreiche Durchführung, Governance, kommerzielle Leistung und Lieferung mehrerer Projekte innerhalb der Organisation.
Die Rolle bietet Projektkoordinatoren, Ingenieuren und Projektmanagern die Führung und stellt sicher, dass Projekte sicher, termingerecht, im Rahmen des Budgets und in Übereinstimmung mit vertraglichen Verpflichtungen und Kundenerwartungen geliefert werden.

Teammanagement

• Stellen Sie sicher, dass Projekte innerhalb der genehmigten Zeitplan-, Budget-, Qualitäts- und HSE-Anforderungen geliefert werden.

• Überwachen Sie Projekt-KPIs, Fortschritt, Risiken und Ressourcenauslastung.

• Führen Sie wöchentliche Projektüberprüfungen und monatliche Portfolioüberprüfungen durch.

• Stellen Sie sicher, dass Projektpläne, Zeitpläne, Wiederherstellungspläne und Ausführungsstrategien aktuell und erreichbar bleiben.

• Proaktive Identifizierung und Minderung von Projektrisiken.

Commercial & Contract Management

• Führen Sie das Management von vertraglichen Verpflichtungen und kommerziellen Risikopositionen.

• Überprüfung und Bewältigung von Liquidated Damages (LDs) Risiken und Entwicklung von Minderungsstrategien.

• Stellen Sie sicher, dass Managemententscheidungen effektiv umgesetzt und verfolgt werden.

Projekt Close-Out & Lessons Learned

• Führen Sie formelle Projekt-Close-Out-Aktivitäten.

• Stellen Sie sicher, dass Sie die Stempellisten, die endgültige Dokumentation und die Übergabeanforderungen ausfüllen.

• Überwachung der endgültigen Abrechnungen und der kommerziellen Schließung.

• Erfassung und Institutionalisierung von Lessons Learned und Best Practices.

Stakeholder-Management

descriptionByLocale.fr:
Sulzer est une société d'ingénierie de premier plan avec un fier héritage d'innovation. Rejoignez notre équipe mondiale pour développer votre expertise et développer des solutions innovantes qui permettent une société prospère et plus durable.

Sur le rôle

Résumé de l'emploi
Responsable de l'exécution réussie, de la gouvernance, du rendement commercial et de la réalisation de plusieurs projets au sein de l'organisation.
Ce rôle assure le leadership des coordonnateurs de projets, des ingénieurs et des gestionnaires de projets, s'assurant que les projets sont exécutés en toute sécurité, dans les délais prévus, dans les limites du budget et conformément aux obligations contractuelles et aux attentes des clients.
Le titulaire joue le rôle de principal point d'escalade pour les questions liées aux projets, stimule l'état de préparation des projets aux examens du Comité directeur, gère les risques commerciaux, y compris les dommages liquidés, les réclamations et les ordres de modification, et veille à ce que les projets soient terminés efficacement et à ce que les enseignements tirés soient mis en œuvre.

Principales responsabilités

Gestion d'équipe

• Diriger, coacher et superviser une équipe d'ingénieurs de projet et de gestionnaires de projet.

• Établir des stratégies d'exécution des projets, des priorités et des objectifs de rendement.

• Attribuer les ressources et équilibrer la charge de travail dans l'ensemble du portefeuille de projets.

• Procéder à des examens du rendement, à la planification du perfectionnement et à la planification de la relève du personnel du projet.

• Servir de premier niveau d'escalade pour les questions liées aux projets.

• Favoriser une culture de responsabilisation, de collaboration, de sécurité et d'amélioration continue.

Gestion de l'exécution des projets

• Superviser l'exécution de plusieurs projets EPC, Énergie, Infrastructure ou Industriel.

• Veiller à ce que les projets soient exécutés dans les limites du calendrier, du budget, de la qualité et des exigences en matière de SST.

• Surveiller les ICR, les progrès, les risques et l'utilisation des ressources.

• Effectuer des examens hebdomadaires des projets et des examens mensuels du portefeuille.

• Veiller à ce que les plans, les calendriers, les plans de rétablissement et les stratégies d'exécution demeurent à jour et réalisables.

• Favoriser l'identification proactive et l'atténuation des risques du projet.

Gestion commerciale et contractuelle

• Diriger la gestion des obligations contractuelles et des expositions commerciales.

• Examiner et traiter les risques liés aux dommages liquidés et élaborer des stratégies d'atténuation.

• Gérer les ordres de modification de contrat, les demandes de modification, les demandes de prorogation de délai et les négociations commerciales.

• Appuyer les activités d'évitement et de règlement des différends.

• Assurer la conformité contractuelle avec les clients, les partenaires et les fournisseurs.

• Participer aux négociations commerciales avec les clients et les sous-traitants au besoin.

• Coordonner avec les services juridiques et financiers les questions contractuelles.

Gouvernance du projet et préparation du comité directeur

• Établir des processus de gouvernance pour tous les projets.

• Veiller à ce que le projet soit prêt pour les examens du Comité directeur et de la haute direction.

• Valider les tableaux de bord, les prévisions, les registres des risques, les mises à jour commerciales et les plans d'atténuation avant la présentation.

• Présenter le rendement du projet, les risques, les possibilités et les mesures correctives à la haute direction.

• Veiller à ce que les décisions de gestion soient mises en oeuvre et suivies efficacement.

Clôture du projet et leçons retenues

• Diriger les activités officielles de clôture du projet.

• Veiller à ce que les listes de perforations, la documentation finale et les exigences de transfert soient remplies.

• Surveiller les règlements définitifs des comptes et la clôture commerciale.

• Saisir et institutionnaliser les enseignements tirés et les pratiques exemplaires.

Gestion des parties prenantes

• Agir comme interface principale entre les clients et les intervenants internes.

• Maintenir des relations solides avec les clients, les consultants, les fournisseurs et les sous-traitants.

• Coordonner les activités entre le génie, l'approvisionnement, la production, la planification, l'AQ/CQ, le HSE et les finances.

• Veiller à ce que les préoccupations des clients soient traitées rapidement et professionnellement.

• Conduire la satisfaction des clients et de répéter les opportunités d'affaires.

Excellence opérationnelle

• Favoriser la mise en œuvre des normes de gestion de projet et des meilleures pratiques.

• Surveiller les ICR du projet et les paramètres du portefeuille.

• Assurer le respect des procédures et des exigences de l'entreprise.

About the role

Job Summary

Sets up and operates machine tools, including HBM, VBM, lathes, milling machines, ID/OD grinders, planers, and bore, without assistance, following department policy and procedures manual, to manufacture and recondition component parts to customer, OEM and industry standards. Interprets mechanical drawings, blueprints, and sketches and performs precision metal cutting, grinding, shaping and fitting. Measures components, parts, and raw materials with precision measuring instruments, gauges, and tools. Works under limited supervision. Pasadena, Texas

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:

• Performs layouts, sets up, and operates conventional machine tools as required

• Reads and interprets all drawings, including geometric dimensioning and tolerancing

• Designs setups and methods where none exist

• Instructs other shop personnel in proper machining techniques

• Continually improving methods to deliver higher quality with improved costs

TO SUCCEED IN THIS ROLE, YOU WILL NEED:

• Completion of a machinist apprentice program or equivalent training

• Ability to hold close tolerances and conduct component inspections

• Ability to setup machine tools: ID / OD Grinders, Turret Lathe, Engine Lathe, Horizontal Boring Mill, Vertical Boring Mill, Radial Drill, Planer Mill

• Four years of experience in machine shop operations

• Willingness to work in a team environment

• Openness to working overtime as required

• Demonstrated ability to effectively set up all, or at least most, of the following machines: I.D./O.D. Grinder, Turret Lathe, Engine Lathe, Knee Mill, Radial Drill, Horizontal Boring Mill, Vertical Boring Mill, and Planer Mill

• Ability to perform with a minimum of direct supervision

• Working knowledge of tool geometry and application

• Working knowledge of effects of feeds and speeds

• 4 years experience in machine shops on the above equipment

• Ability to work overtime as required

• While performing duties of this job, would occasionally be required to stand, walk, sit, reach with hands and arms, climb or balance, stoop or kneel, talk and hear, and use fingers and hands to feel objects.

jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Project Engineer is responsible for supporting technical project planning, execution, and monitoring. The role involves working independently with general supervision and contributing to project success through technical and analytical support.
This job profile is intended for experienced professionals who apply practical knowledge of a job area and work independently with general supervision. About Us

At Sulzer, you are empowered to deliver superior results. As a pioneer in industry, we have a proud heritage of innovation and continue to evolve for the future. Join our story and create your own impact by developing your expertise and building solutions that help make our lives safer, smarter and more sustainable.
Sulzer is a global leader in fluid engineering. We specialize in pumping, agitation, mixing, separation and purification technologies for fluids of all types. Our customers benefit from our commitment to innovation, performance and quality and from our responsive network of 180 world-class manufacturing facilities and service centres across the globe. Sulzer has been headquartered in Winterthur, Switzerland, since 1834.
Join our APAC team within the Flow division in Australia as a Project Engineer.

What will you be doing?

As a Project Engineer, your responsibilities day to day will include:

• Manage and coordinate customer projects from order intake through to delivery, ensuring scope, quality, budget, and schedule requirements are achieved.

• Provide technical engineering support, including equipment configuration (SAP), data sheets design review against customer specification, and preparation of project documentation and reporting

• Act as the primary interface between customers, sales, engineering, manufacturing, and suppliers to ensure successful project execution.

• supporting the sales team to achieve divisional growth and financial objectives.

• Promote and maintain Sulzer's commitment to safety, quality, and continuous improvement across all project activities.

What you will bring to Sulzer

To be a successful Project Engineer, you will ideally have:

• A Bachelor of Mechanical Engineering or equivalent.

• Demonstrated experience with technical report writing / technical documentation

• Exposure and experience to SAP, D365 ERP, Project Control software such as ACONEX, etc

• Project execution responsibility (scheduling, cost control, documentation and invoicing timely reporting.)

• Strong communication skills.

• Ability to engage and work with others.

• Experience in taking responsibility for order delivery and maintaining stakeholder relationships

What we offer you

• Annual bonus scheme.

• Employee Assistance Program.

• On-site car parking.

• Work for a global organisation that values innovation, excellence and a commitment to the most important part of our business - our people and our customers.

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
Sulzer Turbo Services is seeking a skilled Machine Tool Technician to support maintenance, repair, and operation of precision machining equipment used in the repair and servicing of turbomachinery components. This role is responsible for ensuring machine tools operate safely, efficiently, and within required tolerances to support high-quality manufacturing and repair operations. Key Responsibilities

• Perform maintenance, troubleshooting, and repair of machine tools including manual lathes, surface grinders, milling machines, CNC equipment, and horizontal and vertical machining centers.

• Diagnose mechanical, electrical, hydraulic, and pneumatic issues.

• Perform machine alignments, calibrations, and precision adjustments.

• Install, test, and commission new or rebuilt equipment.

• Maintain preventive maintenance schedules for shop equipment.

• Read and interpret mechanical drawings, blueprints, and technical manuals.

• Support production teams to minimize downtime.

• Ensure compliance with safety policies and OSHA standards.

• Maintain accurate maintenance records and documentation.

• Assist with equipment upgrades and continuous improvement initiatives.

• Observe Company Safety Policy and Procedures; follow and support all STS Safety Policies and ISO Procedures.

• Complete and properly document all tasks assigned by the Maintenance Supervisor.

• Report any mechanical issues identified during inspections to the Maintenance Supervisor.

• Work closely and maintain clear communication with other departments, mechanical personnel, Leadman, and Supervisors.

• Complete all company-required training programs.
Required Qualifications

• High School Diploma or GED required.

• Technical or vocational training in machining, industrial maintenance, or related field preferred.

• 7–10 years’ experience maintaining machine tools or industrial equipment.

• Strong knowledge of machining operations and precision measurement tools.

• Experience with CNC troubleshooting preferred.

• Ability to read schematics and technical drawings.

• Strong mechanical aptitude and problem-solving skills.

• Ability to work independently and within a team environment.
Preferred Skills

• Experience in turbomachinery, rotating equipment, or heavy industrial repair.

• Familiarity with vibration analysis or alignment practices.

• PLC troubleshooting experience is a plus.

• Forklift or overhead crane experience preferred.
Physical Requirements

• Ability to lift up to 50 lbs.

• Standing, bending, and working in an industrial shop environment.

• Ability to work around rotating machinery and heavy equipment.
Work Environment

• Industrial repair and machine shop setting.

• Exposure to noise, moving equipment, oils, and machining materials.

• PPE required at all times.

What we offer you

• 12 Paid Holidays

• 15 Paid Time Off (PTO) Days

• Medical, dental, vision, life & disability

• 401K with 6% company match

• Employee Assistance Program

• Employee Wellness Program

• New onsite cafeteria, all meals subsidized (La Porte Service Center)

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Operations Controlling Specialist
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
Serve as the strategic finance business partner to Operations by driving financial performance through product costing, inventory governance, cost management, forecasting, reporting, and operational decision support. The role supports Operations leadership with actionable financial insights, governance, and continuous improvement initiatives while ensuring financial discipline and business performance optimization. Key Responsibilities

• Act as the finance business partner to Operations leadership.

• Provide monthly reporting, variance analysis, and business performance commentary.

• Support budgeting, forecasting, and operational planning processes.

• Monitor operational KPIs and translate operational results into financial impact.

• Drive continuous improvement initiatives and financial governance processes.

• Analyze manufacturing costs and operating expenses and identify improvement opportunities.

• Monitor cost center performance and support productivity initiatives.

• Maintain product costing structures and support standard cost updates.

• Analyze material, labor, and overhead variances and recommend corrective actions.

• Support pricing, profitability, and margin analysis.

• Oversee inventory valuation, accuracy, and inventory-related KPIs.

• Support cycle count, physical inventory, reserve analysis, and working capital initiatives.

• Develop and enhance reporting tools, dashboards, and financial controls.

• Monitor CAPEX spending against approved budgets and provide variance analysis and reporting

• Ensure sustainability and financial accuracy of reported savings initiatives.

• Analyze open order intake, backlog, and shipment performance to support forecast accuracy and period-end reporting.

• Monitor inventory, receivables, and operational working capital performance. Partner with functional leaders to identify opportunities for cash flow improvement
Qualifications & Skills

• Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Business, or related field.

• 3 to 5 years of experience in manufacturing controlling and/or cost accounting

• Experience with ERP systems (SAP preferred if applicable)

• Advanced Excel

• Drive accountability for financial performance.

• Ability to identify root causes and drive corrective actions.

• Data-driven decision making.

• Strong analytical, communication, and business partnering skills.

What we offer you

• Competitive Paid Time Off (3 weeks to start)

• 12 Company Paid Holidays per year

• Annual Bonus Program

• Full Medical, Dental, and Vision benefits

• Company Paid Short Term and Long Term Disability, Company Paid Life Insurance

• 6% 401K or Roth Company Match with Immediate Vesting

• Company Paid Retirement Security Contributions following 1 year of employment

• Tuition Reimbursement/Educational Assistance

• Quarterly Gym Reimbursement

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sulzer è una società di ingegneria leader con un patrimonio orgoglioso di innovazione. Unisciti al nostro team globale per accrescere le tue competenze e sviluppare soluzioni innovative che consentano una società prospera e più sostenibile.

Informazioni sul ruolo

Sintesi del lavoro
Servire come partner finanziario strategico per le operazioni, guidando le prestazioni finanziarie attraverso il costo del prodotto, la governance dell'inventario, la gestione dei costi, la previsione, la segnalazione e il supporto decisionale operativo. Il ruolo supporta le operazioni di leadership con intuizioni finanziarie attuabili, governance e iniziative di miglioramento continuo, garantendo nel contempo la disciplina finanziaria e l'ottimizzazione delle prestazioni aziendali. Principali responsabilità

• Agire come partner finanziario per la leadership Operazioni.

• Fornire report mensili, analisi di varianza e commenti sulle prestazioni aziendali.

• Sostegno di bilancio, previsione e processi di pianificazione operativa.

• Monitorare i KPI operativi e tradurre i risultati operativi in impatto finanziario.

• Promuovere iniziative di miglioramento continuo e processi di governance finanziaria.

• Analizzare i costi di produzione e le spese operative e identificare le opportunità di miglioramento.

• Monitorare le prestazioni del centro costi e sostenere le iniziative di produttività.

• Mantenere le strutture di costo del prodotto e sostenere gli aggiornamenti standard dei costi.

• Analizzare il materiale, il lavoro e le variazioni in testa e raccomandare azioni correttive.

• Supporta i prezzi, la redditività e l'analisi dei margini.

• Controllare la valutazione dell'inventario, l'accuratezza e i KPI correlati all'inventario.

• Conta del ciclo di supporto, inventario fisico, analisi di riserva e iniziative di capitale di lavoro.

• Sviluppare e migliorare strumenti di reportistica, dashboard e controlli finanziari.

• Monitorare la spesa CAPEX contro i bilanci approvati e fornire analisi e report delle variazioni

• Assicurare la sostenibilità e la precisione finanziaria delle iniziative di risparmio segnalate.

• Analizzare le prestazioni di assunzione di ordini aperti, backlog e spedizione per supportare l'accuratezza delle previsioni e la segnalazione di fine periodo.

• Monitorare l'inventario, i crediti e le prestazioni dei capitali operativi. Partner con i leader funzionali per identificare le opportunità di miglioramento del flusso di cassa
Qualifiche e competenze

• Laurea in finanza, contabilità, affari o campo relativo.

• da 3 a 5 anni di esperienza nel controllo e/o nella contabilità dei costi

• Esperienza con sistemi ERP (preferito da SAP se applicabile)

• Excel avanzato

• Responsabilità dell'azionamento per le prestazioni finanziarie.

• Capacità di identificare le cause della radice e guidare azioni correttive.

• Decisioni basate sui dati.

• Forte capacità analitiche, di comunicazione e di partner commerciali.

Cosa ti offriamo

• Competitive Paid Time Off (3 settimane per iniziare)

• 12 Azienda Pagamenti all'anno

• Programma bonus annuale

• Vantaggi medici, dentali e di visione completi

• Società pagata a breve termine e disabilità a lungo termine, Azienda pagato vita assicurazione

• 6% 401K o Roth Company Match con gilet immediato

• Contributi di sicurezza a carico della società a seguito di 1 anno di occupazione

• Rimborso/Assistenza educativa

• Rimborso trimestrale

Sulzer è un datore di lavoro pari opportunità. Crediamo nella forza di una forza lavoro diversificata e ci impegniamo ad offrire un ambiente di lavoro inclusivo.

Siamo orgogliosi di essere riconosciuti come Top Employer 2026 in Brasile, Canada, Cina, Finlandia, Germania, Irlanda, Messico, Svizzera, Sud Africa, Regno Unito e Stati Uniti.

Dienen Sie als strategischer Finanz-Geschäftspartner für Operations, indem Sie die finanzielle Performance durch Produktkostenrechnung, Bestandsverwaltung, Kostenmanagement, Prognose, Berichterstattung und operative Entscheidungsunterstützung steigern. Sulzer est une entreprise d'ingénierie de premier plan avec un fier héritage d'innovation. Rejoignez notre équipe mondiale pour développer votre expertise et développer des solutions innovantes qui permettent une société prospère et plus durable.

Sur le rôle

Résumé de l'emploi
Servir de partenaire stratégique des opérations en matière de finances en stimulant le rendement financier par l'établissement des coûts des produits, la gouvernance des stocks, la gestion des coûts, les prévisions, les rapports et l'appui à la décision opérationnelle. Ce rôle soutient le leadership des opérations en leur fournissant des renseignements financiers concrets, des initiatives de gouvernance et d'amélioration continue tout en assurant la discipline financière et l'optimisation de la performance opérationnelle. Principales responsabilités

• Agir en tant que partenaire financier de la direction des opérations.

• Fournir des rapports mensuels, des analyses des écarts et des commentaires sur le rendement des entreprises.

• Appuyer les processus de budgétisation, de prévision et de planification opérationnelle.

• Surveiller les ICR opérationnels et traduire les résultats opérationnels en incidences financières.

• Mener des initiatives d'amélioration continue et des processus de gouvernance financière.

• Analyser les coûts de fabrication et les dépenses d'exploitation et déterminer les possibilités d'amélioration.

• Surveiller la performance des centres de coûts et appuyer les initiatives de productivité.

• Analyser les écarts matériels, de travail et de frais généraux et recommander des mesures correctives.

• Soutenir la tarification, la rentabilité et l'analyse de la marge.

• Surveiller l'évaluation des stocks, l'exactitude et les ICR liés aux stocks.

• Compte du cycle de soutien, inventaire physique, analyse des réserves et initiatives de fonds de roulement.

• Élaborer et améliorer les outils de rapport, les tableaux de bord et les contrôles financiers.

• Surveiller les dépenses du CAPEX par rapport aux budgets approuvés et fournir une analyse des écarts et des rapports

• Assurer la viabilité et l'exactitude financière des initiatives d'épargne déclarées.

• Analyser la réception des commandes ouvertes, l'arriéré et le rendement des expéditions pour appuyer l'exactitude des prévisions et les rapports de fin de période.

• Surveiller les stocks, les créances et le rendement du fonds de roulement opérationnel. Établir des partenariats avec des dirigeants fonctionnels pour déterminer les possibilités d'amélioration des flux de trésorerie

• Baccalauréat en finance, comptabilité, affaires ou domaine connexe.

• Expérience des systèmes de PGI (favorisation du PAS, le cas échéant)

• Excel avancé

• Favoriser la responsabilisation en matière de rendement financier.

• Capacité à identifier les causes profondes et à prendre des mesures correctives.

• Prise de décision fondée sur les données.

• Fortes compétences en analyse, communication et partenariat d'affaires.

Ce que nous vous offrons

• Temps de repos payé concurrentiel (3 semaines pour commencer)

• 12 Société Jours fériés payés par an

• Programme de bonus annuel

• Avantages médicaux, dentaires et visuels complets

Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

The Regional Head of Sales, AME is responsible for leading the commercial strategy and driving profitable growth across the Americas region for the Mass Transfer Components & Services (MTCS) business. This role owns regional sales performance, strategic account development, and channel partner effectiveness while building strong customer relationships and collaborating cross-functionally to deliver sustainable business growth. What You'll Do

• Develop and execute the regional sales strategy to achieve revenue, order intake, profitability, and market share objectives.

• Lead strategic customer engagement and cultivate executive-level relationships with key accounts to drive long-term growth.

• Manage and optimize the performance of agents, distributors, representatives, and other channel partners across the Americas.

• Drive sales forecasting, pipeline management, territory planning, pricing strategy, and commercial negotiations.

• Partner with Operations, Engineering, Product Management, Supply Chain, Service, and Finance to ensure successful project execution and customer satisfaction.

• Foster a high-performance commercial culture focused on collaboration, compliance, continuous improvement, and commercial excellence.

Qualifications & Criteria

• Bachelor's degree in Business, Engineering, or a related discipline; MBA preferred.

• 10+ years of progressive commercial leadership experience within industrial manufacturing, engineered equipment, or process industries.

• Proven success leading regional sales organizations with responsibility for revenue growth, profitability, and strategic account management.

• Demonstrated experience managing indirect sales channels, distributors, agents, and commercial partnerships.

• Strong business acumen with experience in forecasting, contract negotiations, pricing strategy, and CRM-driven sales management.

• Excellent leadership, communication, and cross-functional collaboration skills with the ability to influence executive stakeholders.

• Preference for bilingual in Spanish and English.

Travel Expectations
25%-30% travel to our Mexico City site - opportunity to office in our Energy Corridor or Humble locations.

What we offer you

• PTO and 12 company-paid holidays

• 401K plan with a 6% match

• Comprehensive health plan including medical, dental, vision, Life, short-term & long-term disability

• Health savings account matching

• Motivating wellness program

• Employee Assistance Program

• Paid paternal leave

• Gym reimbursement

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

Über die Rolle

Der Regional Head of Sales, AME, ist verantwortlich für die Leitung der Geschäftsstrategie und das profitable Wachstum in der Region Amerika für das Mass Transfer Components & Services (MTCS)-Geschäft. Diese Rolle besitzt regionale Vertriebsleistung, strategische Kontoentwicklung und Channel-Partner-Effektivität, während sie starke Kundenbeziehungen aufbaut und funktionsübergreifend zusammenarbeitet, um nachhaltiges Geschäftswachstum zu erzielen. • Entwicklung und Umsetzung der regionalen Verkaufsstrategie, um Umsatz, Auftragseingang, Rentabilität und Marktanteilsziele zu erreichen.

• Verwalten und optimieren Sie die Leistung von Agenten, Distributoren, Vertretern und anderen Channel-Partnern in ganz Amerika.

• Förderung von Umsatzprognosen, Pipeline-Management, Gebietsplanung, Preisstrategie und kommerziellen Verhandlungen.

• Zusammenarbeit mit Operations, Engineering, Produktmanagement, Supply Chain, Service und Finanzen, um eine erfolgreiche Projektabwicklung und Kundenzufriedenheit zu gewährleisten.

• Pflegen Sie eine leistungsstarke kommerzielle Kultur, die sich auf Zusammenarbeit, Compliance, kontinuierliche Verbesserung und kommerzielle Exzellenz konzentriert.

Qualifikationen und Kriterien

• Bachelor-Abschluss in Business, Engineering oder einer verwandten Disziplin; MBA bevorzugt.

• 10+ Jahre fortschrittliche kaufmännische Führungserfahrung in der industriellen Fertigung, in technischen Anlagen oder in der Prozessindustrie.

• Nachgewiesener Erfolg führende regionale Vertriebsorganisationen mit Verantwortung für Umsatzwachstum, Rentabilität und strategisches Account Management.

• Nachgewiesene Erfahrung im Management indirekter Vertriebskanäle, Distributoren, Agenten und kommerzieller Partnerschaften.

• Starker Geschäftssinn mit Erfahrung in Prognosen, Vertragsverhandlungen, Preisstrategie und CRM-gesteuertem Vertriebsmanagement.

• Hervorragende Führungs-, Kommunikations- und funktionsübergreifende Kollaborationsfähigkeiten mit der Fähigkeit, Führungskräfte zu beeinflussen.

• Präferenz für zweisprachig in Spanisch und Englisch.

Reiseerwartungen
25%-30% reisen zu unserem Standort in Mexiko-Stadt - Gelegenheit, in unserem Energiekorridor oder Humble-Standort zu arbeiten.

• PTO und 12 Firmen bezahlte Ferien

Le chef régional des ventes, AME, est responsable de la direction de la stratégie commerciale et de la croissance rentable dans l'ensemble de la région des Amériques pour les activités des composantes et services de transfert de masse (MTCS). • 10 ans et plus d'expérience en leadership commercial au sein de la fabrication industrielle, des équipements de génie ou des industries de procédés.

• Succès prouvé des organisations de vente régionales avec la responsabilité de la croissance des revenus, de la rentabilité et de la gestion stratégique des comptes.

• Expérience démontrée en gestion des canaux de vente indirects, des distributeurs, des agents et des partenariats commerciaux.

• Forte expérience en prévision, négociation de contrats, stratégie de tarification et gestion des ventes axée sur la CRM.

• Excellent leadership, communication et compétences en collaboration interfonctionnelle avec la capacité d'influencer les intervenants de la direction.

• Préférence pour bilingue en espagnol et en anglais.

Voyages attendus
Voyage de 25 à 30 % à notre site de Mexico - possibilité de bureau dans notre corridor énergétique ou Humble.

• PTO et 12 jours fériés payés par l'entreprise

jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Applications Engineer is responsible for evaluating customer requirements and developing technical and commercial proposals for clean water/municipal equipment solutions. This role serves as a critical link between customers, sales teams, and internal engineering/manufacturing to ensure accurate, timely, and competitive responses to inquiries. This position operates in a fast-paced, high-volume environment supporting distributors, OEMs, EPCs, and end users across a wide range of applications. Key Responsibilities:
Proposal & Technical Evaluation

• Ability to manage multiple priorities under tight deadlines

• Experience with pumps, fluid systems, or rotating equipment

• Exposure to reading specifications and technical drawings

Repair various kinds of electro-mechanical equipment. Pasadena, Texas

DUTIES

• Read job cards to determine; job status, work authorization/limitations, estimate, description of problems and/or expected serviceability.

• Lift, tighten, adjust and/or secure heavy objects in order to perform work duties.

• Assisted other mechanics or other shop personnel in skilled or –non-skilled duties as directed by supervisor or shop manager.

jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The 5-Axis CNC Programmer is responsible for programming, optimizing, and supporting complex multi-axis CNC machining operations to manufacture high-precision components.
The 5-Axis CNC Programmer is responsible for creating, optimizing, and maintaining CNC programs for complex multi-axis machining operations. This role supports the production of high-precision components by developing efficient machining strategies, improving cycle times, reducing tooling costs, and ensuring compliance with quality standards. The ideal candidate possesses a minimum of five (5) years of dedicated experience programming 5-axis milling machines and demonstrated expertise using Mastercam 2024 or later versions , which is a required qualification for this position. The successful candidate will have advanced knowledge of multi-axis machining, tooling, fixturing, GD&T, and manufacturing processes, with the ability to independently develop, prove out, and optimize complex CNC programs from engineering drawings and 3D CAD models. This position works closely with engineering, quality, and production teams to ensure safe, efficient, and cost-effective manufacturing operations while driving continuous improvement initiatives throughout the machining process.

What we offer you

• 12 Paid Holidays

jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

The Legal / Compliance Sr. Specialist is responsible for applying advanced legal and compliance knowledge to manage projects independently, ensuring the organization’s adherence to laws and internal policies. This role also supports junior professionals through coaching and review. This job profile is intended for specialist professionals that apply advanced knowledge of a job area. Required to manage projects / processes independently with limited supervision. Typically coaches and reviews the work of lower level experts. Main tasks and responsibilities:

• Patent and Trademark Pros ecution: Manage and assess IP disclosures. Assist Business Units in the decision as to whether to seek patent protection. Responsible for drafting and filing patent and trademark registration applications internally, while also managing and supervising related applications handled by outside counsel, incl. related costs. Responsibility for local priority applications

• IP Operational Management: Effectively manag e the entire IP lifecycle by leveraging internal systems and tools.

• Intellectual Property Right Searching: Manage and control the process for searching patent information databases for patentability, validity, IP landscape, freedom to operate and infringement assessment purposes

• Infringement Opinions: Procure and provide infringement, validity, freedom-to-operate (FTO) and trademark availability clearance opinions, either internally or with the use of outside counsel/IP search service provider

• Third Party IP Conflicts: Contribute to the process for resolving conflicts with third parties concerning own or third-party IP rights or misappropriated own IP, in particular via third party observations, oppositions, C&D letters and negotiated settlement agreements

• Contract Advice: Provide advice on IP aspects for confidentiality agreements and contribute to setting up licensing agreements and IP conflict settlement agreements

• Prepare and deliver IP education in the form of seminars or presentations for engineers, sales and marketing managers and senior business leaders and provide guidance and support for all IP-related questions of the business

Qualifications:

• University-level education in chemistry, chemical or process engineering and Patent bar qualification

• At least 5 years working experience in IP, preferably in the chemistry or chemical/process engineering domain

• Experienced in patent prosecution and FTO

• Previous exposure to trademark and/or trade secret is a plus

• Highly organized professional with the ability to effectively manage multiple tasks and priorities

• Exceptional attention to detail and accuracy in all aspects of work

• Demonstrated ability to negotiate and draft IP agreements

• Strong communication and interpersonal skills to build and maintain professional relationships

• A strategic mindset

• Fluency in English

• Flexibility to travel on demand

What we offer you

target bonus: 18.33% of annual income

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

• Eccezionale attenzione ai dettagli e accuratezza in tutti gli aspetti del lavoro

jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Production Worker / Technician is responsible for assembling, testing, and inspecting products to ensure they meet quality and safety standards. This role supports the manufacturing process by identifying defects, maintaining equipment, and following production protocols.
This job profile is intended for support staff that follows established procedures and works under close supervision. Smaller/easier decisions are made autonomously.
Utility
Business Unit: Sulzer Turbo Services, Houston, Inc.
Department: Core
Reports to: Department Manager

Shift
Working hours will be determined by work load and shift coverage needs. Start time will range from 3:30am to 7:00am and will end between 3:30pm and 5:00pm

Company Overview:

Sulzer Turbo Services (STS) is an independent provider of services and repairs of critical turbomachinery. We specialize in the repair, overhaul, and replacement of parts for high-speed rotating equipment such as steam and gas turbines, compressors, expanders, and other industrial rotating equipment found primarily in the Oil & Gas, Pipeline, Petrochemical, Ammonia, Nitric Acid, Fertilizer and Power Generation markets.

Position Summary

A professional in maintenance who is responsible for cleaning and performing basic maintenance on Sulzer’s buildings and properties.

Responsibilities

· Observe Company Safety Policy and Procedures; follow an support all STS Safety Policies and ISO Procedures
· Handle departments’ recycling and removing of all trash on a daily basis
· Assure all cables, shackles, straps and chains are put away daily
· Keep work area clean and well organized during all phases of the project
· Work closely and clearly communicate with the other departments, including all Supervisors, Managers, Leadmen and hourly personnel
· General cleanup of departments change room / restroom facilities
· Provide assistance to Core departments as required

Qualifications:

The ideal candidate will possess the following:

• Must be able to work overtime when necessary

• Must demonstrate strong attention to detail

• Willing and able to learn in a dynamic environment
· Have and maintain ability to use and operate the overhead cranes and forklifts

What we offer you

• 15 days of paid time off and 12 company-paid holidays

• 401k plan with a 6% match

• Comprehensive health plan including medical, dental, vision, Life, short-term & long-term disability

• Health savings account matching

• Motivating wellness program

• Employee Assistance Program

• Paid paternal leave

• Gym reimbursement

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sulzer è una società di ingegneria leader con un patrimonio orgoglioso di innovazione. Unisciti al nostro team globale per accrescere le tue competenze e sviluppare soluzioni innovative che consentano una società prospera e più sostenibile.

Informazioni sul ruolo

Sintesi del lavoro
Il Production Worker / Technician è responsabile per l'assemblaggio, la prova e l'ispezione dei prodotti per garantire che soddisfino gli standard di qualità e sicurezza. Questo ruolo supporta il processo di produzione identificando difetti, mantenendo le attrezzature e seguendo i protocolli di produzione.
Questo profilo di lavoro è destinato al personale di supporto che segue procedure e lavori consolidati sotto stretta supervisione. Le decisioni più piccole e più semplici sono prese in autonomia.
Utilità
Business Unit: Sulzer Turbo Services, Houston, Inc.
Dipartimento: Core
Rapporti a: Direttore del Dipartimento

Shift
Le ore di lavoro saranno determinate dal carico di lavoro e dalle esigenze di copertura dei turni. L'orario di inizio varia dalle 3:30 alle 19:00 e si concluderà tra le 15:30 e le 17:00

Panoramica aziendale:

Sulzer Turbo Services (STS) è un fornitore indipendente di servizi e riparazioni di turbomacchine critiche. Siamo specializzati nella riparazione, la revisione e la sostituzione di parti per attrezzature rotanti ad alta velocità come turbine a vapore e gas, compressori, espansori e altre apparecchiature rotanti industriali trovati principalmente nei mercati Oil & Gas, Pipeline, Petrochimica, Ammoniaca, Acido Nitrico, Fertilizer e Power Generation.

Posizione Sommario

Un professionista nella manutenzione che è responsabile per la pulizia e l'esecuzione di manutenzione di base sugli edifici e le proprietà di Sulzer.

responsabilità

· Osservare la politica e le procedure di sicurezza della società; seguire un supporto tutte le politiche di sicurezza STS e procedure ISO
· Riciclaggio e rimozione di tutti i rifiuti su base giornaliera
· Assicurare tutti i cavi, le catene, le cinghie e le catene sono messi via ogni giorno
· Mantenere l'area di lavoro pulita e ben organizzata durante tutte le fasi del progetto
· Lavorare a stretto contatto con gli altri dipartimenti, inclusi tutti i Supervisori, i Direttori, i Leadmen e il personale orario
· Pulizia generale dei dipartimenti cambia camera / servizi di toilette
· Fornire assistenza ai dipartimenti Core come richiesto

Qualifiche:

Il candidato ideale avrà il seguente:

• Deve essere in grado di lavorare straordinario quando necessario

• Deve dimostrare una forte attenzione ai dettagli

• Volontà e capacità di imparare in un ambiente dinamico
· Avere e mantenere la capacità di utilizzare e gestire le gru e i carrelli elevatori

Cosa ti offriamo

• 15 giorni di tempo libero e 12 giorni festivi

• 401k piano con una partita del 6%

• Piano sanitario completo tra cui medico, dentale, visione, vita, disabilità a breve e a lungo termine

• Conto di risparmio sanitario corrispondente

• Programma benessere stimolante

• Programma di assistenza dei dipendenti
