descriptionByLocale.de:
Sulzer ist ein führendes Ingenieurunternehmen mit einem stolzen Erbe an Innovationen. Schließen Sie sich unserem globalen Team an, um Ihr Fachwissen zu erweitern und innovative Lösungen zu entwickeln, die eine prosperierende und nachhaltigere Gesellschaft ermöglichen.

Über die Rolle

Stellenbeschreibung
Der Produktionsarbeiter / Techniker ist für die Montage, Prüfung und Inspektion von Produkten verantwortlich, um sicherzustellen, dass sie den Qualitäts- und Sicherheitsstandards entsprechen. Diese Rolle unterstützt den Herstellungsprozess durch die Erkennung von Defekten, die Wartung von Geräten und die Einhaltung von Produktionsprotokollen.
Dieses Stellenprofil richtet sich an Support-Mitarbeiter, die etablierte Verfahren befolgen und unter strenger Aufsicht arbeiten. Kleinere/einfachere Entscheidungen werden autonom getroffen.
Versorgungsunternehmen
Geschäftsbereich: Sulzer Turbo Services, Houston, Inc.
Abteilung: Kern
Berichte an: Abteilungsleiter

Umschaltung
Die Arbeitszeit wird durch die Arbeitsbelastung und den Schichtdeckungsbedarf bestimmt. Die Startzeit reicht von 3:30 Uhr bis 7:00 Uhr und endet zwischen 3:30 Uhr und 5:00 Uhr

Firmenübersicht:

Sulzer Turbo Services (STS) ist ein unabhängiger Anbieter von Dienstleistungen und Reparaturen von kritischen Turbomaschinen. Wir sind spezialisiert auf die Reparatur, Überholung und den Austausch von Teilen für Hochgeschwindigkeits-Rotationsgeräte wie Dampf- und Gasturbinen, Kompressoren, Expander und andere industrielle Rotationsgeräte, die hauptsächlich in den Märkten Oil & Gas, Pipeline, Petrochemie, Ammoniak, Salpetersäure, Dünger und Stromerzeugung zu finden sind.

Positionsübersicht

Ein Wartungsfachmann, der für die Reinigung und Durchführung grundlegender Wartungsarbeiten an den Gebäuden und Grundstücken von Sulzer verantwortlich ist.

Zuständigkeiten

· Befolgen Sie die Sicherheitsrichtlinien und -verfahren des Unternehmens; Folgen Sie der Unterstützung aller STS-Sicherheitsrichtlinien und ISO-Verfahren
· Die Abteilungen recyceln und entfernen jeden Mülls täglich
· Stellen Sie sicher, dass alle Kabel, Fesseln, Riemen und Ketten täglich weggelegt werden
· Halten Sie den Arbeitsbereich in allen Phasen des Projekts sauber und gut organisiert
· Enge und klare Kommunikation mit den anderen Abteilungen, einschließlich aller Supervisoren, Manager, Leadmen und stündlichen Mitarbeiter
· Allgemeine Reinigung von Abteilungen ändern Zimmer / Toiletten
· Unterstützung der Kernabteilungen nach Bedarf

Qualifikationen:

Der ideale Kandidat wird folgendes besitzen:

• Muss Überstunden machen können, wenn nötig

• Muss starke Aufmerksamkeit für Details zeigen

• Bereit und fähig, in einem dynamischen Umfeld zu lernen
· Haben und pflegen Fähigkeit, die Overhead-Krane und Gabelstapler zu verwenden und zu betreiben

Was wir Ihnen bieten

• 15 Tage bezahlte Freizeit und 12 bezahlte Firmenferien

• 401k Plan mit einem 6% Match

• Umfassender Gesundheitsplan einschließlich medizinischer, zahnärztlicher, Sehkraft, Leben, kurzfristige und langfristige Behinderung

• Matching des Sparkontos

• Motivierendes Wellnessprogramm

• Mitarbeiterunterstützungsprogramm

• Bezahlter Vaterschaftsurlaub

• Gymnastikerstattung

Sulzer ist ein Arbeitgeber für Chancengleichheit. Wir glauben an die Stärke einer vielfältigen Belegschaft und engagieren uns für ein integratives Arbeitsumfeld.

Wir sind stolz darauf, als Top Employer 2026 in Brasilien, Kanada, China, Finnland, Deutschland, Irland, Mexiko, der Schweiz, Südafrika, Großbritannien und den USA anerkannt zu werden.
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Sulzer est une entreprise d'ingénierie de premier plan avec un fier héritage d'innovation. Rejoignez notre équipe mondiale pour développer votre expertise et développer des solutions innovantes qui permettent une société prospère et plus durable.

Sur le rôle

Résumé de l'emploi
Le travailleur de production/technicien est responsable de l'assemblage, de l'essai et de l'inspection des produits pour s'assurer qu'ils répondent aux normes de qualité et de sécurité. Ce rôle appuie le processus de fabrication en identifiant les défauts, en maintenant l'équipement et en suivant les protocoles de production.
Ce profil d'emploi est destiné au personnel de soutien qui suit les procédures établies et travaille sous étroite supervision. Les décisions sont prises de manière autonome.
Utilitaire
Unité d'affaires: Sulzer Turbo Services, Houston, Inc.
Département de base
Rapports à : Gestionnaire de département

Déplacement
Les heures de travail seront déterminées en fonction de la charge de travail et des besoins de couverture des postes. L'heure de départ va de 3:30 à 7:00 et se terminera entre 15:30 et 17:00

Aperçu de l'entreprise :

Sulzer Turbo Services (STS) est un fournisseur indépendant de services et de réparations de turbomachines critiques. Nous nous spécialisons dans la réparation, la révision et le remplacement de pièces pour les équipements rotatifs à grande vitesse tels que turbines à vapeur et à gaz, compresseurs, expansionurs et autres équipements rotatifs industriels trouvés principalement dans les marchés du pétrole et du gaz, du pipeline, de la pétrochimie, de l'ammoniac, de l'acide nitrique, de l'engrais et de la production d'électricité.

Résumé du poste

Un professionnel de l'entretien qui est responsable du nettoyage et de l'entretien de base des bâtiments et des propriétés de Sulzer.

Responsabilités

· Observer les politiques et procédures de sécurité de l'entreprise; suivre un support toutes les politiques et procédures de sécurité des STS
· Recyclage et enlèvement quotidien de toutes les ordures
· Assure tous les câbles, chaînes, sangles et chaînes sont rangés quotidiennement
· Maintenir la zone de travail propre et bien organisée pendant toutes les phases du projet
· Collaborer étroitement et clairement avec les autres ministères, y compris tous les superviseurs, gestionnaires, chefs de file et personnel horaire
· Nettoyage général des salles de change / toilettes
· Fournir de l'aide aux ministères centraux au besoin

Qualifications

Le candidat idéal possédera les éléments suivants :

• Doit pouvoir faire des heures supplémentaires si nécessaire

• Doit faire preuve d'une grande attention aux détails

• Volonté et capacité à apprendre dans un environnement dynamique
· Avoir et maintenir la capacité d'utiliser et d'utiliser les grues et chariots élévateurs

Ce que nous vous offrons

• 15 jours de congé payé et 12 jours fériés payés par l'entreprise

• Plan 401k avec un match de 6%

• Plan de santé global incluant les soins médicaux, dentaires, la vision, la vie, l'invalidité de courte et de longue durée

• Correspondance du compte d'épargne santé

• Programme de bien-être

• Programme d'aide aux employés

• Congé parental payé

• Remboursement des frais de gymnastique

Sulzer est un employeur à chances égales. Nous croyons en la force d'un effectif diversifié et sommes déterminés à offrir un milieu de travail inclusif.

Nous sommes fiers d'être reconnus comme l'un des meilleurs employeurs 2026 au Brésil, au Canada, en Chine, en Finlande, en Allemagne, en Irlande, au Mexique, en Suisse, en Afrique du Sud, au Royaume-Uni et aux États-Unis.

jobs.title: Machine Operator
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Machine Operator is responsible for operating and monitoring machinery used in the manufacturing process. This role ensures that machines run efficiently, products meet quality standards, and safety protocols are followed.
This job profile is intended for support staff that follows established procedures and works under close supervision. Smaller/easier decisions are made autonomously.
This job and its associated grade are specifically aligned with roles that have the following scope of responsibility: Small, Medium, Large, Division / Extra Large organization.

Key Responsibilities
Set up and operate machinery according to instructions.
Monitor machine performance and make minor adjustments.
Inspect products for quality and report defects.
Maintain a clean and safe work area.
Record production data and report issues.
Follow safety and operational procedures.
Skills & Qualifications
May require basic vocational training (or equivalent work experience) and up to 2 years of relevant experience to carry out the role.

Basic mechanical skills and attention to detail.
Ability to follow instructions and safety guidelines.
Good hand-eye coordination and physical stamina.
Willingness to learn and work in a team environment.
Familiarity with production tools and equipment is a plus.

What we offer you

• 15 days of paid time off and 12 company-paid holidays

• 401k plan with a 6% match

• Comprehensive health plan including medical, dental, vision, Life, short-term & long-term disability

• Health savings account matching

• Motivating wellness program

• Employee Assistance Program

• Paid paternal leave

• Gym reimbursement

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

Il Machine Operator è responsabile del funzionamento e del monitoraggio dei macchinari utilizzati nel processo di produzione. Questo ruolo assicura che le macchine funzionino in modo efficiente, i prodotti soddisfano gli standard di qualità e i protocolli di sicurezza sono seguiti.

Impostare e utilizzare macchinari secondo le istruzioni.
Monitorare le prestazioni della macchina e fare piccole regolazioni.
Ispezionare prodotti per difetti di qualità e report.
Mantenere una zona di lavoro pulita e sicura.
Registra i dati di produzione e report.
Seguire la sicurezza e le procedure operative.

Può richiedere la formazione professionale di base (o l'esperienza lavorativa equivalente) e fino a 2 anni di esperienza rilevante per svolgere il ruolo.

Capacità di seguire le istruzioni e le linee guida di sicurezza.

Résumé de l'emploi
L'opérateur de machines est responsable du fonctionnement et de la surveillance des machines utilisées dans le processus de fabrication. Ce rôle garantit que les machines fonctionnent efficacement, que les produits répondent aux normes de qualité et que les protocoles de sécurité sont respectés.
Ce profil d'emploi est destiné au personnel de soutien qui suit les procédures établies et travaille sous étroite supervision. Les décisions sont prises de manière autonome.

Principales responsabilités
Monter et utiliser les machines selon les instructions.
Surveiller les performances de la machine et effectuer des ajustements mineurs.
Vérifier la qualité des produits et signaler les défauts.
Maintenir une zone de travail propre et sécuritaire.
Consigner les données de production et les questions de rapport.
Suivre les procédures de sécurité et d'exploitation.
Compétences et qualifications
Peut exiger une formation professionnelle de base (ou une expérience de travail équivalente) et jusqu'à 2 ans d'expérience pertinente pour remplir ce rôle.

Compétences mécaniques de base et attention aux détails.
Capacité de suivre les instructions et les directives de sécurité.
Bonne coordination des yeux et endurance physique.
Volonté d'apprendre et de travailler en équipe.
La familiarité avec les outils de production et l'équipement est un plus.

Ce que nous vous offrons

jobs.description:

About the role

Job Summary
The Accounting Officer is responsible for supporting accounting operations including data entry, reconciliations, and assisting with financial reporting. This role ensures accuracy in financial records and supports compliance with accounting standards. This job profile is intended for early-career professionals who apply broad theoretical knowledge and require the ability to investigate and analyse problems. Solutions are typically discussed/verified with a more senior member. About the Role

Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and contribute to delivering high-quality financial services that support a prosperous and more sustainable society.

Join our Finance team in Madrid as an Invoicing & Collection Clerk . In this role, you will be responsible for managing invoicing and accounts receivable activities, ensuring timely collections, maintaining accurate financial records, and supporting efficient accounting operations across the organization. You will work closely with internal stakeholders, external providers, and Sulzer entities worldwide to ensure smooth and effective financial processes

Your Main Tasks and Responsibilities

• Manage the accounts receivable process, ensuring timely and accurate customer invoicing.

• Monitor incoming payments and proactively follow up on overdue accounts.

• Perform collection activities and support the resolution of outstanding receivables.

• Reconcile customer accounts and investigate discrepancies or billing issues.

• Assist in the preparation of financial reports related to receivables and collections.

• Maintain and update customer and financial master data.

• Support intercompany invoice matching activities during month-end closing.

• Collaborate with internal departments to identify opportunities for process improvements and increased efficiency.

• Coordinate with the external service provider responsible for OTC and RTR activities.

• Build strong relationships with key stakeholders, including Group FP&A, Treasury, Tax & RE functions, and Sulzer subsidiaries.

To Succeed in This Role, You Will Need

• Degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, or a related field.

• Ideally 3 years of experience in Accounts Receivable, invoicing, or collection management.

• Good understanding of accounting principles and financial processes.

• Experience working with SAP FI/CO as a user.

• Strong knowledge of Microsoft Excel, including formulas, functions, and pivot tables.

• Professional English communication skills (B2/C1 level). German would be a plus.

• Strong communication and interpersonal skills.

• Ability to work independently while maintaining a collaborative and team-oriented mindset.

• Customer-focused approach with strong organizational skills and attention to detail.

• Resilience, adaptability, and a proactive attitude toward change and continuous improvement.

What we offer you

• Permanent position within a globally recognised industrial technology leader.

• Competitive salary.

• Annual bonus scheme.

• Meal vouchers.

• Flexible benefits package including health insurance, transport and childcare options.

• Opportunity to work with cutting-edge Data & AI technologies.

• Be part of a highly experienced team.

• International exposure working with stakeholders across multiple business domains.

• Career growth opportunities within a global organisation.

• Modern offices located in Nuevos Ministerios, Madrid.

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, Chin

L'Accounting Officer è responsabile del supporto alle operazioni contabili, tra cui l'ingresso dei dati, la riconciliazione e l'assistenza alla rendicontazione finanziaria. Sulzer è una società di ingegneria leader con un patrimonio orgoglioso di innovazione. Unisciti al nostro team globale per crescere la tua esperienza e contribuire a fornire servizi finanziari di alta qualità che supportano una società prospera e più sostenibile.

• Collabora con i dipartimenti interni per identificare le opportunità di miglioramento del processo e aumentare l'efficienza.

• Coordinate con il fornitore di servizi esterno responsabile delle attività OTC e RTR.

• Costruire relazioni forti con le principali parti interessate, tra cui le funzioni Gruppo FP&A, Tesoro, Tax & RE e Sulzer controllate.

Per vincere in questo ruolo, si avrà bisogno

• Laurea in finanza, contabilità, amministrazione aziendale, o un campo correlato.

• Idealmente 3 anni di esperienza in Contabili, fatturazione o gestione della raccolta.

• Buona comprensione dei principi contabili e dei processi finanziari.

• Esperienza di lavoro con SAP FI/CO come utente.

• Forte conoscenza di Microsoft Excel, comprese le formule, le funzioni e le tabelle pivot.

• Capacità di comunicazione inglese professionale (livello B2/C1). Il tedesco sarebbe un vantaggio.

• Forte comunicazione e capacità interpersonali.

• Capacità di lavorare in modo indipendente mantenendo una mentalità collaborativa e orientata al team.

• L'approccio orientato al cliente con forti capacità organizzative e attenzione ai dettagli.

• Resilienza, adattabilità e atteggiamento proattivo verso il cambiamento e il miglioramento continuo.

Cosa ti offriamo

• Posizione permanente all'interno di un leader tecnologico industriale riconosciuto a livello mondiale.

• Uno stipendio competitivo.

• Programma di bonus annuale.

• Buoni pasti.

• Pacchetto di prestazioni flessibili tra cui assicurazione sanitaria, trasporto e opzioni di assistenza all'infanzia.

• Opportunità di lavorare con tecnologie Data & AI all'avanguardia.

• Fai parte di una squadra altamente esperta.

• Esposizione internazionale che lavora con le parti interessate attraverso più domini aziendali.

jobs.title: Quality Control Inspector (Goods In)
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Key
• Responsibilities

Perform inspection of incoming gas turbine components, materials, and assemblies to ensure compliance with engineering drawings, specifications, purchase orders, OEM requirements, and customer standards.
Conduct dimensional, visual, and documentation inspections using appropriate measuring equipment and inspection techniques.
Review and verify material certificates, certificates of conformity, inspection reports, and supplier documentation to ensure compliance and traceability requirements are met.
Inspect turbine rotors, casings, shafts, blades, vanes, bearings, fasteners, and associated components for conformity prior to release into production.
Identify, document, and support the resolution of non-conforming materials through established quality management processes.
Maintain accurate inspection records and support internal, customer, and third-party quality audits.
Support the implementation and continuous improvement of QA/QC procedures, standards, and inspection practices.
Monitor and provide feedback on supplier quality performance and incoming product quality trends.
Liaise with the Inspection Supervisor, Engineering, Procurement, Project Engineers, and Production teams to resolve quality-related issues and minimise disruption to repair and overhaul activities.
Ensure all inspection activities are performed in accordance with Sulzer quality procedures, customer requirements, and applicable industry standards.

Required Skills:

Experience in a Quality Control, QA/QC, or Inspection role within an engineering or manufacturing environment.
Ability to read and interpret engineering drawings, specifications, technical documentation, and manufacturing standards.
Experience using precision measuring equipment such as verniers, micrometres, bore gauges, height gauges.
Understanding of material certification, traceability, and quality documentation requirements.
Knowledge of dimensional inspection techniques and engineering tolerances.
Strong attention to detail and a methodical approach to inspection activities.
Good communication and documentation skills.
Familiarity with supplier quality management, non-conformance reporting, and root cause investigations.
Competent in Microsoft Office applications.

Desirable Skills

Experience inspecting gas turbine, steam turbine, compressor, pump, or other rotating equipment components.
Understanding of OEM quality requirements and repair documentation.
Knowledge of ISO 9001 quality management systems.
Experience using quality management systems.

What we offer you

Competitive base salary
Inclusion in a company-wide bonus program
Attractive overtime pay scheme
33 days of annual leave
Private medical insurance
On-site parking
Access to various discounts on everyday shopping, entertainment, and lifestyle
An Employee Assistance Programme offering confidential support services, including counselling and resources to help manage personal and work-related issues, enhancing overall well-being and productivity
Continuous learning and development opportunities through on-the-job training and Sulzer Learning Pathways, our dedicated online platform for professional growth

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

We’re looking for a high-impact Key Account Manager to take ownership of one of our most significant long-term utility partnerships – a major regional water provider serving millions of customers across the North West of England.

This is a commercially critical role where you will own the account strategy end-to-end—driving growth across capital projects (pump packages and related equipment) and aftermarket services, while shaping the future of a well-established, high-value relationship. Your main responsibilities:

• Own the P&L and growth strategy for a utility account, with clear accountability for revenue and margin performance

• Drive the narrative with the customer—positioning us as a trusted, strategic partner across both capital investment and lifecycle services

• Lead and coordinate a multi-disciplinary account team, ensuring alignment across sales, service, engineering and delivery

• Build and deepen senior stakeholder relationships, influencing decision-making at operational and strategic levels

• Develop and execute a long-term account development plan, aligned to the customer’s AMP cycles and investment priorities

• Provide accurate forecasting, pipeline management and reporting

• Act as the voice of the customer internally, ensuring continuous improvement and delivery excellence

What We’re Looking For

• Whilst this is a remote role, we have a preference for candidates based in the North West of England. Regular customer visits and face-to-face engagement are essential to building relationships, providing effective support, and maintaining a strong presence across the region.

• Proven experience in a Key Account Management or Strategic Account role within engineering, industrial or utilities environments

• Strong commercial acumen with experience owning revenue targets and driving growth

• Background in pumps, rotating equipment, or fluid handling systems is highly desirable. Alternatively, direct experience working closely with a UK -based water utility provider is a strong advantage

• Demonstrated ability to build and manage high-value, long-term customer relationships

• Experience leading or influencing cross-functional teams without direct line management

• Confident communicator, capable of engaging at both technical and executive levels

• Strategic mindset with the ability to translate customer needs into tangible commercial outcomes

What we offer you

• A fully remote home based role with travel across regions.

• A competitive basic salary

• Annual personal bonus scheme based on company and personal performance

• Private Medical Insurance

• 33 days annual leave.

• Defined pension contributions.

• Access to Medicash helping you cover everyday health costs like dental optical and physiotherapy plus a range of wellbeing perks.

• Confidential support via Employee Assistance Programmes.

• Access to discounts on shopping entertainment lifestyle plus opportunity to apply for Costco membership.

• Discounted personal car leasing for you your family and friends.

• Long Service Awards celebrating your commitment.

• Continuous learning opportunities through Sulzer Learning Pathways.

• As a Silver Award holder of the MoD Defence Employer Recognition Scheme, we welcome and support veterans, reservists and Cadet Adult Volunteers with policies for training, camps and deployment, plus a growing internal military network.

#LI-Remote

Le vostre principali responsabilità:

• Possedere la strategia P&L e crescita per un account di utilità, con chiara responsabilitÃ per le prestazioni dei ricavi e dei margini

• Guidare la narrazione con il cliente, ponendoci come partner affidabile e strategico in entrambi i servizi di investimento di capitale e ciclo di vita

• Guidare e coordinare un team di account multidisciplinare, garantendo l'allineamento tra vendite, servizi, ingegneria e consegna

• Costruire e approfondire le relazioni con gli stakeholder senior, influenzando il processo decisionale a livello operativo e strategico

• Sviluppare ed eseguire un piano di sviluppo di un account a lungo termine, allineato ai cicli AMP del cliente e alle priorità di investimento

• Fornire previsioni accurate, gestione delle tubazioni e reporting

• Agire come voce del cliente internamente, assicurando il miglioramento continuo e l'eccellenza di consegna

Cosa stiamo cercando

• Mentre questo è un ruolo remoto, abbiamo una preferenza per i candidati basati nel nord-ovest dell'Inghilterra. Le visite regolari dei clienti e il coinvolgimento faccia a faccia sono essenziali per costruire relazioni, fornire un supporto efficace e mantenere una forte presenza in tutta la regione.

About the role

We’re looking for a high-impact Key Account Manager to take ownership of one of our most significant long-term utility partnerships – a major regional water provider serving millions of customers across the North West of England.

This is a commercially critical role where you will own the account strategy end-to-end—driving growth across capital projects (pump packages and related equipment) and aftermarket services, while shaping the future of a well-established, high-value relationship. Your main responsibilities:

• Own the P&L and growth strategy for a utility account, with clear accountability for revenue and margin performance

• Drive the narrative with the customer—positioning us as a trusted, strategic partner across both capital investment and lifecycle services

• Lead and coordinate a multi-disciplinary account team, ensuring alignment across sales, service, engineering and delivery

• Build and deepen senior stakeholder relationships, influencing decision-making at operational and strategic levels

• Develop and execute a long-term account development plan, aligned to the customer’s AMP cycles and investment priorities

• Provide accurate forecasting, pipeline management and reporting

• Act as the voice of the customer internally, ensuring continuous improvement and delivery excellence

What We’re Looking For

• Whilst this is a remote role, we have a preference for candidates based in the North West of England. Regular customer visits and face-to-face engagement are essential to building relationships, providing effective support, and maintaining a strong presence across the region.

• Proven experience in a Key Account Management or Strategic Account role within engineering, industrial or utilities environments

• Strong commercial acumen with experience owning revenue targets and driving growth

• Background in pumps, rotating equipment, or fluid handling systems is highly desirable. Alternatively, direct experience working closely with a UK -based water utility provider is a strong advantage

• Demonstrated ability to build and manage high-value, long-term customer relationships

• Experience leading or influencing cross-functional teams without direct line management

• Confident communicator, capable of engaging at both technical and executive levels

• Strategic mindset with the ability to translate customer needs into tangible commercial outcomes

What we offer you

• A fully remote home based role with travel across regions.

• A competitive basic salary

• Annual personal bonus scheme based on company and personal performance

• Private Medical Insurance

• 33 days annual leave.

• Defined pension contributions.

• Access to Medicash helping you cover everyday health costs like dental optical and physiotherapy plus a range of wellbeing perks.

• Confidential support via Employee Assistance Programmes.

• Access to discounts on shopping entertainment lifestyle plus opportunity to apply for Costco membership.

• Discounted personal car leasing for you your family and friends.

• Long Service Awards celebrating your commitment.

• Continuous learning opportunities through Sulzer Learning Pathways.

About the role

Job Summary
The Product Quality Control Inspector is responsible for ensuring that product quality specifications are in compliance with corporate and customer standards. This includes supporting the implementation of QA/QC policies, conducting inspections, and assisting in vendor evaluations.
This job profile is intended for support staff that follows established procedures and works under close supervision. Smaller/easier decisions are made autonomously. Key Responsibilities
Inspect products to ensure compliance with quality specifications and standards.
Support the implementation of QA/QC policies and procedures.
Assist in evaluating vendor quality and performance.
Document inspection results and report deviations.
Collaborate with QA/QC teams and vendors to enforce quality standards.
Skills & Qualifications
May require basic vocational training (or equivalent work experience) and up to 2 years of relevant experience to carry out the role.

Required Skills:

Basic understanding of quality control procedures and tools.
Attention to detail and accuracy in inspection tasks.
Ability to follow established procedures and report findings.
Familiarity with product specifications and documentation.
Willingness to learn and support quality assurance initiatives.

jobs.title: Quality Inspector
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

We are seeking a detail-oriented and quality-focused individual to join our team as a Quality Inspector for electric motors and rotating equipment. The successful candidate will be responsible for inspecting products, materials, and processes to ensure adherence to established quality standards and customer specifications. Responsibilities:

• Conduct thorough inspections of incoming materials, work-in-progress, and finished products to verify conformance to quality standards and specifications.

• Utilize various inspection tools and equipment to assess product quality, such as calipers, micrometers, and gauges.

• Identify and document quality defects, discrepancies, and non-conformances.

• Initiate corrective actions for quality issues in collaboration with production and engineering teams.

• Maintain accurate and detailed inspection records and reports.

• Conduct root cause analysis for quality problems and implement preventive measures.

• Collaborate with other departments to improve quality processes and procedures.

• Stay updated on industry quality standards and regulations.

• Willingness to work overtime as needed.

Qualifications:

• At least 1 year experience in quality inspection related to machining.

• Strong attention to detail and problem-solving skills.

• Ability to read and interpret blueprints, engineering drawings, and specifications.

• Capable in using inspection tools and equipment.

• Knowledge of quality control principles and methodologies.

• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.

• Ability to work independently and as part of a team.

• High school diploma or equivalent.

• Electric motor / rotating equipment repair experience preferred.

PHYSICAL DEMANDS

• While performing duties of this job, would occasionally be required to stand, walk, sit, reach with hands and arms, climb or balance, stoop or kneel, talk and hear, and use fingers and hands to feel objects.

• Ability to lift and/or move up to 50 pounds

The above is intended to describe the general content of, and requirements for, the performance of this job. It is not to be construed as an exhaustive statement of duties, responsibilities, or requirements.

What we offer you

Health insurance (begin upon hire)
Health savings account
Flexible spending account
Vision insurance (begin upon hire)
Dental insurance (begin upon hire)
401(k) 6% match (begin upon hire)
Paid time off (begin upon hire)
Paid parental leave (after 12-months of service)
Gym membership reimbursement
Employee assistance program
Disability insurance
Paid holidays
Wellness program

• Volontà di lavorare straordinario come necessario.

• Forte attenzione ai dettagli e alle capacità di problem solving.

• Capacità di leggere e interpretare progetti, disegni di ingegneria e specifiche.

• Capace di utilizzare strumenti di ispezione e attrezzature.

• Conoscenza dei principi e metodologie di controllo della qualità.

• Ottima comunicazione e competenze interpersonali.

• Collaborer avec d'autres ministères pour améliorer la qualité des processus et des procédures.

• Restez au courant des normes et des règlements de qualité de l'industrie.

• Volonté de faire des heures supplémentaires au besoin.

• Au moins 1 an d'expérience en inspection de la qualité liée à l'usinage.

• Une grande attention au détail et à la résolution de problèmes.

• Capacité de lire et d'interpréter des plans, des dessins techniques et des spécifications.

• Capable d'utiliser des outils et du matériel d'inspection.

• Connaissance des principes et des méthodes de contrôle de la qualité.

At Sulzer, we keep the world’s water flowing. As a global engineering powerhouse, we design, maintain, and service mission‑critical pumping equipment that supports drinking water supply, wastewater networks, flood control, industrial utilities, and energy infrastructure across the planet.

Across Ireland, demand for world‑class Water & Wastewater solutions has never been stronger. • Build strong, long‑lasting relationships with utilities, contractors, consultants, and framework partners

• Identify opportunities for maintenance, repairs, upgrades, retrofits, replacement pumping solutions, and performance optimisation

• A proactive, self‑motivated mindset—and the ambition to help build a high‑growth territory

• Understanding of the municipal water sector is highly beneficial.

What we offer you

• A fully remote, home‑based role where you manage your own schedule and workload

• A competitive basic salary

• Annual personal bonus scheme based on company and personal performance

• Car or Car Allowance

• 26 Days holiday (exclusive of bank holidays)

• Defined contribution pension scheme

• Employee Assistance Program

• Company Sick pay scheme

descriptionByLocale.de:
Sulzer ist ein führendes Ingenieurunternehmen mit einem stolzen Erbe an Innovationen. Schließen Sie sich unserem globalen Team an, um Ihr Fachwissen zu erweitern und innovative Lösungen zu entwickeln, die eine wohlhabende und nachhaltigere Gesellschaft ermöglichen.

Über die Rolle

Bei Sulzer halten wir das Wasser der Welt fließen. Als globales Engineering-Kraftwerk entwerfen, warten und warten wir unternehmenskritische Pumpanlagen, die die Trinkwasserversorgung, Abwassernetze, Hochwasserschutz, Industriebetriebe und Energieinfrastruktur auf der ganzen Welt unterstützen.

In ganz Irland war die Nachfrage nach erstklassigen Wasser- und Abwasserlösungen nie stärker. Intern ist Irland als einer der am schnellsten wachsenden strategischen Märkte für Sulzer anerkannt – deshalb investieren wir. Diese brandneue Rolle ist der Schlüssel zu unseren Wachstumsplänen, und wir suchen einen kommerziell ausgerichteten Sales Engineer, der uns hilft, unseren Service & Aftermarket-Erfolg bundesweit zu stärken. In dieser Rolle sind Sie die technische und kommerzielle Brücke zwischen den Kunden und unserer marktführenden Engineering-Fähigkeit. Sie werden

• Entwicklung und Ausbau des Service & Aftermarket-Geschäfts in kommunalen Wasser- und Abwassermärkten und ausgewählten Industriesektoren

• Aufbau starker, dauerhafter Beziehungen zu Versorgungsunternehmen, Auftragnehmern, Beratern und Rahmenpartnern

• Identifizieren Sie Möglichkeiten für Wartung, Reparaturen, Upgrades, Nachrüstungen, Ersatzpumpenlösungen und Leistungsoptimierung

• Besuche vor Ort durchführen, Kundenherausforderungen beheben und die richtige Engineering-Lösung empfehlen

• Arbeiten Sie eng mit unserem lokalen Servicezentrum und dem breiteren Sulzer-Netzwerk zusammen, um ein hervorragendes Kundenerlebnis zu bieten

• Umsatz- und Margenwachstum durch proaktives Account Management und starke Pipeline-Entwicklung

Wenn Sie gerne technisches Know-how mit kommerzieller Wirkung kombinieren, bietet Ihnen diese Rolle das Beste aus beiden.

Was du mitbringst

• Technischer Hintergrund in mechanischen, elektrischen, Wasser-, Abwasser- oder verwandten Ingenieurdisziplinen

• Nachgewiesene Erfahrung in einer feldbasierten Vertriebs-, Service- oder kundenorientierten Ingenieurrolle

• Starke Kommunikationsfähigkeiten mit der Fähigkeit, Einfluss zu nehmen, herauszufordern und Vertrauen aufzubauen

• Eine proaktive, selbstmotivierte Denkweise - und der Ehrgeiz, zum Aufbau eines Wachstumsgebiets beizutragen

• Das Verständnis des kommunalen Wassersektors ist sehr vorteilhaft.

Was wir Ihnen bieten

• Eine vollständig entfernte, zu Hause ansässige Rolle, in der Sie Ihren eigenen Zeitplan und Ihre eigene Arbeitsbelastung verwalten

• Ein wettbewerbsfähiges Grundgehalt

• Jährliches persönliches Bonussystem basierend auf Unternehmens- und persönlicher Leistung

• Car oder Car Allowance

• 26 Tage Urlaub (ausschließlich Feiertage)

• Beitragsorientierte Altersversorgung

• Mitarbeiterunterstützungsprogramm

• Unternehmen Krankengeldsystem

• Company Income Continuance Scheme

Obwohl dies eine entfernte, häusliche Rolle ist, müssen die Kandidaten ihren ständigen Wohnsitz in der Republik Irland haben und in vollem Umfang in Irland arbeiten dürfen.
Wir können für diese Position kein Visa-Sponsoring anbieten.

Sulzer ist ein Arbeitgeber für Chancengleichheit. Wir glauben an die Stärke einer vielfältigen Belegschaft und engagieren uns für ein integratives Arbeitsumfeld.

Wir sind stolz darauf, als Top Employer 2026 in Brasilien, Kanada, China, Finnland, Deutschland, Irland, Mexiko, der Schweiz, Südafrika, Großbritannien und den USA anerkannt zu werden.

About the role

At Sulzer, we are a global leader in fluid engineering and rotating equipment services. Our Leeds Service Centre is one of the UK's key operational hubs, providing the repair, refurbishment, maintenance and performance enhancement of pumps, motors and other rotating equipment for customers across the power generation, water, oil & gas, chemical and industrial sectors. • Acting as the main customer contact for key accounts

• Monitoring project schedules, budgets, risks and resource requirements.

• Ensuring projects are delivered safely, profitably and in line with customer expectations.

• Identifying and managing commercial opportunities and project variations.

• Come principale contatto con il cliente per i conti chiave

• Coordinamento delle squadre interne in ingegneria, operazioni, appalti e servizi sul campo.

• Garantire i progetti sono forniti in modo sicuro, redditizio e in linea con le aspettative dei clienti.

• Fornire aggiornamenti regolari dei progressi ai clienti e agli stakeholder interni.

• Identificare e gestire opportunità commerciali e variazioni di progetto.

• Sostenere la pianificazione e l'esecuzione di outage per i siti dei clienti critici.

• Costruire relazioni forti che assicurano rapporti commerciali e partnership a lungo termine.

A proposito di te

• Esperienza di Project Management provata all'interno di servizi di ingegneria, produzione, manutenzione o industriale.

• Gestire i progetti di customer-facing con responsabilità commerciale.

• Forte capacità di gestione e comunicazione degli stakeholder.

• Ottima pianificazione e capacità organizzative.

• Un approccio proattivo alla risoluzione dei problemi e alla gestione dei rischi.

• La conoscenza di apparecchiature rotanti, pompe, motori o sistemi industriali correlati sarebbe vantaggiosa.

• È auspicabile una qualifica riconosciuta di Project Management (APM, PRINCE2 o equivalente).

Cosa ti offriamo

Recentemente abbiamo investito in modo significativo nella modernizzazione della nostra struttura Leeds, creando uno spazio di lavoro più luminoso, più efficiente e più avanzato progettato per supportare il lavoro di alta qualità e una grande esperienza dei dipendenti. Accanto alle nostre strutture aggiornate, potrete beneficiare di:

• Uno stipendio competitivo

• Bonus annuale legato alle prestazioni aziendali e individuali, pagato come unico pagamento annuale.

• Assicurazione medica privata – Copertura medica privata individuale fornita tramite Aviva

• Medicash Health Cash Plan (copertura delle spese sanitarie quotidiane come i servizi dentali, ottici e GP)

• 33 giorni di vacanza

• Contributo pensionistico

• Programmi di assistenza ai dipendenti

• Sconti su shopping, intrattenimento e stile di vita

• Opzione di abbonamento Costco

• Noleggio auto personali scontati per te, famiglia e amici

• Premi di servizio lungo

• Apprendimento in corso attraverso Sulzer Learning Pathways

• Supporto delle Forze Armate – Come titolare del Premio d'Argento del programma di riconoscimento dei datori di lavoro MoD Defence, sosteniamo attivamente veterani, reservisti e Volontari adulti Cadet. Questo include politiche che consentono il tempo di formazione, campi e distribuzione, oltre all'accesso a una crescente rete militare interna.

In loco Perks

• Parcheggio gratuito e sicuro con ricarica EV

• Sala di preghiera multi-fedele

• Aree di lavoro di nuova modernizzazione

• Lively Sports & Social Club con eventi e premi

• palestra 24 ore su 24

• Distributori automatici

Modello di lavoro
Questo ruolo è principalmente basato sul sito a Leeds, riflettendo il suo stretto legame con le nostre operazioni e la collaborazione di team. Tuttavia, prendiamo un approccio positivo e flessibile alle modalità di lavoro, riconoscendo l'importanza dell'equilibrio e dell'autonomia, in modo che il lavoro domestico ad-hoc possa essere sostenuto

• Gestion de l'exécution du projet depuis le début jusqu'à la clôture.

• Agir comme principal contact client pour les comptes clés

• Coordonner les équipes internes dans les domaines du génie, des opérations, des achats et du service sur le terrain.

• Veiller à ce que les projets soient exécutés de façon sûre, rentable et conforme aux attentes des clients.

jobs.title: Technico-commercial sédentaire / Inside Sales Engineer
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Sr. Tendering Engineer is responsible for providing technical support to sales teams and conducting technical analysis of product configurations to determine customer-specific pricing.
This job profile is intended for experienced professionals who apply practical knowledge of a job area and work independently with general supervision. Résumé du poste

En tant que Technico-commercial sédentaire chez Sulzer Ensival Moret France SASU, vous serez un élément clé de notre équipe commerciale, chargé de développer et de maintenir d'excellentes relations avec nos clients, tout en assurant la promotion et la vente de nos solutions techniques.

Responsabilités

* Gérer un portefeuille de clients existants et le cas échéant, prospecter de nouveaux clients par téléphone et par e-mail.
* Analyser les besoins techniques des clients et leur proposer des solutions adaptées parmi notre gamme de produits (pompes, agitateurs, etc.).
* Élaborer des offres commerciales détaillées et techniques, en collaboration avec les équipes d'ingénierie et de production.
* Négocier les conditions commerciales et conclure les ventes.
* Assurer le suivi des commandes, de la réception à la livraison, en coordination avec les services internes.
* Répondre aux demandes techniques des clients et les conseiller sur l'utilisation de nos produits.
* Participer à l'élaboration de la stratégie commerciale et au reporting des activités.
* Maintenir une veille technologique et concurrentielle sur le marché.

Qualifications

* Diplôme technique (Bac+2 à Bac+5) en mécanique, électromécanique, génie des procédés ou équivalent.
* Expérience significative (minimum 3 ans) en vente de produits techniques industriels, idéalement dans le secteur des pompes ou équipements rotatifs.
* Excellentes compétences relationnelles et de communication, à l'écrit comme à l'oral.
* Maîtrise des outils informatiques (CRM, Pack Office).
* Capacité à travailler en autonomie et en équipe.
* Sens de l'organisation, rigueur et proactivité.
* La maîtrise de l'anglais technique est un plus.

What we offer you

;

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

responsabilità

Als sesshafter Technico-Commercial bei Sulzer Ensival Moret France SASU sind Sie ein wichtiges Element unseres Verkaufsteams, das für die Entwicklung und Aufrechterhaltung exzellenter Beziehungen zu unseren Kunden verantwortlich ist und gleichzeitig die Förderung und den Verkauf unserer technischen Lösungen sicherstellt.

* Aufrechterhaltung einer wettbewerbsfähigen technologischen Uhr auf dem Markt.

Qualifikationen

* Technischer Abschluss (Bac+2 bis Bac+5) in Mechanik, Elektromechanik, Verfahrenstechnik oder gleichwertig.
* Bedeutende Erfahrung (mindestens 3 Jahre) im Verkauf von industriellen technischen Produkten, idealerweise im Pumpen- oder Rotationsmaschinenbereich.
* Hervorragende relationale und kommunikative Fähigkeiten, sowohl schriftlich als auch mündlich.
* Beherrschung von Computer-Tools (CRM, Pack Office).
* Fähigkeit, in Autonomie und Team zu arbeiten.
* Organisatorischer Sinn, Strenge und Proaktivität.
* Kenntnisse in technischem Englisch sind ein Plus.

Was wir Ihnen bieten

;

Sulzer ist eine Chancengleichheit. Wir glauben an die Stärke einer vielfältigen Belegschaft und engagieren uns für ein integratives Arbeitsumfeld.

Wir sind stolz darauf, als Top Employee 2026 in Brasilien, Kanada, China, Finnland, Deutschland, Irland, Mexiko, der Schweiz, Südafrika, Großbritannien und den USA anerkannt zu werden.

jobs.title: Sr. Mechanical Engineer ORE
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Sr. Mechanical Engineer is responsible for designing and developing mechanical systems and components. This role applies engineering knowledge to support the planning, testing, and implementation of mechanical and electromechanical systems.
This job profile is intended for experienced professionals who apply practical knowledge of a job area and work independently with general supervision. About You

You, as an Order Related Engineer, are critical to fulfilling Sulzer’s mission by ensuring that our products are configured on-time and with accuracy as promised while supporting the needs of manufacturing, sales, and customers.

Sulzer products are second to none and so are our people. We value the strength and diversity of our teams. You will establish an environment of trust and engage with your team so they can perform and grow.

You will be responsible for handling order-related engineering and design in support of fulfilling customer orders on municipal water pumps, systems and accessories.
qualifications

• Bachelor’s degree in mechanical engineering; significant directly related experience may be considered in lieu of degree requirement.

• Proficient in 3D CAD.

• Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite and Adobe Acrobat

• Ability to document clearly and effectively at a high level both orally and in writing.

• Experience in a fast-paced mechanical design environment.
Preferred qualifications

• Knowledge of hydraulics and pumping systems.

• Experience with mechanical design of rotating equipment

• Mainly 7 to 8+ years of industrial experience in Vertical Pump Design & Engineering

• Experience working with an MRP system as SAP

• Experience working with 3D Inventor software, 2D AutoCAD & Siemens NX.

Key responsibilities
Team-Up
· Provide technical support to Sales Managers and Applications Engineers during the sales phase.
Execute

• Create and enter part numbers, BOMs, and other data in MRP in support of order entry, procurement, and manufacturing processes.
Adapt
· Develop fabrication drawings for assemblies and components as required in support of internal and external manufacturing units and suppliers.
· Develop engineering data in support of engineering and structural analyses.
Motivate

• Work on multiple projects to meet established schedules.
Listen

• Work closely with Applications Engineers to understand project requirements and generate engineering data in support of internal and external manufacturing units and suppliers.
Engage

• Develop data as required in support of marketing communications and other various go-to-market efforts, including data required by certifying agencies such as UL, NSF. AWWA,

• Develop, organize, and maintain technical data and documentation of products and accessories in a standardized system for ease of access and control.
Act

• Prepare order related engineering designs, drawings, and data in support of the submittal process on projects.
Decide

• Source third-party products for use as ancillary and accessory solutions.
skills

• Broad understanding of National and International specifications/standards/codes such as ASTM, ANSI, AISI, ASME, ISO, DIN, NEMA, NEC, IEC.

• Strong understanding of machine design concepts such as structural analysis, properties of materials, and geometric dimensioning and tolerancing along with knowledge of manufacturing and fabrications processes.

• Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple assignments and meet deadlines.

• Strong interpersonal and communication skills with the ability to work individually or as part of a team.

What we offer you

Insurance benefits
Company transport

jobs.title: Interim Project Manager
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

At Sulzer, we are a global leader in fluid engineering and rotating equipment services. Our Leeds Service Centre is one of the UK's key operational hubs, providing the repair, refurbishment, maintenance and performance enhancement of pumps, motors and other rotating equipment for customers across the power generation, water, oil & gas, chemical and industrial sectors. The centre supports both workshop-based and field service activities, helping customers maximise reliability, reduce downtime and improve asset performance. As we enter the peak outage season, where maintaining consistent customer support and engagement is critical, we are seeking an experienced Project Manager for an initial 3-month contract, with a strong likelihood of extension .
In this role, you will play a key part in delivering complex service and overhaul projects, ensuring customer commitments are executed safely, on time, and within budget.

The Role

• Managing project delivery from initiation to close-out.

• Acting as the main customer contact for key accounts

• Coordinating internal teams across engineering, operations, procurement and field service.

• Monitoring project schedules, budgets, risks and resource requirements.

• Ensuring projects are delivered safely, profitably and in line with customer expectations.

• Providing regular progress updates to customers and internal stakeholders.

• Identifying and managing commercial opportunities and project variations.

• Supporting outage planning and execution for critical customer sites.

• Building strong relationships that secure repeat business and long-term partnerships.

About You

• Proven Project Management experience within engineering, manufacturing, maintenance or industrial services.

• Experience managing customer-facing projects with commercial accountability.

• Strong stakeholder management and communication skills.

• Excellent planning and organisational abilities.

• A proactive approach to problem solving and risk management.

• Knowledge of rotating equipment, pumps, motors or related industrial systems would be advantageous.

• A recognised Project Management qualification (APM, PRINCE2 or equivalent) is desirable.

What we offer you

Contract & Engagement Options

We are open to considering candidates on either a PAYE fixed-term contract basis or through a Limited Company contractor arrangement. Please note that following a CEST assessment, this role has been determined to fall inside IR35 , and any contractor engagement would therefore be managed accordingly.

Working Pattern

This role is primarily site-based in Leeds, reflecting its close connection to our operations, customers, and team collaboration. However, we recognise the value of flexibility and can support occasional home working where appropriate.

Facilities

We've recently invested significantly in modernising our Leeds facility, creating a brighter, more efficient, and technologically advanced working environment designed to support both high-quality delivery and a positive employee experience.
As part of our team, you'll benefit from:

• Free, secure onsite parking with EV charging facilities

• Multi-faith prayer room

• Newly refurbished and modernised working areas

• Active Sports & Social Club with regular events and prize draws

• 24/7 onsite gym

• Subsidised vending machines

• Subsidised canteen serving a variety of hot and cold food options

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

Informazioni sul ruolo

A Sulzer, siamo leader globale nei servizi di ingegneria dei fluidi e attrezzature rotanti. Il nostro Leeds Service Centre è uno dei principali hub operativi del Regno Unito, fornendo la riparazione, il rinnovamento, la manutenzione e il miglioramento delle prestazioni di pompe, motori e altre apparecchiature rotanti per i clienti in tutta la produzione di energia, acqua, gas, prodotti chimici e industriali. Il centro supporta sia le attività di officina che di servizio sul campo, aiutando i clienti a massimizzare l'affidabilità, ridurre i tempi di fermo e migliorare le prestazioni degli asset. Entrando nella stagione di picco outage, dove mantenere costante il supporto e l'impegno dei clienti è fondamentale, stiamo cercando un Project Manager esperto per un contratto iniziale di 3 mesi, con una forte probabilità di estensione.
In questo ruolo, si svolgerà un ruolo chiave nella fornitura di servizi complessi e progetti di revisione, assicurando gli impegni del cliente sono eseguiti in modo sicuro, in tempo, e all'interno del budget.

Il ruolo

• Gestione della consegna del progetto dall'avvio alla chiusura.

• Come principale contatto con il cliente per i conti chiave

• Coordinamento delle squadre interne in ingegneria, operazioni, appalti e servizi sul campo.

• Monitoraggio degli orari dei progetti, dei bilanci, dei rischi e dei requisiti delle risorse.

• Garantire i progetti sono forniti in modo sicuro, redditizio e in linea con le aspettative dei clienti.

• Fornire aggiornamenti regolari dei progressi ai clienti e agli stakeholder interni.

• Identificare e gestire opportunità commerciali e variazioni di progetto.

• Sostenere la pianificazione e l'esecuzione di outage per i siti dei clienti critici.

• Costruire relazioni forti che assicurano rapporti commerciali e partnership a lungo termine.

A proposito di te

• Esperienza di Project Management comprovata all'interno di servizi di ingegneria, produzione, manutenzione o industriale.

• Gestione dell'esperienza dei progetti orientati al cliente con responsabilità commerciale.

• Forte capacità di gestione e comunicazione degli stakeholder.

• Ottima pianificazione e capacità organizzative.

• Un approccio proattivo alla risoluzione dei problemi e alla gestione dei rischi.

• La conoscenza di apparecchiature rotanti, pompe, motori o sistemi industriali correlati sarebbe vantaggiosa.

• È auspicabile una qualifica riconosciuta di Project Management (APM, PRINCE2 o equivalente).

Cosa ti offriamo

Opzioni di contratto e inserimento

Siamo aperti a prendere in considerazione i candidati su una base di contratto a tempo determinato PAYE o attraverso un accordo di appaltatore di società limitata. Si prega di notare che a seguito di una valutazione CEST, questo ruolo è stato determinato a cadere all'interno di IR35 , e qualsiasi impegno del contraente sarebbe quindi gestito di conseguenza.

Modello di lavoro

Questo ruolo è principalmente basato sul sito in Leeds, riflettendo il suo stretto legame con le nostre operazioni, clienti e collaborazione di team. Tuttavia, riconosciamo il valore della flessibilità e possiamo sostenere occasionalmente il lavoro domestico, se del caso.

Servizi

Recentemente abbiamo investito in modo significativo nella modernizzazione della nostra struttura Leeds, creando un ambiente di lavoro più luminoso, più efficiente e tecnologicamente avanzato progettato per supportare sia la consegna di alta qualità che un'esperienza positiva dei dipendenti.
Nell'ambito della nostra squadra, potrai beneficiare di:

• Parcheggio gratuito e sicuro in loco con impianti di ricarica EV

• Sala di preghiera multi-fedele

• Aree di lavoro rinnovate e modernizzate

• Active Sports & Social Club con eventi regolari e premi

• palestra 24 ore su 24

• Distributori automatici

• Mensa sottosidrata che serve una varietà di opzioni di cibo caldo e freddo

Sulzer è un datore di lavoro pari opportunità. Crediamo nella forza di una forza lavoro diversificata e ci impegniamo ad offrire un ambiente di lavoro inclusivo.

Siamo orgogliosi di essere riconosciuti come Top Employer 2026 in Brasile, Canada, Cina, Finlandia, Germania, Irlanda, Messico, Svizzera, Sud Africa, Regno Unito e Stati Uniti.
descriptionByLocale.en:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

At Sulzer, we are a global leader in fluid engineering and rotating equipment services. Our Leeds Service Centre is one of the UK's key operational hubs, providing the repair, refurbishment, maintenance and performance enhancement of pumps, motors and other rotating equipment for customers across the power generation, water, oil & gas, chemical and industrial sectors. The centre supports both workshop-based and field service activities, helping customers maximise reliability, reduce downtime and improve asset performance. As we enter the peak outage season, where maintaining consistent customer support and engagement is critical, we are seeking an experienced Project Manager for an initial 3-month contract, with a strong likelihood of extension .
In this role, you will play a key part in delivering complex service and overhaul projects, ensuring customer commitments are executed safely, on time, and within budget.

The Role

• Managing project delivery from initiation to close-out.

• Acting as the main customer contact for key accounts

• Coordinating internal teams across engineering, operations, procurement and field service.

• Monitoring project schedules, budgets, risks and resource requirements.

• Ensuring projects are delivered safely, profitably and in line with customer expectations.

• Providing regular progress updates to customers and internal stakeholders.

• Identifying and managing commercial opportunities and project variations.

• Supporting outage planning and execution for critical customer sites.

• Building strong relationships that secure repeat business and long-term partnerships.

About You

• Proven Project Management experience within engineering, manufacturing, maintenance or industrial services.

• Experience managing customer-facing projects with commercial accountability.

• Strong stakeholder management and communication skills.

• Excellent planning and organisational abilities.

• A proactive approach to problem solving and risk management.

• Knowledge of rotating equipment, pumps, motors or related industrial systems would be advantageous.

• A recognised Project Management qualification (APM, PRINCE2 or equivalent) is desirable.

What we offer you

Contract & Engagement Options

We are open to considering candidates on either a PAYE fixed-term contract basis or through a Limited Company contractor arrangement. Please note that following a CEST assessment, this role has been determined to fall inside IR35 , and any contractor engagement would therefore be managed accordingly.

Working Pattern

This role is primarily site-based in Leeds, reflecting its close connection to our operations, customers, and team collaboration. However, we recognise the value of flexibility and can support occasional home working where appropriate.

Facilities

We've recently invested significantly in modernising our Leeds facility, creating a brighter, more efficient, and technologically advanced working environment designed to support both high-quality delivery and a positive employee experience.
As part of our team, you'll benefit from:

• Free, secure onsite parking with EV charging facilities

• Multi-faith prayer room

• Newly refurbished and modernised working areas

• Active Sports & Social Club with regular events and prize draws

• 24/7 onsite gym

• Subsidised vending machines

• Subsidised canteen serving a variety of hot and cold food options

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.
descriptionByLocale.de:
Sulzer ist ein führendes Ingenieurunternehmen mit einem stolzen Erbe an Innovationen. Schließen Sie sich unserem globalen Team an, um Ihr Fachwissen zu erweitern und innovative Lösungen zu entwickeln, die eine prosperierende und nachhaltigere Gesellschaft ermöglichen.

Über die Rolle

Bei Sulzer sind wir ein weltweit führender Anbieter von Dienstleistungen im Bereich Fluidtechnik und Rotationstechnik. Unser Leeds Service Center ist eines der wichtigsten Betriebszentren Großbritanniens und bietet die Reparatur, Renovierung, Wartung und Leistungssteigerung von Pumpen, Motoren und anderen rotierenden Geräten für Kunden in den Bereichen Stromerzeugung, Wasser, Öl & Gas, Chemie und Industrie. Das Zentrum unterstützt sowohl Werkstatt- als auch Außendienstaktivitäten und hilft Kunden dabei, die Zuverlässigkeit zu maximieren, Ausfallzeiten zu reduzieren und die Anlagenleistung zu verbessern. Da wir in die Hauptausfallsaison eintreten, in der die Aufrechterhaltung einer konsistenten Kundenbetreuung und -bindung von entscheidender Bedeutung ist, suchen wir einen erfahrenen Projektmanager für einen ersten 3-Monats-Vertrag mit einer hohen Wahrscheinlichkeit einer Verlängerung.
In dieser Rolle spielen Sie eine wichtige Rolle bei der Bereitstellung komplexer Service- und Überholungsprojekte, um sicherzustellen, dass Kundenverpflichtungen sicher, pünktlich und innerhalb des Budgets ausgeführt werden.

Die Rolle

• Verwalten der Projektlieferung von der Initiierung bis zum Close-Out.

• Als Hauptkundenkontakt für Key Accounts fungieren

• Koordination interner Teams in den Bereichen Engineering, Operations, Beschaffung und Außendienst.

• Überwachung von Projektplänen, Budgets, Risiken und Ressourcenanforderungen.

• Sicherzustellen, dass Projekte sicher, profitabel und im Einklang mit den Erwartungen der Kunden geliefert werden.

• Bereitstellung regelmäßiger Fortschrittsaktualisierungen für Kunden und interne Stakeholder.

• Identifizieren und Verwalten von kommerziellen Möglichkeiten und Projektvariationen.

• Unterstützung der Ausfallplanung und -ausführung für kritische Kundenstandorte.

• Aufbau starker Beziehungen, die Wiederholungsgeschäfte und langfristige Partnerschaften sichern.

Über dich

• Nachgewiesene Projektmanagement-Erfahrung in den Bereichen Engineering, Fertigung, Wartung oder Industriedienstleistungen.

• Erfahrung in der Verwaltung kundenorientierter Projekte mit kommerzieller Verantwortung.

• Starke Stakeholder-Management- und Kommunikationsfähigkeiten.

• Hervorragende Planungs- und Organisationsfähigkeiten.

• Ein proaktiver Ansatz zur Problemlösung und zum Risikomanagement.

• Die Kenntnis von rotierenden Geräten, Pumpen, Motoren oder verwandten industriellen Systemen wäre vorteilhaft.

• Eine anerkannte Projektmanagement-Qualifikation (APM, PRINCE2 oder gleichwertig) ist wünschenswert.

Was wir Ihnen bieten

Vertrag & Engagement Optionen

Wir sind offen für die Berücksichtigung von Kandidaten entweder auf einer PAYE befristeten Vertragsbasis oder durch eine Limited Company Auftragnehmer Vereinbarung. Bitte beachten Sie, dass nach einer CEST-Bewertung festgestellt wurde, dass diese Rolle in den IR35 fällt und dass jedes Auftragnehmer-Engagement daher entsprechend verwaltet wird.

Arbeitsmuster

Diese Rolle ist in erster Linie standortbezogen in Leeds und spiegelt die enge Verbindung zu unseren Betrieben, Kunden und der Zusammenarbeit im Team wider. Wir erkennen jedoch den Wert der Flexibilität an und können gegebenenfalls gelegentliche Heimarbeit unterstützen.

Einrichtungen

Wir haben kürzlich erheblich in die Modernisierung unserer Leeds-Anlage investiert, um ein helleres, effizienteres und technologisch fortschrittliches Arbeitsumfeld zu schaffen, das sowohl eine qualitativ hochwertige Lieferung als auch eine positive Mitarbeitererfahrung unterstützt.
Als Teil unseres Teams profitieren Sie von:

• Kostenloses, sicheres Parken vor Ort mit Ladeeinrichtungen für Elektrofahrzeuge

• Multireligiöse Gebetsräume

• Neu renovierte und modernisierte Arbeitsbereiche

• Aktiver Sport & Social Club mit regelmäßigen Veranstaltungen und Verlosungen

• 24/7 Onsite Gymnastik

• Subventionierte Verkaufsautomaten

• Subventionierte Kantine mit einer Vielzahl von warmen und kalten Speisen

Sulzer ist ein Arbeitgeber für Chancengleichheit. Wir glauben an die Stärke einer vielfältigen Belegschaft und engagieren uns für ein integratives Arbeitsumfeld.

Wir sind stolz darauf, als Top Employer 2026 in Brasilien, Kanada, China, Finnland, Deutschland, Irland, Mexiko, der Schweiz, Südafrika, Großbritannien und den USA anerkannt zu werden.
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Sulzer est une entreprise d'ingénierie de premier plan avec un fier héritage d'innovation. Rejoignez notre équipe mondiale pour développer votre expertise et développer des solutions innovantes qui permettent une société prospère et plus durable.

Sur le rôle

Chez Sulzer, nous sommes un leader mondial en ingénierie des fluides et en équipement rotatif. Notre centre de service Leeds est l'un des principaux centres opérationnels du Royaume-Uni, fournissant la réparation, la rénovation, l'entretien et l'amélioration des performances des pompes, moteurs et autres équipements rotatifs pour les clients dans les secteurs de la production d'électricité, de l'eau, du pétrole et du gaz, de la chimie et de l'industrie. Le centre soutient à la fois les activités de service en atelier et sur le terrain, aidant les clients à maximiser la fiabilité, à réduire les temps d'arrêt et à améliorer les performances des actifs. Alors que nous entrons dans la saison de pointe, où le maintien d'un soutien et d'un engagement cohérents de la clientèle est essentiel, nous cherchons un gestionnaire de projet expérimenté pour un contrat initial de 3 mois, avec une forte probabilité de prolongation.
Dans ce rôle, vous jouerez un rôle clé dans la prestation de services complexes et la révision des projets, en veillant à ce que les engagements des clients soient exécutés en toute sécurité, à temps et dans les limites du budget.

Le rôle

• Gestion de l'exécution des projets depuis le début jusqu'à la clôture.

• Agir comme principal contact client pour les comptes clés

• Coordonner les équipes internes dans les domaines du génie, des opérations, des achats et des services sur le terrain.

• Surveillance des calendriers, des budgets, des risques et des ressources nécessaires.

• Veiller à ce que les projets soient exécutés de façon sûre, rentable et conforme aux attentes des clients.

• Fournir régulièrement des mises à jour aux clients et aux intervenants internes.

• Identifier et gérer les possibilités commerciales et les variations de projets.

• Soutenir la planification et l'exécution des pannes pour les sites clients critiques.

• Établir des relations solides qui garantissent des partenariats commerciaux et à long terme.

À propos de toi

• Expérience de gestion de projet éprouvée au sein de l'ingénierie, de la fabrication, de l'entretien ou des services industriels.

• Expérience de la gestion de projets axés sur la clientèle avec responsabilité commerciale.

• Fortes compétences en gestion des intervenants et en communication.

• Excellente planification et capacités organisationnelles.

• Une approche proactive de la résolution des problèmes et de la gestion des risques.

• La connaissance de l'équipement rotatif, des pompes, des moteurs ou des systèmes industriels connexes serait avantageuse.

• Une qualification reconnue en gestion de projet (APM, PRINCE2 ou équivalent) est souhaitable.

Ce que nous vous offrons

Options de contrat et d'engagement

Nous sommes ouverts à l'examen des candidats sur la base d'un contrat à durée déterminée de CAFE ou dans le cadre d'un contrat conclu avec une société limitée. Veuillez noter qu'à la suite d'une évaluation du CEST, ce rôle a été déterminé à l'intérieur du IR35, et que toute participation de l'entrepreneur serait donc gérée en conséquence.

Plan de travail

Ce rôle est principalement basé sur le site à Leeds, ce qui reflète son lien étroit avec nos opérations, nos clients et la collaboration d'équipe. Cependant, nous reconnaissons la valeur de la flexibilité et pouvons soutenir le travail occasionnel à domicile le cas échéant.

Installations

Nous avons récemment investi considérablement dans la modernisation de notre installation Leeds, créant un environnement de travail plus brillant, plus efficace et technologiquement avancé conçu pour soutenir une prestation de haute qualité et une expérience positive des employés.
Dans le cadre de notre équipe, vous bénéficierez :

• Parking gratuit et sécurisé sur place avec installations de recharge EV

• Salle de prière multiconfessionnelle

• Nouveaux espaces de travail rénovés et modernisés

• Active Sports & Social Club avec des événements réguliers et tirages de prix

• Gym 24/7 sur place

• Distributeurs automatiques subventionnés

• Cantine subventionnée servant une variété d'aliments chauds et froids

Sulzer est un employeur à chances égales. Nous croyons en la force d'un effectif diversifié et sommes déterminés à offrir un milieu de travail inclusif.

Nous sommes fiers d'être reconnus comme l'un des meilleurs employeurs 2026 au Brésil, au Canada, en Chine, en Finlande, en Allemagne, en Irlande, au Mexique, en Suisse, en Afrique du Sud, au Royaume-Uni et aux États-Unis.

jobs.title: Machine Diagnostics Engineer
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

We are looking for a Machine Diagnostics Engineer (100%) to join our team within the Flow division in Switzerland to help us take Sulzer to the next level.

In this role, you will be responsible for machine diagnostics activities related to pump technology. Join our team if you want to contribute to technology development and support in the field of experimental dynamics, vibration and modal analysis, acoustics, and related data analysis techniques.
Your main tasks and responsibilities:

• Project management and project work on Machine Diagnostics projects

• Development of machinery diagnostic and pump condition monitoring solutions

• Analysis of pump and system operation data

• Vibration, acoustic and other dynamic measurements in the testbed, measurement data analysis and interpretation

• Support test bed activities with experimental dynamics, sensor and data acquisition activities

• Field vibration surveys and analysis on pumps

• Travel to test facilities, customer sites or other locations can occasionally be required

To succeed in this role, you will need:

• Master’s degree in Mechanical Engineering or a related field

• Ideally, 3-4 years of experience in machine dynamics, vibration and experimental modal analysis, acoustics, machinery diagnostics and condition monitoring, and data analysis techniques

• Hands-on experience in data acquisition systems, instrumentation and conducting experimental test campaigns

• Solid understanding of rotating equipment; experience with pump technology is a plus

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills

• Proficiency in tools such as Excel, MATLAB, and LabView

• Team player with excellent communication and collaboration skills

• Fluent in English, German is a plus

What we offer you

• An innovative, vibrant and agile culture

• Excellent social benefits (holidays, pension fund etc.)

• Access to a wide range of discounts on Everyday Shopping, Entertainment and Lifestyle

• Central workplace, only 5 minutes from Winterthur train station

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

Sur le rôle

Nous sommes à la recherche d'un ingénieur de diagnostic automatique (100%) pour rejoindre notre équipe au sein de la division Flow en Suisse pour nous aider à amener Sulzer au niveau supérieur.

Dans ce rôle, vous serez responsable des activités de diagnostic des machines liées à la technologie des pompes. Rejoignez notre équipe si vous souhaitez contribuer au développement technologique et au soutien dans le domaine de la dynamique expérimentale, des vibrations et de l'analyse modale, de l'acoustique et des techniques d'analyse de données connexes.
Vos principales tâches et responsabilités:

• Gestion de projet et travaux sur les projets de diagnostic automatique

• Développement de solutions de diagnostic et de surveillance de l'état des machines

• Analyse des données de fonctionnement de la pompe et du système

• Vibrations, mesures acoustiques et autres mesures dynamiques dans le banc d ' essai, analyse et interprétation des données de mesure

• Soutenir les activités de banc d'essai avec des activités expérimentales de dynamique, de capteur et d'acquisition de données

• Enquêtes sur les vibrations sur le terrain et analyse des pompes

• Des voyages pour tester des installations, des sites clients ou d'autres endroits peuvent parfois être requis

Pour réussir dans ce rôle, vous devrez :

• Maîtrise en génie mécanique ou domaine connexe

• Idéalement, 3-4 ans d'expérience dans la dynamique des machines, l'analyse des vibrations et des modes expérimentaux, l'acoustique, le diagnostic des machines et la surveillance de l'état, et les techniques d'analyse des données

• Expérience pratique des systèmes d'acquisition de données, de l'instrumentation et de la conduite de campagnes expérimentales d'essais

• Compréhension solide de l'équipement rotatif; l'expérience avec la technologie de la pompe est un plus

• Fortes compétences en analyse et en résolution de problèmes

• Compétence en outils comme Excel, MATLAB et LabView

• Joueur d'équipe avec d'excellentes compétences en communication et collaboration

• Fluent en anglais, allemand est un plus

Ce que nous vous offrons

• Une culture innovante, vibrante et agile

• Excellentes prestations sociales (vacances, caisse de retraite, etc.)

• Accès à une large gamme de réductions sur le shopping quotidien, le divertissement et le style de vie

• Lieu de travail central, à seulement 5 minutes de la gare de Winterthur

Sulzer est un employeur à chances égales. Nous croyons en la force d'un effectif diversifié et sommes déterminés à offrir un milieu de travail inclusif.

Nous sommes fiers d'être reconnus comme l'un des meilleurs employeurs 2026 au Brésil, au Canada, en Chine, en Finlande, en Allemagne, en Irlande, au Mexique, en Suisse, en Afrique du Sud, au Royaume-Uni et aux États-Unis.
