jobs.title: Senior Legal Counsel
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Join our Group Legal Team in Winterthur and contribute your expertise to a global, publicly listed industrial company. In this highly visible role, you will report directly to the Head Group Legal / Deputy General Counsel and act as a trusted legal advisor to senior leadership and key corporate functions across the Group.

Key Responsibilities:

• Lead and coordinate the legal workstream of domestic and cross-border M&A transactions, including acquisitions, divestments, joint ventures and other strategic investments, working closely with internal stakeholders and external advisors

• Draft, review and negotiate a broad range of complex commercial agreements, including, joint venture arrangements, technology agreements, sales terms and conditions, and procurement and supply contracts

• Advise on financing transactions, including bond issuances, syndicated and bilateral credit facilities, and provide legal support to the Treasury function on a wide range of financing-related matters

• Oversee and coordinate litigation, arbitration and other dispute resolution matters across the Group, including the management of external counsel

• Oversee the preparation and execution of Annual General Meetings and contribute to the legal review of the Company's Annual Report and Non-Financial Report

• Support the Head Group Legal / Corporate Secretary in matters relating to the Board of Directors, its committees and the Executive Committee

Your profile:

• Master of Law degree and Swiss Bar admission

• Minimum of 5+ years of relevant post-qualification experience, ideally gained in a leading law firm and/or the legal department of an international industrial company

• Demonstrated experience in M&A and Swiss corporate law, ideally complemented by exposure to antitrust and sanction law as well as capital markets and stock exchange regulations

• Business-oriented legal professional with strong judgment, a pragmatic mindset and the ability to balance legal risks with commercial objectives

• Excellent project and stakeholder management skills, with experience interacting confidently with senior executives, Board members and key external stakeholders

• Digitally savvy, with a strong interest in technology, AI-enabled solutions and modern ways of working

What we offer you

• An innovative, vibrant and agile culture

• Excellent social benefits (holidays, pension fund etc.)

• Access to a wide range of discounts on Everyday Shopping, Entertainment and Lifestyle

• Central workplace, only 5 minutes from Winterthur train station

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Mechanical Design & Project Engineer
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Mechanical Engineer is responsible for researching, planning, designing, and developing mechanical products and systems. This includes instruments, controls, engines, and machines used in energy production, transmission, and measurement.
This job profile is intended for early-career professionals who apply broad theoretical knowledge and require the ability to investigate and analyze problems. Solutions are typically discussed/verified with a more senior member. Position Summary:
This position operates within the Order Related Engineering (ORE) department and is responsible for comprehensive understanding project scope to determine the requirement for developing a Submittal Package. Submittal package includes mechanical design, General Arrangement (GA) drawings and the preparation of mechanical components specific to individual sales orders. The role involves compiling and coordinating the development of Submittal Packages in close collaboration with Motor Control Designers and the ORE Manager. Additionally, this position will manage the submittal approval process with customers, ensuring timely feedback and resolution. Upon approval, the position is accountable for generating fabrication drawings, creating part numbers within the ERP system, and releasing the finalized package to production. Furthermore, the position provides mechanical engineering expertise to Tendering by reviewing project specifications and offering recommendations.

Principal Duties & Responsibilities:

• Review project scope and specifications and organize hand-off meetings as necessary to ensure alignment and clarity.

• Design mechanical components, assemblies, and general arrangement drawings specific to sales orders using Autodesk Inventor and maintain associated files within the Autodesk Vault management system.

• Create and manage submittal packages through the customer approval process, ensuring timely and accurate release.

• Update and maintain sales order workflows within the Visual ERP system.

• Review and verify mechanical drawings and bills of materials (BOMs) prepared by other team members within the ORE department to ensure accuracy and compliance.

• Conduct mechanical specification reviews to support tendering activities, as assigned by the ORE Manager.

• Provide mechanical engineering support to other departments as directed by the ORE Manager.

Sulzer ist ein führendes Ingenieurunternehmen mit einem stolzen Erbe an Innovationen. Schließen Sie sich unserem globalen Team an, um Ihr Fachwissen zu erweitern und innovative Lösungen zu entwickeln, die eine prosperierende und nachhaltigere Gesellschaft ermöglichen.

Über die Rolle

Stellenbeschreibung
Der Maschinenbauer ist verantwortlich für die Erforschung, Planung, Konstruktion und Entwicklung mechanischer Produkte und Systeme. Dazu gehören Instrumente, Steuerungen, Motoren und Maschinen, die bei der Energieerzeugung, -übertragung und -messung eingesetzt werden.
Dieses Stellenprofil richtet sich an Berufseinsteiger, die ein breites theoretisches Wissen anwenden und die Fähigkeit benötigen, Probleme zu untersuchen und zu analysieren. Lösungen werden in der Regel mit einem älteren Mitglied diskutiert / verifiziert. Positionsübersicht:
Diese Position ist innerhalb der Order Related Engineering (ORE) -Abteilung tätig und ist für das umfassende Verständnis des Projektumfangs verantwortlich, um die Anforderungen für die Entwicklung eines Einreichungspakets zu ermitteln. Das Einreichungspaket umfasst mechanisches Design, General Arrangement (GA)-Zeichnungen und die Vorbereitung von mechanischen Komponenten, die für individuelle Verkaufsaufträge spezifisch sind. Die Aufgabe besteht darin, die Entwicklung von Submittal Packages in enger Zusammenarbeit mit Motor Control Designers und dem ORE Manager zusammenzustellen und zu koordinieren. Darüber hinaus wird diese Position den einreichenden Genehmigungsprozess mit den Kunden verwalten und eine rechtzeitige Rückmeldung und Lösung gewährleisten. Nach der Genehmigung ist die Position für die Erstellung von Fertigungszeichnungen, die Erstellung von Teilenummern im ERP-System und die Freigabe des fertigen Pakets in die Produktion verantwortlich. Darüber hinaus stellt die Position dem Tendering Maschinenbau-Know-how zur Verfügung, indem sie Projektspezifikationen überprüft und Empfehlungen anbietet.

Hauptpflichten und Zuständigkeiten:

• Überprüfen Sie den Projektumfang und die Spezifikationen und organisieren Sie bei Bedarf Übergabesitzungen, um die Ausrichtung und Klarheit zu gewährleisten.

• Entwerfen Sie mechanische Komponenten, Baugruppen und allgemeine Anordnungszeichnungen, die für Verkaufsaufträge mit Autodesk Inventor spezifisch sind, und pflegen Sie die zugehörigen Dateien innerhalb des Autodesk Vault-Managementsystems.

• Erstellen und Verwalten von Einsendungspaketen durch den Kundengenehmigungsprozess, um eine zeitnahe und genaue Freigabe zu gewährleisten.

• Aktualisieren und Pflegen von Bestellungsworkflows innerhalb des Visual ERP-Systems.

• Überprüfen und überprüfen Sie mechanische Zeichnungen und Stücklisten, die von anderen Teammitgliedern in der ORE-Abteilung erstellt wurden, um Genauigkeit und Konformität zu gewährleisten.

• Führen Sie mechanische Spezifikationen durch, um die vom ORE-Manager zugewiesenen Ausschreibungsaktivitäten zu unterstützen.

• Unterstützung des Maschinenbaus für andere Abteilungen, wie vom ORE-Manager geleitet.

• Unterstützen Sie Produktions- und Außendiensttechniker, indem Sie mechanische Unterstützung bei der Herstellung und Produktinstallation anbieten.

• Führen Sie zusätzliche Aufgaben aus und nehmen Sie wie zugewiesen an speziellen Projekten teil.

Bildung & Erfahrung:
Vorgeschrieben:
Bachelor-Abschluss in Maschinenbau mit 2+ Jahren Erfahrung.

Gewünscht:
Bachelor-Abschluss in Maschinenbau und Projektmanagement Professional Certification (PMP) mit 2+ Jahren Erfahrung.

Fähigkeiten:
Vorgeschrieben:

• CAD Erfahrung in der 3D-Modellierung und -Zeichnung

• ERP System Erfahrung.

• Fähigkeit, Technologie und Analysetools (Excel, Outlook, Web, Datenbanken) zu verwenden.

Gewünscht:

• Autodesk Erfinder

• Kenntnisse der ASME Y 14.5M 2018 Standards.

Verantwortlichkeit: Position ist verantwortlich für die Gewährleistung der Genauigkeit und OTD von Einsendungspaket, Herstellungszeichnungen und Visual BOM-Updates. Diese Position ist auch verantwortlich für die Einhaltung der Unternehmensstandards und ihrer Sicherheitsrichtlinien.

Verantwortung: Diese Position ist verantwortlich für Entscheidungen in Bezug auf mechanisches Design, Zeichnungserstellung, Stücklistenprüfung und Koordination zwischen verschiedenen Abteilungen. Auch verantwortlich für die Verwaltung des einreichenden Genehmigungsprozesses des Kunden und die Unterstützung des Betriebs.

Delegation: Diese Position kann Aufgaben wie Zeichnungsprüfungen und Stücklistenüberprüfung an andere Teammitglieder innerhalb des O delegieren.

Sulzer est une entreprise d'ingénierie de premier plan avec un fier héritage d'innovation. Rejoignez notre équipe mondiale pour développer votre expertise et développer des solutions innovantes qui permettent une société prospère et plus durable.

Sur le rôle

Résumé de l'emploi
L'ingénieur mécanique est responsable de la recherche, de la planification, de la conception et du développement de produits et de systèmes mécaniques. Cela comprend les instruments, les commandes, les moteurs et les machines utilisés dans la production, la transmission et la mesure de l'énergie.
Ce profil d'emploi est destiné aux professionnels en début de carrière qui appliquent de vastes connaissances théoriques et qui ont besoin de la capacité d'étudier et d'analyser les problèmes. Les solutions sont généralement discutées/vérifiées avec un membre plus âgé. Sommaire du poste :
Ce poste fonctionne au sein du département d'ingénierie liée à l'ordre (ORE) et est chargé de bien comprendre la portée du projet pour déterminer l'exigence d'élaborer un dossier de soumission. Le colis de soumission comprend la conception mécanique, les dessins d'arrangement général (GA) et la préparation de composants mécaniques propres aux commandes individuelles. Le rôle consiste à compiler et à coordonner le développement des packs de soumission en étroite collaboration avec Motor Control Designers et le gestionnaire ORE. De plus, ce poste gérera le processus d'approbation des soumissions avec les clients, en assurant la rétroaction et la résolution en temps opportun. Une fois approuvé, le poste est responsable de la production de dessins de fabrication, de la création de numéros de pièces dans le système PGI et de la libération du colis final à la production. De plus, le poste fournit une expertise en génie mécanique à l'appel d'offres en examinant les spécifications du projet et en proposant des recommandations.

Principales fonctions et responsabilités :

• Examiner la portée et les spécifications du projet et organiser des réunions de remise au besoin pour assurer l'alignement et la clarté.

• Concevoir des composants mécaniques, des assemblages et des dessins d'arrangements généraux spécifiques aux commandes de vente à l'aide d'Autodesk Inventor et gérer les fichiers associés dans le système de gestion d'Autodesk Vault.

• Créer et gérer des paquets de soumission par le biais du processus d'approbation des clients, en assurant une diffusion rapide et précise.

• Mettre à jour et maintenir les flux de travail des commandes dans le système ERP Visual.

• Examiner et vérifier les plans mécaniques et les factures de matériaux (BOM) préparés par d'autres membres de l'équipe au sein du service ORE pour assurer l'exactitude et la conformité.

• Effectuer des examens mécaniques des spécifications pour appuyer les activités d'appel d'offres, comme l'a assigné le gestionnaire de l'ORE.

• Fournir un soutien en génie mécanique aux autres ministères, conformément aux directives du gestionnaire de l'ORE.

• Aider les techniciens de production et de service sur le terrain en offrant un soutien mécanique pendant la fabrication et l'installation du produit.

• Exécuter des tâches supplémentaires et participer à des projets spéciaux selon les affectations.

Éducation et expérience :
Requis :
Baccalauréat en génie mécanique avec 2+ ans d'expérience.

Désiré :
Baccalauréat en génie mécanique et certification professionnelle de gestion de projet (PMP) avec 2+ années d'expérience.

Compétences :
Requis :

• CAD Expérience de la modélisation et de la rédaction 3D

• Expérience du système ERP.

• Capacité d'utiliser la technologie et les outils d'analyse (Excel, Outlook, web, bases de données).

Désiré :

• Inventeur automatique

• Connaissance des normes ASME Y 14,5M 2018.

Autorité décisionnelle:
Responsabilité : Le poste est responsable d'assurer l'exactitude et la DTO du dossier de soumission, des dessins de fabrication et des mises à jour visuelles du BOM. Ce poste est également responsable du respect des normes de l'entreprise et de ses politiques de sécurité.

Responsabilité : Ce poste est chargé de prendre les décisions relatives à la conception mécanique, à la création de dessins, à la vérification du BOM et à la coordination entre les différents ministères. Également responsable de la gestion du processus d'approbation de la soumission des clients et des Opérations d'appui.

Délégation : Ce poste peut déléguer des tâches telles que des vérifications de dessin et de BOM à d'autres membres de l'équipe au sein de l'O

jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Sulzer is transforming its global product configuration system landscape and is looking for Variant Configuration Transformation Lead to drive this change to global Variant Configuration models.

In this senior expert role, you will lead the SAP CPQ implementation related changes to models, own the transition from classic SAP Variant Configuration (LO VC) to S/4HANA Advanced Variant Configuration (AVC), and define the next generation of configuration models, standards, and best practices. The position can be based at any of Sulzer's locations in Finland.

This is a hands on transformation and architecture role with global impact across sales, engineering, manufacturing, and aftermarkets. Your
• Responsibilities:
· Lead the SAP CPQ implementation related changes to Variant Configuration models
· Lead the migration and redesign of SAP LO‑VC models to S/4HANA AVC , including migration methodology, scoping, validation, and end‑to‑end testing
· Design and implement next‑generation configuration models leveraging advanced AVC capabilities
· Ensure seamless integration of configuration models with: SAP S/4HANA, SAP Commerce, Teamcenter PLM
· Establish global configuration modeling standards, governance, and best practices
· Train, coach, and mentor configuration modelers in best‑practice modeling approaches

What You Bring:
· Deep, hands‑on experience with SAP Variant Configuration (LO‑VC and AVC) and SAP CPQ
· Experience migrating and redesigning configuration models from SAP ECC LO-VC to S/4HANA AVC
· Strong understanding of CTO and ETO product configuration scenarios
· Experience designing global configuration models in global, cross‑functional environments
· Experience with Teamcenter Product Configurator , modular product structures, and multi‑BOM scenarios is a strong advantage
· Ability to work at architecture and transformation level , while remaining hands‑on
· Fluent English communication skills

Important Note:
This role is intended for senior SAP configuration experts and architects .
It is not a general SAP consultant or junior configuration modeling position.

The salary for this position ranges from 6.200 EUR to 7.000 EUR per month. The final salary will be determined based on the selected candidate’s experience and qualifications. The salary range reflects the planned level of responsibility associated with the role.

Interested?
For more information about the position, please contact Head Global Product Configuration, Configured Products Mr. Markus Talasniemi, markus.talasniemi@sulzer.com or tel +358 50 300 9525. · High‑impact role with long‑term influence on Sulzer’s digital and product strategy

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

Sur le rôle

Résumé de l'emploi
Le gestionnaire d'ingénierie (mécanique) est responsable de la gestion d'une équipe d'ingénieurs mécaniques, qui supervise la conception et le développement de systèmes et de composants mécaniques. Ce rôle assure la mise en oeuvre de stratégies d'ingénierie et influence les pratiques techniques.
Ce profil d'emploi s'adresse aux gestionnaires de personnes d'un plus haut niveau d'experts (P20–P40, M20). Principales responsabilités

• Promouvoir et faire respecter une culture de sécurité zéro incident.

• Établir une culture de maintenance de haute performance axée sur la sécurité, la fiabilité, l'amélioration continue et la responsabilisation.

• Définir les objectifs ministériels, les ICR, les plans de dotation et les programmes de formation.

• Gérer les budgets ministériels, les dépenses en capital et les dépenses d'entretien.

• Mettre en oeuvre les méthodes d'entretien de la production totale.

• Analyser les défaillances de l'équipement et provoquer des actions correctives.

• Surveiller et améliorer le temps d'arrêt de l'équipement, le MTBF (temps moyen entre les défaillances) et le MTTR (temps moyen pour réparer).

• Gérer les stocks de pièces de rechange et les stratégies relatives aux biens essentiels.

• Veiller au respect des règlements et des normes applicables en matière d'équipement sous pression.

• Surveiller l'entretien des systèmes de distribution électrique à moyenne et basse tension.

• Assurer un entretien adéquat des transformateurs, des commutateurs, des sous-stations, des générateurs et des équipements de qualité de l'énergie.

• Élaborer des programmes de sécurité électrique, y compris lockout/tagout (LOTO), protection contre les arcs et commandes de travail sous tension.

• Coordonner les mises à niveau du système électrique et les initiatives de fiabilité de l'énergie.

About the role

Responsible for driving profitable growth across Chile, Argentina, Uruguay and Paraguay through new account acquisition, installed-base development, strategic account management, agent management, and promotion of the full Mass Transfer Components Services (MTCS) portfolio including products and services.
• Own commercial growth, order intake, and customer development across the Southern Cone region.

• Develop and execute territory growth plans aligned with MTCS Americas objectives.

• Promote the complete MTCS portfolio including trays, packings, internals, separators, mixers, revamps, TAS and TFS offerings.

• Build relationships with end users, EPCs, licensors, engineering firms and contractors.

• Manage channel partners and sales agents within the territory.

• Support proposal development, negotiations, forecasting and CRM management.

• Monitor competitor activity, market trends and investment projects across the region.

• Represent Sulzer at industry conferences, customer events and technical seminars.

•

• Demonstrated record of growth and customer acquisition.

jobs.description:

About the role

Job Summary
Responsible for end-to-end Procure-to-Pay (P2P) process, ensuring accurate, timely, and compliant supplier transactions in line with company policies, internal controls, IFRS, and KSA regulatory requirements.

Key Responsibilities

• Execute the full P2P cycle, including invoice processing and 3-way matching (PO, GR, Invoice).

• Record supplier invoices accurately in SAP with correct coding and project allocations.

• Resolve invoice discrepancies and coordinate with Procurement, Supply Chain, and business stakeholders.

• Ensure compliance with Purchase Order policies and the "No PO, No Pay" principle.

• Prepare and process payment runs in compliance with Delegation of Authority (DoA) and internal controls.

• Reconcile vendor statements, AP sub-ledger accounts, and GR/IR balances, resolving outstanding items promptly.

• Support month-end and year-end close activities, including AP-to-GL reconciliations.

• Provide required documentation and support for internal and external audits.

• Drive process improvements, automation initiatives, and P2P efficiency enhancements.

• Collaborate with Finance, Treasury, Operations, Procurement, and external vendors to ensure smooth AP operations.

Qualifications / Requirements

• Bachelor's degree in accounting, Finance, or related field.

• 3-5 years of experience in Accounts Payable, General Ledger, or similar finance roles.

• Strong SAP and advanced Microsoft Excel skills.

• Knowledge of KSA VAT, WHT, and ZATCA e-Invoicing requirements.

• Experience with international procurement, Incoterms, LCs, and intercompany accounting is preferred.

• Experience in manufacturing, engineering, or project-based environments is an advantage.

jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Sulzer Pumps (Canada) Inc. - Flow Equipment, is a division of Sulzer Ltd, and is a global leader in the development and supply of pumping solutions and related equipment to its key markets oil and gas, power, general industries (mining, metals, food, CPI & fertilizers) and water. We provide a challenging and rewarding work environment where diversity is valued as a key driver for success.

Job Overview:
We are seeking a dynamic and results-driven Area Sales Manager to join our team in the sales and services (parts and repairs) of Sulzer Pumps / Water & Industrial Business Unit products (pumps, mixers, agitators, compressors etc.). In this pivotal role, you will be responsible for cultivating and expanding client relationships, driving revenue growth through strategic account management and business development initiatives. Your energetic approach and excellent communication skills will empower you to negotiate effectively, identify new sales opportunities, and deliver tailored solutions that meet our clients’ needs. This position offers an exciting opportunity to lead with enthusiasm, influence market growth, and contribute to our company’s ongoing success. Our successful candidate will primarily work independently with occasional guidance from the National Sales Manager PPI.

How You will Contribute:

• Develop growth in new and existing customer base.

• Negotiate orders including all technical, commercial and legal details.

• Call on prospective customers; maintain contracts with customers.

• Travel to customer locations to insure close and regular face-to-face contact.

• Secure and renew orders; arrange delivery dates and other peripherals integral to selling.

• Customer meetings during and outside normal business hours on a regular basis consistent with expense budgets and good business practices.

Other Essential Functions/ Responsibilities:

• Manage sales programs within the assigned territory, maintaining accurate records and providing activity reports as required.

• Follow up on overdue customer invoices in a professional and timely manner.

• Support alliance customers and ensure their needs are met effectively.

• Stay informed on new products, services, and relevant information to better support customers.

• Escalate customer concerns to the appropriate department and follow through to ensure satisfactory resolution.

• Comply with policies regarding safety, including but not limited to proper use of required PPE at all times.

• Perform other duties as assigned.

To succeed in this role, the ideal candidate will have:

• An Engineering degree or 5+ years of experience in pumps, hydraulics, or a related field.

• Proven experience marketing and selling industrial equipment, including pumps and motors.

• Strong written, verbal, negotiation, and interpersonal communication skills.

• Ability to work independently and effectively with minimal supervision.

• Resilience, professionalism, and a positive attitude in overcoming challenges and objections.

• Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications; SAP experience is preferred.

• Strong technical and analytical problem-solving abilities, with the ability to address internal and external customer concerns.

• Willingness to travel regularly, including overnight travel by vehicle and air, as required within the assigned territory.

• Valid driver's license with a satisfactory driving record.

Eligibility to Apply: This position requires legal authorization to work in Canada at time of application.

Location: Remote (Work from home within Western Canada)

What we offer you

• Company pension

• Dental care

• Disability insurance

• Employee assistance program

• Extended health care

• Life insurance

• Paid time off

• Vision care

Sulzer è una società di ingegneria leader con un patrimonio orgoglioso di innovazione. Unisciti al nostro team globale per accrescere le tue competenze e sviluppare soluzioni innovative che consentano una società prospera e più sostenibile.

Informazioni sul ruolo

Sulzer Pumps (Canada) Inc. - Flow Equipment, è una divisione di Sulzer Ltd, ed è un leader globale nello sviluppo e nella fornitura di soluzioni di pompaggio e relative attrezzature ai suoi mercati chiave petrolio e gas, potenza, industrie generali (mining, metalli, cibo, fertilizzanti CPI e acqua. Forniamo un ambiente di lavoro impegnativo e gratificante dove la diversità è apprezzata come un driver chiave per il successo.

Panoramica del lavoro:
Stiamo cercando un Area Sales Manager dinamico e guidato dai risultati per unire il nostro team nelle vendite e servizi (parti e riparazioni) dei prodotti Sulzer Pumps / Water & Industrial Business Unit (pompi, miscelatori, agitatori, compressori ecc.). In questo ruolo fondamentale, sarai responsabile della coltivazione e dell'espansione delle relazioni con i clienti, della crescita dei ricavi attraverso iniziative strategiche di gestione del conto e sviluppo aziendale. Il vostro approccio energetico e le eccellenti capacità di comunicazione vi permetterà di negoziare in modo efficace, identificare nuove opportunità di vendita, e fornire soluzioni su misura che soddisfano le esigenze dei nostri clienti. Questa posizione offre un'emozionante opportunità per portare con entusiasmo, influenzare la crescita del mercato e contribuire al successo costante della nostra azienda. Il nostro candidato di successo lavorerà principalmente indipendentemente con una guida occasionale dal National Sales Manager PPI.

Come Contribuirai:

• Sviluppare la crescita della base clienti nuova e esistente.

• Negoziare ordini, compresi tutti i dettagli tecnici, commerciali e legali.

• Chiamare i potenziali clienti; mantenere i contratti con i clienti.

• Viaggia nelle sedi dei clienti per assicurare un contatto faccia a faccia stretto e regolare.

• Ordine sicuro e rinnovare; organizzare le date di consegna e altre periferiche integrali alla vendita.

• Riunioni dei clienti durante e fuori normali ore di lavoro su base regolare coerente con i bilanci di spesa e buone pratiche commerciali.

Altre funzioni essenziali / responsabilità:

• Gestisci i programmi di vendita all'interno del territorio assegnato, mantenendo registri accurati e fornendo rapporti di attività come richiesto.

• Seguire le fatture dei clienti in ritardo in modo professionale e tempestivo.

• Sostenere i clienti dell'alleanza e garantire le loro esigenze sono soddisfatte in modo efficace.

• Rimani informato su nuovi prodotti, servizi e informazioni pertinenti per supportare meglio i clienti.

• Aumentare le preoccupazioni dei clienti per il reparto appropriato e seguire per garantire una risoluzione soddisfacente.

• Complimenti alle politiche in materia di sicurezza, compreso ma non limitato al corretto uso del DPI richiesto in ogni momento.

• Eseguire altri compiti come assegnato.

Per avere successo in questo ruolo, il candidato ideale avrà:

• Una laurea in ingegneria o 5+ anni di esperienza in pompe, idraulica, o un campo correlato.

• Prove esperienze di marketing e vendita di attrezzature industriali, tra cui pompe e motori.

• Forte capacità di comunicazione scritte, verbali, negoziali e interpersonali.

• Capacità di lavorare in modo indipendente ed efficace con una minima supervisione.

• Resilienza, professionalità e atteggiamento positivo nel superare le sfide e le obiezioni.

• La competenza con applicazioni Microsoft Office; l'esperienza SAP è preferita.

• Forte capacità tecniche e analitiche di problem solving, con la capacità di affrontare le preoccupazioni interne ed esterne del cliente.

• Volontà di viaggiare regolarmente, compreso il viaggio notturno per veicolo e aria, come richiesto all'interno del territorio assegnato.

• Patente di guida valida con un record di guida soddisfacente.

Ammissibilità a Applicare: Questa posizione richiede l'autorizzazione legale a lavorare in Canada al momento della domanda.

Posizione: Remote (Lavorare da casa all'interno del Canada occidentale)

Cosa ti offriamo

• Pensione sociale

• Cura dentale

• Assicurazione invalidità

• Programma di assistenza dei dipendenti

• Assistenza sanitaria estesa

• Assicurazione vita

• Tempo libero pagato

Wir suchen einen dynamischen und ergebnisorientierten Area Sales Manager, der sich unserem Team in den Vertrieb und die Dienstleistungen (Teile und Reparaturen) von Sulzer Pumpen / Wasser & Industrie Business Unit-Produkten (Pumpen, Mischer, Rührer, Kompressoren usw.) anschließt. In dieser zentralen Rolle sind Sie für die Pflege und den Ausbau der Kundenbeziehungen verantwortlich und fördern das Umsatzwachstum durch strategisches Account Management und Geschäftsentwicklungsinitiativen. Diese Position bietet eine spannende Gelegenheit, mit Begeisterung zu führen, das Marktwachstum zu beeinflussen und zum anhaltenden Erfolg unseres Unternehmens beizutragen. Unser erfolgreicher Kandidat wird in erster Linie unabhängig mit gelegentlicher Anleitung durch den National Sales Manager PPI arbeiten.

Wie Sie dazu beitragen werden:

• Entwicklung von Wachstum in neuen und bestehenden Kundenbasis.

• Verhandeln Sie Bestellungen einschließlich aller technischen, kommerziellen und rechtlichen Details.

• Rufen Sie potenzielle Kunden an; halten Sie Verträge mit Kunden.

• Reisen Sie zu Kundenstandorten, um einen engen und regelmäßigen persönlichen Kontakt zu gewährleisten.

• Sichern und erneuern Sie Bestellungen; vereinbaren Sie Liefertermine und andere Peripheriegeräte, die für den Verkauf wesentlich sind.

• Kundenbesprechungen während und außerhalb der normalen Geschäftszeiten regelmäßig im Einklang mit Ausgabenbudgets und guten Geschäftspraktiken.

• Bleiben Sie informiert über neue Produkte, Dienstleistungen und relevante Informationen, um Kunden besser zu unterstützen.

• Eskalieren Sie Kundenanliegen an die zuständige Abteilung und folgen Sie, um eine zufriedenstellende Lösung zu gewährleisten.

• Einhaltung der Sicherheitsrichtlinien, einschließlich, aber nicht beschränkt auf die jederzeitige ordnungsgemäße Verwendung der erforderlichen PSA.

• Führen Sie andere Aufgaben wie zugewiesen aus.

Um in dieser Rolle erfolgreich zu sein, hat der ideale Kandidat:

• Ein Ingenieurstudium oder 5+ Jahre Erfahrung in Pumpen, Hydraulik oder einem verwandten Bereich.

• Bewährte Erfahrung in der Vermarktung und dem Verkauf von Industriegeräten, einschließlich Pumpen und Motoren.

• Starke schriftliche, verbale, Verhandlungs- und zwischenmenschliche Kommunikationsfähigkeiten.

• Resilienz, Professionalität und eine positive Einstellung bei der Überwindung von Herausforderungen und Einwänden.

• Starke technische und analytische Problemlösungsfähigkeiten mit der Fähigkeit, interne und externe Kundenanliegen anzugehen.

Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

The Legal / Compliance Sr. Specialist is responsible for applying advanced legal and compliance knowledge to manage projects independently, ensuring the organization’s adherence to laws and internal policies. This role also supports junior professionals through coaching and review. This job profile is intended for specialist professionals that apply advanced knowledge of a job area. Required to manage projects / processes independently with limited supervision. Typically coaches and reviews the work of lower level experts. Job purpose
The Global Head of Commercial Operations is responsible for leading the commercial management of Sulzer’s global claims portfolio, driving strong commercial and customer outcomes across complex, high-value projects within the oil & gas, industrial, and energy sectors. This is a senior, strategic and operational role leading a team of commercial contract managers, ensuring robust contract interpretation, commercial positioning, and delivery of business objectives, whilst operating at the interface between customers, EPC partners, and internal stakeholders. jobs.title: Field Service Techniker im Außendienst (w/m/d)
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Als Field Service Techniker (m/w/d) sind Sie ein zentraler Ansprechpartner für unsere Kunden im Außendienst und sorgen für einen zuverlässigen Betrieb unserer Anlagen zur Wasser- und Abwasseraufbereitung. Sie übernehmen eigenverantwortlich Serviceeinsätze, Wartungen und Inbetriebnahmen direkt vor Ort und tragen maßgeblich zur hohen Servicequalität unseres Unternehmens bei. Freuen Sie sich auf eine abwechslungsreiche Tätigkeit mit viel technischer Verantwortung, direktem Kundenkontakt und modern ausgestatteten Arbeitsmitteln. Ihre Aufgaben

• Sicherstellung eines reibungslosen, kostenbewussten und kundenorientierten Serviceablaufs

• Durchführung von Serviceeinsätzen an Anlagen zur Aufbereitung von Wasser und Abwasser

• Austausch von Ersatz- und Verschleißteilen sowie Durchführung von Reparaturen, Sanierungen und Wartungsarbeiten direkt beim Kunden vor Ort

• Analyse und Behebung technischer Störungen

• Durchführung von Werkstatt- und Montagearbeiten

• Auf- und Abbau sowie Inbetriebnahme unserer Versuchsanlagen

• Erstellung von Analyseberichten sowie ausführlichen technischen Basisberichten

• Betreuung unserer Kunden inklusive Durchführung von Kundenschulungen

Ihr Profil

• Abgeschlossene technische Ausbildung, z. B. im Maschinenbau, in der Instandhaltung, Wassertechnik oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation

• Kenntnisse im E- und WIG-Schweißen von Vorteil

• Führerschein der Klasse B (ehemals Klasse 3)

• Hohe Reisebereitschaft im Rahmen der Außendiensttätigkeit

• Eigenverantwortliche, strukturierte und kostenbewusste Arbeitsweise

• Teamfähigkeit, Selbstständigkeit sowie Flexibilität

• Ausgeprägte Kommunikations- und Argumentationsstärke

• Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift, Englischkenntnisse wünschenswert

• Grundkenntnisse in MS Word und Excel sowie Erfahrung im Umgang mit Salesforce von Vorteil

What we offer you

• Eine sichere Position in einem modernen und zukunftsorientierten Unternehmen

• Ein angenehmes und kollegiales Betriebsklima

• Eine intensive Einarbeitung sowie regelmäßige Schulungen

• Hohe Eigenverantwortung und abwechslungsreiche Aufgaben

• Attraktive Sozialleistungen, z. B. betriebliche Altersvorsorge und Direktversicherungen

• Firmenfahrzeug (Werkstattwagen), Firmenhandy und Firmennotebook

• Einsatzmöglichkeit direkt vom Wohnort aus

• Vielfältige Weiter- und Fortbildungsmöglichkeiten

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: NX Customization Engineer
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Product Development Engineer is responsible for improving or developing new products, components, equipment, systems, technologies, or processes. This role ensures that research and design methodologies meet scientific and engineering standards and supports the organization in achieving technical, functional, and cost targets.
This job profile is intended for early-career professionals who apply broad theoretical knowledge and require the ability to investigate and analyze problems. Solutions are typically discussed/verified with a more senior member. Purpose of the job
The Engineering Tools Group has the responsibility to provide the global engineering departments with software solutions supporting engineering processes. To complete our team, we are looking for a motivated and committed NXOpen engineer for development of NX Tools applications.

Main tasks and responsibilities
1. Programs new and extends existing software in C#.net for generation of 3D models and 2D drawings on the NX Open Interface and follows an existing programming concept.
2. Analyses and debugs program errors up to final solution.
3. Documents and demonstrates solutions by developing documentation, code comments and clear code.
4. Updates job knowledge by studying NX related 3D development tools and programming techniques.
5. Maintains software by studying user needs, conferring with users, studying systems flow, data usage, and work processes.
6. Development follows the software development lifecycle.
Accomplishes engineering and organization mission by completing related tasks as needed

Qualifications/Experience and Knowledge Required

• Bachelor’s degree in mechanical engineering with a flair for software development

• Minimum 5 years of proven experience in mechanical engineering

• 3 years of experience in developing NXOpen applications using C#

• Experience in software design, programming, debugging, documentation and testing

• Exposure to Agile software development methodology and Azure DevOps is beneficial.

• Experience with 3D and 2D parametric CAD and expression handling

• Minimum 2 years of experience in surface modelling.

• Information analysis, structured problem solving, efficient communication and teamwork.

• Good English skills (written and verbal) required.

• Experience in Turbo Machinery Engineering or willingness to develop in this domain

What we offer you

Defined contribution pension scheme

Job Summary
The Mechanical Engineer is responsible for researching, planning, designing, and developing mechanical products and systems. This includes instruments, controls, engines, and machines used in energy production, transmission, and measurement.
This job profile is intended for early-career professionals who apply broad theoretical knowledge and require the ability to investigate and analyze problems. jobs.title: Supervisor(a) de Engenharia e Qualidade
Bilingual Manufacturing Manager
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

The Bilingual Manufacturing Manager/Supervisor is responsible for leading daily manufacturing operations at the Humble facility while driving safety, quality, delivery, productivity, and continuous improvement objectives. The role provides frontline leadership to production employees across fabrication, welding, machining, assembly, and related manufacturing activities while supporting regional collaboration, operational excellence initiatives, and customer commitments. The position partners closely with Engineering, Planning, Supply Chain, Quality, Maintenance, Project Management, and Operations teams across the Americas to improve throughput, optimize capacity utilization, reduce waste, strengthen execution, and support profitable growth. Essential Functions

• Lead daily manufacturing activities across fabrication, welding, machining, assembly, and related production work centers.

• Ensure compliance with safety requirements, quality standards, work instructions, and manufacturing procedures.

• Allocate labor and resources to support production schedules and customer delivery commitments.

• Monitor manufacturing performance and address issues affecting safety, quality, productivity, or delivery.

• Implement and sustain Lean Manufacturing practices including 5S, visual management, standard work, Kaizen, and waste reduction initiatives.

• Facilitate root cause analysis and corrective actions related to scrap, rework, downtime, bottlenecks, and schedule misses.

• Partner with Maintenance to improve equipment reliability through TPM, preventive maintenance, and downtime reduction programs.

• Support capacity planning, labor utilization, backlog management, and workload balancing activities.

• Develop employee capability through training, coaching, cross-training, and skills matrix development.

• Collaborate with manufacturing, engineering, planning, and supply chain teams across the Americas to share best practices and support regional performance improvement.

• Partner with Project Management, Customer Service, and Sales teams to ensure manufacturing priorities align with customer requirements and project commitments.

• Support implementation of operational excellence initiatives, process improvements, and productivity enhancement programs.
Qualifications

• Technical degree, Associate degree, Bachelor degree, or equivalent manufacturing experience required.

• Minimum 5 years of manufacturing experience in fabrication, welding, assembly, machining, or industrial operations.

• Previous supervisory or team leadership experience required.

• Experience applying Lean Manufacturing principles and continuous improvement methodologies.

• Strong problem-solving, communication, coaching, and organizational skills.

• Experience interpreting manufacturing drawings, production metrics, and operational data.

• Bilingual in Spanish and English

• Experience working with ERP systems such as SAP, IFS, or equivalent preferred.

• Lean Six Sigma Green Belt, TPM, OEE, or other operational excellence certifications preferred.

What we offer you

• 15 days of paid time off and 12 company-paid holidays

• 401k plan with a 6% match

• Comprehensive health plan including medical, dental, vision, Life, short-term & long-term disability

• Health savings account matching

• Motivating wellness program

• Employee Assistance Program

• Paid paternal leave

• Gym reimbursement

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sulzer è una società di ingegneria leader con un patrimonio orgoglioso di innovazione. Unisciti al nostro team globale per accrescere le tue competenze e sviluppare soluzioni innovative che consentano una società prospera e più sostenibile.

Informazioni sul ruolo

Il Manufacturing Supervisor è responsabile delle principali operazioni di produzione giornaliere presso la struttura Humble, mentre guida obiettivi di sicurezza, qualità, consegna, produttività e miglioramento continuo. Il ruolo fornisce la leadership di prima linea ai dipendenti di produzione attraverso la fabbricazione, la saldatura, la lavorazione, l'assemblaggio e le relative attività di produzione, supportando la collaborazione regionale, le iniziative di eccellenza operativa e gli impegni dei clienti. La posizione collabora strettamente con i team Engineering, Planning, Supply Chain, Quality, Maintenance, Project Management e Operations in tutte le Americhe per migliorare il throughput, ottimizzare l'utilizzo delle capacità, ridurre i rifiuti, rafforzare l'esecuzione e sostenere la crescita redditizia. Funzioni essenziali

• Condurre attività di produzione quotidiana attraverso la fabbricazione, la saldatura, la lavorazione, l'assemblaggio e i relativi centri di lavoro di produzione.

• Assicurare il rispetto dei requisiti di sicurezza, standard di qualità, istruzioni di lavoro e procedure di produzione.

• Allocare il lavoro e le risorse per sostenere i programmi di produzione e gli impegni di consegna del cliente.

• Monitorare le prestazioni e le problematiche relative alla sicurezza, qualità, produttività o consegna.

• Implementare e sostenere le pratiche di Lean Manufacturing tra cui 5S, gestione visiva, lavoro standard, Kaizen e iniziative di riduzione dei rifiuti.

• Facilitate l'analisi delle cause della radice e le azioni correttive relative a rottami, rielaborazione, downtime, strozzature, e il programma manca.

• Partner con Manutenzione per migliorare l'affidabilità delle apparecchiature tramite TPM, manutenzione preventiva e programmi di riduzione dei tempi di fermo.

• Pianificazione della capacità di supporto, utilizzo del lavoro, gestione del backlog e attività di bilanciamento del carico di lavoro.

• Sviluppare la capacità dei dipendenti attraverso formazione, coaching, cross-training e sviluppo di matrice di competenze.

• Collabora con team di produzione, ingegneria, pianificazione e supply chain in tutte le Americhe per condividere le migliori pratiche e sostenere il miglioramento delle prestazioni regionali.

• Partner con i team di Project Management, Customer Service e Sales per garantire le priorità di produzione in linea con i requisiti del cliente e gli impegni del progetto.

• Supporta l'implementazione di iniziative di eccellenza operativa, miglioramenti dei processi e programmi di miglioramento della produttività.
Qualifiche

• Grado tecnico, grado associato, laurea o esperienza di produzione equivalente richiesto.

• Minimo 5 anni di esperienza nella fabbricazione, saldatura, assemblaggio, lavorazione o operazioni industriali.

• Precedente supervisione o esperienza di leadership del team richiesto.

• Esperienza di applicazione dei principi di Lean Manufacturing e metodi di miglioramento continuo.

• Forte problem solving, comunicazione, coaching e capacità organizzative.

• Esperienza interpretando disegni di produzione, metriche di produzione e dati operativi.

• bilingue in spagnolo e inglese

• Esperienza di lavoro con sistemi ERP come SAP, IFS o equivalente preferito.

• Lean Six Sigma Green Belt, TPM, OEE o altre certificazioni di eccellenza operative preferite.

Cosa ti offriamo

descriptionByLocale.en:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

The Bilingual Manufacturing Manager/Supervisor is responsible for leading daily manufacturing operations at the Humble facility while driving safety, quality, delivery, productivity, and continuous improvement objectives. The role provides frontline leadership to production employees across fabrication, welding, machining, assembly, and related manufacturing activities while supporting regional collaboration, operational excellence initiatives, and customer commitments. The position partners closely with Engineering, Planning, Supply Chain, Quality, Maintenance, Project Management, and Operations teams across the Americas to improve throughput, optimize capacity utilization, reduce waste, strengthen execution, and support profitable growth. Essential Functions

• Lead daily manufacturing activities across fabrication, welding, machining, assembly, and related production work centers.

• Ensure compliance with safety requirements, quality standards, work instructions, and manufacturing procedures.

• Allocate labor and resources to support production schedules and customer delivery commitments.

• Monitor manufacturing performance and address issues affecting safety, quality, productivity, or delivery.

• Implement and sustain Lean Manufacturing practices including 5S, visual management, standard work, Kaizen, and waste reduction initiatives.

• Facilitate root cause analysis and corrective actions related to scrap, rework, downtime, bottlenecks, and schedule misses.

• Partner with Maintenance to improve equipment reliability through TPM, preventive maintenance, and downtime reduction programs.

• Support capacity planning, labor utilization, backlog management, and workload balancing activities.

• Develop employee capability through training, coaching, cross-training, and skills matrix development.

• Collaborate with manufacturing, engineering, planning, and supply chain teams across the Americas to share best practices and support regional performance improvement.

• Partner with Project Management, Customer Service, and Sales teams to ensure manufacturing priorities align with customer requirements and project commitments.

• Support implementation of operational excellence initiatives, process improvements, and productivity enhancement programs.
Qualifications

• Technical degree, Associate degree, Bachelor degree, or equivalent manufacturing experience required.

• Minimum 5 years of manufacturing experience in fabrication, welding, assembly, machining, or industrial operations.

• Previous supervisory or team leadership experience required.

• Experience applying Lean Manufacturing principles and continuous improvement methodologies.

• Strong problem-solving, communication, coaching, and organizational skills.

• Experience interpreting manufacturing drawings, production metrics, and operational data.

• Bilingual in Spanish and English

• Experience working with ERP systems such as SAP, IFS, or equivalent preferred.

• Lean Six Sigma Green Belt, TPM, OEE, or other operational excellence certifications preferred.

What we offer you

• 15 days of paid time off and 12 company-paid holidays

• 401k plan with a 6% match

• Comprehensive health plan including medical, dental, vision, Life, short-term & long-term disability

• Health savings account matching

• Motivating wellness program

• Employee Assistance Program

• Paid paternal leave

• Gym reimbursement

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.
descriptionByLocale.de:
Sulzer ist ein führendes Ingenieurunternehmen mit einem stolzen Erbe an Innovationen. Schließen Sie sich unserem globalen Team an, um Ihr Fachwissen zu erweitern und innovative Lösungen zu entwickeln, die eine prosperierende und nachhaltigere Gesellschaft ermöglichen.

Über die Rolle

Der Manufacturing Supervisor ist für die Leitung des täglichen Fertigungsbetriebs in der Humble-Anlage verantwortlich und verfolgt gleichzeitig die Ziele für Sicherheit, Qualität, Lieferung, Produktivität und kontinuierliche Verbesserung. Die Rolle bietet Produktionsmitarbeitern eine Vorreiterrolle bei Fertigungs-, Schweiß-, Bearbeitungs-, Montage- und verwandten Fertigungsaktivitäten und unterstützt gleichzeitig die regionale Zusammenarbeit, operative Exzellenzinitiativen und Kundenverpflichtungen. Die Position arbeitet eng mit Engineering, Planning, Supply Chain, Quality, Maintenance, Project Management und Operations Teams in ganz Amerika zusammen, um den Durchsatz zu verbessern, die Kapazitätsauslastung zu optimieren, Abfall zu reduzieren, die Ausführung zu stärken und profitables Wachstum zu unterstützen. Wesentliche Funktionen

• Führen Sie die täglichen Fertigungsaktivitäten in Fertigungs-, Schweiß-, Bearbeitungs-, Montage- und verwandten Produktionszentren.

• Gewährleistung der Einhaltung von Sicherheitsanforderungen, Qualitätsstandards, Arbeitsanweisungen und Herstellungsverfahren.

• Weisen Sie Arbeit und Ressourcen zu, um Produktionspläne und Kundenlieferverpflichtungen zu unterstützen.

• Überwachen Sie die Produktionsleistung und behandeln Sie Probleme mit Auswirkungen auf Sicherheit, Qualität, Produktivität oder Lieferung.

• Implementierung und Aufrechterhaltung von Lean Manufacturing-Praktiken, einschließlich 5S, Visual Management, Standardarbeit, Kaizen und Initiativen zur Abfallreduzierung.

• Erleichtern Sie die Ursachenanalyse und Korrekturmaßnahmen im Zusammenhang mit Ausschuss, Nacharbeit, Ausfallzeiten, Engpässen und Fehlzeiten.

• Partnerschaft mit Maintenance zur Verbesserung der Zuverlässigkeit der Ausrüstung durch TPM, präventive Wartung und Programme zur Reduzierung der Ausfallzeiten.

• Unterstützung von Kapazitätsplanung, Arbeitsauslastung, Backlog-Management und Workload-Balancing-Aktivitäten.

• Entwicklung der Mitarbeiterfähigkeit durch Schulungen, Coaching, Cross-Training und Entwicklung von Kompetenzen Matrix.

• Arbeiten Sie mit Fertigungs-, Engineering-, Planungs- und Lieferkettenteams in ganz Amerika zusammen, um Best Practices auszutauschen und regionale Leistungsverbesserungen zu unterstützen.

• Zusammenarbeit mit Projektmanagement-, Kundenservice- und Vertriebsteams, um sicherzustellen, dass die Fertigungsprioritäten mit den Kundenanforderungen und den Projektverpflichtungen übereinstimmen.

• Unterstützung der Umsetzung von Operational Excellence-Initiativen, Prozessverbesserungen und Produktivitätssteigerungsprogrammen.
Qualifikationen

• Technischer Abschluss, Associate Degree, Bachelor-Abschluss oder gleichwertige Fertigungserfahrung erforderlich.

• Mindestens 5 Jahre Fertigungserfahrung in Fertigung, Schweißen, Montage, Bearbeitung oder Industriebetrieb.

• Vorherige Aufsichts- oder Teamführungserfahrung erforderlich.

• Erfahrung in der Anwendung von Lean Manufacturing-Prinzipien und kontinuierlichen Verbesserungsmethoden.

• Starke Problemlösung, Kommunikation, Coaching und organisatorische Fähigkeiten.

• Erfahrung in der Interpretation von Fertigungszeichnungen, Produktionsmetriken und Betriebsdaten.

• Bilingual in Spanisch und Englisch

• Erfahrung in der Arbeit mit ERP-Systemen wie SAP, IFS oder gleichwertigen Systemen bevorzugt.

• Lean Six Sigma Green Belt, TPM, OEE oder andere betriebliche Exzellenz-Zertifizierungen bevorzugt.

Was wir Ihnen bieten

• 15 Tage bezahlte Freizeit und 12 bezahlte Firmenferien

• 401k Plan mit einem 6% Match

• Umfassender Gesundheitsplan einschließlich medizinischer, zahnärztlicher, Sehkraft, Leben, kurzfristige und langfristige Behinderung

• Matching des Sparkontos

• Motivierendes Wellnessprogramm

• Mitarbeiterunterstützungsprogramm

• Bezahlter Vaterschaftsurlaub

• Gymnastikerstattung

Sulzer ist ein Arbeitgeber für Chancengleichheit. Wir glauben an die Stärke einer vielfältigen Belegschaft und engagieren uns für ein integratives Arbeitsumfeld.

Wir sind stolz darauf, als Top Employer 2026 in Brasilien, Kanada, China, Finnland, Deutschland, Irland, Mexiko, der Schweiz, Südafrika, Großbritannien und den USA anerkannt zu werden.
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Sulzer est une entreprise d'ingénierie de premier plan avec un fier héritage d'innovation. Rejoignez notre équipe mondiale pour développer votre expertise et développer des solutions innovantes qui permettent une société prospère et plus durable.

Sur le rôle

Le superviseur de la fabrication est responsable de diriger les opérations quotidiennes de fabrication à l'installation Humble tout en conduisant des objectifs de sécurité, de qualité, de livraison, de productivité et d'amélioration continue. Ce rôle fournit un leadership de première ligne aux employés de production dans les activités de fabrication, de soudage, d'usinage, d'assemblage et de fabrication connexes, tout en appuyant la collaboration régionale, les initiatives d'excellence opérationnelle et les engagements des clients. Le poste s'associe étroitement avec les équipes d'ingénierie, de planification, de chaîne d'approvisionnement, de qualité, d'entretien, de gestion de projet et d'exploitation des Amériques pour améliorer le rendement, optimiser l'utilisation des capacités, réduire les déchets, renforcer l'exécution et soutenir une croissance rentable. Fonctions essentielles

• Diriger les activités quotidiennes de fabrication à travers la fabrication, le soudage, l'usinage, le montage et les centres de production connexes.

• Assurer le respect des exigences de sécurité, des normes de qualité, des instructions de travail et des procédures de fabrication.

• Allouer du travail et des ressources pour soutenir les calendriers de production et les engagements de livraison des clients.

• Surveiller la performance de la fabrication et régler les problèmes de sécurité, de qualité, de productivité ou de livraison.

• Mettre en oeuvre et maintenir les pratiques de fabrication de lean, y compris la 5S, la gestion visuelle, le travail standard, Kaizen et les initiatives de réduction des déchets.

• Faciliter l'analyse des causes profondes et les mesures correctives liées à la ferraille, au retravail, aux temps d'arrêt, aux goulets d'étranglement et aux retards dans le calendrier.

• Partenaire avec Maintenance pour améliorer la fiabilité de l'équipement grâce à des programmes de MPT, de maintenance préventive et de réduction des temps d'arrêt.

• Appuyer les activités de planification des capacités, d'utilisation de la main-d'oeuvre, de gestion des arriérés et d'équilibrage de la charge de travail.

• Développer la capacité des employés par la formation, l'encadrement, la formation croisée et l'élaboration de matrices de compétences.

• Collaborer avec des équipes de fabrication, d'ingénierie, de planification et de chaîne d'approvisionnement partout dans les Amériques pour partager les pratiques exemplaires et appuyer l'amélioration du rendement régional.

• Partenaire avec les équipes de gestion de projet, de service à la clientèle et de vente pour s'assurer que les priorités de fabrication correspondent aux exigences du client et aux engagements du projet.

• Appuyer la mise en oeuvre d'initiatives d'excellence opérationnelle, d'amélioration des processus et de programmes d'amélioration de la productivité.
Compétences

• Diplôme technique, diplôme associé, baccalauréat ou expérience de fabrication équivalente requis.

• Au moins 5 ans d'expérience dans la fabrication, le soudage, l'assemblage, l'usinage ou les opérations industrielles.

• Expérience préalable en supervision ou en leadership d'équipe requise.

• Expérience de l'application des principes de la fabrication du plomb et des méthodes d'amélioration continue.

• Forte capacité de résolution de problèmes, de communication, de coaching et d'organisation.

• Expérience de l'interprétation des dessins de fabrication, des paramètres de production et des données opérationnelles.

• Bilingue en espagnol et anglais

• Expérience de travail avec les systèmes ERP tels que SAP, IFS, ou équivalent préféré.

• Lean Six Sigma Green Belt, TPM, OEE, ou d'autres certifications d'excellence opérationnelle préférées.

Ce que nous vous offrons

• 15 jours de congé payé et 12 jours fériés payés par l'entreprise

• Plan 401k avec un match de 6%

• Plan de santé global incluant les soins médicaux, dentaires, la vision, la vie, l'invalidité de courte et de longue durée

• Correspondance du compte d'épargne santé

• Programme de bien-être

• Programme d'aide aux employés

• Congé parental payé

• Remboursement des frais de gymnastique

Sulzer est un employeur à chances égales. Nous croyons en la force d'un effectif diversifié et sommes déterminés à offrir un milieu de travail inclusif.

Nous sommes fiers d'être reconnus comme l'un des meilleurs employeurs 2026 au Brésil, au Canada, en Chine, en Finlande, en Allemagne, en Irlande, au Mexique, en Suisse, en Afrique du Sud, au Royaume-Uni et aux États-Unis.

jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Sales Engineering Specialist supports the sales process by providing technical expertise and helping customers understand how products meet their needs. This role bridges the gap between engineering and sales, ensuring technical accuracy and customer satisfaction.
This job profile is intended for professionals who apply advanced knowledge of a job area. Required to manage projects / processes independently with limited supervision. Typically coaches and reviews the work of lower level professionals. Responsabilidades:

• Responsable de realizar presentaciones a los clientes con el fin de asesorar, formar y promocionar nuestros productos y servicios, relacionados con los procesos de tratamiento de aguas residuales urbanas e industriales (bombas y mixers sumergibles, aireadores, trituradoras, tamices, decantadores, filtros).

• Trabajar de manera multidisciplinaria con los otros departamentos para preparar planes de ventas y ofertas, garantizando la precisión técnica y financiera.

• Trabajar con el equipo de ventas en general para identificar y desarrollar nuevas oportunidades de mercado.

• Establecer y mantener relaciones efectivas con los clientes, comprender sus necesidades y promover la comprensión por parte del cliente de nuestra oferta de productos, sistemas y/o servicios.

• Crear valor agregado para el cliente y, a continuación, alinearse para ofrecer una solución, garantizando una experiencia positiva para el cliente.

• Preparar planes de ventas y realizar revisiones periódicas de la situación para mantener los volúmenes de pedidos, y gestionar los procesos administrativos de ventas.

• Promocionar activamente todo el portafolio de productos Sulzer en los mercados asignados.

• Alcanzar o superar los objetivos de venta acordados para el segmento o región.

• Desarrollar e implementar estrategias comerciales consistentes con los objetivos de Sulzer.

• Preparar y acompañar activamente las ofertas para los clientes en las regiones y segmentos asignados.

• Responsable por la proyección precisa de ventas para su región y cuentas relacionadas.

• Revisar órdenes de compra, contratos, términos y condiciones para las cuentas y clientes asignados.

• Preparación de ofertas en coordinación con el departamento de ofertas y propuestas, garantizando que se cumplen los aspectos técnicos y financieros adecuados, incluidos los precios y las condiciones comerciales.

• Visitas constantes a los clientes para desarrollo de nuevos mercados.

• Visitas con clientes importantes y buscar prospectos potenciales.

Requisitos:

• Mínimo 5 años de experiencia como ingeniero de ventas y/o ingeniero de aplicaciones en el área de gestión de agua urbana y/o industrial.

• Titulado en ingeniería industrial, mecánica, hidráulica o afín.

• Experiencia en ventas directas e indirectas a clientes industriales.

• Conocimientos sobre procesos de tratamiento de aguas residuales urbanas e industriales, bombas centrífugas y motores eléctricos.

• Cartera de clientes/relaciones existentes en los mercados de industrias y aguas municipales, incluyendo O&M, EPC, empresas de ingeniería y usuarios finales

• Disponibilidad para viajes (50% del tiempo)

• Dominio de Microsoft Office (Excel) y Sales Force.

• Manejo de inglés intermedio.

• Buenas habilidades de comunicación.

• Capacidad para trabajar de forma independiente.

• Proactivo.

• Motivado, con un historial demostrado de obtención de resultados por encima de los objetivos y las expectativas.

What we offer you

Beneficios:

• Salario y prestaciones acordes con el mercado.

• Bonificación anual basada en los objetivos corporativos y personales.

• Seguro médico y dental.

jobs.title: Area Sales Manager
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary

This role is responsible for driving sales growth, expanding the Sulzer installed base, and delivering innovative service solutions that create long-term value for our customers.

This role supports the execution of sales strategies and provides coaching and development to team members.

We are seeking an experienced and results-driven Sales Manager to lead and develop our sales team, drive revenue growth, and expand market share for Sulzer Pumps in South Africa. The successful candidate will be responsible for setting sales targets, formulating sales strategies, and fostering strong customer relationships within the industrial pump sector.

Job Responsibilities**

* Develop and implement strategic sales plans to achieve company objectives and expand Sulzer Pumps' customer base in South Africa.
* Lead, mentor, and motivate a team of sales professionals, providing guidance, training, and performance evaluations.
* Establish and maintain strong, long-lasting customer relationships, understanding their needs and offering tailored pump solutions.
* Identify new business opportunities and market segments for growth.
* Prepare and present compelling sales proposals, negotiate contracts, and close deals effectively.
* Monitor market trends, competitor activities, and customer feedback to adapt sales strategies accordingly.
* Collaborate closely with engineering, service, and marketing teams to ensure customer satisfaction and seamless project execution.
* Prepare regular sales forecasts, reports, and budgets for management review.
* Ensure compliance with all company policies, procedures, and ethical standards.
* Represent Sulzer Pumps at industry events, trade shows, and conferences.

Job Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Business Administration, or a related technical field.
* Minimum of 7-10 years of progressive experience in sales, with at least 3-5 years in a sales management role, preferably within the industrial pumps, rotating equipment, or heavy machinery sector.
* Proven track record of consistently meeting or exceeding sales targets and driving revenue growth.
* Strong leadership and team management skills, with the ability to inspire and develop a high-performing sales team.
* Excellent negotiation, presentation, and communication skills (both written and verbal).
* In-depth knowledge of the South African industrial market and customer base.
* Technical understanding of centrifugal pumps, positive displacement pumps, and related fluid dynamics principles.
* Proficiency in CRM software (e.g., Salesforce) and Microsoft Office Suite.
* Valid driver's license and willingness to travel extensively within South Africa.

Apply now
If you are a motivated sales professional with a passion for engineering solutions, customer engagement, and business growth, we invite you to apply and become part of Sulzer's success story.

What we offer you

-

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: RE/QC Technician
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Senior Product Quality Control Inspector ensures that product quality specifications comply with corporate and customer standards. This role supports the implementation of QA/QC policies and oversees product assessments and vendor evaluations.
This job profile is intended for support-level staff that generally works autonomously and only requires closer supervision in non-routine situations. Quality Control Inspector
Business Unit: Sulzer Turbo Services, Houston, Inc.
Department: Core
Reports to: Manufacturing Drafting / QC Manager

Shift: Day Shift and Occasional Weekends

Company Overview:
Sulzer Turbo Services (STS) is an independent provider of services and repairs of critical turbomachinery. We specialize in the repair, overhaul, and replacement of parts for high-speed rotating equipment such as steam and gas turbines, compressors, expanders, and other industrial rotating equipment found primarily in the Oil & Gas, Pipeline, Petrochemical, Ammonia, Nitric Acid, Fertilizer and Power Generation markets.
Position Summary
Provide inspection support to the quality control department
Responsibilities

• Inspecting new parts with a wide range of metrology equipment (Micrometers, CMM, ATOS blue light scanning, ect.)

• Operating quality control hardware and software programs.

• Evaluating inspection results per manufacturing/repair drawings.

• Returning rejected parts to appropriate shop members.

• Providing feedback to improve department processes.

• Support the drafting department with instructions as needed.
Qualifications:
The ideal candidate will possess the following:

• Have exposure to precision hand tools (micrometers, calipers, height gauges, depth gauges, etc.)

• Have been exposed to, or willing to learn digital equipment like CMM

• Make logical decisions and provide inspection feedback to the machinists

• Be proactive and solution oriented

• Be familiar with CAD and component drawings

• Be familiar with GDT per ASME Y14.5M-2009.

• Have clear communication, both written and oral.

• Be able to work independently in a fast-paced environment.

What we offer you

• 12 Paid Holidays

• 15 Paid Time Off (PTO) Days

• Medical, dental, vision, life & disability

• 401K with 6% company match

• Employee Assistance Program

• Employee Wellness Program

• New onsite cafeteria, all meals subsidized (La Porte Service Center)

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Area Sales Manager
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

The Area Sales Manager (ASM) is the primary external representative of Sulzer to our clients. The ASM is assigned a geographic or product specific sales area and is financially responsible for the Order Intake (OI), Gross Profit Margin (GPM) and Operating Net Cash-Flow (ONCF) of the assigned areas budget for the company. The ASM finds and develops sales opportunities and engages with clients on these thru closure of orders, and until projects have been completed within Sulzer. The ASM will take direction from and meet or exceed sales targets set by the RSM. In this role, the ASM will properly and proactively represent Sulzer to our clients. ASMs engage clients and are expected to be role models for the company within our larger Sulzer community. The ASM will work closely with other Sulzer Turbo teams to include: Inside Sales, Business Process, Operations, Engineering, Finance, QC, Safety and HR to secure, ship and invoice profitable orders. As a Sales Leader, the ASM will also understand, engage with, promote and represent Sulzer’s RES businesses (Pumps and EMS) to provide a full complement of RES Services to the region. ASM Responsibilities

• Meet or exceed the Order Intake budget for the assigned area/product line

• Develop, sell and maintain all business responsibility for the assigned area/product line

• Develop and implement sales strategies consistent with the goals of Sulzer

• Plan, support and monitor sales activity within the area/product line

• Develop and deliver technically and commercially superior proposals to the client

• Support all business activities with the client thru closing and invoicing

• Develop, maintain and report accurate sales forecasts

• Review RFPs, contracts, POs and terms for all business opportunities

• Control all business expenses as if they were your own

• Be proficient with and maintain Salesforce: opportunities, outage tracking and market condition events, trip call reports and competition updates

• Coordinate, plan, attend and execute promotional trade shows events

• Participate in quarterly sales calls or meetings with the management team

• This position requires and expects frequent travel into the area assigned.

• Support Sulzer strategic initiatives on safety, business, ethics and quality.

• Present a positive, proactive, professional attitude and appearance at all times.

ASM Qualifications:

• High personal standards of character. Must have impeccable moral and ethical behavior.

• Bachelor’s Degree in Engineering or Business is preferred. In lieu of this, the candidate will have at least 5 years of industry knowledge and experience with Turbomachinery.

• Previously experience of pro-actively influencing or closing business with clients, co-workers and/or commercial peers.

• Commercial and technical knowledge and abilities to perform the external sales position.

• In-depth knowledge of turbomachinery and Sulzer’s complete product line

• Must be able to understand, interpret and discuss technical and commercial documents.

• Strong verbal and written communication skills and the ability to read, write and discuss micro details and macro situations, as well as the inter-personal skills to interface with personnel from diverse backgrounds at all levels of our clients organization.

• A willingness to travel frequently and bring business back as a result.

• The ASM is a leadership position that requires strong organizational skills and the ability to prioritize and manage multiple projects simultaneously as well as the ability to willingly work with demanding deadlines

• This position requires and demands exceptional time management skills

• Understanding of basic financial statements

• Proficiency at or the ability to quickly learn how to u

Informazioni sul ruolo

L'Area Sales Manager (ASM) è il principale rappresentante esterno di Sulzer ai nostri clienti. L'ASM è assegnato un'area di vendita geografica o specifica per prodotto ed è finanziariamente responsabile per l'Approfittazione degli ordini (OI), il Margine di Profitto Lordo (GPM) e il Risultato Operativo Netto Cash-Flow (ONCF) delle aree assegnate budget per l'azienda. L'ASM trova e sviluppa opportunità di vendita e si impegna con i clienti su queste attraverso la chiusura degli ordini, e fino a quando i progetti sono stati completati all'interno di Sulzer.
