Sulzer ist ein führendes Ingenieurunternehmen mit einem stolzen Innovationserbe. Steigern Sie mit unserem globalen Team Ihre Expertise aus und entwickeln Sie innovative Lösungen, die eine wohlhabende und nachhaltigere Gesellschaft ermöglichen.

Über die Rolle

Der Area Sales Manager (ASM) ist der primäre externe Vertreter von Sulzer bei unseren Kunden. Dem ASM wird ein geografisches oder produktspezifisches Vertriebsgebiet zugewiesen und ist finanziell für die Auftragseingangs- (OI), Bruttogewinnmarge (GPM) und Operating Net Cash-Flow (ONCF) der zugewiesenen Bereiche für das Unternehmen verantwortlich. Das ASM findet und entwickelt Vertriebsmöglichkeiten und engagiert sich mit Kunden bei dieser Abwicklung von Aufträgen und bis zu dem Abschluss von Projekten innerhalb Sulzers. Das ASM wird die von der RSM festgelegten Umsatzziele verfolgen und erfüllen oder übertreffen.

In dieser Funktion wird die ASM Sulzer bei unseren Kunden korrekt und proaktiv vertreten. ASMs engagieren sich für Kunden und werden voraussichtlich Vorbilder für das Unternehmen in unserer größeren Sulzer-Gemeinschaft sein. ASM wird eng mit anderen Sulzer Turbo-Teams zusammenarbeiten, um folgende Bereiche zu berücksichtigen: Inside Sales, Business Process, Operations, Engineering, Finance, QC, Safety und HR, um profitable Aufträge zu sichern, zu versenden und zu rechen. Als Vertriebsleiter wird die ASM auch die RES-Geschäfte (Pumps und EMS) von Sulzer verstehen, mit ihnen in Kontakt treten, fördern und vertreten, um eine vollständige Ergänzung der RES-Dienstleistungen in der Region zu bieten.

ASM-Verantwortlichkeiten

- Entwickeln, verkaufen und behalten Sie alle Geschäftsverantwortung für die zugewiesene Fläche / Produktlinie - Entwickeln und implementieren Sie Verkaufsstrategien im Einklang mit den Zielen von Sulzer - Planen, unterstützen und überwachen Sie die Vertriebsaktivitäten innerhalb der Fläche / Produktlinie - Entwickeln und liefern Sie technisch und kommerziell überlegene Vorschläge für den Kunden - Unterstützen Sie alle Geschäftsaktivitäten mit dem Kunden durch Abschluss und Rechnungsstellung - Entwickeln, pflegen und melden Sie genaue Umsatzprognosen - Überprüfen Sie RFPs, Verträge, POs und Bedingungen für alle Unternehmen

Möglichkeiten - Steuern Sie alle Geschäftskosten, als ob sie Ihre eigenen wären - Befähigen Sie sich mit und pflegen Salesforce: Chancen, Ausfälle Tracking und Marktbedingungen Ereignisse, Trip Call Reports und Wettbewerbs-Updates - Koordination, planen, teilnehmen und durchführen Werbe-Messeveranstaltungen - Nehmen Sie an vierteljährlichen Verkaufsanrufe oder Sitzungen mit dem Management-Team - Diese Position erfordert und erwartet häufige Reisen in die zugewiesene Fläche.

- Unterstützung von strategischen Initiativen von Sulzer in den Bereichen Sicherheit, Wirtschaft, Ethik und Qualität. - Präsentieren Sie eine positive, proaktive, professionelle Haltung und den Auftritt zu jeder Zeit.

ASM-Qualifikationen:

- Hohe persönliche Standards des Charakters. Muss einwandfreie moralische und ethische Verhalten. - Bachelor,s Abschluss in Engineering oder Business wird bevorzugt. Stattdessen wird der Kandidat mindestens 5 Jahre Branchenwissen und Erfahrung mit Turbomaschinen haben. - Frühere Erfahrung der proaktiv beeinflussen oder schließen Geschäft mit Kunden, Mitarbeiter und / oder kommerziellen Peers. - Kommerzielle und technische Kenntnisse und Fähigkeiten, um die externe Verkaufsposition zu erfüllen.

- Ausführliche Kenntnisse der Turbomaschinen und Sulzer, komplette Produktlinie - Muss in der Lage sein, technische und kommerzielle Dokumente zu verstehen, zu interpretieren und zu diskutieren. - Starke mündliche und schriftliche Kommunikationsfähigkeiten und die Fähigkeit, Mikrodetails und Makrosituationen zu lesen, zu schreiben und zu diskutieren, sowie die zwischenmenschlichen Fähigkeiten, um mit Personal aus unterschiedlichen Hintergründen auf allen Ebenen unserer Kundenorganisation zu interagieren. - Bereitschaft, häufig zu reisen und das Geschäft als Ergebnis zurück zu bringen.

- Die ASM ist eine Führungsposition, die starke organisatorische Fähigkeiten und die Fähigkeit erfordert, mehrere Projekte gleichzeitig zu priorisieren und zu verwalten sowie die Fähigkeit, bereitwillig mit anspruchsvollen Fristen zu arbeiten - Diese Position erfordert und fordert außergewöhnliche Zeitmanagement-Fähigkeiten - Verständnis der grundlegenden Abschlüsse - Kompetenz oder die Fähigkeit, schnell lernen, wie man u

Sur le rôle

Le directeur des ventes de secteur (ASM) est le principal représentant externe de Sulzer auprès de nos clients. Le gestionnaire des ventes de secteur (ASM) est affecté à une zone de vente géographique ou spécifique au produit et est responsable financièrement de l'acquisition de commande (OI), de la marge brute de profit (GPM) et du budget de trésorerie nette d'exploitation (ONCF) des zones attribuées à l'entreprise.

Dans ce rôle, l'ASM représentera adéquatement et proactifment Sulzer auprès de nos clients. Les ASM engagent les clients et sont censés être des modèles pour l'entreprise au sein de notre communauté Sulzer. L'ASM travaillera en étroite collaboration avec d'autres équipes Sulzer Turbo pour inclure: Ventes intérieures, Processus d'affaires, Opérations, Ingénierie, Finance, QC, Sécurité et RH pour sécuriser, expédier et facturer des commandes rentables.

Responsabilités de l'ASM

- Respecter ou dépasser le budget de prise de commande pour la zone ou la gamme de produits assignés - Élaborer, vendre et maintenir toute la responsabilité opérationnelle pour la zone ou la gamme de produits assignés - Élaborer et mettre en oeuvre des stratégies de vente conformes aux objectifs de Sulzer - Planifier, appuyer et surveiller les activités de vente dans la zone ou la gamme de produits - Élaborer et livrer des propositions techniquement et commercialement supérieures au client - Appuyer toutes les activités commerciales avec le client en fermant et en invocant - Élaborer, maintenir et rendre compte de prévisions de vente exactes - Examiner les DP, les contrats, les OP et les modalités de toutes les activités

occasions - Contrôler toutes les dépenses d'affaires comme si elles étaient les vôtres - Être compétent avec et maintenir Salesforce : occasions, suivi des pannes et des événements de l'état du marché, rapports d'appels de voyage et mises à jour de la concurrence - Coordonner, planifier, assister et exécuter des événements promotionnels - Participer à des appels de vente trimestriels ou des réunions avec l'équipe de gestion - Ce poste exige et s'attend à des voyages fréquents dans la zone affectée.

- Soutenir les initiatives stratégiques de Sulzer en matière de sécurité, d'affaires, d'éthique et de qualité. - Présenter une attitude positive, proactive, professionnelle et d'apparence en tout temps.

Qualifications ASM :

jobs.title: Motor Control Design Engineer
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Sr. Design Engineer is responsible for the design, construction, maintenance, and repair of plant buildings and machinery. This role ensures that engineering solutions meet operational, safety, and environmental standards while supporting continuous improvement in plant infrastructure and equipment.
This job profile is intended for experienced professionals who apply practical knowledge of a job area and work independently with general supervision. Position Summary:
This position operates within the Order Related Engineering (ORE) department and is responsible for designing Sales Order specific motor control electrical schematics and entering the associated bill of material (BOM) into the ERP system. This position closely works with Project Engineer to support the submittal package and provide electrical expertise to the customers. Upon approval of the submittal package, this position is accountable for generating part numbers in the ERP system and releasing the finalized package to production. Furthermore, this position provides electrical engineering expertise to Tendering and Operations by reviewing project specifications and offering recommendations

Principal Duties and Responsibilities:

• Review project scope and specifications. Collaborate with Mechanical Engineer to organize hand-off meetings as necessary to ensure alignment and clarity.

• Design motor control electrical schematics to support production sales orders by reading and understanding specifications, quotes, purchase orders, or company scope worksheets.

• Enter parts and create assemblies of the motor control designs in the ERP system for procurement and production electrical assembly.

• Support Project Engineer with motor control design documentation required for sales order submittal packages.

• Check sales order specific electrical schematics (Drawings and BOM) created by other team members in ORE.

• Provides electrical review of specifications for Tendering, as assigned by ORE Manager.

• Provides electrical review and support to other departments, as assigned by ORE Manager

• Provide electrical support to field service technicians during installation and acceptance of products.

• Perform additional duties and participate in special projects as assigned.

Education & Experience:
Required:
Associate’s degree in electrical design with 5+ years of experience in motor control design.

Desired:
Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering with 2+ years of experience in motor control design.

Skills:
Required:

• CAD Experience in electrical schematic design

• ERP System Experience

• Ability to use technology and analysis tools (Excel, Outlook, web, databases).

Desired: AutoCAD Electrical and Vault
Knowledge of NEC Code

Decision Authority:
Accountability: Position is accountable for ensuring the accuracy and OTD of submittal package, fabrication drawings and Visual BOM updates. It is also accountable to maintain compliance with company standards and its safety policies

Responsibility: This position is responsible for making decisions related to electrical design, drawing creation, BOM verification and co-ordination between different departments. Also responsible for collaborating with Project Engineer during submittal approval process and support Operations.

Delegation: May delegate tasks such as Drawing checks and BOM verification to other team members within the ORE department, under the guidance of ORE Manager.

Approval Process: This position is responsible for approving electrical components and drawings before release to production. Collaborate with Project Engineer in the customer approval process for Submittal packages.

Consensus: Required to participate in consensus decision-making during cros

jobs.title: Machine Operator
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
Responsible for operating and monitoring machinery used in the manufacturing process. This role ensures that machines run efficiently, products meet quality standards, and safety protocols are followed.

Key Responsibilities

• Set up and operate machinery according to instructions.

• Monitor machine performance and make minor adjustments.

• Inspect products for quality and report defects.

• Maintain a clean and safe work area.

• Record production data and report issues.

• Follow safety and operational procedures.

Qualifications / Requirements

• Vocational training (or equivalent experience) with up to 2 years of relevant experience.

• Basic mechanical skills and attention to detail.

• Ability to follow instructions and safety guidelines.

• Good hand-eye coordination and physical stamina.

• Willingness to learn and work in a team environment.

• Familiarity with production tools and equipment is a plus.

What we offer you

• A great working environment.

• Excellent opportunities for development.

• Work Location: Dammam 3rd industrial city

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary

The Sr. Strategic Account Manager is responsible for managing and growing relationships with key clients across multiple lines of business. This role involves developing long-term account strategies, identifying growth opportunities, and ensuring high levels of client satisfaction.

This job profile is intended for specialist professionals that apply advanced knowledge of a job area. Required to manage projects / processes independently with limited supervision. Typically, coaches and reviews the work of lower-level professionals.

Role Purpose

The Partnering Manager will lead the commercial function for rotating equipment services, ensuring profitable growth through strategic contract management, pricing, and customer engagement. This role focuses on delivering value-added service solutions for compressors, turbines, pumps, and other rotating equipment, while maintaining compliance and driving operational excellence.

Key Responsibilities
Commercial Strategy & Market Development

• Develop and execute commercial strategies tailored to the rotating equipment service market.

• Identify opportunities for aftermarket services, upgrades, and long-term service agreements (LTSA).

• Monitor industry trends, OEM competition, and customer needs to position the company as a preferred service provider.

•

Contract & Tender Management

• Lead negotiations for service contracts, maintenance agreements, and major overhauls.

• Ensure accurate costing and risk assessment for tenders and proposals.

• Manage contract lifecycle, including renewals and variations, ensuring compliance with technical and commercial terms.

Financial Performance

• Drive revenue growth through optimized pricing models for spare parts, field services, and repairs.

• Prepare budgets, forecasts, and margin analysis for service projects.

• Monitor KPIs such as contract profitability, utilization rates, and cost-to-serve.

Customer & Stakeholder Engagement

• Build strong relationships with key clients in oil & gas, power generation, mining, and industrial sectors.

• Act as the escalation point for commercial issues and disputes.

• Collaborate with operations, engineering, and supply chain teams to ensure service delivery meets contractual obligations.

Leadership & Team Development

• Lead and mentor the commercial team, including contract managers and pricing analysts.

• Promote a culture of safety, compliance, and customer-centricity.

• Drive continuous improvement in commercial processes and tools.

Qualifications & Experience

• Bachelor’s degree in business, Engineering, or related field (MBA preferred).

• 8–10 years of experience in commercial management within rotating equipment or industrial services.

• Strong knowledge of OEM and aftermarket service models.

• Proven track record in contract negotiation and managing high-value service agreements.

• Deep understanding of rotating equipment (compressors, turbines, pumps).

• Excellent negotiation and stakeholder management skills.

• Strong financial and analytical capabilities.

• Ability to lead cross-functional teams and manage complex projects.

jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

A highly skilled industrial technician who installs, maintains, repairs, and troubleshoots complex machinery and mechanical equipment in manufacturing plants, refineries, power facilities, and other industrial environments. Millwrights ensure equipment operates safely, efficiently, and with minimal downtime by performing precision alignment, fabrication, calibration, and preventive maintenance. Responsibilities

• Disassemble, inspect, and assemble compressors, turbines, gearboxes, expanders and other rotating equipment

• Assemble machines as per instructed by Supervisor

• Possess a sufficient quantity of professional hand tools to adequately perform daily assignments

• Continuously upgrade knowledge of projects, materials and procedures to better perform duties including safety cards

• Report any instances of spillage, uncontrolled exposure or other related safety issues to their line manager.

• Ensure the correct use of waste segregation facilities and the efficient use of natural resources and raw materials.

• Supports, cooperates with, and participates in company-wide LEAN and EHS Management System which includes following all safety, health and environmental policies and procedures.
Qualifications:
The i d eal ca nd i d ate will p o sse s s t h e f o l l o win g :

• High School diploma or equivalent

• Valid driver’s License

• Ability to obtain a Transportation Workers Identification credentials(TWIC)

• Strong verbal and written communication skills with the ability to interface with personnel from diverse backgrounds at all levels of the organization

• Strong mechanical aptitude and ability learn technical and design aspects for Rotating Equipment service and repairs

• Physical ability to work in a shop and field environments

• Travel is required

• Experienced in driven equipment repair such as generators, compressors, and pumps

• Experienced in alignments

• Professional presentation, in manner, attitude, appearance, speech, and dependability, to the customer at all times.

• 15 Paid Time Off (PTO) Days

• Medical, dental, vision, life & disability

• 401K with 6% company match

• Employee Assistance Program

• Employee Wellness Program

• New onsite cafeteria, all meals subsidized (La Porte Service Center)

jobs.title: Mig/Tig Welder
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Position Summary
We are seeking a highly skilled Welder to join our manufacturing team. The successful candidate will be proficient in MIG and TIG welding, with extensive experience welding stainless steel and fabricating complex assemblies. This role requires strong blueprint-reading skills, the ability to troubleshoot and resolve fabrication challenges, and a commitment to producing high-quality work while maintaining a safe work environment. Essential Duties and Responsibilities

• Perform high-quality MIG and TIG welding on stainless steel components and assemblies in accordance with engineering drawings, weld procedures, and work instructions.

• Read, interpret, and work from blueprints, fabrication drawings, specifications, and welding process requirements.

• Lay out, measure, mark, cut, fit, and form materials to meet dimensional and quality specifications.

• Fabricate, assemble, and repair metal components and equipment using appropriate welding and fabrication techniques.

• Troubleshoot complex fabrication and assembly issues, utilizing technical expertise and sound judgment to develop effective solutions.

• Perform self-inspections throughout the fabrication process to ensure parts and assemblies conform to print requirements, tolerances, and quality standards.

• Set up and adjust welding equipment, tooling, and welding parameters according to work specifications.

• Perform routine inspections, calibration verification, cleaning, and basic maintenance of welding equipment, machines, torches, cables, and related tools.

• Identify equipment defects and coordinate or perform minor repairs as appropriate to maintain safe and efficient operation.

• Safely operate overhead cranes, forklifts, and other material handling equipment to move, position, and secure materials.

• Repair worn or damaged metal components by welding and rebuilding surfaces as required.

• Assist with the maintenance and repair of welding, brazing, and soldering equipment.

• Complete required production, quality, and maintenance documentation accurately and timely.

• Maintain a clean, organized, and safe work area, including equipment, tools, materials, and workstations.

• Follow all company safety policies and procedures, including machine safety requirements, environmental regulations, and applicable federal, state, and local health and safety standards.

• Actively participate in company safety initiatives, hazard identification activities, and continuous improvement programs.

• Perform other duties and special projects as assigned.
Required Qualifications

• Minimum 3 years of fabrication and welding experience in a manufacturing environment.

• Demonstrated proficiency in MIG and TIG welding, with a strong emphasis on stainless steel.

• Ability to read and interpret blueprints, technical drawings, and fabrication specifications.

• Strong fabrication skills including material layout, cutting, fitting, forming, and assembly.

• Ability to troubleshoot and resolve complex build and fabrication challenges.

• Experience safely operating overhead cranes; forklift experience preferred.

• Strong attention to detail and commitment to quality workmanship.

• Ability to work independently and as part of a team in a fast-paced manufacturing environment.
Physical Requirements

• Ability to stand and walk for extended periods throughout the workday.

• Ability to frequently bend, kneel, reach, push, pull, and lift materials up to 50 pounds.

• Ability to work safely around welding equipment, cranes, and industrial machinery while wearing required PPE.

• Ability to work in a manufacturing environment with exposure to noise, heat, sparks, and welding fumes.
Preferred Qualifications

• AWS welding certification or equivalen

The successful candidate will be proficient in MIG and TIG welding, with extensive experience welding stainless steel and fabricating complex assemblies. This role requires strong blueprint-reading skills, the ability to troubleshoot and resolve fabrication challenges, and a commitment to producing high-quality work while maintaining a safe work environment. Essential Duties and Responsibilities

• Perform high-quality MIG and TIG welding on stainless steel components and assemblies in accordance with engineering drawings, weld procedures, and work instructions.

• Read, interpret, and work from blueprints, fabrication drawings, specifications, and welding process requirements.

• Lay out, measure, mark, cut, fit, and form materials to meet dimensional and quality specifications.

• Fabricate, assemble, and repair metal components and equipment using appropriate welding and fabrication techniques.

• Troubleshoot complex fabrication and assembly issues, utilizing technical expertise and sound judgment to develop effective solutions.

• Perform self-inspections throughout the fabrication process to ensure parts and assemblies conform to print requirements, tolerances, and quality standards.

• Set up and adjust welding equipment, tooling, and welding parameters according to work specifications.

• Perform routine inspections, calibration verification, cleaning, and basic maintenance of welding equipment, machines, torches, cables, and related tools.

• Identify equipment defects and coordinate or perform minor repairs as appropriate to maintain safe and efficient operation.

• Safely operate overhead cranes, forklifts, and other material handling equipment to move, position, and secure materials.

• Repair worn or damaged metal components by welding and rebuilding surfaces as required.

• Assist with the maintenance and repair of welding, brazing, and soldering equipment.

• Complete required production, quality, and maintenance documentation accurately and timely.

• Maintain a clean, organized, and safe work area, including equipment, tools, materials, and workstations.

• Follow all company safety policies and procedures, including machine safety requirements, environmental regulations, and applicable federal, state, and local health and safety standards.

• Actively participate in company safety initiatives, hazard identification activities, and continuous improvement programs.

• Perform other duties and special projects as assigned.
Required Qualifications

• Minimum 3 years of fabrication and welding experience in a manufacturing environment.

• Demonstrated proficiency in MIG and TIG welding, with a strong emphasis on stainless steel.

• Ability to read and interpret blueprints, technical drawings, and fabrication specifications.

• Strong fabrication skills including material layout, cutting, fitting, forming, and assembly.

• Ability to troubleshoot and resolve complex build and fabrication challenges.

• Experience safely operating overhead cranes; forklift experience preferred.

• Strong attention to detail and commitment to quality workmanship.

• Ability to work independently and as part of a team in a fast-paced manufacturing environment.
Physical Requirements

• Ability to stand and walk for extended periods throughout the workday.

• Ability to frequently bend, kneel, reach, push, pull, and lift materials up to 50 pounds.

• Ability to work safely around welding equipment, cranes, and industrial machinery while wearing required PPE.

• Ability to work in a manufacturing environment with exposure to noise, heat, sparks, and welding fumes.
Preferred Qualifications

• AWS welding certification or equivalen

jobs.title: US Holding - Tax Manager
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

The US Holding - Tax Manager is responsible for supporting tax compliance, reporting, and planning activities. This role ensures accurate tax filings and contributes to the organization’s tax strategy.

This job profile is intended for specialist professionals that apply advanced knowledge of a job area. Required to manage projects/processes independently with limited supervision. Typically coaches and reviews the work of lower-level professionals.
Responsible for the tax matters of assigned legal entities, including federal, state and international tax compliance and accounting for income taxes (tax provisions). Also responsible for the transfer pricing documentation of assigned legal entities. This is a working manager position.

Key Responsibilities:

• Responsible for managing the overall tax reporting work of assigned legal entities and providing assistance in minimizing the tax costs of proposed transactions by identifying favorable methods of reporting the facts, and by formulating the necessary action plans.

• Preparation and consolidation of U.S. federal, state and international income tax returns and accruals, working papers, and studies to ensure proper determination and reporting of corporate income tax in each jurisdiction.

• Determine and control estimated income tax payments to maximize return on assets.

• Preparation of responses to tax agency audit requests for information in a timely and accurate manner; research and defend positions taken on the company’s returns; recommend and prepare protests to disputed audit issues to ensure that additional tax assessments are minimized.

• Monitor and analyze proposed and newly enacted U.S. federal, state and foreign tax legislation, regulations, and court cases to ensure that adequate procedures are in place to minimize and accurately report the company’s income taxes.

• Assist in tax planning by preparing analyses of past and proposed transactions with the purpose of presenting alternatives and/or a recommendation for reducing tax expense.

• Encourage management and other personnel of assigned legal entities to seek tax advice as necessary.

• Cooperation with external and internal persons / bodies, including Outside tax authorities - Finance and controlling personnel for US and foreign legal entities - Outside tax consultants

• Managerial Task: Indirect management of related company personnel in completion of tax information requests and advising on tax consequences of transactions.

Experience/Skills:

• Requires Bachelor’s degree or higher from a College or University (prefer Master’s in Taxation)

• Current CPA, preferred

• Experience with One Source Tax Provision and One Source Income Tax software, preferred

• Previous work experience in public accounting, preferred

• Minimum 7 years corporate income tax and compliance experience required

• Prior project management, supervisor and training experience required

• Must be a team player that is self-motivated with the ability to work independently

• Must be organized with a high attention to detail

• Must have good communication skills, assertive, confident and trustworthy

• Must be able to work overtime when required

• Spanish language skills preferable, but not required

The above is intended to describe the general content of, and requirements for, the performance of this job. It is not to be construed as an exhaustive statement of duties, responsibilities or requirements.

What we offer you

• 15 days of paid time off and 12 company-paid holidays

• 401k plan with a 6% match

• Comprehensive health plan including medical, dental, vision, Life, short-term & long-term disability

• Health savings account matching

• Motivating wellness program

• Employee Assistance Program

• P

jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Sr. Process Engineer is responsible for supporting the development and optimization of manufacturing processes. This role applies practical engineering knowledge to improve efficiency, quality, and safety in production environments.
This job profile is intended for experienced professionals who apply practical knowledge of a job area and work independently with general supervision. Job Description: Senior Industrial Engineer

Job Title: Senior Industrial Engineer

Location
Sulzer Production Facility (Global/Regional Site)

Reporting To
Global Head Operations Excellence
Purpose of the Job
The Senior Industrial Engineer is responsible for driving operational excellence, productivity improvements, factory optimization, and manufacturing system design across Sulzer operations. The role combines industrial engineering expertise, lean manufacturing principles, digital manufacturing tools, and factory design methodologies to improve safety, quality, delivery, cost, and sustainability performance.

The position supports both local manufacturing operations and global operations initiatives through value stream optimization, standard work development, capacity planning, line balancing, factory layout design, and deployment of the Sulzer Excellence System (SES). The engineer will lead data-driven improvement projects and support the development of future-state manufacturing systems utilizing digital twins, simulation, and advanced manufacturing technologies.

Main Tasks and Responsibilities

Industrial Engineering & Operational Excellence

• Lead productivity improvement and cost reduction initiatives across manufacturing operations.

• Conduct time studies, motion studies, and video-based manufacturing method analysis using tools such as AVIX.

• Develop and maintain standard work instructions and work combination sheets.

• Perform line balancing and workload optimization to improve flow and labor efficiency.

• Calculate labour standards and manufacturing performance metrics.

• Analyse bottlenecks and implement sustainable corrective actions.

• Support capacity planning and resource optimization activities.

• Conduct overall equipment effectiveness (OEE) analysis and improvement projects.

• Utilize industrial engineering methodologies to improve throughput, quality, and operational performance.
Lean Manufacturing & Sulzer Excellence System

• Drive implementation of Sulzer Excellence System (SES) principles.

• Facilitate Value Stream Mapping (VSM) and future-state design workshops.

• Lead Kaizen, continuous improvement, and waste elimination initiatives.

• Implement pull systems, supermarket concepts, and material flow improvements.

• Support visual management, workplace organization, and 5S deployment.

• Develop and monitor KPI dashboards for operational performance.

• Coach production teams on Lean methodologies and problem-solving techniques.
Factory Design & Digital Manufacturing

• Create and maintain factory layouts and manufacturing line designs.

• Design factory and production flows using Visual Components and AutoCAD.

• Generate digital twins of manufacturing areas and production systems.

• Model equipment, fixtures, tools, lifting devices, and visual management solutions.

• Define material flow concepts and ergonomic workstation designs.

• Support simulation and validation of manufacturing concepts through digital modelling.

• Arrange production areas considering safety, infrastructure, and operational constraints.

Manufacturing Process Improvement

• Lead process optimization projects from concept through implementation.

• Conduct process failure mode and effects analysis (PFMEA).

• Develop process flow diagrams and manufacturing process maps.

The position supports both local manufacturing operations and global operations initiatives through value stream optimization, standard work development, capacity planning, line balancing, factory layout design, and deployment of the Sulzer Excellence System (SES). The engineer will lead data-driven improvement projects and support the development of future-state manufacturing systems utilizing digital twins, simulation, and advanced manufacturing technologies.

Main Tasks and Responsibilities

Industrial Engineering & Operational Excellence

• Lead productivity improvement and cost reduction initiatives across manufacturing operations.

• Conduct time studies, motion studies, and video-based manufacturing method analysis using tools such as AVIX.

• Develop and maintain standard work instructions and work combination sheets.

• Perform line balancing and workload optimization to improve flow and labor efficiency.

• Calculate labour standards and manufacturing performance metrics.

• Analyse bottlenecks and implement sustainable corrective actions.

• Support capacity planning and resource optimization activities.

• Conduct overall equipment effectiveness (OEE) analysis and improvement projects.

• Utilize industrial engineering methodologies to improve throughput, quality, and operational performance.
Lean Manufacturing & Sulzer Excellence System

• Drive implementation of Sulzer Excellence System (SES) principles.

• Facilitate Value Stream Mapping (VSM) and future-state design workshops.

• Lead Kaizen, continuous improvement, and waste elimination initiatives.

• Implement pull systems, supermarket concepts, and material flow improvements.

• Support visual management, workplace organization, and 5S deployment.

• Develop and monitor KPI dashboards for operational performance.

• Coach production teams on Lean methodologies and problem-solving techniques.
Factory Design & Digital Manufacturing

• Create and maintain factory layouts and manufacturing line designs.

• Design factory and production flows using Visual Components and AutoCAD.

• Generate digital twins of manufacturing areas and production systems.

• Model equipment, fixtures, tools, lifting devices, and visual management solutions.

• Define material flow concepts and ergonomic workstation designs.

• Support simulation and validation of manufacturing concepts through digital modelling.

• Arrange production areas considering safety, infrastructure, and operational constraints.

Manufacturing Process Improvement

• Lead process optimization projects from concept through implementation.

• Conduct process failure mode and effects analysis (PFMEA).

• Develop process flow diagrams and manufacturing process maps.

jobs.title: CNC Machinist
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Key Responsibilities

• Set up, operate, and monitor CNC machining centres to manufacture components in line with engineering drawings and specifications.

• Carry out 5-axis machining operations safely and efficiently.

• Perform in-process inspection of components to ensure quality and dimensional accuracy.

• Complete associated inspection records, production documentation, and quality paperwork accurately.

• Identify and troubleshoot machining or production issues, escalating where necessary.

• Maintain machines, tooling, and work areas to a high standard.

• Follow all health, safety, and quality procedures, reporting any hazards or non-conformances.

• Work closely with colleagues and other departments to meet production targets and customer requirements.

• Support and share knowledge with less experienced team members where required.

Skills & Qualifications

• Vocational training, apprenticeship, or equivalent practical experience in CNC machining.

• Essential: Proven experience operating and setting 5-axis CNC machining centres.

• Desirable: Experience with Mazak 5-axis machining centres and Mazatrol controls.

• Comfortable carrying out in-process inspection and completing associated quality documentation.

• Ability to read and interpret engineering drawings, technical specifications, and measurement data.

• Strong mechanical and technical aptitude.

• Experience using measuring equipment and quality control processes.

• Good problem-solving skills and attention to detail.

• Strong communication and teamwork skills.

• Positive attitude, reliability, and a commitment to continuous improvement.

• Ability to work effectively in a manufacturing environment while maintaining high standards of safety and quality.

What we offer you

We’ve recently invested significantly in modernising our Leeds facility — creating a brighter, more efficient, and more advanced workspace designed to support high‑quality work and a great employee experience. Alongside our upgraded facilities, you’ll benefit from:

Core Benefits

• A competitive salary

• A company-wide bonus scheme

• Paid overtime opportunities

• Medicash Health Cash Plan (covering everyday healthcare expenses such as dental, optical and GP services)

• 33 days’ holiday

• Defined pension contribution

• Employee Assistance Programmes

• Discounts on shopping, entertainment & lifestyle

• Costco membership option

• Discounted personal car leasing for you, family & friends

• Long Service Awards

• Ongoing learning through Sulzer Learning Pathways

• Armed Forces Support – As a Silver Award holder of the MoD Defence Employer Recognition Scheme, we actively support veterans, reservists and Cadet Adult Volunteers. This includes policies that enable time for training, camps and deployment, alongside access to a growing internal military network.

Onsite Perks

• Free, secure parking with EV charging

• Multi-faith prayer room

• Newly modernised work areas

• Lively Sports & Social Club with events & prize draws

• 24/7 onsite gym

• Subsidised vending machines

• Subsidised Canteen offering hot and cold food

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Alternant Marketing
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Apprentice is responsible for supporting administrative or operational tasks while gaining practical experience. This role follows specific instructions and procedures and is designed to provide learning opportunities in a structured environment. Résumé du poste

Nous recherchons un(e) Alternant(e) Marketing dynamique et motivé(e) pour rejoindre notre équipe en France. Ce poste offre une opportunité unique d'acquérir une expérience pratique en marketing au sein d'une entreprise industrielle de premier plan.

Responsabilités

* Participer à l'élaboration et à la mise en œuvre de stratégies marketing.
* Contribuer à la création de contenu marketing (présentations, brochures, newsletters, contenu web, etc.).
* Gérer et animer les réseaux sociaux de l'entreprise.
* Effectuer des analyses de marché et de la concurrence.
* Soutenir l'équipe dans l'organisation d'événements et de salons professionnels.
* Mettre à jour la base de données marketing et CRM.
* Aider à l'analyse des performances des campagnes marketing et à la rédaction de rapports.
* Collaborer avec les équipes commerciales et techniques pour aligner les initiatives marketing.

Qualifications

* Étudiant(e) en marketing, communication, commerce ou domaine connexe (Bac+3/4/5).
* Excellente maîtrise du français, à l'oral comme à l'écrit.
* Bonne connaissance des outils bureautiques (Pack Office).
* Une première expérience (stage, projet universitaire) en marketing serait un plus.
* Intérêt pour le secteur industriel et les solutions techniques.
* Esprit d'initiative, autonomie et rigueur.
* Capacité à travailler en équipe et à communiquer efficacement.
* Maîtrise de l'anglais professionnel est un atout.

What we offer you

.

About the role

Job Summary
The Apprentice is responsible for supporting administrative or operational tasks while gaining practical experience. This role follows specific instructions and procedures and is designed to provide learning opportunities in a structured environment. Résumé du poste

Nous recherchons un(e) Alternant(e) Marketing dynamique et motivé(e) pour rejoindre notre équipe en France. Ce poste offre une opportunité unique d'acquérir une expérience pratique en marketing au sein d'une entreprise industrielle de premier plan.

Responsabilités

* Participer à l'élaboration et à la mise en œuvre de stratégies marketing.
* Contribuer à la création de contenu marketing (présentations, brochures, newsletters, contenu web, etc.).
* Gérer et animer les réseaux sociaux de l'entreprise.
* Effectuer des analyses de marché et de la concurrence.
* Soutenir l'équipe dans l'organisation d'événements et de salons professionnels.
* Mettre à jour la base de données marketing et CRM.
* Aider à l'analyse des performances des campagnes marketing et à la rédaction de rapports.
* Collaborer avec les équipes commerciales et techniques pour aligner les initiatives marketing.

Qualifications

* Étudiant(e) en marketing, communication, commerce ou domaine connexe (Bac+3/4/5).
* Excellente maîtrise du français, à l'oral comme à l'écrit.
* Bonne connaissance des outils bureautiques (Pack Office).
* Une première expérience (stage, projet universitaire) en marketing serait un plus.
* Intérêt pour le secteur industriel et les solutions techniques.
* Esprit d'initiative, autonomie et rigueur.
* Capacité à travailler en équipe et à communiquer efficacement.
* Maîtrise de l'anglais professionnel est un atout.

What we offer you

.

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Internationaler Service-Techniker Pumpenservice (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Als Service-Techniker (m/w/d) sind Sie dort im Einsatz, wo technisches Know-how, Eigenverantwortung und Kundenorientierung gefragt sind. Ob bei Inbetriebnahmen, Wartungen, Modernisierungen oder Reparaturen: Sie sorgen dafür, dass unsere Pumpen und Anlagen weltweit zuverlässig laufen. Dabei arbeiten Sie direkt beim Kunden, lösen technische Herausforderungen vor Ort und tragen mit Ihrer Expertise maßgeblich zum Erfolg unserer Projekte bei. Ihre Aufgaben

• Sie sind direkt bei unseren Kunden vor Ort im Einsatz und sorgen dafür, dass Pumpen und Pumpensysteme zuverlässig funktionieren.

• Im Rahmen von Montageeinsätzen im In- und Ausland übernehmen Sie die Installation, Inbetriebnahme, Wartung, Reparatur und Überholung von Pumpen und Pumpenaggregaten.

• Sie analysieren Störungen, finden die Ursache und setzen passende Lösungen um.

• Bei Umbauten, Revisionen und Modernisierungsmaßnahmen bringen Sie Ihr technisches Know-how ein.

• Je nach Erfahrung übernehmen Sie die Leitung von Baustellen und koordinieren die Arbeiten vor Ort.

• Als kompetenter Ansprechpartner beraten Sie unsere Kunden bei technischen Fragestellungen und unterstützen dabei, weitere Service- und Optimierungspotenziale zu identifizieren.

Ihr Profil

• Sie verfügen über eine abgeschlossene technische Ausbildung im metallverarbeitenden Bereich, idealerweise ergänzt durch eine Weiterbildung zum Meister oder Techniker.

• Sie haben bereits Erfahrung im Service, in der Montage oder Instandhaltung von Pumpen, Maschinen oder anderen rotierenden Anlagen gesammelt.

• Kenntnisse aus den Bereichen Kraftwerkstechnik, Öl & Gas oder Raffinerie sind von Vorteil, aber kein Muss.

• Sie kommunizieren sicher auf Deutsch und können sich auch auf Englisch verständigen.

• Sie arbeiten gerne praktisch, lösungsorientiert und packen vor Ort mit an.

• Sie besitzen einen Führerschein der Klasse B.

• Sie haben Freude an abwechslungsreichen Einsätzen und bringen die Bereitschaft mit, regelmäßig im In- und Ausland zu reisen.

• Ein professioneller und kundenorientierter Auftritt rundet Ihr Profil ab.

What we offer you

• Schlüsselposition mit Verantwortung und direktem Beitrag zum Wachstum

• Kurze Entscheidungswege und hoher Gestaltungsspielraum

• Unbefristeter Arbeitsvertrag

• Flexible Arbeitszeiten und 30 Tage Urlaub

• Moderne Arbeitsumgebung und Ausstattung

• Attraktive Vergütung und Zusatzleistungen (u. a. Mitarbeiterrabatte, JobRad, betriebliche Altersvorsorge, Familienservice ‑ Hotline)

• Internationale Zusammenarbeit, offene Unternehmenskultur und ein motiviertes Team

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: (Senior) Sales Engineer (w/m/d) – Kommunale & industrielle Wasser-/Abwasserlösungen
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

In dieser Position sind Sie die technische Schnittstelle zwischen Kunde, Vertrieb und internen Fachbereichen. Sie begleiten den gesamten Sales‑Prozess von der Anforderungsanalyse über Präsentationen bis hin zur Umsetzung und stellen sicher, dass die Lösungen technisch fundiert und passgenau auf die Kundenbedürfnisse abgestimmt sind. Die Position richtet sich an erfahrene Fachkräfte, die selbstständig arbeiten und ihre Expertise gezielt einbringen.
Ihre Aufgaben

• Eigenverantwortlicher Vertrieb von Nordic Water Lösungen:

• Filtrationssysteme (insb. 4. Reinigungsstufe / Spurenstoffe)

• MEVA-Rechen

• Zickert Schlammräumer

• Entwicklung und Ausbau eines regionalen Kundenportfolios (Bestandskunden + Neukunden)

• Identifikation und Bewertung von Projektchancen im kommunalen und industriellen Umfeld

• Technische Beratung und Ausarbeitung maßgeschneiderter Lösungen

• Verantwortung für den kompletten Angebotsprozess inkl. Kalkulation

• Enge Zusammenarbeit mit dem Vertriebsteam für kommunale und industrielle Abwasserlösungen

• Präsentation von Lösungen bei Kunden, Planern und Entscheidern

• Unterstützung bei der Umsetzung und Klärung technischer Fragestellungen

Ihr Profil

• Abgeschlossenes Hochschulstudium (oder vergleichbare Qualifikation) sowie mindestens 3–4 Jahre relevante Berufserfahrung in einer vergleichbaren Rolle

• Fundierter technischer Hintergrund im Bereich Engineering oder einer verwandten Fachrichtung

• Erfahrung in strukturierten Vertriebs ‑ , Angebots ‑ oder Projektprozessen sowie ein gutes Prozessverständnis

• Sehr gute Kommunikations ‑ und Präsentationsfähigkeiten

• Fähigkeit, komplexe technische Inhalte verständlich und kundenorientiert darzustellen

• Erfahrung im Umgang mit CRM ‑ Systemen sowie Sales ‑ Enablement ‑ Tools

• Ausgeprägte Problemlösungskompetenz, strukturierte Arbeitsweise und kundenorientiertes Denken

• Reisebereitschaft von bis zu 80%

What we offer you

• Internationale Zusammenarbeit, offene Unternehmenskultur und ein motiviertes Team

• Unbefristeter Arbeitsvertrag

• Flexible Arbeitszeiten und 30 Tage Urlaub

• Dienstwagen, auch zur privaten Nutzung

• Ein starkes, hilfsbereites Team mit gutem Zusammenhalt

• Moderne Arbeitsmittel

• Attraktive Vergütung und Zusatzleistungen, u. a.: Vergünstigungen/Mitarbeiterrabatte, JobRad ‑ Programm, Betriebliche Altersvorsorge, Betriebliche Sonderleistungen wie Familienservice ‑ Hotline

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sulzer è una società di ingegneria leader con un patrimonio orgoglioso di innovazione. Unisciti al nostro team globale per accrescere le tue competenze e sviluppare soluzioni innovative che consentano una società prospera e più sostenibile.

Informazioni sul ruolo

In questa posizione, sei l'interfaccia tecnica tra cliente, vendite e reparti interni. Essi accompagnano l'intero processo di vendita dall'analisi dei requisiti alle presentazioni e all'implementazione e assicurano che le soluzioni siano tecnicamente sane e adattate alle esigenze del cliente. La posizione è rivolta a specialisti esperti che lavorano in modo indipendente e contribuiscono alla loro esperienza in modo mirato.
I loro compiti

• Distribuzione autonoma delle soluzioni Nordic Water:

• Sistemi di filtrazione (in particolare 4 ° fase di purificazione/sostanze di traccia)

• Calcoli MEVA

• Sludge Clearer

• Sviluppo e espansione di un portafoglio clienti regionale (clienti esistenti + nuovi clienti)

jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

The Lead (Field) Service Technician is responsible for installing, configuring, calibrating, and repairing technical products and systems at customer field locations. This role performs a variety of maintenance and technical support tasks and may provide onsite training to customer support personnel.
This job profile is intended for experienced support-level staff that generally works autonomously and only requires closer supervision in non-routine situations.
Job Title
FIELD SERVICE SUPERVISOR

Area/Department
Services Division

Required Education
Higher Vocational Training in Mechatronics, Industrial Master Technician, a Mechanical Engineering degree (or any engineering discipline with a mechanical specialization), or an equivalent qualification, with solid knowledge and practical experience in rotating equipment, preferably centrifugal pumps, or alternatively steam turbines and centrifugal compressors.

Specific Knowledge

• Minimum of 2 years of professional experience in the supervision of commissioning activities and field service support for rotating equipment, in Italy, Spain, Portugal and worldwide. Alternatively, candidates should have at least 5 years of experience in the repair and maintenance of rotating equipment within workshop environments.

• Native Italian speaker, with excellent verbal communication skills.

• High level of spoken and written English (mandatory) and Spanish (valuable).

• Microsoft 365 package.

• High Knowledge of Occupational Risk Prevention.

Required Experience
With experience

Reporting Line

Direct Reports

Purpose of the Position
Provide expert field service, technical support, and supervision for the installation, commissioning, inspection, maintenance, and repair of rotating equipment, with a primary focus on centrifugal pumps. The role ensures the reliable and efficient operation of customer assets by delivering high-quality technical services both at customer sites as well as at the company's Service Centers in Italy and Spain.
The successful candidate will act as a technical representative of the company, contributing to customer satisfaction, equipment reliability, and business growth through professional field service and engineering expertise.

• Prepare comprehensive field service documentation, including daily and monthly service reports, commissioning records, inspection findings, technical recommendations, and corrective action plans, providing clear and timely communication to customers and internal stakeholders.

Ce rôle s'acquitte de diverses tâches de maintenance et de soutien technique et peut fournir une formation sur place au personnel de soutien à la clientèle.

Formation professionnelle supérieure en mécatronique, Master Technicien industriel, un diplôme de génie mécanique (ou toute discipline d'ingénierie avec spécialisation mécanique), ou une qualification équivalente, avec une connaissance solide et une expérience pratique dans les équipements rotatifs, de préférence les pompes centrifuges, ou alternativement les turbines à vapeur et compresseurs centrifuges.

Fournir des services spécialisés sur le terrain, un appui technique et une supervision pour l'installation, la mise en service, l'inspection, l'entretien et la réparation du matériel rotatif, en mettant l'accent sur les pompes centrifuges. Le candidat retenu agira en tant que représentant technique de l'entreprise, contribuant à la satisfaction de la clientèle, à la fiabilité de l'équipement et à la croissance de l'entreprise grâce à une expertise professionnelle en service sur le terrain et en génie.

· Effectuer l'installation, la mise en service et le démarrage de nouvelles pompes centrifuges et d'équipements rotatifs connexes sur les sites clients en Italie, en Espagne, au Portugal et dans le monde entier, en veillant au respect des normes Sulzer, des spécifications du client et des meilleures pratiques de l'industrie.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sulzer è una società di ingegneria leader con un patrimonio orgoglioso di innovazione. Unisciti al nostro team globale per accrescere le tue competenze e sviluppare soluzioni innovative che consentano una società prospera e più sostenibile. Informazioni sul ruolo Agisce come il collegamento tra il cliente, le vendite, i fornitori, l'ingegneria e i reparti di produzione, determina e fornisce riassunti dettagliati dei costi e citazioni per lavori di riparazione nel centro di servizio. Coordina la riparazione fornendo istruzioni di lavoro che includono tutte le informazioni pertinenti necessarie per elaborare la riparazione attraverso il centro di servizio che soddisfa i requisiti ISO. Principali responsabilità
• Recensioni requisito del cliente per la riparazione della pompa
• Analizza i risultati dell'ispezione, lavora con il personale del negozio e il sovrintendente dell'area per determinare la portata del lavoro richiesto per le riparazioni
• Piani di riparazione (orario di lavoro, requisiti di acquisto, istruzioni di lavoro e costo totale)
• Genera le citazioni di riparazione
• Completa lo smontaggio, l'ispezione, la riparazione e i pacchetti di istruzioni di lavoro di montaggio, (ordinari di lavoro, stampe, procedure, moduli di ispezione).
• Fare / rivedere schizzi e disegni a norma ISO e in AutoCAD dove richiesto.
• Completa le requisizioni di acquisto. Consulta i fornitori per determinare la disponibilità, la qualità, la quantità e il miglior prezzo di tutti i materiali relativi a un determinato lavoro.
• Valuta le quotazioni dei fornitori e determina i requisiti di qualità, quantità e prezzi accettabili per soddisfare gli impegni assunti ai clienti.
• Quando necessario, parti e materiali espediti dai fornitori per garantire gli impegni di consegna sono soddisfatti.
• Come applicabile, preparare e facilitare tutte le attività di spedizione in entrata / in uscita necessarie per il trasporto finale di riparazioni. Ciò può includere tutta la documentazione di spedizione, importazione e di esportazione come richiesto.
• Gestire i progetti per soddisfare gli obiettivi del ciclo di gara e di ordine per il centro di servizio.
• Per garantire la conformità con gli impegni del cliente e il programma generale di master comunica regolarmente con tutti i dipartimenti per tenerli al passo delle attività di coordinamento
• Tutto il lavoro è eseguito dai requisiti ISO e OSHAS
• Supporta, collabora e partecipa al sistema aziendale LEAN e EHS Management, che include tutte le politiche e procedure in materia di sicurezza, salute e ambiente. Sostegno e cooperazione in iniziative di miglioramento a livello aziendale.
• Eseguire l'analisi della causa radice sui guasti della pompa
• Eseguire le selezioni dei materiali di base per i progetti di riparazione
• Eseguire calcoli di ingegneria per l'industria e gli standard Sulzer
• Esegui altri compiti assegnati Qualifiche / Requisiti
• Forte capacità organizzative, interpersonali e analitiche.
• Eccellente capacità di comunicazione verbale e scritta; tra cui la diplomazia e le competenze di negoziazione
• Conoscenza solida di tutti i processi produttivi e commerciali relativi alla riparazione di pompe e produzione di parti della pompa e o attrezzature strettamente correlate richieste
• Forte capacità del PC, con competenza nel software Microsoft
• Esperienza di lavoro e conoscenza dei sistemi ERP richiesti. Precedente esperienza SAP fortemente desiderato ma non critico.
• Laurea in ingegneria meccanica è preferito
• L'esperienza in ruoli strettamente correlati è preferito.

• 15 giorni di tempo libero e 12 giorni festivi

descriptionByLocale.de:
Sulzer ist ein führendes Ingenieurunternehmen mit einem stolzen Erbe an Innovationen. Schließen Sie sich unserem globalen Team an, um Ihr Fachwissen zu erweitern und innovative Lösungen zu entwickeln, die eine prosperierende und nachhaltigere Gesellschaft ermöglichen. Über die Rolle Als Bindeglied zwischen Kunden, Vertrieb, Lieferanten, Ingenieur- und Produktionsabteilungen bestimmt und liefert detaillierte Kostenübersichten und Angebote für Reparaturarbeiten im Servicecenter. Koordiniert die Reparatur durch Bereitstellung von Arbeitsanweisungen, die alle relevanten Informationen enthalten, die für die Bearbeitung der Reparatur durch das Servicecenter erforderlich sind, das die ISO-Anforderungen erfüllt. Hauptzuständigkeiten
• Bewertungen Kundenanforderung für Pumpenreparatur
• Analysiert Inspektionsergebnisse, arbeitet mit dem Werkstattpersonal und dem Area Superintendent zusammen, um den Umfang der für Reparaturen erforderlichen Arbeiten zu bestimmen.
• Pläne für Reparaturen (Arbeitszeiten, Einkaufsanforderungen, Arbeitsanweisungen und Gesamtkosten)
• Generiert Reparaturangebote
• Vervollständigt Demontage-, Inspektions-, Reparatur- und Montageanweisungspakete (Arbeitsaufträge, Drucke, Verfahren, Inspektionsformulare).
• Machen Sie / überprüfen Sie Skizzen und Zeichnungen nach ISO-Norm und in AutoCAD, wo erforderlich.
• Schließt Kaufanforderungen ab. Beraten Sie sich mit Anbietern, um Verfügbarkeit, Qualität, Quantität und beste Preise für alle Materialien in Bezug auf einen bestimmten Auftrag zu ermitteln.
• Bewertet Lieferantenangebote und bestimmt akzeptable Qualitäts-, Quantitäts- und Preisanforderungen, um die gegenüber den Kunden eingegangenen Verpflichtungen zu erfüllen.
• Beschleunigen Sie bei Bedarf Teile und Materialien von Lieferanten, um sicherzustellen, dass die Lieferverpflichtungen eingehalten werden.
• Gegebenenfalls Vorbereitung und Erleichterung aller Aufgaben im Zusammenhang mit dem ein- und ausgehenden Versand, die für den endgültigen Transport von Reparaturen erforderlich sind. Dies kann alle erforderlichen Versand-, Import- und Exportdokumentationen umfassen.
• Verwalten Sie Projekte, um die Ausschreibungs- und Bestellzykluszeitziele für das Servicecenter zu erfüllen.
• Gewährleistung der Einhaltung der Kundenverpflichtungen und des allgemeinen Masterplans kommuniziert regelmäßig mit allen Abteilungen, um sie über die Koordinationsaktivitäten auf dem Laufenden zu halten
• Alle Arbeiten werden nach ISO- und OSHAS-Anforderungen ausgeführt
• Unterstützt, kooperiert mit und beteiligt sich am unternehmensweiten LEAN- und EHS-Managementsystem, das die Einhaltung aller Sicherheits-, Gesundheits- und Umweltrichtlinien und -verfahren umfasst. Unterstützung und Zusammenarbeit bei unternehmensweiten Verbesserungsinitiativen.
• Führen Sie eine Ursachenanalyse bei Pumpenausfällen durch
• Führen Sie grundlegende Materialauswahl für Reparaturprojekte durch
• Führen Sie Engineering-Berechnungen nach Branchen- und Sulzer-Standards durch
• Führt andere Aufgaben wie zugewiesen aus Qualifikationen/Anforderungen
• Starke organisatorische, zwischenmenschliche und analytische Fähigkeiten.
• Hervorragende verbale und schriftliche Kommunikationsfähigkeiten; einschließlich Diplomatie und Verhandlungsfähigkeiten
• Solides Wissen über alle Herstellungs- und Werkstattprozesse im Zusammenhang mit der Reparatur von Pumpen und der Herstellung von Pumpenteilen und oder eng verwandten Geräten erforderlich
• Starke PC-Fähigkeiten, mit Kenntnissen in Microsoft-Software
• Arbeitserfahrung und Kenntnisse der ERP-Systeme erforderlich. Bisherige SAP-Erfahrungen waren sehr erwünscht, aber nicht kritisch.
• Bachelor-Abschluss in Maschinenbau wird bevorzugt
• Erfahrung in eng verwandten Rollen wird bevorzugt.
• Technische Kenntnisse des Pumpendesigns und der Reparatur sowie der Einbauform und Funktionen von Komponenten werden bevorzugt. Was wir Ihnen bieten
• 15 Tage bezahlte Freizeit und 12 bezahlte Firmenferien
• 401k Plan mit einem 6% Match
• Umfassender Gesundheitsplan einschließlich medizinischer, zahnärztlicher, Sehkraft, Leben, kurzfristige und langfristige Behinderung
• Matching des Sparkontos
• Motivierendes Wellnessprogramm
• Mitarbeiterunterstützungsprogramm
• Bezahlter Vaterschaftsurlaub

Wir sind stolz darauf, als Top Employer 2026 in Brasilien, Kanada, China, Finnland, Deutschland, Irland, Mexiko, der Schweiz, Südafrika, Großbritannien und den USA anerkannt zu werden.
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Sulzer est une entreprise d'ingénierie de premier plan avec un fier héritage d'innovation. Rejoignez notre équipe mondiale pour développer votre expertise et développer des solutions innovantes qui permettent une société prospère et plus durable. Sur le rôle Agit comme la liaison entre le client, les ventes, les vendeurs, l'ingénierie, et les services de production, détermine et fournit des résumés de coûts détaillés et des devis pour les travaux de réparation dans le centre de service. Coordonner la réparation en fournissant des instructions de travail qui incluent toutes les informations pertinentes nécessaires pour traiter la réparation par le centre de service satisfaisant aux exigences de l'ISO. Principales responsabilités
• Critiques besoin client pour la réparation de pompe
• Analyse les résultats de l'inspection, travaille avec le personnel de l'atelier et le directeur de secteur pour déterminer la portée des travaux requis pour les réparations
• Planifier les réparations (heures de travail, exigences d'achat, instructions de travail et coût total)
• Génére des devis de réparation
• Compléter les ensembles d'instructions sur le démontage, l'inspection, la réparation et l'assemblage (commandes de travail, imprimés, procédures, formulaires d'inspection).
• Faire/examiner les croquis et les dessins selon la norme ISO et dans AutoCAD au besoin.
• Remplir les demandes d'achat. Consulter les fournisseurs pour déterminer la disponibilité, la qualité, la quantité et le meilleur prix de tous les matériaux par rapport à un emploi donné.
• Évaluer les soumissions des fournisseurs et déterminer les exigences acceptables en matière de qualité, de quantité et de prix pour respecter les engagements pris envers les clients.
• Au besoin, accélérer les pièces et les matériaux des fournisseurs pour s'assurer que les engagements de livraison sont respectés.
• Le cas échéant, préparer et faciliter toutes les tâches liées à l'expédition à l'arrivée ou à l'arrivée nécessaires au transport final des réparations. Cela peut inclure tous les documents d'expédition, d'importation et d'exportation au besoin.
• Gérer les projets pour répondre aux objectifs du cycle d'appel d'offres et de commande pour le centre de services.
• Veiller au respect des engagements des clients et communiquer régulièrement avec tous les ministères afin de les tenir au courant des activités de coordination
• Tous les travaux sont effectués selon les exigences ISO et OSHAS
• Soutient, coopère avec l'ensemble de l'entreprise et participe à son système de gestion du LEAN et de l'EHS, qui comprend le suivi de toutes les politiques et procédures en matière de sécurité, de santé et d'environnement. Soutenir et coopérer à des initiatives d'amélioration à l'échelle de l'entreprise.
• Effectuer une analyse de cause racine sur les défaillances de la pompe
• Effectuer des sélections de matériaux de base pour les projets de réparation
• Effectuer des calculs techniques par industrie et par normes Sulzer
• Exécute d'autres fonctions selon les affectations Qualifications / Exigences
• Fortes aptitudes organisationnelles, interpersonnelles et analytiques.
• Excellentes compétences en communication verbale et écrite, y compris diplomatie et négociation
• Connaissance approfondie de tous les processus de fabrication et d'atelier liés à la réparation des pompes et à la fabrication des pièces de la pompe et ou de l'équipement étroitement lié requis
• Fortes compétences PC, avec compétence dans les logiciels Microsoft
• Expérience de travail et connaissance des systèmes de PGI requis. Expérience SAP précédente fortement souhaitée mais pas critique.
• Baccalauréat en génie mécanique est préféré
• L'expérience des rôles étroitement liés est privilégiée.
• La connaissance technique de la conception et de la réparation des pompes, ainsi que la forme d'ajustement et les fonctions des composants sont privilégiées. Ce que nous vous offrons
• 15 jours de congé payé et 12 jours fériés payés par l'entreprise
• Plan 401k avec un match de 6%
• Plan de santé global incluant les soins médicaux, dentaires, la vision, la vie, l'invalidité de courte et de longue durée
• Correspondance du compte d'épargne santé
• Programme de bien-être
• Programme d'aide aux employés
• Congé parental payé

Nous sommes fiers d'être reconnus comme l'un des meilleurs employeurs 2026 au Brésil, au Canada, en Chine, en Finlande, en Allemagne, en Irlande, au Mexique, en Suisse, en Afrique du Sud, au Royaume-Uni et aux États-Unis.

jobs.title: Indirect Tax Specialist
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Tax Coordinator is responsible for supporting the preparation, filing, and maintenance of tax-related documentation and ensuring compliance with federal, state, and local tax regulations. This role involves coordinating tax data, assisting with audits, and maintaining accurate records for reporting and compliance purposes. The Tax Coordinator works autonomously and may coordinate the activities of other professional-level staff, especially in non-routine situations.
This job profile is intended for professional-level staff that works autonomously and may coordinate the activities of other professional-level staff, especially in non-routine situations. Key
• Responsibilities
Coordinate and support the preparation and filing of federal, state, and local tax returns, including sales and use tax, property tax, and business licenses.
Maintain and update tax records, ensuring accuracy and compliance with applicable laws and regulations.
Assist in the preparation of documentation for internal and external audits.
Monitor tax deadlines and ensure timely submission of all required filings.
Reconcile tax accounts and resolve discrepancies in collaboration with internal departments and external agencies.
Conduct research on tax regulations and assist in implementing changes to ensure compliance.
Support the tax team in special projects, including tax planning and process improvements.
Liaise with external consultants, auditors, and tax authorities as needed.
Utilize tax software and ERP systems to manage data and generate reports.
Provide administrative support to the tax department, including document management and correspondence.
Skills &
• Qualifications
Typically requires advanced vocational training (or equivalent experience) and several years of relevant work experience to carry out the role.

Required Skills:

Solid understanding of tax principles and compliance requirements.
Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and tax preparation software (e.g., SAP, Oracle, Vertex, or similar).
Strong organizational and time management skills with the ability to manage multiple deadlines.
Excellent attention to detail and accuracy in data entry and record-keeping.
Effective communication skills for interacting with internal teams and external stakeholders.
Ability to work independently and handle non-routine situations with minimal supervision.
Familiarity with tax research tools and databases is a plus.
Experience in a shared services or corporate tax environment is preferred.

What we offer you

Benefits Over law
Saving found
Training
Christmas bonus over low
Development plan

jobs.title: Inside Sales Associate
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

The Inside Sales Representative is responsible for managing assigned house accounts and providing comprehensive sales and customer service support for industrial service projects. This role serves as a key liaison between customers, Account Sales Managers (ASMs), operations teams, and internal stakeholders to ensure smooth project execution, timely customer communication, and efficient account management. Responsibilities include coordinating project-related activities, customer onboarding, order acknowledgments, intercompany transactions, and CRM administration. Responsibilities:

• Manage and develop assigned “House Accounts”

• Order acknowledgments – create and send to the customer as required.

• Coordinate intercompany projects and transactions – communications, project management, invoicing support as required.

• Project related communications (status updates, milestone communications, etc) – Customer/ ASM/ Operations where required

• Support ASM in facilitating customer visits where required (including witness test runs, TDI review, etc)

• Support development of sales process SOP’s and document templates

• Salesforce and D365 admin tasks – inactive customer accounts, house account related contacts, etc

• Participate in weekly production/ WIP meetings – coordinate and communicate sales related actions as required

• Coordinate commercial tasks of customer motor storage – quotes, PO’s, customer documentation where required

• Coordination and support of new customer onboarding

Required Experience:

• Excellent verbal and written communications skills

• Strong listening and presentation skills

• Fluent in reading and speaking both English and Spanish

• Ability to multi-task, prioritize, and manage time effectively

• Required to work in the office including overtime as required

• Required to work flexible and to respond to client emergencies.

• Computer skills including email, internet, data entry and MS Excel

Preferred Experience:

• Experience working with Salesforce.com or similar CRM

• Working knowledge of services of industrial rotating equipment

What we offer you

• 15 days of paid time off and 12 company-paid holidays

• 401k plan with a 6% match

• Comprehensive health plan including medical, dental, vision, Life, short-term & long-term disability

• Health savings account matching

• Motivating wellness program

• Employee Assistance Program

• Paid paternal leave

• Gym reimbursement

jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Purpose of the job
The role is responsible for driving sustainable Order Intake growth for Sulzer Chemtech’s Mass Transfer Components (MTC) business through:
· Active hunting of brownfield revamp opportunities from existing
operating assets
· Early involvement and development of greenfield / grassroot CAPEX projects, from feasibility to FID
· Providing front-end technical sales leadership, translating customer process challenges into differentiated, value-based MTC solutions Main tasks and responsibilities

Revamp & Brownfield

• Proactively identify revamp, debottlenecking, capacity expansion, separation efficiency improvement, and reliability upgrade opportunities in existing operating plants

• Ability to conduct asset‑level analysis (age of internals, operating issues, performance gaps, fouling, corrosion, capacity creep, energy efficiency requirements)

• Drive revamp‑led sales strategies, including Tray replacement, Packing retrofits (random ↔ structured), Mist eliminator and separator upgrades, Hydraulic rating changes and column internals optimization

• Position Sulzer as a lifecycle partner, not just an equipment supplier

Greenfield/Grassroot Project Development

• Actvely pursue new CAPEX grassroot projects
Engage customers, licensors, consultants & EPCs early (feasibility,pre-FEED,FEED)

• Coordinate with application & technology, global applications teams in accordance to Sulzer project governance to lock in Sulzer MTC solutions early.

Technical & Application Leadership

expected margin objectives are met.

• Strategic Planning & Execution
Implement long-term and short-term business strategies and ensure
alignment with regional and global MTCS initiatives.

• Proposal Follow-up & CRM Management
Proactively follow up on outstanding proposals and maintain accurate, up-to-date information in the Sulzer Customer Relationship Management system.

• Cross-Functional Coordination
Collaborate closely with Head Office, Regional Offices, and local intermediaries to support project acquisition, proposal development, and market initiatives.

• Market Intelligence & Reporting
Provide regular updates on market trends, competitive landscape, project pipeline, and sales forecasts to support strategic decision-making.
Lead country-level market mapping , demand analysis, competitive intelligence, and customer segmentation

• Compliance & Governance
Ensure all commercial activities comply with local legal requirements,
industry regulations, and company policies and procedures.

• Other Duties
Perform any additional business related tasks assigned by the
superior to support business objectives.

• Degree in Chemical Engineering or closely related disciplines such as Process Engineering, Petroleum Engineering, or Mechanical Engineering with proven process equipment and mass transfer experience.

• Proven track record in achieving YoY sales growth with strong penetration and success in refinery, Petrochemicals & Chemical segment

Informazioni sul ruolo

Sintesi del lavoro
Il Sales Engineering Expert è responsabile di fornire competenze tecniche durante il processo di vendita, supportando lo sviluppo di soluzioni su misura per i clienti, e garantendo l'allineamento tra le esigenze del cliente e le capacità del prodotto.
Questo profilo di lavoro è destinato a esperti di materia tema riconosciuta in una zona di lavoro. Richiesto di gestire grandi progetti o processi con supervisione limitata dal gestore. Allenatori, recensioni e delegati lavorano per professionisti di livello inferiore.
Questo lavoro e il suo grado associato sono specificamente allineati con ruoli che hanno la seguente portata di responsabilità: piccola, media organizzazione.

Proposta di sostegno allo sviluppo e ai negoziati contrattuali.
Fornire supporto tecnico post-vendita.
Rimani aggiornato sugli sviluppi dei prodotti e sulle tendenze del settore.
