jobs.title: Advance Scheduler
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The role is responsible for developing and managing production schedules to ensure timely delivery of products. This role coordinates with procurement, manufacturing, and logistics to optimize resource utilization and meet customer demand. Key Responsibilities

• Create and maintain production schedules based on demand forecasts.

• Coordinate with supply chain and manufacturing teams.

• Monitor production progress and adjust plans as needed.

• Analyze capacity and resource constraints.

• Implement planning tools and systems.

• Report planning metrics and performance.

• Support continuous improvement initiatives.

Skills & Qualifications

• Typically a University degree and at least of 5-7 years of relevant experience.

• Strong knowledge of production planning and scheduling.

• Experience with ERP and MRP systems.

• Analytical and problem-solving skills.

• Excellent organizational and communication abilities.

• Ability to manage multiple priorities.

What we offer you

• 11 days' public holidays and maximum 15 days' annual leave.

• Supplementary Commercial Insurance.

• Annual Physical Examination.

• Festival & Birthday Gifts.

• Long service awards.

• Shuttle Bus.

About the role

Job Summary
The HR Director is responsible for leading HR strategy and operations for a business unit or function. This role supports organizational goals through effective talent management, workforce planning, and employee engagement.
This job profile is intended for senior leaders that support the mid to long-term (3–5 years) strategy development for their functional area, and have ownership of the short to mid-term (1–3 years) execution of functional strategy/operational direction. Requires ability to communicate with and influence executive leadership. Typically manage multiple teams. Key Responsibilities:
- Develop and implement HR strategies aligned with business goals supporting 3 divisions across multiple countries in the region
- Lead talent acquisition, development, and retention efforts.
- Oversee payroll, compensation, benefits, and performance management.
- Lead labor cost budgeting process across multiple countries in the region.
- Partner with Legal Counsel to drive compliance culture.
- Ensure compliance with HR policies and labor laws.
- Partner with leadership to drive organizational effectiveness.
- Lead HR projects to improve in operational performance.
- Lead a team of HR professionals in the region.

Skills & Qualifications:
- Requires a minimum of 8 - 10 years of relevant working experience in a similar industry in managerial capacity.
- A degree in relevant field such as business management or Human Resources is preferred.
- Strong HR leadership and strategic planning experience.
- Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
- Proven ability to lead HR teams and initiatives.
- Able to multi-task and detail oriented.

Fixed Transport Allowance, Bi-yearly heathy lifestyle incentive and enrichment allowance.

jobs.title: Embedded Electronic Software Development Engineer
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Sulzer Pump Solutions Ireland Ltd is part of our Water and Industry Business Unit which aspires to develop - among others - products and solutions that support water recycling in s sustainable energy efficient way. There are 270 people employed in the Sulzer Company based in Wexford.

This role requires the capabilities to design, develop, code, test and debug software of our embedded devices and systems. A key responsibility will be to recommend new approaches, advising on industry standards, and will work closely with hardware specialists and programming teams. We are looking for a/an Embedded Electronic Software Development Engineer to join our FE_Products, Technology and Digitalization team in Ireland. Your main tasks and responsibilities:

• Technical responsibility for the design of our embedded software (firmware) for control, monitoring and connectivity solutions.

• Specify, design and document technical requirements, and define test plans as appropriate.

• Analyse and enhance efficiency, stability and scalability of our designs.

• Work closely with internal and external resources to ensure work is completed to specification.

• Evaluate and select software components that will be used in larger solutions.

• Manage technical updates to our existing product portfolio.

• Advise on opportunities to streamline our control, monitoring and connected solutions.

To succeed in this role, you will need:

• Honours Degree in Electronic Engineering, Computer Science, or similar with 7+ years of experience in best practices software development, delivery, and deployment.

• In-depth knowledge of C programming languages.Experience in developing firmware for embedded applications.

• Knowledge of software architecture for connected industrial applications/solutions.

• Knowledge of embedded systems with IoT or M2M capability.

• Knowledge of industrial communications protocols (Modbus, CAN, OPC, DNP3,).

• Knowledge of Telecoms/Network communications protocols (TCP/IP, GPRS/3G/4G, Wireless, low energy protocols).

• Experience with version control software.

• Analytical skills for root cause determination.

• Experience of working in a multi-disciplinary and multinational team environment.

What we offer you

• Annual Leave - Enjoy 26 days of holiday.

• Pension - Benefit from a defined contribution pension scheme.

• Flextime - Work Life Balance

• Long Service Awards - We acknowledge and celebrate your dedicated years of service.

• Employee Assistance Programme - Prioritise well-being with confidential support and guidance.

• Professional Growth and Development Opportunities - Access to continuous learning and development programs, providing employees with valuable opportunities for skill enhancement and career progression.

• Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sulzer è una società di ingegneria leader con un patrimonio orgoglioso di innovazione. Unisciti al nostro team globale per accrescere le tue competenze e sviluppare soluzioni innovative che consentano una società prospera e più sostenibile. Informazioni sul ruolo Sulzer Pump Solutions Ireland Ltd fa parte della nostra Water and Industry Business Unit che aspira a sviluppare - tra l'altro - prodotti e soluzioni che supportano il riciclaggio dell'acqua in modo efficiente e sostenibile. Ci sono 270 persone impiegate nella Sulzer Company con sede a Wexford. Questo ruolo richiede le capacità di progettare, sviluppare, codificare, testare e debug software dei nostri dispositivi e sistemi incorporati. Una responsabilità chiave sarà quella di consigliare nuovi approcci, consigliando gli standard del settore, e lavorerà a stretto contatto con specialisti hardware e team di programmazione. Stiamo cercando un/un Ingegnere per lo sviluppo di software elettronico integrato per unire il nostro team FE Products, Tecnologia e Digitalizzazione in Irlanda. I vostri compiti principali e responsabilità:
• Responsabilità tecnica per la progettazione del nostro software integrato (firmware) per le soluzioni di controllo, monitoraggio e connettività.
• Specificare, progettare e documentare i requisiti tecnici e definire i piani di prova come appropriato.

jobs.title: Industrial Welder / Fabricator
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Position Summary
We are seeking a highly skilled Fabricator/Welder to join our manufacturing team. The successful candidate will be proficient in MIG and TIG welding, with extensive experience welding stainless steel and fabricating complex assemblies. This role requires strong blueprint-reading skills, the ability to troubleshoot and resolve fabrication challenges, and a commitment to producing high-quality work while maintaining a safe work environment. Essential Duties and Responsibilities

• Perform high-quality MIG and TIG welding on stainless steel components and assemblies in accordance with engineering drawings, weld procedures, and work instructions.

• Read, interpret, and work from blueprints, fabrication drawings, specifications, and welding process requirements.

• Lay out, measure, mark, cut, fit, and form materials to meet dimensional and quality specifications.

• Fabricate, assemble, and repair metal components and equipment using appropriate welding and fabrication techniques.

• Troubleshoot complex fabrication and assembly issues, utilizing technical expertise and sound judgment to develop effective solutions.

• Perform self-inspections throughout the fabrication process to ensure parts and assemblies conform to print requirements, tolerances, and quality standards.

• Set up and adjust welding equipment, tooling, and welding parameters according to work specifications.

• Perform routine inspections, calibration verification, cleaning, and basic maintenance of welding equipment, machines, torches, cables, and related tools.

• Identify equipment defects and coordinate or perform minor repairs as appropriate to maintain safe and efficient operation.

• Safely operate overhead cranes, forklifts, and other material handling equipment to move, position, and secure materials.

• Repair worn or damaged metal components by welding and rebuilding surfaces as required.

• Assist with the maintenance and repair of welding, brazing, and soldering equipment.

• Complete required production, quality, and maintenance documentation accurately and timely.

• Maintain a clean, organized, and safe work area, including equipment, tools, materials, and workstations.

• Follow all company safety policies and procedures, including machine safety requirements, environmental regulations, and applicable federal, state, and local health and safety standards.

• Actively participate in company safety initiatives, hazard identification activities, and continuous improvement programs.

• Perform other duties and special projects as assigned.
Required Qualifications

• Minimum 3 years of fabrication and welding experience in a manufacturing environment.

• Demonstrated proficiency in MIG and TIG welding, with a strong emphasis on stainless steel.

• Ability to read and interpret blueprints, technical drawings, and fabrication specifications.

• Strong fabrication skills including material layout, cutting, fitting, forming, and assembly.

• Ability to troubleshoot and resolve complex build and fabrication challenges.

• Experience safely operating overhead cranes; forklift experience preferred.

• Strong attention to detail and commitment to quality workmanship.

• Ability to work independently and as part of a team in a fast-paced manufacturing environment.
Physical Requirements

• Ability to stand and walk for extended periods throughout the workday.

• Ability to frequently bend, kneel, reach, push, pull, and lift materials up to 50 pounds.

• Ability to work safely around welding equipment, cranes, and industrial machinery while wearing required PPE.

• Ability to work in a manufacturing environment with exposure to noise, heat, sparks, and welding fumes.
Preferred Qualifications

• AWS welding certification o

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sulzer è una società di ingegneria leader con un patrimonio orgoglioso di innovazione. Unisciti al nostro team globale per accrescere le tue competenze e sviluppare soluzioni innovative che consentano una società prospera e più sostenibile.

Informazioni sul ruolo

Posizione Sommario
Stiamo cercando un Fabricator/Welder altamente qualificato per unirsi al nostro team di produzione. Il candidato di successo sarà abile nella saldatura MIG e TIG, con una vasta esperienza di saldatura in acciaio inossidabile e assemblaggi complessi. Questo ruolo richiede forti competenze di lettura della stampa, la capacità di risolvere e risolvere le sfide di fabbricazione, e un impegno a produrre lavoro di alta qualità, mantenendo un ambiente di lavoro sicuro. Duità e responsabilità essenziali

• Eseguire la saldatura MIG e TIG di alta qualità su componenti e assemblaggi in acciaio inossidabile in conformità con disegni di ingegneria, procedure di saldatura e istruzioni di lavoro.

• Leggere, interpretare e lavorare da progetti, disegni di fabbricazione, specifiche e requisiti di processo di saldatura.

• Allacciare, misurare, marcare, tagliare, adattare e formare materiali per soddisfare le specifiche dimensionali e di qualità.

• Realizzare, assemblare e riparare componenti e attrezzature metalliche utilizzando tecniche di saldatura e fabbricazione appropriate.

• Risoluzione problemi complessi problemi di fabbricazione e montaggio, utilizzando competenze tecniche e giudizio sonoro per sviluppare soluzioni efficaci.

• Eseguire le auto-ispezione durante tutto il processo di fabbricazione per garantire parti e assemblaggi conformi a requisiti di stampa, tolleranze e standard di qualità.

• Impostare e regolare le attrezzature di saldatura, utensili e parametri di saldatura secondo le specifiche di lavoro.

• Eseguire ispezioni di routine, verifica della calibrazione, pulizia e manutenzione di base di attrezzature di saldatura, macchine, torce, cavi e strumenti correlati.

• Identificare i difetti dell'apparecchiatura e coordinare o eseguire riparazioni minori nel modo appropriato per mantenere un funzionamento sicuro ed efficiente.

• Azionare in modo sicuro gru a testa alta, carrelli elevatori e altri dispositivi di manipolazione del materiale per spostare, posizionare e proteggere i materiali.

• Riparare i componenti metallici usurati o danneggiati, saldando e ricostruendo le superfici come richiesto.

• Assistere con la manutenzione e la riparazione di saldatura, brasatura e attrezzature di saldatura.

• Completa la documentazione di produzione, qualità e manutenzione richiesta con precisione e tempestiva.

• Mantenere una zona di lavoro pulita, organizzata e sicura, tra cui attrezzature, strumenti, materiali e postazioni di lavoro.

• Seguire tutte le politiche e le procedure di sicurezza dell'azienda, compresi i requisiti di sicurezza della macchina, le normative ambientali e gli standard federali, statali e locali per la salute e la sicurezza.

• Partecipa attivamente a iniziative di sicurezza aziendale, attività di identificazione dei rischi e programmi di miglioramento continuo.

• Eseguire altri compiti e progetti speciali assegnati.
Qualificazioni richieste

• Minimo 3 anni di esperienza di fabbricazione e saldatura in un ambiente di produzione.

• Dimostrata competenza nella saldatura MIG e TIG, con una forte enfasi sull'acciaio inossidabile.

• Capacità di leggere e interpretare i progetti, disegni tecnici e specifiche di fabbricazione.

• Forti capacità di fabbricazione tra cui layout di materiale, taglio, montaggio, formazione e assemblaggio.

• Capacità di risolvere e risolvere complesse sfide di costruzione e di fabbricazione.

• Esperienza di funzionamento sicuro gru a soffitto; esperienza carrello elevatore preferito.

• Forte attenzione al dettaglio e all'impegno nella lavorazione della qualità.

• Capacità di lavorare in modo indipendente e come parte di un team in un ambiente di produzione veloce.
Requisiti fisici

• Capacità di stare e camminare per lunghi periodi durante la giornata di lavoro.

• Capacità di piegare, ginocchiare, raggiungere, spingere, tirare e sollevare materiali fino a 50 libbre.

• Capacità di lavorare in modo sicuro intorno alle apparecchiature di saldatura, gru e macchinari industriali durante l'usura del PPE richiesto.

• Capacità di lavorare in un ambiente di produzione con esposizione a rumore, calore, scintille e fumi di saldatura.
Qualificazioni predestinate

• Certificazione di saldatura AWS o

descriptionByLocale.de:
Sulzer ist ein führendes Ingenieurunternehmen mit einem stolzen Erbe an Innovationen. Schließen Sie sich unserem globalen Team an, um Ihr Fachwissen zu erweitern und innovative Lösungen zu entwickeln, die eine prosperierende und nachhaltigere Gesellschaft ermöglichen.

Über die Rolle

Positionsübersicht
Wir suchen einen hochqualifizierten Hersteller/Welder, der unserem Produktionsteam beitritt. Der erfolgreiche Kandidat wird das MIG- und WIG-Schweißen beherrschen, mit umfangreicher Erfahrung beim Schweißen von Edelstahl und der Herstellung komplexer Baugruppen. Diese Rolle erfordert starke Blueprint-Lesefähigkeiten, die Fähigkeit zur Fehlersuche und Lösung von Fertigungsherausforderungen sowie die Verpflichtung, qualitativ hochwertige Arbeiten zu produzieren und gleichzeitig eine sichere Arbeitsumgebung zu gewährleisten. Wesentliche Pflichten und Verantwortlichkeiten

• Führen Sie hochwertiges MIG- und TIG-Schweißen auf Edelstahlkomponenten und -baugruppen gemäß technischen Zeichnungen, Schweißverfahren und Arbeitsanweisungen durch.

• Lesen, Interpretieren und Arbeiten von Blaupausen, Fertigungszeichnungen, Spezifikationen und Schweißprozessanforderungen.

• Legen, messen, markieren, schneiden, passen und formen Sie Materialien, um Dimensions- und Qualitätsspezifikationen zu erfüllen.

• Herstellung, Montage und Reparatur von Metallkomponenten und -geräten unter Verwendung geeigneter Schweiß- und Fertigungstechniken.

• Beheben Sie komplexe Herstellungs- und Montageprobleme, indem Sie technisches Fachwissen und fundiertes Urteilsvermögen nutzen, um effektive Lösungen zu entwickeln.

• Führen Sie während des gesamten Herstellungsprozesses Selbstinspektionen durch, um sicherzustellen, dass Teile und Baugruppen den Druckanforderungen, Toleranzen und Qualitätsstandards entsprechen.

• Einrichten und Anpassen von Schweißgeräten, Werkzeugen und Schweißparametern gemäß Arbeitsspezifikationen.

• Führen Sie Routineinspektionen, Kalibrierungsprüfung, Reinigung und grundlegende Wartung von Schweißgeräten, Maschinen, Brennern, Kabeln und verwandten Werkzeugen durch.

• Identifizieren Sie Gerätefehler und koordinieren oder führen Sie kleinere Reparaturen durch, um einen sicheren und effizienten Betrieb aufrechtzuerhalten.

• Betreiben Sie sicher Overhead-Krane, Gabelstapler und andere Materialfördergeräte, um Materialien zu bewegen, zu positionieren und zu sichern.

• Reparieren Sie verschlissene oder beschädigte Metallteile durch Schweißen und Rekonstruktion von Oberflächen nach Bedarf.

• Unterstützung bei der Wartung und Reparatur von Schweiß-, Löt- und Lötgeräten.

• Vervollständigen Sie die erforderliche Produktions-, Qualitäts- und Wartungsdokumentation genau und zeitnah.

• Pflegen Sie einen sauberen, organisierten und sicheren Arbeitsbereich, einschließlich Ausrüstung, Werkzeuge, Materialien und Arbeitsstationen.

• Befolgen Sie alle Sicherheitsrichtlinien und -verfahren des Unternehmens, einschließlich der Anforderungen an die Maschinensicherheit, der Umweltvorschriften und der geltenden Bundes-, Landes- und lokalen Gesundheits- und Sicherheitsstandards.

• Beteiligen Sie sich aktiv an Sicherheitsinitiativen des Unternehmens, Aktivitäten zur Gefahrenidentifizierung und kontinuierlichen Verbesserungsprogrammen.

• Führen Sie andere Aufgaben und spezielle Projekte wie zugewiesen durch.
Benötigte Qualifikationen

• Mindestens 3 Jahre Fertigungs- und Schweißerfahrung in einer Fertigungsumgebung.

• Nachgewiesene Kenntnisse in MIG und TIG Schweißen, mit einem starken Schwerpunkt auf Edelstahl.

• Fähigkeit, Blaupausen, technische Zeichnungen und Fertigungsspezifikationen zu lesen und zu interpretieren.

• Starke Fertigungsfähigkeiten einschließlich Materiallayout, Schneiden, Passen, Formen und Montage.

• Fähigkeit, komplexe Build- und Fertigungsherausforderungen zu beheben und zu beheben.

• Erleben Sie sicher arbeitende Overhead-Krane; Gabelstapler Erfahrung bevorzugt.

• Starke Liebe zum Detail und Engagement für hochwertige Verarbeitung.

• Fähigkeit, unabhängig und als Teil eines Teams in einer schnelllebigen Fertigungsumgebung zu arbeiten.
Physikalische Anforderungen

• Fähigkeit, während des Arbeitstages längere Zeit zu stehen und zu gehen.

• Fähigkeit, sich häufig zu beugen, zu knien, zu erreichen, zu schieben, zu ziehen und Materialien bis zu 50 Pfund zu heben.

• Die Fähigkeit, sicher um Schweißgeräte, Kräne und Industriemaschinen zu arbeiten, während das Tragen erfordert PSA.

• Fähigkeit, in einer Fertigungsumgebung mit Lärm, Hitze, Funken und Schweißdämpfen zu arbeiten.
Bevorzugte Qualifikationen

• AWS Schweißzertifizierung
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Sulzer est une entreprise d'ingénierie de premier plan avec un fier héritage d'innovation. Rejoignez notre équipe mondiale pour développer votre expertise et développer des solutions innovantes qui permettent une société prospère et plus durable.

Sur le rôle

Résumé du poste
Nous recherchons un fabricant/soudeur hautement qualifié pour rejoindre notre équipe de fabrication. Le candidat retenu sera compétent en soudage MIG et TIG, avec une vaste expérience de soudage en acier inoxydable et de fabrication d'assemblages complexes. Ce rôle exige de solides compétences en lecture de plans, la capacité de résoudre les problèmes de fabrication et de les résoudre, ainsi qu'un engagement à produire un travail de haute qualité tout en maintenant un environnement de travail sécuritaire. Fonctions et responsabilités essentielles

• Effectuez un soudage MIG et TIG de haute qualité sur des composants et des assemblages en acier inoxydable conformément aux plans techniques, aux procédures de soudage et aux instructions de travail.

• Lire, interpréter et travailler à partir de plans, de dessins de fabrication, de spécifications et de procédés de soudage.

• Disposer, mesurer, marquer, couper, monter et former des matériaux pour répondre aux spécifications dimensionnelles et de qualité.

• Fabrication, montage et réparation de composants et d'équipements métalliques à l'aide de techniques appropriées de soudage et de fabrication.

• Dépanner les problèmes complexes de fabrication et d'assemblage, en utilisant l'expertise technique et le jugement solide pour développer des solutions efficaces.

• Effectuer des auto-inspections tout au long du processus de fabrication pour s'assurer que les pièces et les assemblages sont conformes aux exigences d'impression, aux tolérances et aux normes de qualité.

• Mettre en place et ajuster l'équipement de soudage, l'outillage et les paramètres de soudage selon les spécifications de travail.

• Effectuer des inspections de routine, la vérification de l'étalonnage, le nettoyage et l'entretien de base des équipements de soudage, des machines, des torches, des câbles et des outils connexes.

• Identifier les défauts de l'équipement et coordonner ou effectuer des réparations mineures, selon le cas, pour assurer un fonctionnement sûr et efficace.

• Utilisez en toute sécurité des grues, des chariots élévateurs et d'autres équipements de manutention des matériaux pour déplacer, positionner et sécuriser les matériaux.

• Réparation des composants métalliques usés ou endommagés par soudage et reconstruction des surfaces au besoin.

• Aider à l'entretien et à la réparation du matériel de soudage, de brasage et de soudure.

• Remplir la documentation requise sur la production, la qualité et la maintenance avec exactitude et en temps opportun.

• Maintenir une zone de travail propre, organisée et sécuritaire, y compris l'équipement, les outils, les matériaux et les postes de travail.

• Suivez toutes les politiques et procédures de sécurité de l'entreprise, y compris les exigences de sécurité des machines, les règlements environnementaux et les normes de santé et de sécurité fédérales, étatiques et locales applicables.

• Participer activement aux initiatives de sécurité de l'entreprise, aux activités d'identification des dangers et aux programmes d'amélioration continue.

• Exécuter d'autres tâches et des projets spéciaux selon les affectations.
Qualifications requises

• Minimum 3 ans d'expérience de fabrication et de soudage dans un environnement de fabrication.

• Füllen Sie alle Unterlagen aus, die sich auf den Arbeitsauftrag beziehen

• Enge und klare Kommunikation mit den anderen Abteilungen, Maschinenpersonal, Supervisor und Lead Man

• Kann große, schwere Ausrüstung mit dem Kran oder Spreader Bar Setup heben, wenn erforderlich

• Bedienen Sie manuelle und automatische Zuführungen zu 0,0002" wie für Endschnitte erforderlich"

• Bedienen Sie die Maschine, um komplexe Winkelschnitte und Gewinde zu machen, wo mehrere Geschwindigkeiten und Vorschub

• sind erforderlich

• Vollständige zugewiesene Jobs beginnen mit wenig oder keiner Aufsicht zu enden.

• Führen Sie eine Zwischentrigonometrie durch, um die für die Bearbeitung des Teils erforderlichen Werkzeuge und die beste Übereinstimmungsmethode zu bestimmen

• Lesen Sie Blaupausen, Zeichnungen und Skizzen, die möglicherweise Mathematik- und Problemlösungskompetenzen erfordern, um Dimensionen zu berechnen, die im Druck nicht angegeben sind

• Helfen Sie bei der Wartung von Geräten, dies umfasst Folgendes:

• Kontrolle / Öl hinzufügen

• Reinige Maschine nach jeder Schicht

• Platzieren Sie Werkzeuge an der richtigen Stelle und organisieren Sie

• Wann/wenn Artikel entgratet wird

• Sobald die Abmessungen pro Druck verifiziert sind

• Warnaufseher bei Abweichungen

• Schritte erforderlich, bevor das Teil vollständig ist

• Vom Schichtbeginn bis zum Schichtende körperlich aktiv bleiben, einschließlich, aber nicht beschränkt auf:

• Kehren

• Reinigungsbereich

• Organisieren Sie das Tooling

• Bediengerät

• Projektteile organisieren

• CNC betreiben

• Bestimmen Sie, welche Tools benötigt werden

• Vorprogrammierbare Schritte bestimmen

• Bestimmen Sie manuelle Programmierschritte

• Bestimmen Sie die beste Ladeposition, um die Bearbeitungsanforderungen zu erfüllen

• Suchen / Laden Sie alle erforderlichen Werkzeuge für das Projekt in den richtigen Werkzeughalter

• Korrekte Programmierung der Werkzeuge und Versätze für jedes Werkzeug im Halter CNC — Operation

• Bleiben Sie aufmerksam, während die CNC läuft

• Tragen Sie richtiges Material / Teile

• In der Lage sein, das Programm schnell herunterzufahren oder zu ändern, um schädliche Schäden an der Maschine oder der Sicherheit des Personals zu verhindern

• Berechnen / Antizipieren von Werkzeugversatzänderungen aufgrund von Verschleiß während des Maschinenprozesses CNC - Wartung

• Halten Sie die Ölstände wie erforderlich

• Reiner Bereich nach Bedarf

• Seien Sie auf der Baustelle und in Ihrem zugewiesenen Arbeitsbereich zur geplanten Zeit

• Halten Sie den Arbeitsbereich in allen Phasen des Projekts sauber und gut organisiert

• Befähigung zur Verwendung und Bedienung von Oberleitungen, Fackeln, Schleifmaschinen und

• Gabelstapler

ZWEITE ZUSTÄNDIGE VERANTWORTUNGEN:

• Befolgt Unternehmens- und Abteilungsrichtlinien, -verfahren und -standards

• Unterstützt, kooperiert und beteiligt sich am unternehmensweiten LEAN- und EHS-Managementsystem, das die Einhaltung aller Sicherheits-, Gesundheits- und Umweltrichtlinien und -verfahren umfasst.

• Führt andere Aufgaben wie zugewiesen aus

• Fähigkeit, enge Toleranzen einzuhalten und Komponenteninspektionen durchzuführen

• Bereitschaft, in einem

jobs.title: Retrofit Specialist
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Sulzer RES Canada is seeking a technically strong and customer focused Retrofit Specialist to join our Ontario team. In this role, you will partner closely with Sales to identify, develop, and secure turnkey retrofit and upgrade opportunities for rotating equipment across Eastern Canada.
This position is ideal for an engineer who enjoys blending technical depth with customer engagement, and who thrives in a role that directly contributes to business growth. Strategic & Sales Support

• Support the Retrofits Supervisor – Canada in executing regional strategy, sales planning, and continuous improvement initiatives.

• Develop territory‑specific plans to grow retrofit opportunities based on technical insight and customer needs.

• Serve as the primary technical resource for the Sales Team and customers on retrofit‑related inquiries.
Opportunity Identification & Customer Engagement

• Lead customer‑facing activities such as asset reviews, health checks, technical forums, and site visits to uncover retrofit opportunities.

• Build strong, trust‑based relationships that position Sulzer as the preferred provider for retrofit solutions.

• Intermittent travel requirements estimated at 30% based on business needs (success in this role depends on being present with customers).

• Use the CRM system (Salesforce) to track opportunities and support sales pipeline visibility.
Engineering Support

• Conduct technical assessments of rotating equipment to identify retrofit, upgrade, and rerate opportunities.

• Translate customer performance issues into clear scopes of work and retrofit concepts.

• Develop preliminary engineering calculations, hydraulic and equipment selections, and conceptual designs for proposals.

• Review historical equipment data and performance curves to recommend optimized solutions.

• Prepare technical documentation including specifications, design briefs, and engineering justifications.

• Collaborate with Service Center operations and engineering teams to validate feasibility and risk considerations.

• Provide technical clarification during proposal and negotiation phases.

• Stay current on emerging technologies and design practices relevant to rotating equipment retrofits.
Proposal Development & Technical Delivery

• Prepare clear, technically robust retrofit proposals that highlight Sulzer’s value proposition.

• Work with the Toronto Service Center to identify retrofit potential within incoming repair projects.

• Ensure accurate categorization and tracking of retrofit orders in company systems.

• Provide timely input toward the Rolling Forecast (RFC) process for the assigned territory.
Execution & Handover

• Support the full proposal lifecycle and orders review.

• Participate in handover meetings to ensure technical requirements and execution strategy are clearly communicated to execution teams.

• Ensure smooth transition from pre‑order to post‑order execution through effective documentation and communication.

• Participate in sales meetings and provide technical updates from the region.

Safety, Quality & Compliance

• Follow all safety, health, and environmental procedures in alignment with Sulzer’s EHS Management System.

• Contribute to company‑wide quality initiatives and continuous improvement efforts.

QUALIFICATIONS: What You Bring

• Bachelor’s degree in mechanical engineering or related discipline.

• Experience with rotating equipment (pumps, turbines, compressors, or similar).

• Strong analytical and problem‑solving skills with the ability to translate technical issues into practical solutions.

• Excellent communication skills and comfort engaging directly with customers.

• Ability to work collaboratively with Sales, Engineering, and Service Center teams.

• A proacti

jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

We are seeking an experienced and highly motivated Manager to build and oversee a Field Service team. The team will be responsible for the installation, maintenance, and repair of electrical and mechanical equipment across multiple client sites. The ideal candidate will possess solid technical expertise and strong leadership abilities, managing a team of field technicians, optimizing service processes, and ensuring high levels of customer satisfaction. This position requires frequent site visits, coordination with engineering and operations teams, and the ability to address complex technical and operational challenges efficiently.
Key Responsibilities

• Oversee profit and loss (P&L) responsibilities for the EMS field service operations, including budget management, cost control, and financial reporting.

• Collaborate with engineering, project management, and sales teams to support client projects and technical proposals.

• Serve as the primary technical escalation point for complex field service issues

• Lead, mentor, and manage a team of field service technicians specializing in electrical and mechanical equipment.

• Plan, assign, and optimize work orders, routes, and schedules to maximize efficiency and meet service deadlines.

• Coordinate installation, preventive maintenance, troubleshooting, and repair of electrical and mechanical systems.

• Ensure compliance with safety regulations, company policies, and industry standards (OSHA, NEC, NFPA, etc.).

• Maintain accurate records of service activities, parts usage, and site documentation.

• Analyze performance metrics, including first-time fix rates, system uptime, and response times, and implement process improvements.

• Develop and maintain strong client relationships to ensure service satisfaction and promote additional service opportunities.

• Conduct site audits, field inspections, and on-the-job training for technicians.

• Develop and manage operational budgets, review cost efficiency, and ensure profitability of service operations.

Required Qualifications & Skills

• Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, or related technical field preferred. Equivalent experience in field services may be considered.

• Minimum of 5 to 7 years experience in field service management or equivalent technical supervision role supporting electrical and/or mechanical equipment.

• Strong technical knowledge of electrical systems, mechanical systems, PLCs, motor controls, power distribution, and industrial equipment.

• Proven experience in team leadership, performance management, and personnel development.

• Excellent problem-solving and decision-making skills under pressure.

• Proficient in field service management software, CRM systems, and route optimization tools .

• Strong verbal and written communication skills; ability to interact effectively with clients, team members, and management.

• Valid driver’s license with willingness to travel extensively to client sites.

• Familiarity with industry certifications (NICET, CET, Journeyman/Master Electrician, PMP / CSM certification a plus).

jobs.title: Manual Machinist
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

As a Manual Machinist you will be responsible for setting up and operating machine tools, including HBM, VBM, lathes, milling machines, ID/OD grinders, planers, and bore parts to manufacture and recondition component parts to customer, OEM and industry standards. You will interpret mechanical drawings, blueprints, and sketches and perform precision metal cutting, grinding, shaping and fitting. You will measure components, parts, and raw materials with precision measuring instruments, gauges, and tools. Key Responsibilities

• Performing layouts, setting up and operating conventional machine tools as required

• Reading and interpreting all drawings, including geometric dimensioning and tolerancing

• Designing setup methods where none exist

• Instructing other shop personnel on proper machining techniques

• Continually improving methods to deliver higher quality with improved costs

Qualifications / Requirements

• Completion of a machinist apprentice program or equivalent training

• Ability to hold close tolerances and conduct component inspections

• Ability to set up machine tools: ID / OD Grinders, Turret Lathe, Engine Lathe, Horizontal Boring Mill, Vertical Boring Mill, Radial Drill, Planer Mill

• Four years of experience in machine shop operations

• Willingness to work in a team environment

• Openness to working overtime as required

What we offer you

• 15 days of paid time off and 12 company-paid holidays

• 401k plan with a 6% match

• Comprehensive health plan including medical, dental, vision, Life, short-term & long-term disability

• Health savings account matching

• Motivating wellness program

• Employee Assistance Program

• Paid paternal leave

• Gym re-imbursement

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Operations FP&A Manager
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

The Operations FP&A Manager serves as the primary finance business partner to Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Operations, Procurement, and Project Management teams. This role provides financial leadership and analytical support to drive operational performance, improve forecasting accuracy, optimize inventory and working capital, and enhance profitability. The position focuses on inventory management, raw materials oversight, WIP reporting, operational forecasting, manufacturing KPI reporting, project financial tracking, and decision support. Primary Responsibilities

• Lead operational forecasting for production volumes, labor, material consumption, manufacturing costs, inventory and working capital.

• Partner with Operations leadership to identify financial risks and opportunities.

• Analyze raw material, WIP and finished goods inventories and drive inventory turn improvements.

• Monitor inventory aging, excess inventory and obsolescence exposure.

• Establish and maintain robust WIP reporting and forecasting processes.

• Track project costs, margins, labor utilization and forecasted outcomes.

• Develop and maintain manufacturing KPI dashboards and performance analytics.

• Perform variance analysis, root-cause analysis and profitability assessments.

• Support capital investment evaluations and operational improvement initiatives.

• Serve as a trusted business partner to Manufacturing, Supply Chain and Project leaders.
Key Manufacturing KPIs

• Production Volumes

• Capacity Utilization

• Labor Efficiency

Sulzer est une entreprise d'ingénierie de premier plan avec un fier héritage d'innovation. Rejoignez notre équipe mondiale pour développer votre expertise et développer des solutions innovantes qui permettent une société prospère et plus durable.

Sur le rôle

Le gestionnaire des opérations de la FP&A est le principal partenaire financier des équipes de la fabrication, de la chaîne d'approvisionnement, des opérations, des achats et de la gestion de projet. • Suivre les coûts, les marges, l'utilisation de la main-d'oeuvre et les résultats prévus.

• Effectuer une analyse de la variance, une analyse des causes profondes et des évaluations de la rentabilité.

• Appuyer les évaluations des investissements et les initiatives d'amélioration opérationnelle.

• Servir de partenaire d'affaires de confiance pour les dirigeants de la fabrication, de la chaîne d'approvisionnement et des projets.

• Frais de scrap et de retravail

• WIP Vieillissement

• Fonds de roulement

• Baccalauréat en finance, comptabilité, économie, génie, chaîne d'approvisionnement ou domaine connexe.

• 7 ans et plus en FP&A, financement des opérations, financement de la fabrication ou financement de la chaîne d'approvisionnement.

• Bonne connaissance de l'inventaire, du fonds de roulement, des prévisions et de l'analyse manufacturière.

• Expérience avancée Excel et ERP; SAP préféré.

• Power BI, Tableau ou outils d'analyse similaires préférés.
Profil de candidat idéal

• Professionnels des programmes et des programmes axés sur l'exploitation.

• Forte capacité de partenariat et de communication.

• Travail confortable avec les gestionnaires d'usine, les chefs de chaîne d'approvisionnement et les gestionnaires de projets.

• Capacité de traduire le rendement opérationnel en perspectives financières réalisables.

Ce que nous vous offrons

• Programme d'aide aux employés

• Remboursement de gymnastique

jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary

We are seeking an experienced and driven EMS Supervisor to lead our workshop operations in Elandsfontein. Reporting to the EMS Service Centre Manager, you will be responsible for supervising a team of employees and contractors while ensuring safe, efficient, and high-quality repair, refurbishment, assembly, and testing of mechanical equipment, particularly gearboxes.

This is an excellent opportunity for a technically strong leader with a passion for operational excellence, safety, customer service, and continuous improvement.
Key Responsibilities

• Plan and manage workshop activities to ensure work is completed within agreed timelines.

• Supervise gearbox overhaul, refurbishment, repair, assembly, and testing activities in accordance with OEM specifications and engineering standards.

• Attend to breakdowns and repair requests.

• Promote and maintain a strong safety culture through behavioural safety initiatives and toolbox talks.

• Conduct root cause investigations and implement corrective actions.

• Ensure compliance with engineering drawings, repair procedures, quality standards, and customer requirements.

• Manage inventory of critical components, consumables, bearings, seals, and lubricants.

• Oversee maintenance, calibration, and certification of workshop equipment and measuring instruments.

• Liaise with customers, suppliers, OEMs, and internal stakeholders on technical matters and project execution.

• Drive reliability improvement initiatives, cost control, and operational efficiency.

Qualifications

• Qualified Millwright or Fitter & Turner .

• National Diploma or equivalent technical qualification.

• Valid driver's licence.

Experience

• 5 to 10 years' progressive supervisory experience in a mechanical workshop or engineering environment.

• Sound knowledge of electrical and mechanical equipment.

• Experience using Microsoft Office (Word and Excel) and SAP.

• Sound knowledge of the Occupational Health and Safety Act

Key Competencies

• Strong leadership and people management skills.

• Excellent communication and relationship-building abilities.

• Commercial awareness and cost-control mindset.

• Strong planning, organisational, and problem-solving skills.

• Ability to work independently and adapt to changing priorities.

• Attention to detail and commitment to quality.

• Strong influencing, negotiation, and customer service skills.

What We're Looking For

The ideal candidate will be a hands-on supervisor with strong technical expertise, a safety-first mindset, and the ability to lead teams effectively while delivering exceptional service to our customers. You should be capable of analyzing engineering drawings, understanding engineering tolerances, and driving continuous improvement within the workshop

Ready to take the next step in your career? Apply today.

What we offer you

Medical aid
Pension/Provident Fund
Life and disability cover
Professional development and training opportunities
Employee wellness programmes

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

jobs.title: Area Sales Manager
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Are you ready to take your career to the next level with a world-leading engineering company? At Sulzer, we operate through a network of advanced service centers in the UK sites and over 100 global service sites, offering cutting-edge solutions for parts, maintenance, and repairs related to pumps, turbines, compressors, motors, and generators. We service not only our own original equipment but also third-party rotating equipment, ensuring sustainability and cost-effectiveness throughout their life cycle. Our industry-leading product experts offer unparalleled technical support, and our capabilities range from local site services to large machine refurbishment and upgrade. We are committed to investing in and growing our market share in essential industries through key partnerships. e have an exciting challenge in the Midlands . This role will involve driving our growth in the area, covering the entire North West of England. You’ll be at the forefront of building new partnerships, opening doors, and getting Sulzer in front of prospective clients. It’s a pivotal role that requires both resilience and a strategic approach to establish Sulzer’s presence and grow our customer base in a region primed for expansion.

Your main tasks and responsibilities will include:

• Develop and maintain strong connections with both existing and potential clients. Understand their unique challenges and collaborate to create bespoke solutions that meet their needs.

• Carry out in-depth research within your region to uncover new sales leads, particularly for electric rotating machinery maintenance, including generators, motors, and transformers. Provide insightful market feedback to continuously enhance Sulzer's offerings.

• Offer support and guidance to customers, showcasing Sulzer's innovative products and services to address complex engineering problems.

• Pursue new business opportunities to drive revenue growth.

• A proven track record in technical sales with a deep understanding of the sales process.

• Extensive knowledge of rotating machinery, including pumps, gearboxes compressors, motors, generators, transformers etc.

• Exceptional communication and presentation skills, capable of conveying technical information to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

jobs.title: Despatch Freight Coordinator
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

At Sulzer Leeds, we design and build some of the world’s most advanced engineered pump packages — the kind that keep global infrastructure moving and can weigh anything up to 150 tonnes. As we continue to grow and bring key capabilities in‑house, we’re now looking for a Despatch Freight Coordinator to help us take full control of our import, export, and heavy‑lift logistics. If you thrive in complex, high‑value engineering environments and love the challenge of out‑of‑gauge and break bulk freight, this is your opportunity to play a pivotal role in how we move some of the biggest kit in the industry. Key Duties ​

• Coordinate global import and export shipments, ensuring compliance with customs regulations and trade laws.

• Manage OOG and break bulk shipments, working closely with specialist carriers, port operators, and freight forwarders.

• Prepare and verify shipping and customs documentation (CDS entries, bills of lading, CoO, packing lists).

• Plan and book UK and international transport, optimising routes, loads, and freight costs.

• Monitor shipment progress, maintain accurate records, and keep internal teams updated in real time.

Required Skills & Experience

• Experience in freight coordination, transport planning, or logistics—ideally within heavy engineering or project cargo.

• Knowledge of out-of-gauge, break bulk, or oversized cargo handling (road, sea, or multimodal).

• Strong understanding of customs procedures, Incoterms, and international trade compliance.

• Excellent organisation, communication, and problem‑solving skills.

• Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast‑paced, project‑driven environment.

What we offer you

We’ve recently invested significantly in modernising our Leeds facility — creating a brighter, more efficient, and more advanced workspace designed to support high‑quality work and a great employee experience. Alongside our upgraded facilities, you’ll benefit from:

Core Benefits

• A competitive salary

• A company-wide bonus scheme

• Medicash Health Cash Plan (covering everyday healthcare expenses such as dental, optical and GP services)

• 33 days’ holiday

• Defined pension contribution

• Employee Assistance Programmes

• Discounts on shopping, entertainment & lifestyle

• Costco membership option

• Discounted personal car leasing for you, family & friends

• Long Service Awards

• Ongoing learning through Sulzer Learning Pathways

• Armed Forces Support – As a Silver Award holder of the MoD Defence Employer Recognition Scheme, we actively support veterans, reservists and Cadet Adult Volunteers. This includes policies that enable time for training, camps and deployment, alongside access to a growing internal military network.

Onsite Perks

• Free, secure parking with EV charging

• Multi-faith prayer room

• Newly modernised work areas

• Lively Sports & Social Club with events & prize draws

• 24/7 onsite gym

• Subsidised vending machines

• Subsidised Canteen offering hot and cold food

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

À propos du rôle

Au sein de notre division Services, ce poste assiste le responsable des ventes ENA Services et le responsable des ventes DACH dans des tâches administratives, opérationnelles et de gestion commerciale de haute qualité. Dans ce rôle, vous apporterez une contribution significative au bon déroulement des affaires quotidiennes en coordonnant la communication, en préparant des rapports et des documents de présentation, en soutenant les réunions et en assurant une maintenance précise des données dans Salesforce. Cela permettra à nos dirigeants commerciaux de se concentrer sur les priorités stratégiques et de contribuer de manière significative à l’efficacité de l’organisation ENA Services.

Tâches

- Soutenir la direction des ventes en coordonnant les réunions, y compris la création de l'ordre du jour, les procès-verbaux et le suivi des points en cours

- Préparation des documents de réunion et fourniture en temps opportun des informations et du matériel pertinents
- Soutenir la collaboration entre les ventes, les centres de service et autres interfaces internes

- Très bonne connaissance de MS Office, notamment Excel, PowerPoint et Outlook

- Formation commerciale ou baccalauréat dans un domaine lié aux affaires ou à l'administration

- Haut niveau d'exactitude, de confidentialité et de responsabilité
- Capacité à collaborer avec des équipes interfonctionnelles

Nous offrons

- Collaboration étroite avec des responsables commerciaux expérimentés
- Aperçu des sujets liés au commerce international, des rapports ainsi que des chiffres clés et des évaluations des ventes
- Travail varié avec une combinaison de soutien administratif, de soutien commercial et de coordination des processus
- Participation active à l'augmentation de l'efficacité au sein de l'organisation Sales ENA Services

jobs.title: Engenheiro(a) de Vendas
Industry Sales Manager - Mining
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Mining is the backbone of South Africa's economy. At Sulzer, we help keep it running.

With over 190 years of engineering excellence, a presence in 40+ countries, and thousands of customers relying on us every day, Sulzer is a global leader in rotating equipment services. From pumps and motors to turbines and compressors, we help mining operations maximise reliability, reduce downtime, and extend asset life.

We're looking for a commercially driven Industry Sales Manager - Mining to lead growth across South Africa's mining sector.

This is a high-impact role for someone who knows the industry, understands customer challenges, and thrives on turning relationships into long-term business partnerships. What You'll Be Doing

You'll be the face of Sulzer within the mining sector, identifying opportunities, building strategic relationships and driving profitable growth across our services portfolio.
You'll:

• Develop and execute the mining sales strategy across Africa.

• Build relationships with mine operators, engineering teams, maintenance leaders and procurement stakeholders.

• Identify, develop and secure new service opportunities.

• Grow key accounts while winning new business.

• Promote Sulzer's maintenance, repair, overhaul, upgrade and field service capabilities.

• Work closely with operational teams to deliver exceptional customer solutions.

• Monitor market trends, competitor activity and emerging opportunities.

What We're Looking For

• Proven success in B2B sales within the mining sector.

• Experience selling engineering, maintenance, reliability or industrial service solutions.

• Knowledge of rotating equipment, pumps, motors, compressors or related assets.

• Strong commercial and negotiation skills.

• A natural relationship builder with the ability to influence at every level.

• Self-motivated, customer-focused and driven to win.

What we offer you

Medical AId
Provident Fund

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Buyer
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

We are seeking a highly motivated and experienced Buyer to join our team at Sulzer GT Aero Services Ltd. In this role, you will be responsible for procuring goods and services necessary for our operations, ensuring timely delivery, cost-effectiveness, and adherence to quality standards. Job Responsibilities:

• Identify and evaluate potential suppliers, negotiate contracts, and establish strong vendor relationships.

• Prepare and process purchase orders, ensuring accuracy and compliance with company policies and procedures.

• Monitor inventory levels and anticipate material needs to prevent stockouts and support production schedules.

• Collaborate with engineering, production, and quality assurance departments to understand material requirements and specifications.

• Resolve supplier issues, including quality discrepancies, late deliveries, and invoice discrepancies.

• Analyze market trends and supplier performance to identify opportunities for cost savings and process improvements.

• Maintain accurate purchasing records and generate reports as required.

• Ensure all procurement activities comply with relevant regulations and company ethical guidelines.

• Participate in cross-functional teams to support new product development and continuous improvement initiatives.

Job Qualifications:

• Minimum of 3-5 years of experience in a purchasing or procurement role, preferably within the aerospace, manufacturing, or industrial services sector.

• Proven negotiation skills and the ability to build and maintain effective supplier relationships.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.

• Excellent communication (written and verbal) and interpersonal skills.

• Proficiency in using ERP systems (e.g., SAP, Oracle) and Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, Word, Outlook).

• Ability to work independently and as part of a team in a fast-paced environment.

• Knowledge of purchasing best practices and supply chain management principles.

What we offer you

• A competitive salary

• A company-wide bonus scheme

• Medicash Health Cash Plan (covering everyday healthcare expenses such as dental, optical and GP services)

• 33 days’ holiday

• Defined pension contribution

• Employee Assistance Programmes

• Discounts on shopping, entertainment & lifestyle

• Costco membership option

• Discounted personal car leasing for you, family & friends

• Long Service Awards

• Ongoing learning through Sulzer Learning Pathways

• Armed Forces Support – As a Silver Award holder of the MoD Defence Employer Recognition Scheme, we actively support veterans, reservists and Cadet Adult Volunteers. This includes policies that enable time for training, camps and deployment, alongside access to a growing internal military network.

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Goods in Controller
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

At Sulzer Birmingham Service Centre, we repair, refurbish and overhaul critical rotating equipment that keeps essential industries running. From pumps and motors to compressors, generators and turbines, our teams deliver world-class engineering solutions for customers across the UK and beyond.

Based at our 82,000 sq. ft Birmingham Centre of Excellence, you'll work from one of the most advanced service and repair facilities in the UK. Opened in 2021 following a major investment, the site combines cutting-edge digital technologies, advanced machining capabilities and additive manufacturing, operating 24/7 to support customers when reliability matters most.

We're looking for a highly organised and computer-savvy Goods In Controller to take ownership of all incoming deliveries, ensuring goods are received, inspected, recorded and stored accurately. You'll be the crucial link between suppliers, stores and production teams, helping ensure materials and components are available when needed and that inventory records remain accurate at all times. What You'll Be Doing

• Receiving and inspecting incoming goods, materials and equipment

• Checking deliveries against purchase orders and delivery notes

• Recording receipts accurately within Microsoft Dynamics 365

• Identifying and escalating shortages, damage or discrepancies

• Ensuring materials are correctly labelled, stored and available for production

• Maintaining accurate stock and inventory records

• Supporting stores, purchasing and workshop teams with day-to-day operational requirements

• Promoting high standards of housekeeping, quality and safety

What We're Looking For

• Experience in a Goods In, Stores, Warehouse or Logistics role, preferably within an engineering or manufacturing environment

• Strong attention to detail and a commitment to accuracy

• Confident using IT systems and technology

• Experience working with Microsoft Dynamics 365 ERP or similar systems would be highly advantageous

• Ability to work independently and prioritise workload effectively

• Strong communication and organisational skills

• Forklift licence desirable

What we offer you

• A competitive salary

jobs.title: Pump Service Engineer
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Sulzer is looking for a skilled Pump Service Engineer to join our Birmingham Service Centre, supporting the overhaul, repair and testing of critical pumping equipment for customers across the water, energy, industrial and infrastructure sectors.

This is primarily a workshop-based role, working within our state-of-the-art facility alongside experienced engineers and technicians. However, flexibility is essential, as you'll also support customers on-site with inspections, fault finding, maintenance and emergency breakdown activities when required. What You'll Be Doing

• Dismantling, inspecting, repairing and rebuilding a wide range of pumps and rotating equipment

• Diagnosing faults and recommending repair solutions

• Conducting performance testing and quality inspections

• Producing accurate service reports and technical documentation

• Supporting site activities including maintenance, installation, commissioning and breakdown response

• Working safely and professionally at customer locations across the UK when required

What We're Looking For

• Experience servicing, repairing or overhauling pumps and rotating equipment

• Strong mechanical engineering and fault-finding skills

• Ability to interpret engineering drawings and technical documentation

• A flexible approach, with willingness to undertake site work and travel when required

• Commitment to quality, safety and customer service

Why Join Sulzer?

Based at our Birmingham Service Centre, you'll work from one of the most advanced facilities of its kind in the UK. Opened in 2021 following significant investment, our 82,000 sq ft Centre of Excellence has been designed around lean manufacturing principles and equipped with advanced machining technologies, digital inspection systems and state-of-the-art additive manufacturing capabilities.
Operating 24/7, the facility delivers world-class maintenance, repair and overhaul solutions for pumps, motors, generators, compressors, turbines and other critical rotating equipment, supporting some of the UK's most important industries.

Hours of work:
Monday - Thursday : 07:00 - 15:45
Friday : 07:00 - 14:30

What we offer you

• A competitive basic salary

• Company-wide bonus scheme

• Paid overtime opportunities

• 33 days annual leave.

• Defined pension contributions.

• Access to Medicash helping you cover everyday health costs like dental optical and physiotherapy plus a range of wellbeing perks.

• Confidential support via Employee Assistance Programmes.

• Access to discounts on shopping entertainment lifestyle plus opportunity to apply for Costco membership.

• Discounted personal car leasing for you your family and friends.

• Long Service Awards celebrating your commitment.

jobs.title: Environmental & Energy Compliance Manager
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

At Sulzer, innovation has been at the heart of everything we do for nearly 200 years. As a global leader in fluid engineering and rotating equipment services, we design, manufacture and maintain critical pumps, agitators, compressors, motors, generators and turbomachinery that keep essential industries moving. From water and wastewater treatment to energy, chemicals, power generation and industrial manufacturing, our technologies help customers improve efficiency, reliability and sustainability across their operations.

We are now creating a new role that will help shape the future of environmental compliance and energy performance across our UK & Ireland business. This is an exciting opportunity for an experienced Environmental professional to develop and drive a strategic environmental agenda across multiple manufacturing and service locations, ensuring compliance excellence while supporting Sulzer's sustainability ambitions. What You'll Do

• Manage and continuously improve Sulzer's ISO 14001 Environmental Management System across UK & Ireland sites.

• Ensure compliance with environmental legislation, permits and regulatory requirements.

• Help shape and deliver environmental and energy initiatives that support Sulzer's sustainability ambitions.

• Conduct audits, assessments and compliance reviews across multiple locations.

• Monitor environmental and energy performance, identifying opportunities for improvement.

• Support carbon reduction, waste minimisation and resource-efficiency projects.

• Investigate environmental incidents and drive corrective actions.

• Partner with site teams, operational leaders and external bodies to embed best practice.

• Keep the business informed of emerging environmental legislation and compliance requirements.

What We're Looking For

• Experience in environmental compliance within manufacturing, engineering or industrial environments.

• Strong knowledge of UK environmental legislation and management systems.

• Proven experience managing or supporting ISO 14001.

• ISEP membership (or working towards it).

• Excellent communication and stakeholder engagement skills.

• The confidence to challenge, influence and drive improvements across multiple sites.

• A proactive mindset and passion for sustainability.

What we offer you

Core Benefits

• A competitive basic salary

• Annual personal bonus scheme based on company and personal performance

• Private Medical Insurance

• 33 days annual leave.

• Defined pension contributions.

• Access to Medicash helping you cover everyday health costs like dental optical and physiotherapy plus a range of wellbeing perks.

• Confidential support via Employee Assistance Programmes.

• Access to discounts on shopping entertainment lifestyle plus opportunity to apply for Costco membership.

• Discounted personal car leasing for you your family and friends.

• Long Service Awards celebrating your commitment.

• Continuous learning opportunities through Sulzer Learning Pathways.

• As a Silver Award holder of the MoD Defence Employer Recognition Scheme, we welcome and support veterans, reservists and Cadet Adult Volunteers with policies for training, camps and deployment, plus a growing internal military network.

We’ve recently invested significantly in modernising our Leeds facility — creating a brighter, more efficient, and more advanced workspace designed to support high‑quality work and a great employee experience. Alongside our upgraded facilities, you’ll benefit from:

• Free, secure parking with EV charging

• Multi-faith prayer room

• Newly modernised work areas

• Lively Sports & Social Club with events & prize draws

• 24/7 onsite gym

• Subsidised vending machines

• Subsidised Canteen offering hot and cold food

jobs.title: Master Scheduler/Production Planner- Spare Parts
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
Acts as primary factory contact for Sales and Customer Service on all matters related to new Spare part & Accessory orders. Responsible for determining and communicating lead-times for new orders with the goal of ensuring they will be on time. Overall Spare part & Accessory Backlog management will be another vital task in ensuring orders continuously go out on time with competitive lead times while minimizing overdues. Essential Functions

• Responsible for following Sulzer's program.

• Provides accurate lead times for new Spare Part & Accessory orders.

• Create and maintain a Master Backlog Schedule for the Easley Factory with the intent of ensuring orders go out on time and overdues are minimized.

• Maintains a 6-week rolling plan with a clear display of how each order is tracking within that timeframe.

• Able to collaborate in a cross functional setting to obtain information in a timely and organized manner.

• Organized and able to display daily/weekly clear updates to the Planning Manager.

• Proactively communicates with Sales in matters related to upcoming orders.

• Acts as backup to coworkers in the Planning Department.

Secondary Responsibilities

• The Planning Department also includes Pump scheduling so future cross-training will be required

Supervisory Responsibilities

• None

Qualifications

• Proficiency with Microsoft Office products required.

• Proficiency in SAP ERP preferred.

• Clear and articulate written and verbal communication skills required.

• Able to analyze, organize and execute plans for large amounts of data.

• Proficient with BI software.

• Must possess excellent time management, problem solving, interpersonal and organizational skills

What we offer you

• Competitive Paid Time Off

• 12 Company Paid Holidays per year

• Medical, dental, and vision insurance

• Company paid short term and long term disability

• 6% 401K or Roth match with immediate vesting

• Company Paid Retirement Security Contributions upon one year of employment

• Quarterly Gym Reimbursement

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

• Responsible for following Sulzer's program.

• Provides accurate lead times for new Spare Part & Accessory orders.

• Create and maintain a Master Backlog Schedule for the Easley Factory with the intent of ensuring orders go out on time and overdues are minimized.

• Maintains a 6-week rolling plan with a clear display of how each order is tracking within that timeframe.

• Able to collaborate in a cross functional setting to obtain information in a timely and organized manner.

• Organized and able to display daily/weekly clear updates to the Planning Manager.

• Proactively communicates with Sales in matters related to upcoming orders.

• Acts as backup to coworkers in the Planning Department.

Secondary Responsibilities

• The Planning Department also includes Pump scheduling so future cross-training will be required

Supervisory Responsibilities

Qualifications

• Proficiency with Microsoft Office products required.

• Proficiency in SAP ERP preferred.

• Clear and articulate written and verbal communication skills required.

• Able to analyze, organize and execute plans for large amounts of data.

• Proficient with BI software.

jobs.title: Head of Strategic Growth - Services EUA

titleByLocale.en: Head of Strategic Growth - Services EUA

jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

As Head of Strategic Growth - Services, Europe & Africa, you will play a critical leadership role in driving Sulzer Services' strategic agenda across the region. Reporting directly to the Regional President, Europe & Africa, and working closely with the Regional Leadership Team, you will lead the development, execution and governance of high-impact strategic initiatives that support sustainable growth, operational excellence and long-term value creation.

Acting as a trusted partner to the Regional President and senior leaders, you will translate strategic priorities into actionable programmes, oversee mission-critical business projects, and ensure alignment between regional objectives and the broader Services Division strategy. This highly visible role offers significant exposure to executive stakeholders and the opportunity to influence the future direction of the Europe & Africa business.

The successful candidate can be based at any of our Services sites across Europe & Africa, with international travel required to support business and project needs.

Your Main Tasks and Responsibilities

• Serve as a key strategic advisor to the Regional President and Europe & Africa Leadership Team, supporting the development, prioritisation and execution of the regional strategic agenda.

• Lead the implementation of divisional and corporate strategy across Europe & Africa, ensuring effective deployment, governance and tracking of strategic initiatives, objectives and key performance indicators.

• Drive critical growth and transformation projects across the region, including business expansion, market development, operational excellence programmes, organisational effectiveness initiatives, partnerships and other strategic business priorities.

• Lead and coordinate a regional team of Strategic Projects, Transformation and Operational Excellence resources, with indirect and matrix leadership responsibility across Europe & Africa. Drive alignment of priorities, capability development, resource deployment and collaboration across functions and geographies, ensuring strategic initiatives are delivered effectively and generate measurable business impact.

• Prepare executive-level presentations, reports and business cases for regional and divisional leadership, providing clear insights and recommendations to support decision-making.

• Lead and coordinate the regional mergers and acquisitions agenda, working closely with the Global M&A team to identify opportunities, develop investment cases, support transaction execution and drive successful post-acquisition integration activities.

To Succeed in This Role, You Will Need

• Significant experience in strategic leadership, business transformation, corporate strategy, management consulting or operational leadership roles within an industrial or engineering environment.

• Proven experience leading complex, cross-functional programmes and delivering business-critical initiatives across multiple countries and stakeholders.

• Strong commercial and business acumen with the ability to evaluate growth opportunities and develop strategic recommendations.

• Experience supporting mergers, acquisitions, partnerships or broader corporate development activities is highly desirable.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities, with the ability to translate data and insights into actionable business strategies.

• Demonstrated ability to influence and engage senior executives and leadership teams within a matrix organisation.

• Exceptional stakeholder management, communication and presentation skills.

• A strategic mindset combined with a hands-on approach to execution and delivery.

• Proven ability to manage multiple priorities, navigate ambiguity and deliver results t

jobs.title: IT Expert
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The IT Lead Analyst is responsible for analyzing business requirements and translating them into IT solutions. This role supports system development, testing, and implementation, ensuring that IT services meet business needs. This job profile is intended for experienced professionals who apply practical knowledge of a job area and work independently with general supervision. Actividades a realizar:

• Crear y mantener redes virtuales y físicas, documentando su objetivo, configuración, seguridad, mejoras proyectadas y todo aquello que contribuya a su entendimiento y operación por otro colega del área.
• Programación de switches a nivel comando para definir redes segmentadas.
• Realizar revisiones constantes de las redes para mejorar su velocidad, calidad de señal, detectar posibles problemas futuros, llevando una estadística de su operación.
• Adicionar componentes que la compañía determine instalar sobre las redes, estudiar y documentarlos.
• Sobre las redes y sus componentes principales, realizar análisis de fallos y documentar los hallazgos. Esto incluye switches, firewalls, Proxy’s, Access point, equipos de voz, video, seguridad, controladoras de tráfico, Wireless y todo componente de comunicación y control de redes.
• Crear y mantener paneles de comportamiento de los equipos en la red, e implementar los protocolos de reacción ante cualquier incidente o requerimiento.
• Apoyo al equipo global de IT y a cualquier entidad legal que requiera de su apoyo en forma local o remota en temas de redes.

Experiencia requerida:

• Programación de switches cisco, creación y manejo de Vlans

• Instalación de sistemas operativos en equipo de cómputo, especialmente servidores.

• Administración de servidores virtuales y sincronización de replicas. (deseable)

• Administración de servicios de redes tales como DHCP; DNS’s, DC’s, Proxy, Firewalls.

• Mantenimiento de equipo activo y pasivo de redes.

• Atención de usuarios.

• Manejo de calendarios de mantenimientos

• Manejo de cableados de voz y datos estructurados

• Uso de sistemas de respaldo, antivirus y anti spam

• Diagnóstico de fallas en equipo de cómputo y periféricos

Requisitos:

• Licenciatura Informatica o afín

• 3 años de experiencia en adelante en administración de redes

• Inglés avanzado

• Soporte a atención a usuarios

• Experiencia gestionando proyectos de IT

• Haber laborado con equipos globales

What we offer you

Ofrecemos:

• Salario competitivo acorde a experiencia

• Vales de despensa

• Seguro de Gastos médicos mayores

• Fondo de ahorro

• Aguinaldo superior a la ley

• Prestaciones superiores

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.
